text:
Worst place I've ever visited. The bouncer was rude and he didn't have to be. This place thinks just cause your on broadway you can treat people bad and over charge. 
 I'm not a tourist I live here and will never visit or recommend

It was great. The your was interesting if you're in to tours. The beer was good. The atmosphere was the best part. A couple of Tvs for sports, board games, live music, and yours every hours. At times it seems like there's a lot going on but it flowed well. Great spot for a good time with friends or a date.

Terrible establishment.  Poor service. The bouncers do not have any restraint. If you are female they will grab you aggressivley. ..very hostile. I have had a few terrible experiences there and I share them with everyone I meet so they know what they are getting into when they go there. Don't waste your time or your money when Nashville has so many other awesome places to offer!

Ordered their chicken fajita and fish chips. 
Chicken was really good, fish and chips not so much. Portions sizes were too little, for the price I would expect a little more. Drinks were alright.

Three stars is pretty much on the money. I don't understand a Margaritaville in Nashville but I also am probably not the actual target demographic of these places...see: my dad who sometimes makes me think he can't find anything else on his XM radio other than Margaritaville. 

So we've of course been to the one in the Caymans and on Key West. Since clearly these are out of the way places, I didn't get in the way of my parents having their experience here. 

I was kind of hoping to avoid listening to music...or at least if I was going to have to listen to covers, NOT "Call Me Maybe" gone country. It's somewhat loud in here and I imagine as the night goes on it's louder. We were here prior to a hockey game but it was still pretty busy. 

Since I procured my family a free app coupon I decided I was worthy of the 5 o'clock somewhere which is a take on a Hurricane, which somehow in five years of legal drinking I have never had before. It wasn't bad. I imagine it's one of those things where you're like "oh this barely tastes like alcohol, I'll have another" and then suddenly you're hitting on someone you shouldn't be hitting on. Wait what.

For that free app, we had the spinach artichoke dip. It wasn't bad, I certainly wouldn't have let anyone pay full price for it though. 

I wasn't feeling like having a full on sandwich or anything but there aren't really any smaller sized options. I guess a cup of soup but I had had soup for lunch and it was like obscenely hot for December so that was out of the question. I decided to just get the chicken quesadilla app and if I didn't finish it then whatever. The rest of my family had burgers or a chicken sandwich. The burgers were liked all around, although my brother got the diablo one and complained that it wasn't spicy enough. But I don't think he understands that poblanos aren't that hot.

The quesadilla wasn't bad, there were some spots though where the chicken was a bit tough. Nothing you can't fix with a good bit of salsa though. 

Even though like I said it was pretty busy, we were there only about an hour. Service was great. Would I come back on my own? Probably not. In my case it's really one of those places where once is enough for the experience but if I were asked to come again, I wouldn't say no.

Awesome place on Broadway in Nashville.  Music was better than most great entertainment.  Had deep fried chicken was tasty once you get past the breading.  Only first floor was open with a 15 minute waiting time.

I've now been to Margaritaville in Nashville and the Bahamas. I enjoyed both places (even though the menu could use some refreshing from time to time.

The only reason I didn't mark this as four stars?

I don't know where they buy the shirts they sell, but the one from the Bahamas had a hole in the back within two months, and the one from Nashville I noticed before washing it the first time.

For the money I spent on it, I wasn't happy with it.

But the spirits were great!

As avid brewery connoisseurs and current Nashville locals, we were extremely and pleasantly surprised with our experience at Tennessee Brew Works this evening.

 It was a dreary, rainy night and as we pulled up we were fairly apprehensive about the string of dark warehouses and quiet alleys. It all changed quickly as we walked into the "Tennessee Fill Station" (or some name similar) portion of the building. The fellas working there directed us to the "Tennessee Tap Room" (or some name similar) portion of the building that overlooked 2 stories into the "Tennessee Brew Works" (or some name similar) portion of the building where the brewing takes place. I've added the specifics because this is the first group audacious and clever enough to pull off all three portions under one roof.... and to still comply with Tennessee's archaic liquor laws! If sticking it to the man isn't enough reason for you to check it out.... keep reading. 

The tap room is super neat and cleverly laid out with patios, long & community-oriented tables, a flying bridge or "catwalk" and a steady stream of live, local music. It's largely non-smoking (which is enough to convince me to cross the bridge from East Nashville) and has a few TVs to cater to the football crowds. 

Biggest fortes:

- The staff is amazing. The smiles and enthusiasm when they start talking about their beer are a sweet relief. They're excited! They're adventurous! They aren't pretentious. Real People.
- The beers are fresh & different. They keep it local. They aren't afraid to venture from the norm. They add their own zing and flair.... and for that, I respect them.
- They appreciate the food & beer pairing concept. They're bringing in great food to compliment their brews. It's a movement.

If you've managed to read all of that rambling- you can ignore any other reviews and just go ahead and get there.

$1 PBRs until 6pm - can't  beat that plus live music! Very talented artists playing. The bar reminds me of a local joint, although it's in the middle of broadway. No cover, great to to stop in during late afternoon. Will update if I get a chance to come at night!

We shared the volcano nachos and they were pretty tasty. My son got wings and he enjoyed them. We had to sit upstairs and it kinda took away from the scene. I would have rather been downstairs with the live music. I enjoyed the Margarita flight and it did not disappoint.
I walked in to an amazing set by an all-female bluegrass outfit (with the owner, Layla, on drums) and soon the talent segued into a tears-in-your-beer and honky-tonking country four-piece.

Didn't know that this was Blake Sheldon's place. We here for a private party.  The place was beautiful. Love the flow of the chair set up, bar, and stage. Place was also clean and their food was delicious. We had biscuits, mash potatoes, fried chicken, pull pork, Mac and cheese, Brussels Sprouts, and some salad stuff and all were delicious. I love their fried chicken; crispy and crunchy. This place was lively and groovy.  I also loved their live camera and great lighting and sound system.

I'm not much of a fan of modern mainstream country music but I like a lot of older stuff and love the blues. The band that was playing here today was perfect for me banging out a mix of electric blues, southern rock, bluegrass and everything in between. Assuming this is the type of band that normally plays here (and the vibe and decor here tells me it is) this would be a great spot in Nashville for those more into outlaw/alt country. Only bummer is that the beer and alcohol selection is a bit Spartan and generic; I asked for a local whiskey and was told all they had was Jack Daniels or one called Old Hickory (which is what I went with). Apparently they only have bottles for beer and it looks like only bud or corona.

Went to two different party's this week at ole Reds first upstairs private party the food very good service was even better. Everyone had a great time. 
Second party even bigger our hosts rented the whole restaurant for a private party. Again the food was fabulous service was perfect. 
The problem was a more personal issue. There was a group of us from Bakersfield enjoying the food and service while listening to the band who were taking requests so I got up with a $20.00 dollar bill in hand and made a request for anything from Merle Haggard . Returned to our table and waited and waited.  It became clear the leader of the band preferred more current song choices not old forgotten Country Music legends. 
Being from Bakersfield it would have meant a lot to us. The band was good but lack of respect to take a tip and dishonor Country legend all in the same night is shameful. One song any song ??

The worst!!! We waited in line for 2 hours while they let ppl cut in front of us...when we finally get in...order drinks and food it takes 23 min to get our food..nachos....all bottom of the barrel chips...server says NOTHING!!! ...and still no 2 beers and a marg....never come...I do this for a living...there is no excuse for food to beat drinks...if this is happening the MOD on duty is NOT doing their job helping and backing up the staff....drinks come..we order shots....wrong shots came out not what we ordered...then we get charged for 6 shots!!! Sorry wrong again.... Nothing to fix the problem...then give us the wrong bill!!! We pay bill because obviously we are not here for customer service...and it's a few dollars cheaper...don't think we would have gotten much better. Surprising how a establishment can treat their guests this way and expect them to come back....wait it's a tourist spot so why would they care. Seriously you couldn't last on your guest services...good thing your a "TRAP" makes me wonder if our "stellar" service is because of poor management and training. Good luck..hate to think a big corporate restaurant like you can take out honest wholesome business with good service and honest and integrity. Never again

We were excited about the fun vibe and great music in a laid back atmosphere on Broadway! Bartender was not friendly--yelling at customers and not real accommodating. Had to leave to enjoy our laid back vibe elsewhere.

Ordered burger and wings. My husband and I split them great portions to split. Best burger we ever had! Made with short ribs. The wings were great.  The sauce was excellent little sweet and a little spicy.  Oh yeah the beer very good. Excellent service order at the bar and they serve you. All round great service.

Food is awesome; better than you find in most restaurants.  
The beer is spot on as well.  My only complaint about the beer is that you can't always get growlers filled if the beer is a limited edition. 
Location is okay, construction all over the place so parking is limited.
Great atmosphere and wait staff.

Sat in open seating at the bar, purposefully picking a table near the large open window at the front of the restaurant. I came with my mother and we were looking for drinks and a quick bite to eat. We ended up going with the margarita flight and a quesadilla. The margaritas were amazing and the quesadilla was delicious. We ended up getting a second flight of margaritas because we couldn't settle on just one from the selection. Our waitress was sweet and attentive. She had a lot of recommendations both for drinks at Margaritaville and other places on the strip. Live music arrived about 20 minutes after we had and had a good sound and playful interactions with those in the bar. Our bill was approximately $50, which initially was shocking but I left happy, full, and feeling good from my drinks so it was worth it. Overall a nice experience; good drinks, food, and environment.

It is not too many arenas and stadiums across the world that I land as a five stars.  It really is a lot that has to work in making this happen.  The first but probably most important reason why a stadium or arena gets a five star review is due to accessibility to it.  What I love about Bridgestone Arena is it knocks it out the park with accessibility.  Meaning, you can drive to the nearby garage to park there. You can park for free at Nissan Stadium (formerly known as LP Field)  and walk across the Pedestrian bridge (10 min walk) right to the arena.  And you have the bright lights of Broadway where the arena is on.  So before the game or after the game, you have a surplus of sports bars, live music venues and barbeque joints to check out before, during or around the game.  IT WORKS!  All what I have said is before talking about the arena itself.  I'm sure the concerts here are great.   The hockey games here is a great watch.  Seats are decent but getting in and out, the concourse, the food venues..all good with me.

Grade: A++

We just had a drink and dessert here. My husband had the fried pie. It was apple. He said it was too much like Mickey D's....and that it needed  some cinnamon. I had the ice cream sandwich which was a sugar cookie with vanilla ice cream and marshmallows. It was good.

Great food good times if your looking  for a great time this is the place hands down the staff are professional and always taking care of their customers tell unsweetened tea comes in a huge glass and the food comes in huge portions the customers are nice and will hold a great conversation with you as well.

This is a fun little bar that seems like it might be the kind of place to really let loose. I wasn't really in a karaoke kind of mood, but it was fun hearing those brave souls step up to the mike and give it their all. Props to the strong drinks!

2nd night in Nashville we wanted something a little different and not so touristy honky tonk of broadway. We heard midtown is the spot. This place is like a dive bar you would see in a college town. Everyone is fairly young, well alot younger then broadway. Love how they have karaoke here. The vibe is fun, very laid back. In the battle between Winners and Losers (the bar next door) this place deff wins!

This was probably the most dive type bar we visited this past weekend for our girls trip in Nashville but I tend to like smaller bars so I really enjoyed my time! 

We stayed downstairs because 1. we wanted to hear the extremely talented band & 2. because upstairs felt about 20 degrees hotter. But overall the experience was very fun & relaxed.

The only suggestion would be to go with a smaller group because it felt smaller than the other bars we had been visiting so it was hard to find a spot for all 9 of us.

Wow! Great new addition to Broadway. The venue is amazing. Ate at the rooftop Lookout. Ordered almost half the menu between the five of us. Love the small plate concept, got to try and share so much. Cocktails are fabulous. Prices are extremely reasonable, especially for the quality. Service is spot on. Can't wait to go back and try the rest of the menu.
Awesome spot and off the beaten touristy path in Nashville. Will be my first stop when I come back to visit
Great food, drinks, and service!!! Thank you to our server Madison! We had an awesome experience!

My experience at Tennessee Brew Works was noteworthy! I tried the beer flight so that I could sample all the yummy brews they have to offer. I really enjoyed them all but my favorite was their Witt! We sat outside on their patio on a sunny day. The atmosphere was super relaxed- it really made for the perfect afternoon. The live music was also a huge plus.

We didn't sample their food this time, but it looked SO delicious, and will definitely try it next time. I highly recommend Tennessee Brew Works for a fun afternoon with friends or family! I'm already looking for an opportunity to go back.
We didn't eat here but all the food on the plates looked very good and had big servings, we just stopped in the check out the store and use the restrooms.

Probably an amazing bar- I typically LOVE Margaritaville bars, but the security guard here was SO rude and SO disrespectful, even to those doing exactly what he asked. He put a huge damper on the day and the fun of the event. I'm so disappointed that the bar staff was so unreceptive to feedback from customers.
Jazmine Sullivan concert. She is singing her heart out. She's great the venue does not have good acoustics

Winner's is hands down my favorite place to karaoke in Nashville.

While there are some aspiring country music singers scattered throughout, I feel more comfortable singing my random crazy songs here with a group of friends. A lot of downtown karaoke bars are 80% amazing singers, 20% random drunk people. I like that I don't feel that I'm the only bad singer out there when I visit Winner's! 

Plus, you never know who you will run into at Winner's. One night a random dude came in and sang "Friends in Low Places" with someone from our group who was on stage; it turns out the guy is a well known songwriter in Nashville, and he WROTE that song. Wow.

The prices are reasonable and you are sure to meet some new friends! Plus I love the patio out front and the randomness that ensues! 

Note: karaoke is only on Friday and Saturdays :)

Shane was the best !! We will definitely come back for him. Came in for a bachelorette and he was attentive, funny and helpful on suggesting fun places around the city to check out. We feel lucky having him !

I haven't been this disappointed in a restaurant for a very long time. Ole Red's is a burger and beer joint. My burger came in undercooked and wasn't really very flavorful. My wife made the same statement, "We waited for this??!" I tried the Nashvillian burger and she had the Ole Red burger.  Neither is anything special. Service was extremely average for 4:30 on a Saturday without a big crowd.  I gave it 2 stars because the apps were good and it's a cool location. Go here if you want to say you've been to Blake Shelton's restaurant. His music is a lot better than his restaurants food.

5 stars for the consistently good music & experience that is Layla's. Wife & I were having a beverage at the bar and struck up a conversation with the patron next to us - turned out to be Layla herself!Lovely lady who generously chatted with us. & bought us a round. Never know who 'a sitting next to ya!
Food and drinks were really good! Service wasn't! At one point we couldn't find our server. But the live music was really good! If our server wasn't MIA we would have stayed the whole night!

Had a wonderful night with husband and 2 of our kids at Cirque de la Symphonie with the Nashville Symphony. An amazing show! This is a great, comfortable concert hall. We sat in a Founders box and it was very comfortable with great views. We have come for different concerts here and they are always very enjoyable.

Stopped in here while on a quick trip to Nashville! Very instagram-worth spot with cool sofas and fun decor. We had the pickle flight and nachos, along with several cocktails. Nachos were so good--made with homemade potato chips?!? Take me back!
Prettay prettay pretty good.  Nice outdoor area and the craft beer is great.  Staff is nice.

Atmosphere was top notch.
Beer was decent.
Kid friendly, modern decor, outdoor seating, kid-friendly.

Wow ... impressed. Super yummy food with huge portions. Homemade Tater Tots and great pickles. Pulled pork has a thicker smoke flavor, but good. Grits had great texture, well made. Everything was fantastic ... come with a huge appetite. I ate maybe 1/3 of my lunch, but couldn't take it as we are bar hopping. I told the server I cut it in 1/2 and to eat it. Lol

Very cool establishment... great music !
Good beer and good food! Fish tacos were great. Large seating area in and out. Bit of a walk from dwntwn but worthwhile.

The food, service, atmosphere was amazing. We came here for my girlfriends 21st birthday and it was simply incredible. Live music, great staff, and great food. Everyone in here is having a great time. Would definitely recommend this for others

If you are looking to go somewhere where customer service is not a priority, this is your place. Extremely rude and unprofessional waitresses. Every other place on Broadway had accommodating waitstaff. Highly disappointed in the lack of training that seems to be happening in a place that has potential.
Make sure you pee before the end of the game. They close bathrooms after the hockey game.

Yummy yummy yummy is all I can say! I've come here for drinks before, but tonight I decided to order dinner, and I wasn't disappointed! My caprese burger was juicy, flavorful, and absolutely delicious, the nachos were delightful, and the frozen strawberry margarita made me a happy girl!! The crowd of people dining in were pleasant, and everyone was thoroughly enjoying the live music up front, the decor was lively and colorful which just tied up my experience with a shiny bow! Not a single complaint, just a fun dinner out!
I had some crap dip as an appetizer, it is delicious and later on my server told me that I had picked the best appetizer on the menu. Check it out guys. It's worth it

Getting a table here was a little difficult. There was no wait but the servers couldn't decide where to put us so we ended up just going to the bar area. Kiersten took great care of us. Came here to take my friend for his first marg! Prob will just sit at the bar from now on, they seem very attentive and friendly.

This establishment is truly the worst. (And I'm not just saying this to fit in with the 50 other 1-star reviews.)

For starters, the owner is an absolute jerk off who has no problem getting wasted in the bar and kicking you out if you disagree with him. I've seen it happen at least twice. They should bite the bullet and place a sign over the door stating that differing opinions are not welcome. 

I've also been privy to him taking advantage of drunk people and telling the bartender to add drinks to the tab that weren't ordered or that were "on the house" for other people. 

Then there is the "manager." I can't count how many times I've seen him berate paying customers, get into loud, heated arguments, and throw people out. 

And let's not forget the aforementioned bottled water debacle. 

I'm not sure how or why this place stays open through Nashville's boom. I would come fairly regularly for a while to give it a chance but I eventuslly couldn't do it anymore. 

I certainly hope this is not the impression of Tennesseans tourists leave with.

My 8 girlfriends & I decided on Margaritaville on a Thursday night around 6pm because the menu looked like there was something for everyone. (2 vegetarians, 2 who loved seafood, all of us who love tequila etc.).

We put our name in for a table & it was ready in under 10 minutes which went by so fast because we sat outside & enjoyed the live music playing. Our waitress was phenomenal, 9 hungry & thirsty girls seemed like a breeze for her. We let her know right away we wanted separate checks & she had no problem with that at all while many restaurants make you feel extremely guilty for asking. 

I ordered the veggie burger with fries which was good but I have had better. My margarita however was one of the bests I've ever had but I can't remember the name.

Service was excellent & ticket times were running quick for it being so very busy. While it was pricey for me, ($30 including tip), I would still recommend this restaurant.

The Margaritas were yummy!  And I have never liked Margaritas. Lol. My mom had the regular on the rocks and I had Mango over Paris which consisted of peach snapps, tequila and mango pieces small enough to fit through the straw right into my mouth. Ingenious!!  They were $7.50 and $9.25 roughly each. Well worth it especially since they had a country guitar player there playing older songs. Fun time!

Went here for dinner and ordered a hamburger. It took almost an hour (or at least it felt like it) to get our food. And it was a Tuesday night.

I ordered the Cheeseburger in Paradise." So for $12.99 you get a cheeseburger with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, sliced (not the little circles) pickles, their secret sauce with a side of fries. The hamburger was pretty bland - I don't know how to describe it, but I felt like I was just eating a piece of meat with bread and some toppings. The fries weren't any better - they were about the thickness you'd get at a fast food joint, but they were too crunchy.

Would I go there again? Probably not. It wasn't bad by any means, but for the time it took to cook the food, the underwhelming nature of the food, and the prices I will try something else next time I'm in Nashville.

Sorry we cannot rate NO STARS...made reservation 24 hrs in advance with Open Table app...arrived for dinner 15 minutes early only to find restaurant was "closed for private party"...staff member who was not at all sympathetic told has they tried to call everyone that morning...had no missed calls on phone or message from Open Table app...never again Ole Red...Big Blake really disappointed us.

Server was super friendly and nice but after putting in our order, we never saw him for over 30 mins. He came to tell us our food would be out shortly,  that meant another 30 mins, yes it took over an hour for our food to show up. Even then we had to get someone else to bring us forks and napkins, no one even found us knives. Dry chicken in a southwest salad, bland quesadilla,  very average burger but all at higher prices than normal. Asked for hot sauce and server came to table 3 times and made excuses each time of why he did not have with him. He was a trainer and taking care of other servers was more important than taking care of his own customers. Terrible service, bad food,  high prices, i think Jimmy himself would be embarrassed with this place, will never be visiting this chain again just because of this experience.

When in a city where there's a Margaritaville, one must stop and soak in the atmosphere.

You can hear the live entertainment wherever you might be in the establishment.  The staff is super nice, and really ready to make your visit memorable.  I had picked up a shirt and one of the associates told me a story that involved one of the best country singers (Toby Keith) and how he related to the saying on the shirt.  It was awesome to the connection.

It never surprises me that each location has its own unique merchandise items to call their own.  Who doesn't want a sign that says, "I'm the woman to blame" ?

The food is good, but the margaritas are better.
I love the Predators, I love the atmosphere, I have always had great experience with staff, lots of clean facilities and lots of food options.

Karaoke is wonderful!!!!! They need more women's restrooms. One stall is not enough to have the traffic they have. It's quite ridiculous!!! Have respect for the customers you serve!! Close your doors if you can't renovate!

Did a tour here! Pretty regular tour. Guy was super nice and funny in a weird quirky way. One beer is included! Great spot and has great food! Tried the wings and the butternut squash hummus which is incredible! Definitely check this place out! But low key kinda hard to find.
Great place, friendly staff had a great time and the Rische family band was super, and this from a hard rock, heavy metal guy.

Caught Odesza at Marathon on March 13, 2015... Sorry for the late review:) Awesome show! The building itself has an industrial feel, very much like a refined Buster's (Lexington, KY) I was surprised to find it was 18+ and on the edge of a residential neighborhood. The show had to end fairly early to comply with a noise ordnance (at least that's what we were told) I heard several people complaining as we were leaving but I didn't think it was a big deal. The ladies room was clean and had an attendant (and a tip jar) which is fine, but slightly out of step with a venue trying so hard for that unpolished look. Security was a little over the top for such a small show. The guys at the door were actually sticking their hands in guys' pockets... Anyway, it's a nice venue with decent acoustics. Worth the drive - I would go again.

Oh Bridgestone, how I love thee. Yes the beer is pricey and the food can be kinda boring but it's an arena! I've attended multiples concerts (Barry Mainlow, Miranda Lambert, Blake Shelton), countless Preds games and even the circus here. Tickets for most events are decently priced and most seating is very good. Preds games always have a good selection of alcohol (beer and liquor depending on the stand you go to) and they've added a lot of different food options within the last couple of years. I'm looking forward to seeing the George Jones tribute concert in November as well as George Strait in March!

This is now my 2nd venue I've visited to see the Blues play and I was very impressed with everything.

We arrived early so we could get a feel for the place and see all the pregame activities.  They had a lot of tents set up outside for the various Nashville companies and they did their security checks outside as well.  Once on the grounds, the Preds Entertainment Team had a "Gold Rush" set up where if you were dressed in your team gear, you got to go through while they cheered you on.  Very neat, but they did not welcome the other team's fans through.

Inside the arena, we were in awe at how neat it was set up and how clean it was.  The prices of the items did not shock me as it is the same price as our hometown arena.  They had a lot of family activities, photobooth included, set up for the night.

The game itself was great, they have a lot of great umph that makes the game.  I mean who doesn't like to hear Tim McGraw's voice when the Preds score...however since the Blues won, you didn't hear it very much!

Tickets are not bad priced, check Stubhub for the best ones.

I recommend parking in the Library garage, its up 2 blocks from the arena, easy in and out and won't break the bank.
Cool lunch on a very hot day.  Loved the selection of specialty drinks, and the island decor.  I had a burger here and it really hit the spot.

Came here to try the beers and to get some dinner. The food here is amazing!  I would come here even if I didn't like beer!  We got the fish tacos and the burger. The fish tacos were very good and slightly sweet. Very similar to other ones I have had previously but definitely worth getting. The burger is fabulous. The meat was cooked perfectly - very juicy and messy!  I'm glad they didn't ask us how we wanted it cooked because we might have ruined it by getting it done too 'well.'   We got a flight of beer and the Vintage cider. The Vintage cider tastes a lot like apple juice so great if you have a non-beer drinker in your group. Wish I lived nearby so I could come here on a regular basis.

Wasn't impressed, yes it was a Sat night, yes the NHL playoffs were across the street so I expected a wait.  Only waited about 15 min for a table....then came the real wait and I couldn't say it was the waitress' fault she was attentive and sweet but she had nothing to give us, drinks weren't coming out fast enough food was ready.  Disappointed in the prices too, 2 dinners and app $68 no sodas no liquors....just another chain

We took a family member who came from Boston, MA & we had a fantastic Bartender who was pleasant & on top of all guests at the bar!  Drinks were great, great entertainment & definitely a place we will visit again!!!  Loved the License Plates on the ceiling. And when we do return we will be bringing a License Plate to add to the collection!

The $10 sampler was good.  Only one out of the five beers I didn't like.  It was the Country Roots Stout, which I am not a fan of stouts.  Others may live it.  I tried the Five Beer Burger and not the best I ever had.  They should not try do hard to come up with a different burger and just stick to the classic burger.  I just felt they were trying to hard to be different and it is not necessary.  Less is better in my opinion.  The BBQ chips were amazing.  Overall, I had a nice experience.  I would come back for the beer but not the food
.

I would give the the atmosphere 4.5 stars - excellent serving. The live music was fun and very good. We were there on a Saturday night. The food however left something to be desired, nothing to get excited about, especially Because it wasn't cheap.
Great live music, friendly staff, good food (love the taco salad) best sweet tea around!

This place has some great beer and very friendly staff. The flight prices are great and the food is really good. I had all of the beers over two flights and the fish tacos. The great thing about their beer is it doesn't have the same after taste like so many places these days.
The Bridgestone Arena was clean and all of the staff I encountered were friendly. Nice space for our conference.

To put it as nicely as I can, everything about this meal and experience was sub par. I once stopped here for a drink on the Pedal Tavern and remember seeing a sign that boasted "best burger in Nashville!" After ordering the cheeseburger, I realized that statement was about as true as the stuff you read on Wikipedia. It was a bland burger, nothing more and nothing less. The fries were good, though. 

The service, to also put it nicely, was pretty bad. When my brother and I walked in, we didn't know if we were supposed to seat ourselves or order at the bar. So, for about 5 minutes we waited at the bar, where there were only 3 or 4 other customers, and finally the bartender came over to take our order. My brother and I, we're pretty friendly, non-pushy people. But the bartender seemed put out by every request we made. I don't think she cracked a smile the entire time we were there.

One last complaint and I swear I'll be done...I asked for a cup of water and then the bartender brought me a bottled water and charged me $2. I asked her if I could get a cup of tap water but she said they only had bottled water. Since when do restaurants literally FORCE you to pay for water?

To sum it up, save your money and appetite for somewhere with better service and better food.

I drink TN Brew Works regularly at local spots all over town. I have a real sweet spot for their ESB-- SO GOOD. Anyway my husband's mother was in town and we decided to finally check out the TN Brew Works Taproom. The location seems a little off the map but once you arrive there are no worries. The taproom was busy but we still got front row parking. The space is really beautiful and has a lot of different nooks and crannies so even when busy you don't feel like you are in a crowded loud restaurant. We sat upstairs because we saw a band setting up downstairs and wanted to be able to hear each other. Once the band started I was so impressed with the sound level. It was very pleasant and traveled all over the building without being too loud or annoying at all. It was so nice. 

Definitely, travel down to Ewing and try this place out. Perfect place to drink beer!
I enjoyed the entertainment and the food. Our waitress was excellent. I felt sorry for her, she had to walk so far. I don't think the restaurant is setup in mind of the servers.

I was disappointed with the food. The grilled chicken salad tasted like they pulled the chicken out of the freezer. Definitely not fresh. We went at 6pm with a group and couldn't hear each other talk.
I love this place. Loved it for the last 16 years and will continue to. As a native Nashvillian this is one of 2 places I will come to when I visit. Good music. Good beer. Good times.

Great, large portions of food with live music.  Margaritaville is a fun, beachy place with food ranging from fish tacos ($17) to burgers ($16.)  The music is good if  a bit loud.  Service was excellent.  You can people watch from the window tables and they angle to let in a nice breeze.  Lunch is a bit high, but that may be the area pricing as well.  Live music pours from all of the establishments along Broadway.  Nice lunch place!
Best music on Broadway, in my opinion -- you won't hear classic rock covers here!

This was one of our more memorable experience, date night for hubby and I.
Star Wars New Hope with symphony was awesome.Watching the movie and the Orchestra at the same time was so cool. If you enjoy these type of performances this is very good. The Orchestra was great, sounds were right on point,beautiful arrangement. The art of music and film was amazing to watch. Thank you Nashville Symphony 
We will return.

Came in on a Wednesday for 2-for-1. Not a lot of variety of beer which is why I gave them 4 stars. 

They had a live band which was over by the time we arrived about and hour before closing.

Parking can be difficult if your coming on a busier night. Other than that i will definitely be coming again. Great beers!!!!

Rude, surly, and unhelpful! Service was not just slow, it was HOSTILE. These people act like you are crashing a private party at their home! Not only did they not apologize for fucking up my order, they acted like I should apologize for asking them to fix it. I spend plenty of time in dive bars with "relaxed" service. But these people were not "relaxed," they were pissed at customers for being there. No wonder we were some of the only people there on a Friday night. Plus, the bathrooms are nasty (even for a bar) and the whole place REEKS of old beer. I could get better food and service at a Quick Trip, and Quick Trip will give you FREE WATER.

I had such a good time here! The band was amazing- a great mix between honky tonk and blues. It was crowded but I got a drink right away... a Jack and Coke is $7, like just about anywhere else, but silly me ordered a DOUBLE Jack and Coke and the $14 bill gave me a scare. The little bartender dumped practically a whole bottle of whiskey into my cup, so bless her heart and it was well worth the money. I got a kick out of the tourists in their khakis and polos, but I'm just a tourist too I suppose. We all clapped and danced together anyways, and this ended up being my favorite bar all weekend.

Hitting the Town? Start with something at Bridgestone Arena if an event is happening like hockey. This arena is actually really nice with a lot of great restaurants and drink choices inside at reasonable stadium prices. There is actually a bar called the Patron Platinum Club that is open to the public but, a lot of people don't realize it is accessible for everyone. What I really like about this arena is that it is literally next door to all the action on Broadway and is perfect for drunkenly stumbling starting your night on the town. Plus if you are going to a hockey game the Predators are actually pretty decent and puck bunnies are always hot.
A beautiful space that sometimes offers unique experiences. I went to see a screening of Casablanca where the orchestra performed the soundtrack live! It was incredible.

I'm really impressed with Bridgestone Arena and I like it a lot more than the YUM! Center that's here in Louisville. It's a huge venue with tons of options for beer, liquor, food and vendor souvenir shops. I came here to see the one and only Stevie Nicks, we didn't have floor seats because they were too expensive, but the seats we did have were close enough that we could see, get good pics and good video as well. 

The sound inside of the arena was loud and the acoustics were amazing. It was the escape from real life that I craved and not only did I lose my cherry to seeing one of my idols that night, but also my voice screaming (just ask Scott XD). 

The food smelled great, but we knew better than to get food at an arena because of the up sell on it, instead we had a few drinks. Honestly the beer prices weren't bad, I spent too much money, but for a 16oz craft beer from draft it was $11 and for a 25oz domestic canned beer it was also $11. All the bartenders were very knowledgeable about the products and spirits. Scott didn't think that his cocktails were worth it because we like ours strong, though. At $20 for a double is about the average for any sort of concert venue. The whole staff was extremely friendly and helpful in whatever questions we had when getting drinks, walking around or getting back to our seats. 

One of the major pluses to Bridgestone Arena is that they have a section for smokers & people who just want some fresh air to go outside and be able to re-enter at. This was excellent because between The Pretenders and Stevie Nicks there was about a 20 minute intermission that would have just been boring to sit through, so we were able to get a drink each and enjoy a cancer stick outside. 

Overall I would LOVE to see another one of my idols at Bridgestone Arena again, and soon because we weren't able to explore Nashville too much due to the next day being election day (gotta do my civic duty!), but I'm all. The. Way. Down. I'm blown away (tire pun intended) by this arena and you will be too!

Blake Shelton sure knows how to grill a good burger. My friend and I went here after a full evening of drinking and enjoyed some awesome music and delicious melt-in-your-mouth cheeseburgers. The house-made tater tots are just about the best thing you can put in your mouth then you add in a little beer cheese to dip them in and it's a life changing experience. Totally recommend this bar for food and music entertainment. 

Only con is that it is more contemporary than a true honky tonk should be in my opinion. Perhaps Blake is letting Gwen have too much say.

Also I found it ironic that the band was singing Miranda Lambert covers.

I've never had the opportunity to use the disclaimer that the only reason I gave it one star was because a no-star option was not available...until now. From the beginning the service was absolutely terrible.  When we asked for menus. The server's response was, "It's posted (inside on a chalkboard...I suggest you take a picture.."  Some food came earlier than the rest...not everyone got silverware...we were told it was in the dishwasher...bad, bad, bad...keep walking past this joint
I think one of the best things to do in Nashville is to visit Nashville Symphony! If  you get a chance go see a jazz concert,  a classical concert whatever you choose you will not be disappointed!!

We arrived before doors opened for a show and the venue bar had BOGO draft beers which was awesome. They have quick bar service and a taco stand inside in case you need a bite to eat. We went to a pretty chill show but a small group of people decided this was a punk/mosh pit kind of show. They were moshing around, throwing beer on people, falling down, etc. Security was nowhere to be found. I tried talking to security and they were not interested in hearing from patrons.  Pretty disappointing after we traveled 3 hours to attend. Aside from the vibe, the sound, service, and bars were good.

First time here, was pretty pleased. We had a group of 7, but didn't have to wait long for a table, staff very friendly. I got a chicken Caesar salad that was delicious, and more than enough! I went with our waiters suggestion of some Margherita w/o sour mix and some citrus flavor...it wasn't all that great, could've stuck with a regular and been happy. Also, two of our party's food came out late, so they comped their orders! Very accommodating and not many complaints for a chain restaurant.

We ate here on Mother's Day. (Party of 5 plus one munchkin) The restaurant was not busy by any means however our food took approx. an HOUR to arrive at our table after placing our orders. Other patrons dined and exited as we waited for our meals.  When our food finally arrived it did not include my meal. My family graciously waited until I received my food (Cuban sandwich which was very tasty, btw) before they ate and by then all of their meals were cold. Our waiter was very apologetic and swore up and down that he turned in my order with the others and blamed it on the kitchen. My sandwich ended up being comped which I felt was fair. However I was really worried about the fact that we had parked in a pay by the hour parking lot since we waited so long for our food to arrive. When we were finished with our meal we headed to the parking lot only t o find a $40.00 parking ticket. I returned to the restaurant and asked the manager if he would be so kind as to help me out with it since we had waited exceedingly long for our meals. He said there was nothing he could do and compared it to me expecting him to pay for a speeding ticket?! Thank you Margaritaville Nashville for making my Mother's Day one to remember.

My boyfriend and I did date night at the symphony last night. It was a wonderful experience. We sat in the Founders Circle and had a great view of the symphony and the movie screen [Home Alone]. The Symphony orchestra and chorus were amazing and the building is beautiful. 

The staff, ushers, and volunteers were all very friendly and helpful. 

There were several bars throughout the venue and the prices weren't too extreme and were affordable. 

It was wonderful that there is a variety of opportunities in which all can experience the symphony and is a highly recommended venue.
Walk the Line is awesome! Perfect description from John the Baterender, "it's like laying on the beach" Great place to hang out and chill, catching up with old friends.
Awesome place. Great music and solid drinks. You'll enjoy it on a Saturday afternoon or Saturday night spot with friends. Great bluegrass and country music!

Don't be surprised if the manager makes you out to be a liar. Tried to get a table after a hockey game for a table of 4. Once we did not get seated, I asked why open seated began when we were on list. He said they seated everyone on the list and acted like I was lying. He then proceeded to walk away. I manage a business and that's not how you treat any customer. How about asking when we put our name in or who did we tell at the hostess stand??? Really surprised by how we were treated. Never been treated so poorly by any business!!
The Underground burger is the best burger in town!!  Cheese fries are fabulous.  Great service.  Place is a little small but totally worth it for the food and hospitality.

I came a long way to get here. 

Maybe ten whole minutes, but to people in Nashville that's a lot of walking. Being a New Yorker, I saw the town was not a walking city. The place is hidden on the edge of the Gulch, but that doesn't even explain half my adventure. There was a train stuck along the way, and blocking our path. After two minutes of waiting, we decided we had seen enough action films, hopped on the train and made it to the other side. Eat your heart out James Bond. 

Was it worth it? You better believe it. 

Upon entrance there was a band playing some tunes. Definitely something I had not seen in a brewery before. Kudos for that. The staff was super chill and friendly. Got us on a tour right away. Surprising because we heard how so many places sell out by the middle of the day. 

The beers were tasty and the tour was solid. Stayed around to school some people in Jenga, but ended up getting abused. I was trying too hard to make the really difficult moves. I need to stop trying to show off, never works. 

Split some food to refuel a bit, after lots and lots of drinking. Hit the spot. Much needed. 

Thanks Tennessee Brew Works, hopefully people find this gem.

The Bridgestone Arena is where the Preds play, big name concerts are held and I'm sure the occasional Monster Truck rally. But the review is really about the fans rated number one by ESPN. While I am not sure of the formula the "mother ship" used, I'm pretty sure they got it right.
Everyone seems to be dressed in team colors, the anthem is often sung by some recording star, a veteran is recognized for their service all before the puck drops.
The fans taunt the opposing goalie with a verse that questions his ability. Loud music is played when the Preds need a lift. Live bands play between periods. It must all work as they often have the best home record in hockey.

This is very laid back, relaxed and fun spot for a Nashville show. The sound quality isn't the very best, and it can be down right bad depending on where you're standing. And it's all standing, which is sometimes tough for this old broad. I love the new little attached bar though - great place to relax, chat, and yes I'm old, sit before a show. Good prices and I like the mobile ticketing through ticketfly.
this place is great. i was there for a burger for the second time and was amassing.service was great and food come out fast.this guys know how to make a great tasting meal.am coming back for more.

My husband and I went here on a whim after brunch for Valentine's Day. We had the beer and chocolate pairing flight- it was oh so good! My husband LOVED their IPA and Extra Easy, I enjoyed their Southern Witt. The people working their were very nice and helpful. I would recommend this place for a first date or date night out, regardless of age!

This place is the place to go if you like the small town, whole in the wall (in a GOOD way), local atmosphere. The live music was good and the staff were friendly. This was definitely the the atmosphere my husband and I were looking for while visit Nashville. We only stopped in for one drink but when we visit Nashville again, I will go here and would recommend you checking it out.

Layla's is one cool dive bar with kickass live music. It's two stories, and the second floor has a great view of the stage but if you want the music to kiss your face than sit up front. Service was great too as both the bartender (who sang a song with the band) and the wait staff made sure your drinks were always full. There's plenty of options around the vicinity but Layla's knows how to take care of its patrons.
In typical Margaritaville fashion,  this place won't let you down. Food is delicious and our bartender,  Noelle is a sweetheart and was a great Nashville ambassador to tourists like us.

Not a bad place to see a game.  We bought our tickets kind of last minute so we had to sit one row from top in the nosebleed section but we still had a nice view.  Maybe this was because we were in the "cheap" seats but a lot of the folks near us were pretty rednecky with colorful vocabularies so it was "educational" for my 9-year old to say the least.  Perhaps it would have been different if it were a game the Preds played well in and weren't drawing so much ire from the local faithful.

Otherwise, I thought the arena was laid out fine and it's in a convenient location to all the downtown attractions.   Also, check out the specials they're offering before you go.  I met up with a friend there who had bought two lower bowl tickets, two hot dogs, two drinks, and a car flag for $99. That's a steal.

As breweries go, this place is well set up. Great porch and a nice interior with views of the brewing area.  The music is good to listen to in some spots, but in others (like parts of the upstairs) the sound can get a little distorted. 

Beers are passable and there's generally a decent selection.  They're not going to win any major awards but by Nashville standards they at least brew clean beers.  Thankfully they don't offer a bakers dozen of "IPAs" and have some imagination when it comes to their recipes.  That said, I'd stick to their more hoppy beers and maybe their dark beers. Their more lightly hopped beers are their most drab, and I suspect the pressurized mash filter system they use is primarily to blame--it literally wrings out all the sugars from the grain thereby allowing them to use less grain per batch of beer (so malt *flavor* is lacking). 

So 4.0 stars for the brewery venue, 3.0 stars for their beers..

The service was awesome! Great bartender named Aukje VERY friendly and very knowledgable about the area. Best bartender in the area so far. Great buffalo bites, margaritas and live music. Only thing missing is a good IPA. Will definitely recommend this restaurant.

Excellent ambience and hang out spot!! Great place to catch some college football! Really enjoyed they're cheese platter. Excellent selections and for a no pork eater, I was super pleased they include only cheeses!! Didn't have to miss out. The toast was on point, and don't get me started on the candied nuts. Yum! Had a perfect Fall flair. Have it 4 stars because they beer was good, but nothing really stood out. Our favorite, by far, was the 1927 IPA. Really delicious, citrusy, dank flavor. I'm normally the imperial fan, but wasn't too impressed. Too boozy over malty. Live music was just a plus. Great place to hang for a little 30th celebration. Would come back, and just might, just wishing we were more in love with the brews!

Expected a larger burger for $11. Seasoned very well. Staff was friendly. I ordered a Sex on the Beach and the bartender faked her way through. Pretended she knew how to make one but it was no where close. LOL! Still good, but a totally different drink from what I ordered. Back to the burger...tasty, but not an $11 burger.

I absolutely love stopping in here for a quick drink and socializing with friends and family. A friend kept mentioning events hosted here and I first visited with family from out of town. The layout is friendly for group outtings. The brewery floor is appealing with areas for guest to view the process without a formal tour. I have become hooked on there Kombucha. As a beer lover it's weird to say that I truly get excited about this place for their Kombucha, it's such a niche in Nashville. They're the only brewery that offers an alternative non-alcoholic beverage adding to the appeal. 
I have yet to try the menu but it's intriguing and unique. Offering a wide array and providing beer lovers a reason to stick around. I could see this as a great date spot for beer and food enthusiasts like me.
I've been here twice, it is much bigger than I expected. It wasn't too crowded when I went. I will go back if there is a show I want to see.

What an awesome place to see a show! My first show at marathon was a sold out James Bay show. The line went fast to get in, and it was very easy to get drinks. The bartenders are very friendly even during loud shows! 
The second show I saw was Jamie XX! Much different crowd than James Bay but an even better experience. It was the perfect venue for Jamie XX! Bathrooms were clean and the set up for the stage is perfect for viewing all around.
I won't skip an opportunity to see my favorite artists here.

This place isn't half bad as far as local bars go, but the tourists kind of ruin it so make sure you get there at a descent time. The roof top bar is really nice. The staff is friendly. Overall not a bad spot if you're looking get some drinks and make friends with strangers

Not bad but not great. We arrived around 6 and went to the roof top. We were wanting a table outside and the waitress was pretty rude about letting us know where we could not sit. Funny thing is that when we left an hour later it was still empty. Not a great start Blake. Let's break it down:

Atmosphere 3 stars - nothing special about the interior or rooftop. The downstairs area has a nice stage but the entire restaurant has a commercial feel to it. I considered it average for Broadway. 

Service 4 Stars - our waitress was very pleasant. She was helpful and attentive. No issue here. 

Food 4 stars - it's bar food but pretty darn good. I consider it above average. I had the trio sliders. The pork was very tasty, the bologna sandwich (yes they still make these) a we really good and clever. Lastly, the hamburger was solid. My wife had the pimento cheese wrapped in mozzarella. Really well done. 

Value 3 Stars - for basically two appetizers and four beers we left with a $60 bill. Alittle high for what you get but considering it is in the heart of broadway, probably pretty typical. 

All in all, it was ok. I would give it 3.5 but yelp won't allow me to do that. It's definitely slightly above average and I would come back.
So yummy! Great atmosphere. Valerie was the best! So helpful and attentive. Made the experience so much better!!!

I assume this is a classic honky-tonk dive. I chose this place because the sign out front said "Nashville Hillbilly Music". The music was great - solid musicians, pretty broad repertoire for requests, and the sound was great. even from way in the back we had an okay view.

If you care about what you put in your body and like food that is well thought out, this is a place for you. Big bonus - fantastic beer. Where can you go for great beer and food that is made with a conscience? 
The fries were crispy, burger oh-so juicy and delicious, hot chicken sandwich - amazing! All locally sourced. This place deserves a "Real" Certification. (https://eatreal.org/ )

There was a 45 min wait when we got there, but we were seated quicker than that. My first margarita was say too sour and not good at all, which is disappointing considering it was Margaritaville. The 2nd margarita, a more expensive one, was better. The food was good and I love the atmosphere. Our waitress was very nice and friendly. I'd go again.

Had a great time with my group at Margaritaville! Fun for everyone - drinks and food to serve all tastes and ages. Thank you so much Valerie for your amazing service and tips. Yum! 

Edit: 
We were told they let lunch goers into the Friday show but this is not true. Just a heads up before you plan to dine before the show... better to just wait in line and dine upstairs at 2 when they open it up
Not a half bad neighborhood bar. The patio was pretty nice, drinks were just alright though. Tables were hard to come by.

Family friendly place on Broadway.  Those traveling with people under 21 will know that it can be difficult to find a place to eat in the downtown Broadway area, especially the later it gets.  While we would have preferred a local non-chain restaurant, we opted for Margaritaville and had a good experience.  The place was crowded, but the wait wasn't too long and there was a pretty good live band playing, which added to the Nashville atmosphere we were hoping for.  The food was decent and service was good.  The server accommodated our vegetarians and made sure their orders were adjusted to accommodate their needs.

Enjoyable atmosphere, good music/musicians, & a super sweet waitress made this place enjoyable. I was really hoping I would love this place but the menu is limited and our food wasn't great. We got the fried pickles as an appetizer and the Nashville Hot Chicken & biscuit with Fries and tator-tots for dinner. The biscuit buns were great, I actually think I would've enjoyed them alone with butter and jelly more than I did on the sandwich. The chicken was hard to chew and not very spicy. The French fries were nothing to write home about but the tarot-tots were great! They're homemade and much better than the boring steak fries. The fried pickles were good, large portion so easy to share with a group of 5-6! Overall just an ok experience, I'd probably pick a different place next time to get the real honky-Tonk Nashville vibes.

MMW is definitely my favorite place to see a show in Nashville. The layout allows for a great view of the stage no matter where you stand. The bars a large and easy to access throughout the night. And the sound fills the room perfectly. I've been to multiple shows at MMW, each different genres, and the venue adapts easily to the different styles. I always have more shows here on my radar because they book the best acts and up and coming talent I always want to see. I'll be back time and time again!

Pretty fun place!
We had a good time. And the staff was nice, which is always a plus!

We attended the Father John Misty show on March 27th, 2015. The opening act was King Tuff. Parking was Super convenient cheap and a block away from the entry.

When entering the show the usual security measures were in place. Stamp on the hand and in you go. We quickly made our way to one of the two bars inside and  were friendly served weak drinks. Drinks in hand, we made our way to the bands merchandise stand. We bought a record and a tshirt. Since we had plenty of time before the show we wanted to take our purchases to the car so we could have both hands free. This was prohibited by security despite having a hand stamp and ticket. We shuffled into our place for the opening act. 

And this is where the real problem is with this venue. The reflective  nature of the concrete floor destroyed any hopes for decent acoustics and created an impossible task for the FOH(front of house) sound guy. So the sound was shite. The low end was muddy and overwhelming. The high end was worse. The middle was absent. 

I really believe FJM is a top shelf act. They were killin IT.  We walked away feeling like we didn't see or hear their best performance due to the Marathon Music Work shite PA filter.

Started off badly when the hostess wanted to seat the two (my mom and i) of us across from the kitchen when the entire establishment was 1/3 full. I objected and we were placed in a better spot. we both ordered the fried chicken. Chicken tasty and lots of it. Could have used more gravy. Server nice and attentive.

We had so much fun in Nashville and visiting many of the bars with live music on Broadway! On a busy Thursday night Margaritaville was the only place that had an open table. My husband and I just shared a club sandwich as a late night snack which was delicious and went just fine with my margarita. The service was outstanding! Claire was our server and she was so sweet, friendly, helpful and made sure we were completely satisfied with our experience at Margaritaville.

Really, really warm in the concert hall, last night.
Instead of reading the magazines they give us, when we sit down, most people were using the magazine as a fan... and there was a lot of "fanning" going on..

I sat behind the orchestra for the concert, last night.
Good seats, can watch all the musicians do their thing, talk to one another, drink their water...
Lots of stuff going on that is fun to watch.

Again, acoustics are good, seating is good, seats are comfy, plenty of legroom, lighting is good... my only gripe was it was so damn warm, last night...

I have tickets for a February concert and believe you me.. I will be wearing something summery, so I don't sweat my ass off.

We went to the Bridgestone Arena for the first time for the Womens Basketball Final Four Championship. We actually loved the experience. People couldn't have been nicer. All the employees were so very helpful, friendly and efficient in the job they were doing.
I realized I had lost my camera about 5 minutes after entering the premises. We immediately went to the information counter to find out what I needed to do. My camera was already sitting on the lost and found shelf! Unbelievablel!There was an  estimated 17,000 people in the arena at that time. Some one found my camera and immediately turned it in. Could hardly believe this happened in barely 10 minutes. Grateful.
I love Nashville. 
UCONN ROCKS.....

The atmosphere of the restaurant is wonderful! The service has always been up to par when I dine here. The wait is acceptable for an average dinner time, so long as Nashville isn't hosting a special event. 

The drinks are delicious, but can be light on the alcohol at times. The food, although delicious, seems pricey for the portion size. I could get a larger burger at Cheddars or even Applebee's. It seems you pay more for the ambiance of the restaurant than you do the food.

Five stars for her best waitress in the history of waitresses. Food was good, but what really made it was Amy. If you come to margaritaville and don't get Amy, you're missing the hell out. Funny, good person, and real Nashville treat. We were here as a bachelorette and she played along with all our dumb antics. 10/10 would recommend.
Awesome!!! Walked by and heard a great band playing so we went inside. Beth Garner Band was absolutely rocking it!!! Great vibe and a lot of history, if you are in Nashville it is a must see!

This place ROCKS!!! As a "non-beer" drinker, I was less than enthusiastic to follow my beer snob husband here on our trip to Nashville.  I was WRONG!   The knowledgable staff led me in the direction of several beers that even the non-beer girl could enjoy!  My beer snob husband looked like he had died and gone to heaven! While the beer was obviously a religious experience (from the look on my husband's face), the food is what stole the show for the non-beer chick.  The burger was the best thing I've eaten in a long time and put all other burgers to shame.  I don't know what they are putting in it.. But evidently there are 5 different beers making up various components of the burger.. And the experience was enough to have me racing to book my next trip to Nashville!! A must stop on any Nashville tour!

Poor service from host through lunch. 
We had a large group (13) so they made us split up. They refused to even seat us near each other even though there were enough empty tables to put both groups next to each other. We were all seated by 2:50. Not even during a lunch rush. The party of 6 had menus when they sat down and had their drink order take right away and good order fairly quickly. The party of seven had no menus  for over 20 minutes and only after we asked 3x. No one took our drink order until after we had been seated for 30 minutes and I spoke to an employee standing by the doorway to the elevator.  We did not actually order our food or our first beverages until 3:25.  My first beverage was made incorrectly. Our waiter said he knew that but did nothing to correct the issue. 

A trainer came over to inform us our server was in training and today was his last day of training so he was trying to go solo. She told US we needed to give him a hard time for the errors. I told her that is not our place. She needed to address it and she may want to give him more support in training. 

Food finally came around 4:00. The party of 5 was completely done eating. So we're the smaller parties they say at the two empty tables near us. Most things came out correctly except for the smoked chicken. Two of us ordered 1/2 orders. Both orders came out full. The manager eventually reduced our food bill (not including any drinks) by 50%.  We finally got our bill about 4:35. But our waiter did not fix what he charged for the chicken so we still paid more than we should have.  

We finally got out of there about 2:45. Almost 2 hours after being seated. We did package up our leftovers and shared with Nashville's homeless. Saw a lot of need along Broadway. 

All in all, not the experience I expected and not a place I would suggest to others without a lot of warning about what could happen.
Do not visit for the food.  It's very poor quality.  In addition they don't have many gluten free options either.  Our group enjoyed having cocktails on the rooftop and that's all I would recommend.
Food was good and the service was also good. Margaritas were definitely out of this world!! Didn't have a long wait either.

Things have changed here. Especially since the brains behind their establishment quit last year. They had a girl there that did all their booking, organizing - basically she ran the ship. She left and things went downhill quickly. 

The bottom line - there are bigger and better venues that have moved into Nashville. This place will also be a well known because they have been around for years. But if I were an artist, dj or anyone looking to book an event, this place wouldn't be on my radar.
Cool beach vibe. Lot's of margarita choices. Items on their menu can be made Gluten Free which is a plus. Staff was very friendly, food arrived quickly and was very good. The live music was great.

Nashville makes other cities look second rate. The Bridgestone is so awesome and the location plenty of parking decks within walking distance and right on broadway means it is close to plenty of great restaurants. Love the atmosphere downtown and the arena is clean and plenty of friendly staff.

This is for "The Lookout" which should be called the Watchout. IT IS NOT OLE RED. We made a reservation but didn't realize The Lookout was not part of Ole Red. We were whisked through Ole Red which looked fun and had a great menu. The Lookout is like a lame hotel bar and does NOT play country music. Our server was wonderful but she had to shoo people away from our table when we arrived. People who continued to stand behind us the entire time and blocked our view. AWKWARD. The food was overpriced and not good. The wine was warm. The table was dirty. The view was okay, I watched people at the bar across the street having fun and wished I was there instead. The worst part? The stench of rotten trash blowing up from the street to the table. Is this a "thing" in Nashville or were the garbage collectors on strike? Every dumpster was overflowing. I became nauseous from it and we had to leave. So sad that this was how we had to spend our last night in Nashville, we were having a great time until this.

This review is about The Lookout which is the top floor of Ole Red. It has a different menu. When you get tired of bar food or just want a superb meal, this is the place to go. We are seafood lovers and this was some of the best we have ever eaten including at the gulf. They have a raw bar and you pay by the item. We ordered two Alaskan King Crab Legs, a dozen raw oysters, a dozen boiled shrimp.  We also got their special huge pretzel with great warm queso dip, which was very good . The seafood was amazing ...  Most of the reviews on here are for the main floor food. Don't stop there. Go to the roof top. We can't wait to go back. Delicious! We were a group of four and had plenty of food. View was also great.

Ok, I'm not a huge fan of beer, but my husband really wanted to try this place and now we are both hooked! 

Trying the Basil Ryeman and when in season Walk the Lime are both musts! I am obsessed with the Basil Ryeman and it is definitely my go to beer there! 

I wish they would open a store in Murfreesboro where we live! I believe they have started serving a small array of food, but they always have Moose Head Kettle Corn and try it or you'll be sorry you missed out. They pair so well with the beer!

It's an awesome place to chill out. They have a lot of room inside as well as outside. They typically have some kind of live music and there is a dart room in the back. 

Reasonably priced and the staff is very knowledgeable as well as friendly.

I've never eaten here, but the music is fanatic and I've always had excellent service from the bartenders.  Downstairs has a bar and a dance floor in front of the stage, and upstairs has a bar and is lofted with seats so its easy to see the band.
Great place to listen to live music and grab a few beers. Open late and great house band.

Weird place with strange vibes BUT had to give them a solid review for great customer service.  My friend lost her Louis Vuitton purse and they found it and returned it! Everything is in was saved! And then my husband forgot his credit card and never closed his tab.. but when we went back the next day, they waited to charge us and were cool.  Nice nice staff!

This is always my favorite honky tonk for the unique music selection.  Was in on a recent Friday night with an out of town friend.  I hadn't been there since they added the second story addition, which helps with crowds on a busy night.  The band featured a female lead and she was a total bad a$$, we enjoyed singing, dancing, and drinking along.

New favorite brewery on Nashville. Was welcomed immediately by one of the owners who served me and talked to me about beer for 15 minutes. Everything I had was a very solid beer, ranging from a rosemary fall beer to a super crushable ESB. The bar itself is very nice and clean. It opens on to the brewery itself which is nice to poke your head in to. 5 regular beers on tap, a seasonal, 3 barrel aged beers, and 2 session ales rounded out the offering while I was here. Do yourself a HUGE favor and come here and get the flight to taste a range of great local beer.

So many places to choose this looked nice. Plus comfy air conditioning inside to escape unusual warmth for October. Good band playing at lunchtime. Nice menu, lots of options.. burgers, salad, famous fir their huge nachos platter. Sit near the front and hear the band or way in the back ( as we did) where it's cool and relaxing.  Ordered the taco salad and my husband had a chicken sandwich.  Taco salad is excellent! Chicken sandwich good too! Glad we stopped in

We had a great time on Broadway, the music strip in Nashville, and enjoyed a great dinner at Jimmy Buffet's Margaritaville. My wife had the chicken Caesars salad, but my son and I enjoyed the steak teriyaki. It was phenomenal. Best of all is e service. They just did enough not to be annoying, but helpful. And they have a guy on stilts who makes complex balloon designs for the kids. A MadHatter top hat with a fish. never severe that great. We enjoyed the dinner and also enjoyed the live music. The restaurant is on the best entertainment strip in Nashville. Loved every minute of it. Average pricing made it even more enjoyable.

We've been frequenting this place pretty much since they've opened up. At first we thought it was just another standard brewery but over the last year they have really upped their game. We love the food and brews here lately and plan to frequent much more often.

Amazing food and staff here...I went here a few days ago while on vacation and man i want to go back!!! It was so good!!! 

If you don't know what to get share the red neck nachos with the table and the bucket of champagne chicken oh my wows you'll be in a food coma for sure but they are so good

Came to grab some dinner and had such a great experience with Chris! We ended up in the middle of the dinner rush on top of the Music City bowl and he handled all of his tables like a true professional. Great food, great drinks, excellent service!
We wandered into this venue and were treated to a very enjoyable lunch. Food was great and not run of the mill. Service good. Music good.

Great venue, big, cool looking, but WAYYY too loud. Now I'm not a dork and I go to a lot of concerts and I like my music loud but it was PAINFUL. I have permanent hearing loss from it now. My right ear rings constantly. Maybe consider earplugs

I like this venue in so much as I like the bands they book. Parking is terrible. There is no security inside the venue. I and several friends have experienced being basically assaulted during concerts here on the floor, and not because of moshing. Would love for this venue to have floaters on the floor taking care of belligerent fans. Also, the sound kind of sucks. But, you get a great view of the performer.

Came here last night for blue grass night. The beers were two for one, not including flights. The beer was delicious. We ordered food too. The burger was just ok in my opinion. I didn't love the sauces they had on it. The fries were very thin and delicious. The atmosphere is great!  Nice outside patio that is dog friendly. Will be back!!!

Came here visiting from out of town with another friend of mine who is in to craft beer. Personally, none of the beers currently on tap were for me. However, the saving grace of this place is the food. Wow! I've seriously never had such good unique food at a brewery. First let me start with the butternut squash hummus. Easily some of the best hummus i've ever had the flavor was so unique and well balanced. I also had the grilled cheese and my friend had the fish tacos and both were amazing!!! Seriously i know you're not usually at a brewery for the food, but make it a point to try some food while you're here.

Just have to give kudos to our waiter, Chris McKenna.  Went above and beyond in service, and made our visit the best meal on our vacation this entire week.  The restaurant was great too.  Ask for Chris McKenna to be your waiter.  You will NOT be disappointed.

My friends and I were in Nashville for a weekend and checked out this brewery, they have a really cool outdoor setting, great prices at $11 for a flight (you get 5) and serve food. I only liked one of my beers from the flight, the ciders on the list were only available in cans. The food was good. They ID you when you enter in the brewery to order and put a T mark on your hand with a sharpie, which I did not like, felt like we were going into a club at night. They also allow smoking on the patio so at one point both tables beside us were smoking and it was blowing right in our faces.

SUB PAR MARGARITAVILLE!
Served a Margarita in a broken glass.  Very visibly broken. When repoured it was just okay
Soggy french fries. Floor so dirty I stuck to it.
Crab dip very very good.
Music okay
Wait staff fair.
Probably because this is a tourist area they know they can bank on tourist dollars and do not really have to try.

Venue: Margaritaville

Decor:   Nice

Service:   Pretty good, Friendly

Environment:   Pretty size restaurant

Food:   Lot of options:  American, Seafood

Prices:   Not too bad

Debbie Downers:   This location, the beverages are slightly higher than the chains in the south and Caribbean islands

Conclusion: All in all, Margaritaville is an excellent option to hang out on the town.  Lots of people, plenty of seating, place gets jammed pack.  Unique house beverages, good food and service.  Definitely a good chain to have right on Broadway in the heart of it all.

Overall: B
Worst service I have ever had at a bar and the most disgusting bathroom I've ever been in and I'm a plumber.

The beer - I had the sweet potato stout - was pretty solid. I'd definitely drink again. The music was enjoyable, folksy, not overbearing, pleasant. Tight seating indoors,  but ample outdoors. Food was...okay. had the sweet potato poutine, grilled cheese and BBQ nachos. Poutine was the best, but wasn't actually poutine at all. Grilled cheese was decent, but not very cheesy. The BBQ nachos were disappointing...loaded with cream and sprouts, with only a hint of BBQ flavor.

Let me start off by saying we are Not big drinkers so a night out for us consist of two  to three drinks and we start to feel a good buzz. So it's our first time to Nashville we head straight to Broadway on Saturday night. Want to get a good buzz going and enjoy the atmosphere and town. . The place is beautiful, very modern. Sat in the second level bar had the Buckshot and 2 jack and cokes to follow.  All I have to say is SUPER weak drinks!! Paid about $75 and felt Like we drank water!!!

Ive been here two times and had two different experiences. The first was on an early Sunday afternoon. It was great! It was not crowded, had cheaper beer, and an outdoor patio with plenty of seating. The last time was during a Saturday night. It wasnt so good. It was very crowded and people were hostile. I was shoved and pushed the whole time. Some people seemed hateful and irritated. There was a fight that broke out also that I nearly ended up being in the center of accidentally.

Come for the beer, stay for the food!!!! This is a must do on any Nashville visit. The beer is what originally made me want to visit the brewery. As a home brewer and what my wife calls "a beer snob" the beer was the main attraction. It did not disappoint. There are flavors and a variety of beers for everyone. Two that stood out were the Basil Ryeman and the Country Roots. What I did not expect was the unbelievable food. It was hands down the best burger I had ever had. The brewery is a short Uber ride from the Broadway bar scene and you need to visit. The staff are more than helpful with service and recommendations.
