Thus, for anyone who has to have a bourbon-barrel-aged double something or other to be impressed, you won't be here. But for the styles they were serving, the quality was pretty decent.

The service was on-point too. The bartender (owner?) suggested saving the stout and the fruity pale for last, as the dry stout sampled before the pale would really bring out the flavors. And he was right.

I'd happily return.

Great atmosphere for a brewery. Love all of the different seating options. Fish tacos were fantastic! Prices were reasonable. 

I did not like the 'hurry up & order' vibe at the order counter. I really didn't like that my flight came with no direction as to which beer was what. I liked 2 of the 5 beers I sampled, but no labeling means I have no idea which ones I liked. It was a Tuesday afternoon. I can't imagine how frustrating ordering would be on a weekend. 

Overall I liked it here, but not sure I would return. The vibe is better to me right down the road at Jackalope, which feels more like a brewery & the folks working there appear to love what they do. This place is more like a restaurant that happens to brew some beer.

Sat at the bar for dinner.  I had the shrimp wedge salad which was nothing spectacular.  The dressing that comes with it is very similar to thousand island... this is one of my pet peeves.  If it is a spade call it a spade.  I can't remember what fancy name they called the dressing on the menu but I was kicking myself for not asking what it was. It is thousand island, people!!!  YUCK.  The shrimp were pretty good but too greasy for them being blackened.  This wedge salad desperately needed some bacon on it.  And ranch dressing.  The lettuce wedges (3 of them) were obnoxiously huge.  Really who is going to eat all that?  They were so big there was no room left to cut them up on the plate.  And the capers were just out of place and weird.  Anyway...my friend is a vegetarian and ordered the veggie burger which looked a lot like a beef burger from my angle.  Luckily he checked it out before biting into it...  Not cool.  Wasn't impressed. 

The atmosphere was really loud.  I know it is Nashville but it was overbearing and the band wasn't all that great.  The bartender seemed to personally know the guy sitting next to me so I had to listen to her almost constant conversation with him which was her loudly talking (almost yelling) over the band.  It was annoying.

This is my favorite restaurant in Nashville. Yes it is a bit over priced but I enjoy the wonderful atmosphere. The decorations are awesome and there is always life music. One of the best margaritas I have ever had. Only $7 and got me more than buzzed. I enjoy the shrimp on the menu. Can't wait to come back!!! As a margarita lover, Margaritaville is my safe haven.
The security (axis) was very pleasing but the venue not so much! They wouldn't let me re enter even with the funds to buy a new ticket! They refused any help and I am ver very displeased!
Quick service. 5 dollar beers. Band was awesome female lead. Only stayed a few beers. But atmosphere had a good vibe

Amazing time! Beers are excellent, and they are stocked with tons of games for people to play in a cool atmosphere. Picnic table-type seating upstairs, which allows for easy game play. 
Servers were courteous and very helpful. We very much enjoyed our brief stop here.

Spacious, good atmosphere and delicious food! We were skeptical at first as we had several kids with us. We thought maybe it was more of a beer place and not so much a restaurant. We were wrong! The menu is fairly limited, but every person in our large group loved their meal! I can see why The Travel Channel made a stop there. We had burgers and pork sandwiches. The reason for four stars is that I thought it was more on the expensive side. We didn't end up trying any beers (next time for sure) so I can't review that part, but food-wise it was definitely worth the stop!

Woo gotta love Marathon. If it wasn't for the Exit/In's simplicity and intimacy, Marathon Music Works would be my favorite venue. I've attended some unforgettable concerts here (Cut Copy, Odesza, Interpol) and they tend to do a wonderful job with the special effects and sound.

The "big room" spacious venue style is prime for mid-high popularity bands that attract decently large crowds. While I have pushed my way to the front before, you can definitely still have a more relaxed time towards the back of the venue without sacrificing too much in sound quality. 

Overall, this is a laid-back, fun venue that constantly brings in spectacular acts.

Gorgeous location, with both indoor and outdoor seating. And since we're in Nashville, live music to listen to in the background was great.

Beers were respectable. I got the flight, plus two tasters of their two sours and everything was good. I'm a HUGE stout fan, and the only disappointment of the night was the sweet potato stout. Had this pronounced ashy/burnt quality, and honestly just tasted a little watered down. I definitely didn't get any sweet potato from it.

All in all a great place. This was the only brewery I made it to in Tennessee, and had I had to do it all over again I probably still would have sought this place out. Their stout needs some work, but other than that they're doing some great stuff. Wish I would have ordered some food, but I wasn't too hungry.

If I could give more stars I would. Hands down best brewery in Nashville, heck, THE WORLDDDD. So much work goes into each beer, each piece of food, everything. The staff know what they are talking about, can steer you in the right direction if you are unclear of what to order, and are just so nice and friendly. 

The food is insanely good, all local, and almost every thing on the menu incorporates one of the beers. 

I like the laid back atmosphere, and the patio is superb. Nothing else like it in Nashville!

I recommend the burger or hot chicken sandwhich, and the 1927 IPA (so refreshing).

We made the mistake of going on Saturday afternoon.  We thought mid-afternoon would be relatively quiet.  WRONG! The bartender was very nice, attentive, and found a beer I liked.  I didn't realize I'd caught him in a lull.  Then, a tour group came out and the bar was inundated, repeatedly.
Main negative to this place, other than being jammed and not much parking, was the upstairs restroom.  There was a single unisex bathroom.  The door wouldn't close securely, much less lock, leading to men walking in on women and vice versa.  The bathroom was FILTHY, even by guy standards for bar toilets, with water overflowing from the urinal running out under the door, and no paper supplies of any kind.
They get two stars rather than one because we went back Sunday evening and things were much more sane.  I also discovered nice, clean restrooms on the first floor, back in the touring area.  The staff was great and the beer was good, but not good enough to offset the parking problem, small bar area (upstairs bar was closed on Sunday), and general atmosphere.
What a beautiful venue. Went to the mixtape tour and the place was packed. Thet have a variety of foods and drinks to choose from. The bathrooms could've been cleaner.

MMW is a great venue! I love the industrial/factory feel and that it's a good size with two bars! The sound is great, and I love all of the fixtures and set up of the space. It's great! They have a good variety of shows and its an excellent venue. However, the parking definitely blows. The streets are always crowded so if you don't want to pay to park you have to drive quite a bit. Otherwise, lovely place!

I forgot my servers name, but the gentleman that served us was great. Friendly and helpful. Not one complaint . I'm from Texas. Thanks for the great service while I visited. I recommend the maestro tequila, smooth. Hopefully they have it in Texas. 
My crowd went out on a limb and tried the Jamaican wings and 3 out of 8 didn't like it . 4 teens and 4 kids( 7-17 age)..... I got nothing else to say .... Peace out and keep that ish up
Very unimpressed. Blake Shelton wouldn't come here. Food menu was odd. However, great service and employees were friendly though.

We met here with our Green Bay Packers group twice. Really nice place to meet up. 

We Wisconsin (Florida) people made it truly unbearable on the main Nashville strip (Broadway). Too crowded in several bars as Packers fans travel well.

So, we hung out south of the main strip in an area they call The Gulch. The Gulch is an old warehouse district that is being torn down and replaced with high-rise condos, restaurants and a host of micro-breweries. 

This place is a little tricky to find if you don't have it in your mobile GPS, but well worth the visit. They play contemporary music, they have a downstairs, an upstairs with two huge TVs (with sports on) and an outdoor section. 

We hung out upstairs and outdoors during our two visits. I had a hefeweizen which was really good and stuck with that. We had great conversation and really good service. Hope to make it back here in future visits. 

Highly recommend!

THE worst place in Nashville.  So poorly run it must be a front for something. as you wait on line for the bathroom, people are taking food off of plates at the kitchen counter. The manager is a street thug with no manners and hasn't bathed in a while. Food ? They dont seem to keep the place clean and their is no hot water to wash your hands. If you want a crap time thats the place . What a S.... Hole ! So many nice places in Nashville.Stay away!!!!  Ps if you reserve a table with a view for New years. I guarantee you will be ripped off. Dont pay cash. The promise one thing and totally lie about what they deliver.

Took my mom and sisters for brunch on a Sunday. Live music was awesome! All our dishes were delicious. Spacious and open seating. It wasn't noisy from other people, even though it was packed. Definitely worth the trip.

This place is awful. After ordering a cheese basket, we recieved cheese with a a bite out of it. Such a low value of entertainment compared to the rest of the places in nashville.  Service is OK.  Food selection is lacking.  Do not be tricked by the coupons being handed out for 10% off down the street.  Its not worth it!!!

First time we've eaten here. The menu was small. We've stopped in for drinks and live music before which I recommend. The Tennessee mule was just a regular mule, but the cherry limeade was good. The southern tater tot poutine was amazing! The hot chicken biscuit with fries and slaw was okay. I would have really loved it if the biscuit was better. I ended up just eating the chicken. The ranch was very good, watery which I usually don't like... but the dill flavor in it made it. I'd go back

Loved this place! Everything was great, even the food! We got the cheese plate and some baba ghanouj along with a couple flights and a pitcher. The area's very spread out and not too crowded. They have live music downstairs and free board games upstairs. We found a darts area and played darts for a while too, just ask the counter for them! Overall, it's a fun place to spend an evening and the staff is very kind.

I am only giving one star because otherwise Yelp won't let me write a review. Awful. I don't even have articulate words to describe our experience. Just read all of the other awful reviews. They sum it all up. Lesson learned- read the Yelp reviews BEFORE you try a new place.

Layla's was a super fun experience. I love the band, the atmosphere and the drinks. I thought the drinks were reasonably priced and they were not stingy on the pour, either. The bartenders were friendly and made the experience awesome! I will be going back to Layla's when I go back to Nashville.

We visited Margaritaville this weekend.  We are Margaritaville veterans, as we have been to 10 or 11 different Margaritaville Cafes and have visited this location many times since it's in our hometown.  

The food is almost always consistent.  In my opinion, it is slightly better than other themed chains.  However, the menu did change a while ago when Margaritaville sold the restaurants to a Brazilian company.  For instance, the Cheeseburger in Paradise now includes a "paradise island sauce"...I must have missed that ingredient in the lyrics of the song.  "I like mine with lettuce and tomato, Heinz 57 and paradise island sauce..."

However, as mentioned, the food is usually very consistent...it's certainly a notch above other chains.  On this trip, I had the Cheeseburger in Paradise (minus the aforementioned island sauce) and my wife had the quesadilla.  Both were fine.  My burger was underdone, but not to the point of being inedible.  Normally, I might have said something, but this trip was unique.  The NRA's national convention was in downtown Nashville and the restaurant was definitely packed.  We didn't see a waitress for about 10 minutes after being seated.  Then, our initial waitress handed off our table to a new waitress (who you could tell had not been working there very long) about halfway through the meal.  It just seemed like it would be easier to deal with the undercooked burger than trying to get the problem corrected.  My wife's quesadilla was fine according to her...nothing to write home about, but there were no problems either.

Also, a warning for Parrotheads - this location does not play much Buffett music.  There's usually a live band (which is necessary on Lower Broadway), but, even when the band is on break, you will be lucky to hear one Buffett song during your meal.  We were in the restaurant for close to 2 hours this weekend between waiting for a table and eating and heard 3 Buffett songs the entire time (and one was actually a Zac Brown song that Jimmy sings on).  But, we did get to hear Bon Jovi, Jason Mraz and several other things that (in my opinion) have very little to do with Jimmy Buffett.  The playlist won't impact your meal...but it's just a pet peeve of mine about the Nashville location.

Had an awesome time at the beerfest did not had the opportunity to catch a game while there.  The beerfest was well organized and the venue was kept very clean considering the hundreds of people in attendance.

Cool brewery to check out, especially if you're from out of town and don't know where to go. We did the flight which was plenty for us to sip on and let us try the different varieties they offer. Live music was playing so we hung out for a while. We didn't try the food but it looked really good!
Entertainment is good the ribeye was ok. Outback Steakhouse is better! If you wanna check out a spot to hang out and have a drink and enjoy the scenery it's a good spot to stop on Broadway.
Meh, its a chain... what do you expect? Mediocre food, fun crazy atompshere. Been to one, been to them all. Balloon hats made by girl on stilts was entertaining.

This was our first stop in Nashville and the Margarita's were good as well as the appetizers.  We sat at the bar and the bar tender was friendly and very helpful recommending other sites to see and restaurants to stop in while we were in town.

Horrible service from female bartenders. They need to be trained better. We were there with a big group ordering a lot of drinks and they didn't appreciate the business we were giving them. I guess we won't be going back there again. They are very racist!!!!!!!

One of the things I love more then anything in life is music in any form but life music is on top of it.

This place give my the chills when I hear wonderful vocals from people I love just to mention some Bruno Mars, Cher, Kelly Clarkson and do many others. 

Great service, helpful people giving direction, the sound is incredible actually is the best to make an incredible 

Ok food but good drinks

HORRIBLE SERVICE!! This place has a lot of great things.  Live music, decent food, but the servers are awful.  Situation: brought out everyone's food but one person and didn't even notice.  Took orders for two others that came by later and then claimed their printer paper for receipts was out so the cook never got the order.. Yah right.  I get that it's a bar... But really? Cool place.. Just go for a drink, and then sit at the bar.
Great food. The group Aberdeen Green is super great. Waitstaff is so nice - our waitress is from Chicago - and Blake Shelton's touches are EVERYWHERE!!

Make sure that you eat before going here. So, I tried to go to other restaurants but all the reservations were booked. So, after walking forever, we decided to go in the arena and eat bad decision). The food of course is very overpriced(No surprise). However, the thing that got me is there are no tables to sit and eat. Everyone was eating on top of trash cans(gross) and one area to stand  that does not have enough room for all of the customers. I am not sure why they do not have tables ( especially paying 15.00 for a meal plus drinks). The Arena itself is nice..... I was in the nose bleed area and was a little afraid to stand because I just knew I would fall forward ( glad I was not drunk). When leaving after the concert.... it was crazy. It seemed to have no order and not many escalators letting people down( it was a mess) to exit. Overall, it was an ok experience.

This arena is fantastic. Nothing too exciting, but it's always clean and the staff is super friendly, as well as almost all of the guests. Food prices are decent for a large sport/concert venue. Great acts often visit here and there's never a shortage of things to do and see in the area. The hockey is great with live bands between periods. I always look forward to going back here!
This place is full of yokel tourists and downer doormen! Worthless. Give your money to another dope space

We ended up in Ole Red at some point every single day we were in Nashville for a week. We'd start out elsewhere and end up coming here when we weren't enjoying ourselves as much. 
The standards for live performers here is very obviously higher than most places. The stage setup is great and sets the tone for such a fun music-centered atmosphere. Service is prompt and friendly. It's not a fine dining experience and if you're looking for that, you're in the wrong place but Our food was always good and the drinks even better. We found the celebrity-branded restaurant trend going on in Nashville to be mostly a let down with sub-par, over-priced food and mediocre entertainment but not the case here. 
Definitely a highlight of our vacation!

The good:
Comfortable seats.
Easy access.  
Has some really unique shows (like Roger Waters Ça Ira).
Acoustics aren't as bad as you'd expect from a squared venue.  

The bad:
The square venue is acoustically challenging and for Roger Water's Ça Ira, they felt the need to augment the sound with microphones... Which is unusual for an opera.  

The bottom line:
The experience was awesome and easy the best performance of any opera in English I've ever heard and one of my favorite opera performances of all time period.

Great Arena! Never had a bad experience and there is definitely not really a bad seat in the place. Only complaint I have is the outrageous prices for the concession stands. Water for $5....are you kidding me? They definitely need to lower the prices but other than that a great venue with lots of great acts coming through. I know they are always busy doing something, which is a good sign!

To be clear the 4 stars is ONLY for the staff and ambience which were great but the brunch food selection.... awful. I was very disappointed that there wasn't more available. It's Nashville! Where's the meat!?! The "continental buffet" that came with the eggs side of the menu was a bit of a joke. 

Our waitress was pleasant and attentive And the decor was beautiful. Very clean and modern with beautiful  views. Not sure if I'll be back but the wait staff from the greeter to our waitress was amazing. Great customer service!

Well first off, I learned the frog legs were seasonal but their replacement chicken wings were the bomb! Absolutely delicious. Service was super friendly and the other foods (hot chicken sandwich and bbq pork) were also very yummy. The actual brewery part of the place was a little unkempt but it was cool to look at. I will definitely be returning.

My rating is based on the over-priced food & drinks, however the quality was good. I had the hummus appetizer & a lager. Great live music most nights & the bartenders are friendly. Great spot to sidewalk watch the crazy downtown scene. Seems like a good date spot too. Consistency is a plus. We will be back but I wish they had happy hour!! Come on Buffett!! It's 5 O'clock here!!
The service was so slow the kid at the table next to us started eating his boogers. I don't know why he thought it was a good idea. But it was.

Great craft brewery close to downtown Nashville! We came yesterday for their annual crawfish boil and had a great time! It was pretty busy, but we were able to order quickly from the bar and easily found a seat. Our crawfish also came out quickly! We enjoyed a pitcher of the state park blonde and listened to live music for a couple of hours.

They also have a large, multi level patio with lots of seating. Their bathrooms are clean and have multiple stalls. They also offer tours (I have not personally taken the tour, but sounds like something fun to do!) and brew their own beers on site!

We dined here as a family for lunch to celebrate our daughter's 21st birthday. Service was EXCELLENT from the host to our server "Deb". We had such a great time and the food was great as well. Huge portions! We had the fried chicken x3 and a burger. Molly Stevens (from the Voice) was singing and was so kind to take pictures with our daughter and her friend. Such a great time! 
We went to a few other places for dinner and we all said at the end of the night that we should have just gone back to Blake's for dinner as well. By far the best set up to be able to eat and hear/see live music + positive family friendly (young adult daughters) vibe. Highly recommend

Best chicken fingers I had in a while.  Great bartenders and great company.  Was there for a Thursday night football game while in town for business and Elaine the bartender was great company.  I would recommend this place to anyone in midtown looking for live music, down to earth people, and looking for a good time

As a update to an older review-I want to take a second to say how insulted I feel after the rude treatment by the female manager on Saturday. As someone who comes in once a month even though I don't live in Nashville, her attitude, rudeness and actions will make me think twice before spending $300 weekend there. Sad as we really enjoy coming here.

What a great experience!!!! Chris Rhodes was professional, funny, and entertaining!!!! Even during a rush!!! We had a great time and will definitely be returning!!!! Great place and space if you are out with the family!!!
This is a great brewery a little off the path which is what makes it kind of cool.  Great seating outside and the beer is very good.  Highly recommended.
Great food and awesome service. Waitstaff worked as a team so you never had to wait for anything. We were impressed with how attentive they were. Good prices and great experience
Food was poor quality...not a lot of options....cheese tastes spoiled and worst off all fruit flies everywhere...absolutely disgusting...definitely keep your options open!!

I went here with a big group of people, about 50-60. We were served buffet dinner with very generic food on it. Grilled chicken, grilled salmon, jalapeno mac & cheese, salad and corn. It got the tummy full but nothing to rave about, but what do you expect from a place that specializes in margaritas. The atmosphere was okay and the wait staff was good. Maybe the experience would be better visiting on my own, but for now, don't think that'll happen.

Decided to bring family here who were visiting from out of town.  We had never been here ourselves but the gamble paid off. It was amazing.  The food was much better than I had expected especially the awesome veggie/vegan options.  We were pleasantly surprised about that.  I had the Nacho Average Vegan Burger and loved it.  Good food, great service and some talented entertainment on stage to boot.  If you want to give your out-of-town visitors a true Nashville experience, you won't go wrong with this place on your list.

I'm not why we had to wait 2 hours to get a seat. They took the wrong number to call us. Had to call twice and stop in to make it right. Multiple order were wrong. I was very disappointed on multiple levels. They do a poor job of maximizing their space. To many places to pick... pick a different location!!!

I wish they had Bluegrass bands here. That would make them different from the other honkytonks on Broadway.

But that said, I still like the place.

Employees very rude- won't be back. Walked in and was treated very rudely because this little doorman thinks he is cool. He was too busy talking to a friend to be doing his job. Then treated very rudely bc we interrupted him.

Kind of a lame addition to the other honky tonks on the Broadway "strip" in Nashville. While there was a little more care taken in outfitting the decor of the place to look more like a bar than a lumberyard (see my review for Tootsie's Orchid down the block), the two bartenders we had to contend with were behaving like jerks for most of our visit.  I guess they fancy themselves a place for locals, and my wife and eye stood out a little as tourists, so they came off with a bit of a chip on their shoulder.  Too many other options on the street to put up with it for very long, so we didn't.

I'm not too sure why they've gotten the "best burger in Nashville" award because really, their burgers were at best, mediocre. I definitely don't think their prices are great, over $14 for a burger (extra cost for bacon and cheese!) and even a charge for fries! Not just that, I barely even got a handful of fries (9 to be exact) and they just weren't that good. 

The wait for my ridiculous, over 45 minutes and there is was hardly anyone in here. It's constantly loud and I feel like everyone is yelling at one another. Also, it was rather cold in there and no one seemed to want to do anything.  

Overall, I'm not overly satisfied with this place. Not worth it

Pretty good buyers and if you sit the back, the music is not real overwhelming. The service was pretty standard, the decoration tho, is kinda weird, I cannot figure out what theme they were going for..all and all, ok place to grab a quick bite, not real pricy either.

This is my first time in Nashville. Everyone who has been to this town loves it and told me I would love it too. 

Someone told me Ole Red is owned by Blake Sheldon. Because he's one of my favorite singers, a group of work friends and I went to this bar as my 1st bar to visit in Nashville. 

Let's get this part right! The live music was on point. Zach Ray was the best part. 

We stop at the bar and Josh is the bartender. He can't look more unhappy. I asked what one of the wines on the shelf was because I couldn't see the label. He hands me a wine list. We order drinks. I ordered a veggie burger and he tells me to come back in 15 minutes. I come back in 10 mins because our friends parents arrived and they wanted drinks. When I walk up to the bar, Josh says, "your food isn't ready, I said 15 minutes." Me, "Okay, I understand that, I'd like to order more drinks." He just can't look anymore annoyed. 

I had my knife on my belt but it was hidden under my jacket. Chris with Security was actually a nice guy. He asked me to leave because you can't have knifes in there. His manager Jackie rolls her eyes at me, when I ask if i can keep it in my purse. "I'll show you on the front door that you can't have knifes." 

I walked to the front door and all it shows is a firearm sign. I'm not going to spend money at a place that has rude people treating their guests poorly. 

Sorry Blake. Your food was good, music was amazing; however you should take a second look at the personalities of your staff. Friendly faces and attitudes will keep your guests coming back. 

The Whiskey Bent Saloon was a lot of fun. And so was Jason Aldean's.

This is a horrible place. The band that was playing the night we came on our vacation was practically forcing the crowd to tip them and when people didn't, they accused them of being members of ISIS. The racist and also untalented lead singer was also calling out African Americans in the bar and talking about white America... We raised complaints to the bouncers who laughed and ignored us. Maybe this is normal in the South, but my friends and I live in the modern world and this is just totally unacceptable.

Whatever you do, don't go to the bar on the roof. Kimberly is the bartender up there and she could not have been more unpleasant. She seemed inconvenienced that we asked for another menu and that she had to work. The drinks were blah on the roof. Not as great as a selection down stairs. Maybe I'll try down stairs next time if i ever feel like coming back.

Tennessee Brew Works es una muy linda cervecería que se encuentra en el centro de Nashville, quizás en un lugar medio escondido, pero muy agradable y confortable por dentro.

Es de esos típicos lugares que tienen tanto la fábrica como el bar en el mismo lugar. El espacio es muy lindo y con bastante onda.

Pero lo importante, o sea la birra: probé una muy buena IPA en este lugar, posta que muy recomendable. La atención es muy buena y los precios -dentro de todo- accesibles. Tiene merchandising de todo tipo y distintas birras para llevar. Generalmente hay músicos y bandas que tocan en vivo.

Great location and super service are two of the strong points of this Broadway Bank location. Blake is doin it right with his new addition to the Broadway scene. Except this place is obviously two notches above the best of the crowd in this neighborhood. Quality, consistency, reputable and clean....all things not easily found down on Broadway. 

Has the chicken which was good. The pulled pork was delicious and sides did not fail our expectations. Try the Mac &Cheese, biscuits/gravy and bread/butter pickles. Drink selections are well planned recipes but expensive....you get what you pay for. Everything in Blake's place is high dollar, but then again when you're good you can get what you charge. 

The variety of bands is pleasant and the quality of the productions is refreshing. 

Now on to the Tishomingo location!

First off Blake Shelton owns or has his name on this place.  Who doesn't love Blake Shelton!?...well except for Miranda now but let's not get into that.  I wanted to go last June but it wasn't open so this trip we took with our 17 year old daughter, her first trip to Nashville! Ole Reds was our first stop! The initial impression was wide open space with tables. There was music playing as in most places in Nashville. We waited about 10
Minutes for a table. We sat downstairs near the stage but they also have upstairs where the bathrooms are located. Not ideal when you aren't planning on going up there but you'll need the exercise since all the food is yummy and unhealthy stuff. Or should I say all we ordered was yummy and unhealthy! They had salads on the menu. We ordered the tater tot poutine and quesadilla. We wanted to eat a little everywhere so started with these two items. They arrived and
the portions were LARGE! The poutine has lots of meat(pork) homemade tots and country gravy! They top it off with a fried egg! The quesadilla was huge and packed with chicken. A guy seated next to us had the potato chip nachos and they were HUGE!!! The food was good, I love Blake and we enjoyed the young man singing. It was a great place so not sure why the star rating isn't better. But I am an elite Yelper and it's a must stop on Broadway!

I won a charity auction for a gift certificate to Margaritaville and came with my BF on a Saturday around 1. Upon entry you hear the live music and notice the gift shop. The walls are covered in faux bamboo and the vibe is beach bum fun like every other Margaritaville I've ever been to. We were seated and ordered margaritas, the spicy shrimp app, and fish and chips.  My margarita was called the perfect margarita and that was accurate. It was potent and used fresh ingredients. The shrimp app came out and it was basically unseasoned fried shrimp topped with spicy mayo. Very underwhelming. My fish and chips came out cold so I got another order and they were much fresher. The fish is not hand battered or fresh or seasoned. I ate all the fries and left the fish. I ate my BFs jerk salmon dish with him and then we went and ate somewhere else. The food here is bland, frozen and quick but the margarita was great.
The champagne fried chicken was nothing short of amazing. Was honestly sooooo amazing. Highly recommend!

We stopped in for an early lunch. They were easily able to accommodate our party of 7 and we were seated promptly. The waitress was knowledgeable about the menu. We had 2 different adult beverages and both were great. There was live music and the band was great. We ordered the cornbread appetizer and it was amazing! We also had the pimento cheese appetizer and it was also delicious. Both my sister and I ordered the 1/2 chicken. This was A LOT of chicken but it was not good:( we wanted to like it but it was over fried. We also had the side order of Mac n cheese and it was nasty. The 3 kids wouldn't even eat it.  Overall, this was a good experience but I would not need to go back if I was in Nashville again...unless Blake was there!

The rudest staff ever. We sat at an empty table at the rooftop bar area not  knowing it was "reserved" because there was NO SIGN. The RUDEST person told us if we did not move we would be escorted out by security - REALLY????? Why not just ask us politely to move? 

If this was my restaurant/bar I would be MORTIFIED. I will NEVER go here again!
Great food and drinks. Loved the atmosphere and band. I am short (5'3) and couldn't see over the edge of the rooftop bar. Other than that, everything was great!
We went there on Monday night and it was awesome. Had the nacho's and they were some of the best we have had. The band adairs run was great. Thanks ole red, we want to come back!!

Let my preface this by saying I live in town, so I only go to Broadway when I have visiting guests who make me. That being said, I was pretty impressed with the food at Ole Red, and will definitely bring guests in the future. This restaurant had multiple vegetarian and vegan items-we had an impossible burger with tots that was delicious! We also had a chicken quesadilla that was huge- two people could definitely share that entree. There is also a vegan version of the quesadilla. The drinks are expensive for Broadway, but on par with nicer restaurants.

Stopped by the stadium to enjoy the pregame festivities out front.  Unfortunately my wife and I didn't have tickets to see the opening match of the predators .  But we had fun took a few pictures and enjoyed Downtown Nashville
As a sports nut, I had to go here and get some pics. Located downtown, so parking is a hassle just to snap some pics. Still, it is definitely worth the trip!

Buffett, I love you.  I've been to Margaritavilles all over.  This is unfortunately, the worst.  I know I'm in Nashville but I don't go to Margaritaville to hear country music.  I go to Margaritaville to hear Buffett or at the very least, trop rock.  Not in this location.  Here not only do you get live country that blares out, but it overrides the videos of Buffett.  If I wanted country I could go to the dozens of places all over downtown.  I don't want country.  I want either Buffett or trop rock. I've given up on ever being able to hear that in the Nashville Margaritaville.
The rudest bartender I've ever encountered. Every other bar was packed and this one had about 6 people there. Wonder why! Great music, cool atmosphere but HORRIBLE bartender from the Boston area!

I visited this location having never been to a Margaritaville.  Was looking forward to having some island inspired (in an American way) food.  

A friend and I met up with our group (8 total) for dinner, we were a little late due to the parking mess in that area.  They had been seated pretty quickly after arriving on a Sunday evening.  Only drinks had been ordered.  We added our drink orders to our waiter.  Other group members reported that the waiter had said they were out of a many items.  Overall, I can't remember how many things they were out of, but it was quite a lot.  

Our group orders - one young lady isn't able to get seafood mac and cheese without seafood, seems....fishy.  Another young man gets wings with two sides.  A few minutes later, waiter returns to say they're out of wings (the young man had attempted to order several other things that were also out that night).  Later, he returns to say they did have wings.  Manager follows up to tell him they did have the wings.

I settled for the BBQ chicken sandwich with fries. Everyone's food comes out and manager (there may have been two, or one in training) says "enjoy!"  My friend and I that had been late did not receive our meals.  Manger asks what we had and clearly has to place the order again.  Our party had pretty much finished eating by the time we got our plates.  We were going to ask for them to go at this point, but I was ravenous enough when the plate was placed in front of me that I devoured it in about 5 minutes.

Chicken was moist and bbq sauce had nice flavor.  Cheese was not worth the calories, but I ate it anyway, along with the bacon.  Fries were satisfactory.  I took the bun completely off the sandwich bc it was enormous.  No report from anyone else's food.

Manager did comp the late meals along with the wings of the young man.  Apologized we were not able to eat with our friends.

Did not take part in the libations, can't give a review of that.

Wish I would have tried the nachos - saw a couple of plates of them walk by and they were heaping!  They do add chili instead of just beef which always makes me a little weary and is probably why I didn't order them.  If you have friends that want to come, go ahead....but I'd rather find something local.  However, I have to commend the manager for comping 3 out of 8 of our meals.  Cannot complain of a free meal on my graduate student budget right now!

So here for lunch on a Monday. Place is just ok. 

Partner got the hot chicken said it was super good. The potato salad is good. Taste like it has ranch dressing In it. Chicken definitely the best value 

I got the catfish. Came with the good potato salad as well. The fish was good only complaint would be for $11 I kinda expected a bit more than one small piece
Absolute worst customer service, I will never be coming back to Marathon. All they care about is money, and the place is swarming with underage drunken posers.

Came here twice during Spring Break since it was one of the few places Downtown that was clean and kid friendly. Had great bands both nights. Food was just OK. Fried green tomatoes and pickles basket was mainly pickles w/only 3 pieces of tomatoes and lacked flavor. Came in for dessert second time for funnel cake but they ran out of it. Had lucky charms sundae which had good presentation but just ok.

A first Nashvillle trip.  Desired to look up Blake Sheltons new place there.  Weather hasn't been TN weather..  30's... 
seated by stage, performers were on break, hostess kind, atmosphere multi ages, 
High top and regular tables, 
Ordered crazy named quesadillas and pulled pork sandwich.  All was fresh and tasty.

Service A+
Prices A+

If ever return (warmer time) would re-do visit!

The beer is great. Don't order the charcuterie meat plate. I'd love to tell you what's on it, but the waitress never told us. There was something that resembled corn beef hash with peppers, some ground up meat, and some type of soft sausage. Yes, soft sausage...just what we all want to put in our mouth. I can't speak to the rest of the food, but it looked good.

Cool joint but watch out on Friday night's.
First visit was great but on Fridays the bouncers become very arrogant. I stepped out for a smoke and bought a Gatorade from a hot dog stand which offended the staff outside, so they allowed me no reentry, after I paid for my full beer on the bar and my meal which I didn't get to eat. I asked to speak to a manager and was instead threatened. I could see if i was being a drunken loudmouth, but being sober and only having a sip of my beer, with being treated like that is completely unprofessional. Way better venues in town.

Love the double decker patio, especially in the warmer months! TN Brewworks has a nice selection of craft brews that are not too outrageous in terms of flavor profiles. A solid handful of bar favorites to chow down on like Nashville Hot Chicken and typical brew foods. What's not typical is the unique beer flavor profiles added to the food! i.e. the 5 beer burger with "country roots" flavored onions. Definitely recommend this place if you like craft brews, good food, and nice weather!

Stopped by in Aug 2011 for a drink at the new Margaritaville in Nashville. I have been to a lot of the Margaritaville places around the world, This one was not as fun as some of the others. Vegas, Turks and Caicos, and a couple more. It is nice place for a drink and talking with friends
$5 any bottle of beer. Quick service and a cool, live band- on a Monday night. Order the IPA, it makes the bluegrass go down easy.

We stopped in early evening Saturday . We went to the 5th floor and decided to grab some food before our night was to start . We were set at a nice table and had to wait for quite a while do someone to come and check on us . We orders simple drinks and waited for 20 minutes to get our drinks . We said ok it must be an anomaly and it will get better .Very limited menus and the first item we ordered Peel and eat shrimp they were out of ... ok well we decided on a few other items . Pork Belly and grits , some picketed shrimp
And the slider trio . That order took almost 30 minutes to show up . So when received the portions were. Wet small and 3 people had a snack and 2 drinks for $120 ... what in the hell ... I live in Nashville and take guests to Broadway a lot and won't be seeing Blake's place anymore .

I've been to Margaritaville many times while I've lived here in Nashville and it comes with both pluses and minuses.

Positives:
- The vibe.  Beachy, fun vibe with great decorations and a fun gift shop for tourists.
- The music.  There are some great, live bands that pass through here and it's always great to listen to local music while you eat/drink.
- Nice people.  The bartenders and waiters/waitresses have always been very friendly!
- Great for under-21s and under-18s.  It's a great place to bring kids and teenagers if they want to experience Broadway/Nashville music after 6:00PM.

Negatives:
- No-so-great, high-calorie food.  The food isn't awesome.  Their burgers are dry, overcooked, and flavorless.  Their fish and chips are dry and taste like old fryer oil.  I've never been impressed with any of the food there and it's impossible to find anything close to healthy.
- Expensive.  Not only is the food not very good, it's also expensive.  Definitely not close to worth the cost.
-Syrupy drinks.  While there are some unique drinks that are pretty good (try the loaded Landshark - a Landshark with a shot of tequila and lime), many of their beachy drinks come from a mix and are syrupy/too sweet for my taste.  Also, my last cranberry vodka had salt in it (??)

Summary?  Great place to get a drink or two and listen to music.  I wouldn't go for the food, though!
The food here was incredible and HUGE portions! The entertainment so fun!!!! Definitely a MUST SEE!!!!

This is such a cool, unique venue. I have attended the "Boolesque" event here multiple times and always enjoy the space. The building keeps it interesting, the stage is large and the two bar locations make for easy drink access. I really enjoy the ambiance of Marathon Village in general, so I always enjoy coming here.

Finally got to go check it out with our out of state friends.  Sadly, very disappointed.  The band Russ Livermore did not play the music we hoped for and the food was typical, tourist bar food.  The fried chicken was triple hard, over fried and tasteless, the potato chip nachos were hardly touched by the four of us and the cauliflower appetizer had s good flavor but it was greasy.  We will continue to leave Broadway for food then come back to it for sightseeing.

We were thrilled to find a Margharitaville in Nashville, mostly because we know they have a good gluten free menu! This place was great when we were starving today as it was an easy walk from Music Row. We were served by the very knowledgable and helpful Samantha who answered all our questions about the menu and took great care of us. Thanks Samantha! Gluten-free cheeseburgers are excellent, we haven't tried the Volcano Nachos yet as it looks like a little too much food for us. Fun place with lovely staff and good food!

This brewery is located in the Gulch. It has a good reputation and is served in many local restaurants and bars. The taproom serves delicious food, and live music, complete with rooftop patio. 
For more brewery info visit: travelptswithacraftbeerproblem.wordpress.com

My husband and I had a great time! Our server, Ethan, was the best!  He suggested the grilled Mahi-mahi for my fish tacos and boy did he know what he was talking about!  It was wonderful!  The live entertainment was great, even if it wasn't Buffett music.  It is Nashville!  It was a great place to go and sit down and not be so crowded you couldn't enjoy yourself.

I've been to TN Brew Works twice now, and am looking forward to future beer drinking and overeating.  I had the house burger, and damn I was surprised how good it was!  One of the best burgers I've had anywhere.  They had live music playing inside, and a spacious outdoor patio with 2 levels.  The surrounding views are, shall we say, raw industrial with a bit of stalled construction work.  Aside from the unique location, TN Brew Works is legit.  The beer is great, food is great, and service was excellent.  My suggestions (besides the burger of course) are the Basil Ryeman and Southern Wit.  Please enjoy.

Skip the lobster roll.  It is literally just plain lobster sitting on a bun. The brussel sprouts, kale salad, and salmon poke salad were all very good. The ambiance was nice, and we did enjoy the live music. Overall, a nice place to eat.

Strolled in this place on a warmer than usual winter Sunday and ordered some of their chicken nachos.  I was very pleased with them.  There were way more than I could eat and lots of gooey cheese.  I wanted just straight queso, but they didn't carry it so this was the next best choice for me.  My friend ordered chicken and waffles and gave me a few bites.  That chicken was to die for.  Very tender and moist.  I was impressed since I don't normally appreciate white meat pieces.  There were two folks on the stage playing some bluegrassy-country music and they were a joy to watch and listen to.  The wait wasn't too long for the food, but couldn't even get in the place the night before.

We loved our recent visit to the Nashville Symphony to see Harry Potter with live music accompaniment. The seeds, the orchestra, the humor of the conductor, and even the snack bar was all exemplary. Great way to introduce kids to the joys of a live orchestra.

Wicked fun bar!! We went here around 8pm until 9pm. There is a massive stage that everyone crowds around watching- there's the whole crowd swaying and chatting and then a bunch of people really dancing and then the stage. The live band was fantastic- Matthew Davidson and his crew! We got vodka seltzers with limes and they were made very well and timely. Overall a great time!

I came to Nashville for fun girls weekend before my best friend moves away. Came to this bar to enjoy live music on the rooftop at about 4 pm on a Friday....bouncer SNAPPED my REAL Arkansas drivers license in half because he thought it was fake. Ruined the rest of my weekend. Can't go out with a snapped ID.

Mediocre meal, mediocre music -- not terrible by any means, but nothing special either.  Waitress was spunky and fun, but the service overall was a little casual, the food was pretty bland, and the space was an odd one too.  They did have gluten-free options though, which is why we picked it.  We probably won't be back.
Didn't stay to partake of anything on their menu-service was terrible with a F- you attitude and prices for domestic bottled beer were outrageous $6 for Miller lite. Won't be back.

#excellent

     I'm glad to have finally made it out here to this brand spankin new brewery.  This place is located just on the border downtown Nashville and sits in the midst of aged warehouses.  As I was following my GPS, I began to wonder if I was being taken to the wrong location. I drove through questionable alleys of what seemed like a ghost town. 

I finally arrived and found the facade of this new brewery to have quite the design. The design is very industrial contemporary with a slight rustic feel.  The designs are very eye appealing. A lot of natural wood is used for the table & walls which give this place warm feel.The peeps here have converted a very large rectangular warehouse into what is now Tennessee Brew Works. About 15% of the space is used for patrons to come and enjoy some brews @ a fair $5 a pop. The rest of the place is where all of the magic happens. There seems to be a lot more space here that's unused but is likely awaiting further expansion or storage.  

I visited during the 2nd weekend after the opening and was pretty impressed.  It's very simple, the staff is very friendly and attentive. The owner Garr made his rounds and came to speak with my buddy and I for about 15 minutes providing us insight the brewery's inspirations and processes of developing recipes.  I was thoroughly impressed and felt extremely welcomed by all of the people, here. 

There is a filling area for growlers which hold about 5 beers or 62ish ounces. You also have 2 bar areas, one upstairs & one downstairs where can purchase your brew & start your tab.  On the front portion of the inside of the building, you can see the exposed second floor & of course you can look down to people watch. There are long tables upstairs and a separate area close to the brewing stations where you have barrels that are used as standing drink tables. Also on the second floor, you can walk outside on a catwalk where there are even more drinking areas. Pretty cool stuff. Oh, and the front patio is pretty darn sweet. 

I tried two of the beers, I tried their IPA which was pretty darn good, the IPA had a surprisingly darker than normal IPA color. I also enjoyed the very flavorful Extra Easy Ale which had a nice bitter taste. I loved both beers and can't wait to go back and try the others.  

Food? They only have flavored prepackaged popcorn to offer though I am sure food trucks will make their rounds here at some point.  Might I suggest pork rinds from a local joint?  Mmmmmm, yes, you should sell them here, TBW. 

I loved the site and the staff here @ TBW.   The craft beer is fantastic and the location is convenient to Peg leg which is around the corner for some good ole BBQ.  

I certainly recommend this joint if you're meeting your buddies and enjoy great craft beer.  Certainly a spot to hit up if you're getting off work or making this place one of your stops during a night out on the town hopping bars.  Open till 8PM Thursday - Saturday. Tours to come, soon.  

Can't wait to get back!
Went to Ole Red tonight. Great music and good food. Had a great time and the band playing was fantastic.

As with all of jimmy buffets places you will not be disappointed! Came here for the music row happy hour featuring buzz from the highway and had a blast. 
Show starts at 3pm, doors to the second floor open at 2pm but if you want a seat upstairs you need to line up between 1130-1200 outside. When we got to the second floor we ordered some food and drinks and waited for the show to start. They had a few bucket specials so thats what we did. Food wise we got the nachos to split which were very good. Not to expensive and id say each app of nachos is good for 4 ppl to split. 
Show wise id 100% recommend it. We got on the radio and buzz and his staff were great. The wait staff and bartenders at margaritaville were also very good.

After standing in line for quite a while, we were Very disappointed in management and "corporate policy." We were in town for a concert and celebrating my friend's 35th Birthday. Her license expired at midnight, but she had a printed state of Tennessee temporary license along with her just expired license to show she is 35. If you are going to have a business in Tennessee, you need to know the Driver's License procedure and be prepared for this type situation.  It has all of the markings, etc on it to make it official.  EVERY other place we went to let us use it with her  expired license in hand. We were so looking forward to going here.  We were such @blakeshelton fans.  I have always said if there was one star I would like to sit down and have a beer with it is him.  I feel like if he knew, he would have been disappointed too.  They need to look at state of TN licensing and make a change to their corporate policies that Amy, Andrea and Chris were not so nicely pointing out. I did not get ugly, I just explained the same thing I am writing here.  The bar is in Nashville...just send the corporate employees down the road to learn the state system.  They even brought Chris the bodyguard down who was very rude, when again I was just explaining the TN process.  There is another location opening close us in Gatlinburg.  Hopefully the policies will change by the so others won't be as disappointed as we were.  By the way you lost about $200 in sales last night and we are in Nashville a lot. I know this makes no difference to corporate or the managers, especially the one there last night. #disappointed #blakeshelton #olered #nashville

Nice open space with seating on two floors, live music near the bar, great service and really good food. The portions are HUGE! I love how creatively they use lime in the coleslaw and sour cream. Great burgers. Sweet potato fries and a nice gift shop to boot! It's five o'clock all the time at Jimmy Buffet's Margaritaville.
Best service yet thanks to Bowie.. In town for the Preds game got us in and out.. again big props to Bowie..

I want to start off by saying if I could give this place 0 stars - I would. The wait to get inside wasn't too bad maybe about 5-10 minutes the problem is the AWFUL SERVICE once you get in! I went with a party of 6 and we waited at LEAST 30 minutes standing RIGHT NEXT TO THE BAR WITH CARDS/CASH in hand!! The bartender named Eric was 100% just downright rude!!!  He was so rude to all of us, that we actually just left and spent lots of money at other bars right next door/ down the street. I will personally tell everyone I know to never go to this bar and I hope that Eric finds a new job that is not in customer service very soon.

An update to this: I reached out to the management team (as they asked me to in their response below) over a week ago to discuss this and nobody responded back to me- can't say I'm surprised. Avoid this place at all costs.
Good food and outstanding music to go along with it.  Whiskeys may have been watered down slightly only thing that may have been better.  Overall, good food, good time

Fantastic experience! I visited for the first time to watch Star Wars: A New Hope (Episode  IV) and hear the score played LIVE by the Nashville Symphony. It was a memorable event and I enjoyed every moment! The acoustics were pristine from my seat about 1/2 to 3/4 of the way from the front in the center. The staff was so very friendly and helpful! I dressed up nicely for the event, which I personally felt added to the experience, but I found that not everyone was as this was attended by families with children. Surprisingly most parents respected the entire event and kept their children behaved so that others could enjoy the movie and symphony. I will definitely go back! I absolutely love my home city, Nashville, Tennessee!
Hard place to find with all the construction going on. We arrived here near closing time so didn't really get to experience all they had to offer. Beer was decent but nothing outstanding.

I have visited 5 breweries in Nashville this weekend. Tennessee Brew Works is by far the best. The beers were really good, but what sets it apart is the staff. The people working here are naturally friendly like friends giving advice and being helpful. Whereas some of the other breweries felt like I was part of a business transaction. 

The stage up front had great music and the 2 story taproom with dart boards and seating inside the brew room was great. The outside 2-level seating looked great but it was a little too hot/humid for us to be out there. 

Go here over the other brewery spots. You will not regret it.

Alright for concerts, a lot of the big stars like Lady Gaga and Bruno Mars will perform here due to the venue's size as accessibility. Hockey games here are fun, and I've seen the Preds play and WIN quite a few times which was a treat. Snacks and drinks are a tad costly - I believe my can of watery pee beer was $9 and I remember my stale popcorn or nachos always being on the pricey side as well. Your bags will be searched upon entry (I didn't mind - but just be expectant of that). The crowd control to get in and out of the arena is not very good because of this, so expect a good wait and cramped lines. We've tried different means of entry each time and haven't found any to be better than the next.
Really good.hardly had to wait for a table.and the food was great. Try the chimichurri steak.

Since this venue opened I have lost count of events I have gone to see here. May not be the biggest place, but it is indoors and the best artist come here to play. We usually have a family member drive and drop us off nearby or we get everyone in a spot and get a van with a driver to drop and return for us later when we are ready to leave Nashville. No complaint about the beer prices. I figured out years ago to wait to party after concerts instead of missing the show while in the line for the ladies room. Once the concert is over your downtown and the next phase of the night begins then. That's when you get your drink on if that's your thing. Do I miss Starwood? Of course.  But it hasn't slowed anyone who loves live music or sports. Even family entertainment like the circus and Disney on ice. Bridgestone always has A - list entertainment!!!
It's 2:30 in the afternoon, not very busy, but I still haven't seen a server since I was seated 20 minutes ago. I am thirsty and hungry, and think I will have to go elsewhere to be served.

If I could give zero stars I would. Not a fan. Staff was not friendly from the start. I had friends in from out of town and for absolutely no reason one of my friends was forcibly removed from the bar by the bouncers. I can only assume they grabbed the wrong guy but we weren't given an explanation. Or maybe these meatheads just wanted to have some fun and my buddy was the unlucky person. Whatever the reason it was totally unnecessary. Regardless I won't be back to this place ever again. I've been a resident of Nashville for 25 yrs and there's way better bars than this one anyway. My advice is don't go to Ole Red!

Our first stop in Nashville was this brewery. We loved the live music and brew style seating on the entry level. Laid back is our go-to and this place did not disappoint! The hamburger was great and our favorite beer was their seasonal Wildwood Flower honey blonde. It was seriously liquid honey, AMAZING!

I never go to breweries because I have a barley allergy, therefore I can't have beer (I know, tragic). But I met up with some friends there last night because someone said I had to try the food, and I was so happy I did. I didn't think once about not being able to drink any of the awesome beers. They do have two wine options, but I just went with water and was still extremely happy.

I had their burger and it was honestly one of the best burgers I've ever had. Super juicy, cooked perfectly, the flavors were phenomenal. The fries were also outstanding. For $15 I was a little worried but the plate is worth $15. So yummy!! My other friends had fish tacos as well and said they were great too. I love that there's parking available and it's not located on a crowded street. Really cool spot. Come here!

These guys have an awesome building it allows you to drink beer, eat food and watch operations through the windows, or play a giant game of connect four wall inside the brewery. We love the burger and the frog legs in addition to beer.

HOLY GUACAMOLE!  Their nachos prove that there is a God.  I can't tell you what's on them, even though I reviewed the menu I don't know that everything that was on the menu showed up on top of my nachos but they literally were the best I've ever had.  I seriously think about them ALL THE TIME.  The wine was good and decently priced and the waffle fries weren't very flavorful. GET THE NACHOS. 

Also, we came to hear Tessa Violet and the show was amazing. The bartenders on the stage side were great, attentive, and enjoying themselves.  Sound was great, and would highly recommend.  Show up a little early to eat the nachos then go for the show once you've finished up. 

OH, and be prepared to stand in line. It literally wraps around the building into a back dark alley. 

I love this place and would definitely recommend it!! :)
Lager Fish & Chips was really good, especially with lemon. Nice atmosphere with good live entertaining band, but long wait. It's was worth it.

Blake Shelton has referred to me as an old fart, and he's probably right, but the band at Ole Red's featured a lot of the classic music we old farts love.  Ole Red is being billed as an upscale honky-tonk which seems to be an oxymoron.  Nevertheless, it is a very nice bar, and we really enjoyed ourselves.  We were entertaining some of my wife's cousins from out-of-town, and everybody had a great time.

The staff is friendly, and helpful, and more importantly, they seem really excited to be working there.  My wife tends to judge any establishment by its Cosmos, and Ole Red makes an excellent Cosmo.  I was impressed with their beer selection, and found a very tasty IPA from East Nashville.  Go figure.  

We had tickets to a show at the Ryman, and we planned on having dinner shortly before the show.  So we thought we'd split an appetizer to tide us over until dinner.  The waitress suggested the nachos, and they were delicious. They also were served on a platter the size of Oklahoma.  Six of us were not able to finish them.  And none of us felt like dinner before the show, or after the show.

We do not go downtown often, but we are sure that the next time we have out-of-town guests, we will introduce them to Ole Red.

So I still love this place. Just wanted to update on the food. The first thing I had was the grilled cheese & it was pretty good but nothing too memorable. Well now I've had the sweet potato poutine & the fish tacos. AMAZING! Not really poutine but I don't care. So good. My friend also said best burger in Nashville. Better than Pharmacy.. Which whoa, I'm trying it next. Or maybe the sandwich with the ham. Decisions, decisions. Plus, they have new games. Love the darts and giant connect 4.

I was honestly surprised at all the negative ratings about this place.  We had a great time in here.  We wanted to stop in because we are Jimmy Buffett fans.  The food was good -- wife had a club sandwich and I had the fish tacos.  Everything tasted great.  We also ordered margaritas (I mean, it's Margaritaville) -- they were very tasty.  There was a live musician up front by the bar which is pretty typical for a place in Music City.  The musician was covering lots of different songs, took requests, and gave a nice vibe to the place.  The highlight of our visit was our server, Kiersten.  She was on it.  She made us feel like family while we were there.  Took a nice trip into the gift shop after lunch and chatted up some of their staff -- bought a T-shirt and some trinkets.  Staff was nice and friendly, and we left happy.

We stopped by for the SiriusXM Musical Happy Hour.
Great service from Kelsey. The margaritas were very good and a nice selection of local beer . The food was okay but not special. We enjoyed the show.

Terrible. I'm not a big review person, but I had to write a review on this pathetic excuse of a establishment.

Avoid at all cost. Terrible service. Overpriced. Not a good burger.

12th and Porter. What can I say. I give it five stars for lighting, four stars for sound, five stars for large and comfy-looking stage, three stars for acts, which are roller-coaster-y. Some are incredibly good. But others, you really don't know what is going on at all.  

 -1 star for nosebleed height of stage, - 1 stars for hideous, hideous junky bathroom with non-closing door and truly frightening, "junkie," dirty vibe. Please clean, it, give it a decent lock,  get that  #$% together.  Steal some of the $$ from what I'm guessing is the drug budget of your "bouncer," who doesn't seem to lead a clean lifestyle, in the grand tried and trued tradition. He was reasonably curt and distant, which I respect in a bouncer. Overly-friendly bouncers aren't good. Your bartenders were friendly. That's good.

Anyhoo, the last band I saw here that was the "hot new thing." 

 I tried to be open-minded, but there were no blue-eyed soul wonderkinds among them. Nope. It was like an awful Blues Traveler-, but without blues, or traveling. And that's if you LIKE Blues Traveler, Dave Matthews, and Phish. I realize some people do. I leave them to their private hell.  My friend and I, not wanting our soul-sucking hatred of their bland music to spread like a fog, felt the "violet death of our Goth vibes" spreading, (hehee) so we left.  

So my friend and I swore and cussed all the way out of there, then put in their CD. We're listening to it, and I'm like "They're so plastic. Do I just not get it?"

Then all the sudden, (while I'm putting on my lipgloss) a new song came on, and I'm like "Omigod! Omigod! I take it BACK! I WAS WRONG! THIS BAND IS GOING TO BE HUGE AND SELL MILLIONS OF RECORDS! THEYRE AWESOME!!" 

She was like "Dude I changed the Cd in the changer." (old car). That's Radiohead."

HAHAHAHAHHAHAHAHHAHAHAAA!

That's my 12th & Porter story.

This is my favorite venue - in the south - by far! Bridgestone always has the biggest names in music every year, from George Strait, Garth Brooks, Kelly Clarkson, the CMA Awards, Keith Urban (big country fan here!), Springsteen, Billy Joel, and countless others. 

Pros: 

The vendors on each level, they even have one off of the floor so you don't have to go up to the 100 level. 

You can see the stage from just about any seat in the house.

Tavern '96 off Demonbreun 

Cons:

The seats are small and crammed together, if you're not a stick figure or always wind up sitting by, in front of, or behind "that person", you will be shifting around to try to get comfortable. I always hope ticketmaster gives me the "pick your seat" option so I can get an aisle seat to have a little leg room. 

The escalator to go to the upper levels. There are two escalators, both going up before the show, down after. Be prepared to wait getting out, the line to get to the escalators takes a whiles There are stairs as well but you have to walk around the arena to get there.

Both cons are worth putting up with to see whoever's playing the Bridgestone!

Parking garages are close by, the closest being part of Music City Center off Demonbreun across the street, then another one is two blocks away at the library and the Renaissance. I've always received an email with the option to buy a parking pass for the Pinnacle but both of the lots I mentioned are closer and are around the same price, although it helps to buy it if a big name is playing.

10/10 would recommend. This place was amazing. We created our own flight to try 5 different beers (state park, 1927, secret city, wildwood, hippies and cowboys). I'm not a huge beer person but I did enjoy the variety they had. Their burger, fish tacos and hummus were amazing! A lot of food but we definitely didn't let any go to waste! Too good!

Amazing selection of micro brews, not to mention food that rocks! Friendly and knowledgeable staff. Super cool open space where you can either gather with a large group or take the party outside on one of the decks. Views of the actual brew floor from both floors. They have live music as well. Perfect place to watch a game of just try something new. I highly recommend.

We went in once.  The food was okay, had the 1/2 chicken in BBQ sauce or style, the breast was okay, but the leg and thigh undercooked. Bill was pricy, mostly because we had 4 drinks, at about $11.00 a pop, and just average (barely adequate) margaritas which were on the specialty menu, not great, and definitely less than expected for the price charged.  Paying for the name Jimmy Buffett.   Waitress was the best part, Annie took good care of us.  Music, fair to middling.  Would not spend time to go again, better places.

Had a fun time here. Don't remember a whole bunch, but music was great and some drunk dancing with other patrons. 
What .ore can you ask for?!

Great food.... Go for the chicken both hot and not are great.... Best music on Broadway...

And tater tots are definitely a must order

Damn good burger! Perfect set up for a beer and some food. The 1927 IPA was one of the better I sampled from the 5 taster flight they offered. Would highly recommend this spot for a good hangout spot with friends.

Excellent atmosphere always been a fan of all the margaritavilles always stop whenever come across one had the double cheeseburger in paradise make sure your hungry if you order this also had loaded tater tots appetizer also very good unfortunately couldn't be there for Friday happy hour music was good went multiple times while we were there the only place we went more than once
This is the worst arena i've ever been, come to la to see how to make an organisation, people are waiting standing for almost 3 hours now, and the show is in an hour, this place sucks,,,
Excellent spot for beer! Been here a few times and it did not disappoint! Just wish they had more seasonal Christmasy beers

We spent opening day of Ole Red at the rooftop bar to kick off CMA Fest weekend. This was the perfect respite from the scorcher down below. We sat at the far corner of the bar where Sasha took fabulous care of us. We drank a variety of craft cocktails and draft beers. The oversized pretzel with cheese sauce and roasted carrots were delicious. We tried 3 of the Pickers drinks: Blood Orange was my favorite. The Blueberry & Lemon was way too tart and had to water it down with some soda water and ice. The Mule has a nice ginger flavor. One of the Pickers Reps even gave me a nice coozy to hold my drink. We really enjoyed our time at Ole Red.
Neat little brew pub, Natchez is a great beer. Not exactly a hardcore beer spot, more mainstream. I bet it's sweet in the summer.

Although I'm not a beer drinker, I really love this new hangout spot and the great atmosphere. I anticipate that summer will be hopping here. My husband really enjoyed the brews and our group enjoyed the board games at each table even more. Will definitely visit again!

It all depends what you're looking for. If you're looking for a meal, don't recommend. The reviews we read were amazing, but not our experience. The service was terrible, and the food menu was limited and not appealing. The beer list is 'meh.' What is it with these pretentious places that charge $15 for a burger and have to have their own special "Basil Ryeman ketchup". We're going someplace else.

This atmosphere was so fun! We went for dinner and there was live music and the guy was wonderful. Pulled pork was not so good but cheeseburger was SO GOOD. Drinks were very tasty. I recommend this place is you're in town.

I don't think I have ever had a more atrocious experience at a bar in Nashville than I have at Winners. Stevie, our female bartender, was an utter bitch. When we tried to ask her for food she was immediately irritated and refused to serve us. She continued to pass us by as we sat at the bar trying to get service. Her attitude was absolutely awful. I have never seen a more emotional, more inept bartender than this girl. Rather than serve customers, she would choose to greet her fiends instead, who were not here to stay. I would suggest that anybody considering this bar stay as far away as possible due to the level of incompetence held by the bartenders.

Rude and slow service. Stay away! We went there on Thanksgiving day. It took about 20 minutes to catch the waitress to give our order. She simply ignored us as long as she could. After giving our order, we waited about 45 minutes to have our food. She didn't even bother to come and say sorry. She doesn't care if customers are happy. The place is on Broadway. It's convenient for people to stop by and grab some foods. That's why this place is still in business. I don't think people like to go there twice. Worst restaurant experience ever

Margaritaville Nashville was an okay experience, but I wouldn't necessarily recommend it to others nor return personally. The best comments I have about this restaurant involve the decor & live music. The location is ideal, right in the heart of broadway, the live music is a nice touch, and the decorations are fun (fake palm trees, fake tiki torches, etc.). Cool vibes overall so fun if you're just looking to grab a drink. 

The food was definitely nothing to be excited about. The menu lists the calories next to every menu item, which is helpful, but also disappointing when every entree item is over 670 calories (most are 1,000-4,000). Makes it almost frustrating to know the calories but having no options to chose any lighter choices if it pains you to know that the delicious seafood Mac and cheese you're eyeing has like 2,500 calories. I went with a salad, which was soggy and unappealing. The margaritas were okay, but I'd recommend ordering them without salt because mine was super salty. That being said, my family had a far better experience and enjoyed it more than me!

Decent facility. Went here to see Jimmy Buffet. It was beyond a disgrace. He stinks. To be subject to even 30 minutes of the noise he considers music is a punishment beyond imagination. I had an extra ticket and gave it to a homeless person. My biggest regret of my early 20's was not giving that homeless person all of my tickets. My friends that I brought don't intend to associate with me going further (rightfully so).
Service was very slow. Bartender backed up. 15 minutes to get drinks. Group was ok but laid back. Tootsies, Nudies and Like Bryant's were much better.  However, the food was good

This place was great for the alcoholic drinks, live music and service. Great location in the middle of broadway too. I should have gotten the cheeseburger in paradise - all three of my friends did and they loved them. I got the shrimp and grits and they were way too dry and tasteless. I prefer for the shrimp tails to be cut off and these were not.

This place is alright, went here on a Friday night and the atmosphere was pretty chill. The reason I'm rating 3 stars is because my girlfriend ordered a top shelf drink and the bar tender started off pouring her rail liquor. 

She corrected her but she left the rail liquor in the drink and shortly afterwards my girlfriend felt sick (not because of being too drunk, cause and effect of the rail liquor). We had to end our night early due to this so if you really can't stomach cheap liquor, make sure they pour you the good stuff.

PERFECT!!   Perfect ambiance, perfect level of music, perfect service, food cooked perfect (we had a burger and Cobb salad, strongly recommend Cobb). 

We went there a second time in 4 days and nothing but perfect. COLD BEER, great staff attitude even at the opening bell of 11 am.
Fun, fun, fun! Great atmosphere, good drinks, awesome band and a happy crowd. Doesn't get much better than that!

First time to Nashville so definitely not an expert but we really liked this place!! A) Portions are huge B) The service was awesome C) the food we ordered was delicious. My sister had the fried chicken, my mom the nachos, I had the jalapeño wings, my other sister the ham and cheese sandwich with tater tots, and someone ordered onion rings...all of it was so good! We had beers for lunch...draft beer is cold! Highly recommend! And music was not so loud that you could not talk...I would have gone here again but it was a short trip.

Enjoyed getting stuffed here last night! I ate way too much! The Redneck Nachos were great and the pork steak and potatoes were delicious. The wait staff were courteous and on the ball. Live band played great music. Seating on the main level is by reservation and was about an hour wait. Seating on the second level was first come first served. We were able to snag a table pretty quickly but as the night progressed it did seem to be a little more difficult.

This was our last stop on Broadway at about 11pm. We were not able to enter in the front. They send you to the side entrance not a big deal just odd. We wanted to go to the roof,so we took the elevator, very quick. Downstairs had live music with the second level overlooking it. When we got to the roof there was someone playing live. He was set up in one of the booths. Seems like that forgot to build a spot for artists to play on the roof. We sat outside and it does have one of the best views. Overall it was a good spot to finish up the night.
What a pleasant surprise. Nashville has a beautiful symphony hall. We saw the Music of Led Zeppelin with the symphony. What a fabulous experience! A must do in Nashville.

We had lunch here on Monday, right before we flew back home. It was quiet, service was great, and the food was also really good! We had drinks because the drink specials were killer! Our waitress was so nice, and made conversation with us for a while. Besides the great service I could tell she was good at her job because of the relationship she had with her regulars at the next table. Will be back!

Can't say much for the Buzz show. In 1 hour he spoke to the audience 3 times (not sure if more on air that we didn't hear). He only talked with those on stage that were "picked ". FINALLY after an hour he went into the crowd. But then went back to stage. No price break for drinks. In fact appear more than other places in town. We understand they only allow 400 people in. They let more in as people leave. However, there's only about 40 tables. So lots of people standing. There's a large couple of walls that separate the side bar/sitting so you can't see the action if you aren't in the main area which is small. Can't say anything much for the bartenders either. They have an attitude for sure. One positive they finally turned on a close circuit tv for viewing in side bar area. Can't say we'd wait again to go in. NOT worth the hype!
