Meanwhile, I've been standing near the balcony eyeing the other levels and looking at our tickets, and still believe that we had reserved seating, so I hiked back down the stairs to talk to the women who ushered us up stairs. She was nice and told me that I had purchased a general admission ticket, and told me again that I had access to the second floor, except the railing. I walk back up stairs to the second floor and make three or four laps around to try to find anywhere to sit. No available seats at all. So I walked back up to the third floor and find my boyfriend who is still waiting on fried pickles (at this point it had been 20mins). While we were waiting, we pulled up the tickets and were still convinced that we should have seats, as the tickets have seat numbers on them, so I go back downstairs to talk to the seating lady once again. This time I show her my ticket and where it has a seat number listed. She begins explaining the seating on the second floor and told me that the seats where labeled with the seat number and then begins looking for a 2nd Floor Map. At this time, a manager (I assume, because he was in a suite and tie) comes by and says it's general admission ticket. So, I show them on their website where it says "tickets are reserved seating on main floor rows 5 and back along with elevated booth areas." I also pointed out that there were $10 tickets listed on their website as "general admission" and I should be a tier up from that. If I wanted to stand I would have paid for the $10 tickets and saved myself a ton of money. At this point, I can tell that the seating lady has gotten frustrated with me. They begin explaining that Tickmaster makes them assign seating numbers and that's why there's a seat listed on the ticket. I feel stupid and embarrassed that I've had to talk to her THREE times and still don't understand how their seating works. This conversation ended with me walking back up the stairs to the third floor, only to find out that we still don't have our pickles (45 mins at this point and the people sitting next to us had ordered and gotten their food within 10 mins). I thought I was going to come in, be seated, eat dinner and watch the show and up to this point, my feet were hurting, I was angry and I had no food. After about another ten minutes without food, I decided to go ask the staff about our order. The food runner was very nice and apologetic, and told me that I would have the order in a few minutes. He comes back over to us to tell us that he can't find out order, asks us for a receipt (who keeps those?!) he gets the order confirmation number and comes back a third time only to have me write the order down on a piece of paper because they have no record of the order. Another ten minutes later and we finally get our pickles. They were gross. Soggy. The ranch that accompanied them was like flavorless watered down sour cream. I am starving, and hangry, so I eat them, begrudgingly. The show begins and a few more awful things happen (drunk girl spills entire drink on our coats and cellphones, but I'm not going to blame WH Saloon for this. It certainly didn't help the evening get any better). We ended up leaving early and left feeling ripped off.
Amazing bartenders and I loved the fried pickles - some of the best I have ever tasted. I would love to go back and try more of their food.

Not sure why this place doesn't have better reviews. We honestly didn't even look before we went. We went on suggestion from family. Glad we did. We went twice. Once for drinks and music and went back the next day for lunch. 

The night for music and drinks. We stopped in for drinks and and there was a great band playing. Stood in the front bar area. The drinks are strong there! My only complaint was that my drink was way smaller than my cousins and they were the same price. 

The day for lunch. Still another great band. Sat at a high top in the back area. The waiter was great. Super attentive. The bushwhacker was really good. Basically an adult frosty. We got the pulled pork nachos to start. Wow were they yummy. The bbq was really good too. We got some kind of pork loin melt. It was really good too. The band that day was awesome as well. Even brought a little girl on stage so she could sing the song she requested. 

We would definitely stop on here again on our next trip to Nashville.

Touristy af so if it's your first time in the city, go! Line dancing lessons (we did two and it was two different dances) tho the girls teaching them looked so bored. Fun atmosphere and you can sit and people watch if you're lame and that's your thing...or git up there on the ol' town road and ride til you can't no mo'. Anyways yes go. Margarita had enough kick w/o being too spicy. Pickles are good but I'm from TX so fried food is in my blood, and decent amount for the price. Ladies say hi to Barb for me - she the real MVP!!

Fuck this place. Tried to wait for a dumb outside seating and the dumbfuck fucked us and skipped us on the list for 45 MINUTES!!!!!!!!' When they said it was an only 20 minute wait. Got a parking ticket because of the dumbass who LIED ABOUT CALLING US!!!! Fuck this place. And the people who run this shitty place.

Love the classic ambiance here. Live music seems to be great everywhere in Nashville but I like that this place is less touristy and more local authentic Nashville. The audience is less juvenile and not pretentious at all. We enjoyed ourselves so much!

Horrible customer service. When the 6 of us walked in for dinner we were told to just grab some tables and put them together. Apparently it's not the job of the wait staff to ensure parties are accommodation? So we put two tables together and then one of the staff cone to us and say you can't move that table because it's in a different wait section, she must have been in a bad mood because of her total bitch attitude. We went to a different area, 10 feet over, and asked about moving two tables that were literally 5 feet apart and they told us no again. We ended up having to sit at 2 different tables, less than 5 feet apart....

Music was great, server was friendly enough but barely attentive talking to other staff. We had to keep flagging him down and it was not busy. Overall though he was fine and very quick when we got his attention. The bartender was abysmal and ruined the dinner. Drinks tasted terrible on the second round and she refused to fix it. She was rude and refused to break a twenty so we could tip the waiter. She was dismissive and a downright bitch. I've bartenders for years and I have no idea how she makes a living with her bad attitude. I guess that's why she's working on a Tuesday.

I was recommended this place by a friend of mine who mentioned their moonshine. We were offered a sample and how to drink it. The best moonshine I've ever tasted that will definitely clear your system out. The Moscow mike was made to perfection and very tasty. Check out this gem.

This is my first Yelp for TPAC. I didn't think about doing a review until now. Of course every time is a different experience but always a good one. People who work here are very friendly and helpful. Parking isn't bad. We park and walk over from near the State Capital area. I've seen many shows here and most are really good. The only reason I say most is because I'm a G or PG kind of person. It's always a fun date with my best friend, my husband. Sorry they don't allow pictures during the show.

Great live music venue.  During the Titans night game at end of Dec 6 of us walked in and easily found a table. Dance floor was full. Line dancing to Tom Petty's Mary Jane cover was uniquely good. 
Drinks were reasonable inexpensive. Parking is a challenge especially during a game day. But found a spot one block back towards the river and two blocks down. $20 for three hours.  

Shelby Lee sang his heart out and even made Garth Brooks and AC/DC sound as if they could be sang next to each other.  People watching is the best thing to do here.

Mediocre at best. Go there for drinks. I had pulled chicken sandwich & fries. The pulled chicken was barely warm. Th bun seemed like the kind you buy in bulk at SAMs or Costco. The sauce tastes like anything I can get at the store.

Awesome bar. One star for one reason.  My wife was going to the bathroom and the woman working in the bathroom was passed out on the ground. My wife is a muse and went into nurse mode. I was there talking to the manager and everything was good besides people were trying to go into the bathroom and they couldn't. So he called a bouncer over to help point people to the other bathroom. As I'm standing there with my wife and my mom (who are both helping) the bouncer comes up to tell me to "get the fuck out of here before I beat your ass". As I'm helping someone who is in need of medical attention. Everyone was cool besides that one guy but that put a spur taste in my mouth. It was 5/18 at 0600PM and he was working the front but not the front door. Standing right by the gift shop.
Service was really good considering there wasn't empty table.  Food was great and more impressive was the fact it was hot.  Music was to bad either.
Grumpy service and TWENTY FIVE % tax on liquor!!! Rip off!! Not worth it unless you don't drink liquids.

Was this place fun, sure? If you're into the whole hipster/hippy/unbathed atmosphere. 

I'm not at all a fan of how they run their karaoke, instead of writing your name and a song down you're entered into a rotation which takes far too long to get through. 

The crowd was incredibly friendly as was the chick running the karaoke, but this places takes the term "dive bar" to a whole new level. You can literally only get beer, water, or soda. The worst part for me was the poor ventilation and the smoking. I needed a nebulizer treatment after leaving this place. I recommend it if you're looking for a fun drama free bar. And if you enjoy wearing black framed glasses with no lenses, you'll fit right in.

Ask to be seated to listen to the band.  Was told there would be one on 3rd floor soon- they had Just had not started yet.  Was told this as hostess walked off.  However, with the other bands playing you get parts of the music from other levels and it sounds like they are off key and music is mixed together.  

Wait staff was not friendly and drinks were not that great.  Had to stop staff to get refills on tea, coke etc.
Service was great. However, I Got food poisoning from the pulled pork sandwich on 1.25. Not cool.

More 2.5 stars, but definitely not a 3. It's definitely not what it was many years ago. Although they are still doing some dances I did in the line dance craze from 20 years ago. Used to be a great place for dancing, but with their variations to the dances, it's hard to just jump back in at all these years and look like you know what you're doing. And there was not much 2-stepping. 

Came here with a reunion and we reserved a space on the second floor for over 100 people to include BBQ buffet. It was a Saturday night and the place was not packed. With the quality of food served on the buffet (1/2 star), I'd rather have not paid what we paid and just walked in downstairs and gotten tables to order from the menu or just get drinks from the bar, since drinks (outside tea and water) were not included in our price. 

The salad dressings had no flavor, the roasted herbed potatoes were way undercooked, and the "brisket" (depending on the batch that came out) was soggy and pink in the middle or a grey overcooked blob. It was more like a roast sliced like brisket, than it was true brisket. The baked beans and rolls were the only decent food on the buffet. I didn't bother to try the peach or apple cobblers. So definitely not worth the $70 per person to basically have special access to a bar and a couple pool tables. 

Didn't bother to go down for dancing. Lots of little kids running around on the floor and somebody's toddler throwing temper tantrums and laying in the floor. Dance floor is about half the size it used to be.

The live music acts were pretty good though. 

It's really just a tourist place these days, known for its past. I think big country stars taking over old bars on Broadway and putting their names on it are taking the toll on stuff off the strip. People choose here because it's not crowded.

I can't complain about this place. There were multiple bands, the place was full, and we didn't have to wait long to be seated.

The wait staff was good, understanding we were in a rush.

The food was tasty. Nobody was unhappy in our party with a wide variety of food. The prices were reasonable as well.

I would recommend.
Food was good and the band was great. I'd definitely come back. The place has a great atmosphere for sure.

Stopped in for the CMA Fest. Bar tenders were on point. They open beer bottles like champs. Crazy to watch them. I got fried pickles and nachos. I am picky about my fried pickles and they were awesome. Spears not chips and well fried. Worth it. The nachos had chili which was an awesome surprise. Band on the top floor was rocking but they did a lot of repeats. First time seeing a female singing in a bar since being in Nashville. Overall, nice bar to be at during CMA Fest

Food was mediocre for how expensive it was. Ordered spoon fries and they were cold. Bartender wasn't very attentive. People were trying to get his attention and he was ignoring them and acting like he was busy when the place was empty. He also forgot to put my order in and when I asked about my food he said he never heard me place an order...but everyone clearly remembers him saying my order back to me.  The entertainment made the environment somber. The musicians were playing sad songs about suicide and just killed everyone's drinking vibe. I spent $44 on 2 drinks and fries with tip. The place needs work so until then go somewhere else that's already established. This is definitely the B team who can't work on Broadway.

Dropped on for a quick drink as the place had A/C and some fine live music (@Britney_Monroe). 

Service was good. Extensive TN brew list and cocktails.
My coworker and I loved our meals there. So fresh and tasty. Definitely recommend. Service was great too. We went for lunch
Good place to bring family and just to hang out and have a drink. Great music form live band good bbq menu and family friendly entertainment.
Went here before concert at bridgetone. Amazing grilled chicken salad with blue cheese dressing. The mozarzarella sticks and queso dip was good as well.

Maybe I'm partial to Texas bbq or maybe this place is just truly mediocre. I had seen Instagram pics of their salad and it looked pretty good. I got the house salad and asked the waitress chicken or pork, and she said pork all the way. The pork was okay and the salad was okay. Nothing special or amazing. I think I might have even liked the chicken better. I guess I'll never know bc I prob wouldn't get it again. 

The live band and their music were all very good and entertaining. This place has a fun atmosphere and lots of space upstairs and down. If I came back, I would prob just stick with getting drinks and listening to music!

I overall enjoyed my experience here, despite the odd impression I got from the hostess when we entered the restaurant the rest of our dining experience was very pleasant. Our server was VERY pleasant and attentive. I will absolutely return.

SLOW SLOW SLOW. We stopped here on Saturday because we like to try a new restaurant every Saturday. We were hoping this was going to be a great one! Sadly it was not. We ordered our beer and appetizer at the same time. Did not get our beer until after the appetizer was finished. Then received our food 45 minutes after that (for only two people, should not take that long) and the food wasn't even worth the wait. The catfish tacos were so bland and gross. The turkey sandwich i had was meh. You can get it anywhere.
Phenomenal food and awesome music performances and line dance classes. The Mac grilled cheese sandwich is INCREDIBLE. Come hungry!

We were staying at the attached hotel, Cambria, so upon wondering in one night from Broadway, we decided it would be the easiest thing to grab some night caps and snacks before heading up stairs. NashHouse's theme and menu are very similar to many other places in this area Nashville, with the live music and the southern fare based menu. 

Food: While we didn't have a full meal, we did get the Bacon Queso dip that came with unlimited chips. I couldn't really tell if it was fully infused with bacon or the bacon pieces crumbled on top gave it the "bacon". Either way, it was a decent bowl of cheese dip that certainly hit the spot. In addition to the app, my partner got the banana pudding - two thumbs up from him! 

Drinks: We both got cocktails, one was a house specialty and the other was a basic Gin & Tonic. No major complaints here, they came out quick, cold and FULL of liquor. The bartender was certainly not shy with their pours! 

Service: This is where things became a slight bummer for me. As mentioned above, the place was not packed and there seemed to be several wait staff working the floor. However, when it came to our waiter, he seemed rushed, disinterested and disconnected with our experience as a whole. Once we were sat, it took several minutes for him to swing by and get our initial order. During this conversation, he was clearly distracted and rushed, as when asked about a particular drink he answered with vague "yeah, sure" and "I think its good". Additionally, during our entire 1 hour visit, he came by twice. It wasn't a total experience derailer by any means, but it was certainly frustrating. 

Overall, we enjoyed the music, our drinks, the queso and dessert. It's a solid restaurant with a great location and given the chance of us staying at Cambria on a future trip to Nashville, we would certainly swing again.

In town for the EMS expo. Had dinner there last night- server was attentive even though the place was packed. Had the BBQ wrap - so large that I used a fork to eat it all. My hubs gad the chicken wrap- good but not hot in the center, Fries were good and hot. The band sounded great. Got a little people watching in too- a bird pooped on someone by the rail- he was a jerk about it too! LOL! It's a rooftop open air venue idiot!!!
Comfort foods with a twist.  The short rib grilled cheese is great.  Some of the better food in the Lower Broadway area.

Awesome pizza with a light, bubbly, crispy crust, and perfect cheese/sauce/topping ratio.   If you saw me you would know, this guy loves a carnivorous lifestyle. During this visit to Soulshine I opted for the magic mushroom pizza, which was a magically delicious vegetarian option. 

We sat upstairs where the stage was occupied by a local musician. The owner even came and sang the song that inspired him to become an entrepreneur. It made for an authentically local feeling atmosphere. 

If you find yourself in music row, mosey on over to Soulshine and eat a slice!

Stopped in here for lunch. So many choices downtown. We were happy with our choice. Of course there is live music in all the downtown eateries. We shared a sampler plate of ribs and pulled pork. Both were yummy. Our server was very friendly and helpful when we asked for directions.
I had the pork salad, the pork was good the salad was ordinary and the waiter jokes were rude

The food was good but the service was lacking. I had the ribs with pimento Mac and cheese. Nice dinner. Also has the pickles as an app. Also good. 

When we arrived their wasn't a hostess for about 5 minutes so we were just hanging out at the stand. Then once we finally got seated it took another 10 minutes to get our drink order taken. This timely service continued for our whole meal.

These crab cakes are for real! Chef Adam from Baltimore really rocked the kitchen and I can see why the wings won so many awards! Jessica was the best server we have had this entire trip and we will definitely be back! Great hospitality, fabulous food, fun environment. Can't wait to come back
Our waiter was lethargic, queso was cold. Entrees were decent but wasn't impressed.  Also, didn't expect to pay broadway beer prices thus far off of broadway.
We did a group event here so did not order off menu. Our buffet had pulled pork and beef brisket - both good. Overall good food and decent venue.

I stopped by in the evening for lunch and drinks. I went upstairs where there was a live band and good view of broadway. I sat next to the open window so I had good seat. I ordered some BBQ ribs and the Tennessee lager, which is good. The food, beer and music were all fantastic.

Went to Big Machine Distillery downtown Nashville yesterday.  The service and alcohol smarts of  everyone there was off the charts.  First off I'm a loyal Tito's guy,  but their Vodka was really smooth. Ended up buying a lemonade slushy w Vodka-unbelievably good. Now I'm back home in Indiana trying to duplicate it with the big bottle I bought. I will certainly keep buying Big Machine Vodka.

My friends and I went in to be involved in the "line dance class." I wouldn't go just for that because they only taught one dance and it was too short, but we had a great time. If you are a fast learner you can stay on the dance floor and learn other line dances from other people. It is a huge space and very clean.
Great service!! Good ribs and best homemade pecan pie!!Worth a stop when in Nashville

Went here to show my dad Nashville and experienced the rudest bartender ever. I politely said "whenever you get a chance" and Adam replied "if you keep bugging me I'm not gonna answer you"..... this was the first time I had spoken to him.  Had to go to the other end of the bar to finally get a drink. Awesome atmosphere but definitely ruined the night because of poor service and a rude bartender. Manager was awesome and bought us a round.

Yo, worst brisket I've ever had--there was no fat whatsoever in this brisket. It was dry, sliced thin, and had nooooo flavor other than cooked meat. I didn't hate the visit--two stars because the atmosphere was good and service was acceptable. But I would not recommend this place as a BBQ destination by any means. Try your luck elsewhere.

we have people in our group who are not able to eat spicy food. We asked them if the barbecue was spicy and got the sampler platter when they told us that it was not. Everything in the platter was spicy and covered in the hot sauce from the week. When we spoke to the waiters they didn't seem to care.

We were told this was the place to be. And it was a lot of fun! Love music, great vodka, slushie drinks, and friendly bartenders. 

I was here on a weekday, so it was a bit quiet, but nevertheless it was a great time & we bought some vodka to bring home with us.

This is a great venue.  I can park close by and there are restaurants within walking distance, so TPAC makes for a great, easy date night destination.

Inside, it's easy to find my seat, and the very well staffed with helpful ushers everywhere.  The size feels perfect - big enough to feel like something big, but small enough to see well from pretty much every seat.  I've not had a bad seat acoustically, either, so it's a real treat to hear good music here.
We waited 40 minutes while looking at empty tables. The fried pickles made me sick. Our waitress, Octavia was the best part of this experience.
Charged my diabetic friend $14 for a shot of whiskey. That seems ridiculously overpriced. I wouldn't even pay that much here in NYC unless it was a super high end club.

Imagine Chuck E. Cheese except the mechanical animal band is replaced by human beings. I have never been in a "bar" that had so many kids running around acting a fool. I can't imagine the band being enthused to see a troop of 8 year olds playing slip and slide on the dance floor. Perhaps the blame should be placed on their parents who were shotgunning Bud Lights on the sideline, but then again, what kind of "bar" allows you to roll in with a half dozen 4th graders per adult. Needless to say, I couldn't even give this place a fair shot as I was dodging out of control kids running around while I tried to walk around. I guess the decor was cool, except my focus was on the wild pack of hyenas running around...

I felt that this review needed and update after my most recent experience.  After dealing with terrible service, an even worse response from the manager and then finally my card overcharged for a tip I did not intend to leave (for the first time in my life), I was ready to start picketing in front of Soulshine.

When I called to dispute this, ready for more trouble, I dealt with a manager named Kent.  He took responsibility, apologized and made the issue right.  Amazing how quickly some good customer service redeemed this place for me.  I plan to return soon and try some more of this great pizza.

This is just a great old school honky tonk music hall with a lot of history.  The beers are cold and the music is fantastic.  It was mostly older folks cutting a rug out on the dance floor but they have far better moves than most young folks I've seen so I enjoyed watching their skillful dancing along with the great music.  This is a nice spot to catch some great music for the price of what you pay for your drinks. Friendly folks, great bartenders, great music and just a great time along with very easy parking.
Featured in the center of the menu is Nashville hot chicken. 6:30 Saturday night they are out. Lack of photos of this entree leads me to believe this is a common occurrence. Great service though!

I tried to eat at the restaurant at 2:15am and the security Guard (L. Smith) was so rude and did not let me in the door. He wanted to arrest me for trying to enter the building. The google app says they close at 3am. Fake advertising !!! Don't eat Rippy's, they are so unprofessional. # is about a 2
The food at Nashhouse is awesome! Atmosphere is great. Good place to watch the predators and titans game

The food was pretty good (fried pickles were yummy) but definitely not worth the money. My boyfriend and I got two drinks and two burgers and our bill came out to be 70$! Save your money and go elsewhere.

The wait was unreasonably long and the service wasn't great, but the food was very good. The fried pickle chips were out of this world and the bbq was fantastic. 

The live entertainment was very good (as with most places in Nashville), and the environment was fun and family friendly.

Great place to hit downtown if u want all the flair of a southern hospitality, good live music, and delicious southern standard dishes.....without the sticky floors and over served crowd down on Broadway. 3 floors all w a stage view. Service is friendly and prompt. Clean bars,  floors, and bathrooms. This place runs like a Disney resort with some southern flavor added in. I really enjoyed myself as a guest from out of town and was made to feel welcome.

We came here for a birthday celebration and it was a party of 16.  It was a Saturday night, and a little empty when we arrived at 6:00, but we were happy to see our table was ready.  We were also happy to see that they featured live music. The restaurant filled up quickly.  The venue is very Country/Nashville themed;  but more upscale than the other crowded touristy places along Broadway.

Our waiter was Trenton, and he did an outstanding job of keeping up with everybody's food and drink orders.  Plus he was able to accommodate our large party with separate checks.  I had heard that the chicken fried chicken was outstanding so that is what I ordered.  It came with a biscuit, gravy, and onion straws on top.  Delicious!  Two friends had the salmon entree and they both said it was wonderful as well.  There were 4 or 5 people who ordered the steak.  They all had the same comments; over cooked (too well-done,) but still good quality steak & flavorful.  There was another person who ordered the pulled pork.  I thought it smelled delicious, but she said it was just ok. 

They had a full bar, lots of signature cocktails and local brews as well.  I got to try a few new beers and Trenton was happy to provide me with samples  beforehand so I could find some I like. While we were there we saw 3 local performers on stage.  I liked that they had short sets so you could see 3 different musical styles during our dinner.  All were talented!

The restaurant also provided one free birthday dessert and it was enough to feed 16 people!  Brownie sundae....also delicious!  Great times at s great place!
Tons of fun. Had a blast with the band and the service was great. Live music on each floor. 3 bands in total.

2 stars because the service sucked! Great place but they need to train the servers. Didn't know the menu and stopped coming to the table after food was served. Great band. Food over priced for the quality.

Excellent Burgers but worst customer service. Ordered Spicy burger from the menu. Noticed Burger had bacon on it, mentioned Waiter there should be no bacon according to the menu so she removed it and brought the same burger back with an attitude. Asked for a new burger and she rudely said " I can't get you another one". Spoke to the Kitchen Cook and she was nice enough to make another burger without bacon.

Not really impressed.  Expectations weren't high to begin with and unfortunately they didn't improve. Music was decent, but ridiculously loud (and we were sitting very far from the rooftop stage). Plastic cups and plastic, pre-packaged silverware. My paper napkin smelled like the pepper that was in the plastic wrapper with it.  Not good.  We had nachos and the bbq chicken dinner. Food was ok, but sooo overpriced for the quantity and quality.  Drinks were a little on the pricey side as well.  Won't be back anytime soon.
As always great food! Brisket was excellent! A must stop every time I go to Nashville!

Had such a great time!  A friend suggested stopping here for line dancing lessons. We stopped in and ended up
Eating lunch. Food was yummy. We ended up
Spending 2 hours here. Family friendly. Lots of fun.

I have never felt the need to write a Yelp review until last night. While trying to get a cup of water at the bar, the bar tender asked why I wasn't drinking then when I followed up again screamed at me "If you want a water go drink out of the bathroom sink!" 

I know she wasn't making a tip off of a cup of water, but when someone is trying to be safe, or sober drive their friends home that cannot happen. Not to mention it's probably illegal to deny someone water at a food/bar establishment. 

I hope that my complaint was actually delivered to the manager as I was insured it would be.

Fun local place with cheap bar food and drinks. Go on a Saturday night to see Nathan Belt and the Buckles... such a great band playing Elvis, Johnny Cash, etc.  Nothing fancy at this place but great people watching and great music.

Went to this place for lunch during the CMA Fest and the food was fantastic! I ran back the next day and was met with major disappointment. Instead of fried cauliflower I was met with coleslaw. Instead of a pick 2 meats I was only allowed one. Had a fantastic waiter now I have someone rude. For someone who works in the vacation capitol of the world I know something about customer satisfaction and this is how you will fail. Be consistent. Yesterday's experience is nothing of today's. Today you fail.
All 5's! It was great! My parents and I had so much fun with the music and walking around

I Was delighted with my meal experience here. The music was good and my smoked chicken platter was amazing. Loved the bbq sauce options as well. This was exactly what I was looking to experience when visiting - good food, good people and good music. Solid service!

Many of the Broadway bars are the same.  They are overcrowded, extremely dirty, have bad service, and very overpriced drinks.  Rippy's is no exception to this.  The reason they are rated a 3 instead of a 1 is because they do have seating available to people watch and they have one good drink, the bushwhacker.

This place will rippy-you-off ...I couldn't recommend only because the portion sizes for the money you pay. Geat quality but not worthy of us returning when there are so many other places to try in Nashville
The Yee Haw was a great drink served in a plastic cup but larger than some of the other drinks they serve. These drinks at $9 ....And I say give me a break.
For 1 meal (pulled pork with 2 small sides) and 2 beers and 2 mixed drinks was way over priced for the quality

Slow service, average bar food. I lived in NYC for a few years so I'm hard on pizza but this place was not good. We had apps, pizza, sandwiches, and none of it was anything above chain restaurant quality.

Had to practically beg our waiter for water. Our apps came out WITH our food after about 45 mins of waiting and a member of our group checking up TWICE. Never going back after that.

Added a star because they have live music...but there's live music everywhere here. Not worth the hassel or prices. Go to Castrillos in Sylvan Park.

So much fun! The line dancing lessons were fun. The live band was really good!! The food was excellent. The only downside to this place was ordering food & drinks. You have to order from the bar. The line to order took 30 min at one point.

The place was not crowded at all we were seated immediately upon entering. We ordered tea came very quickly then ordered appetizer wasn't sure yet what we wanted for lunch. Appetizer came fairly quick we placed our order & then sat for one hour! As we started approaching the 45 min mark we noticed people who
Had been there when we first got there just receiving their food. Pancakes...one of the easiest quickest items to make. However upon noticing more no entire table ever got their food together. Witnessed 2 people from another table finally get up from their party of 6 chases waitress down stand there until she handed them 2 plates not at their table. The people walked back to the table and immediately boxed it up because the rest of the table had long finished their lunch. Finally brought us 2 of the 3 orders for the table. With the excuse they were backed up in kitchen mine would be out in 2 minutes tops! 8 minutes later I finally got the attention of our waitress who was also the bartender could she please check my food. She stays gone for several minutes then the manager brings my plate to apologize. The other 2 plates we received Luke warm steak frites & chicken fried chicken. I told her that. Then cut into my chicken fried steak thinking ok should be piping hot because of the wait no not even a little it was like warm the potatoes under were cold. So unsure what the hold up was for an hour when we received cold food. By this point I'm almost in tears. We are from out of town was leaving that day cake here before the crowds for Easter lunch that was cold after waiting forever. The manager comped our entire meal. We ate our cold food because by this time we were all starving. The food had potential it was good. Would have been much better hot or even warm!  
Watched the couple in booth next to us have the same issues. Got their drinks, got their appetizer never got food. Watched them go to bar to chase the bartender/waitress down to question where their food was. She told them it was coming right out. 5 min later they chased her down again where she shrugged her shoulders & told them theirs had been comped she really didn't know where their food was.  
You knew it was Easter you would have probably more customers than usual. But when we were there maybe 25-30 customers when we left double. I honestly wanted to tell the people sitting waiting to just leave you will never get served food & if you did it will be cold! The bathroom looked like it hadn't been cleaned since early the day before. Garbage cans overflowing...paper all in the floor! 
This place has potential. Great location..very cool inside...food was good just cold. Need better management! And no will not go back do not recommend.

Good music. Pricing is what you'd expect. If you're thinking of grabbing a seat don't bother unless you plan on eating and drinking enough to provide your server a nice tip. 

My husband and I came to hang out before a game bought a bucket and we're happy to stand. A nice group had a table the gave up to us. After being asked by the waiter if we'd be buying more we said we'd do more drinks for sure but just got our bucket so not at the moment. He proceeded to tell us he wanted to save the table for someone spending money or he'd lose money. He then came back 10 minutes later and asked us to leave so someone else who was spending money could sit there. We didn't want to cause a scene and moved. Our next visit to nashville we won't be going to rippleys. If we didn't have a bucket to finish we'd have left right away.

Was excited to try this place for the live music and solid food, and good service. Well, they got the music right! Service was slow, there were 3 items ordered that were out (including all red meat options...at a bbq place?!) The check was wrong, and took forever to get sorted. For our troubles we were promised a round of drinks, which then we were told that they couldn't deliver for free. When we got the bill, not only was it wrong, but there was a $10 fee to use a Credit Card. Can't speak poorly enough about this experience...but at least the music was good!

Being a Mississippi man, I wanted to love Soulshine fot its Mississippi roots, but it was not to be. The decor and atmosphere are cool although very noisy. I had spaghetti & meatballs and the red beans rice. Sadly, they both looked and tasted pr-packaged. The red beans and rice tasted like Popeyes, spot-on. The service was so bad we had wave down the waiter for drink refills. On a Sunday, we were surrounded by empty tables so the lack if service was a mystery. I will go back if I see better reviews.

Wildhorse Saloon was not my favorite place to go. The food was great and the service was fast. Our waiter (I can't remember his name) was very nice and got our order right away. I think this place wouldn't be an ideal place to bring kids because it is very loud. The line dancing lesson was fun. I wish that I could be longer and you learn more then one dance. If you like loud music restaurants, or bars, you will like this one. And if you wanna learn how to line dance, here's you're place.

I visited Nashville recently and visited this place for a few drinks and some live music. The band was great and the service to get drinks was super fast. I've seen a lot of bad reviews but I did not have that issue at all. The service here was amazing and the band was amazing. If you want to listen to some good music and have a few drinks I would definitely recommend dropping into this place.

What a fun night! Taylor, our waiter, was exceptional and very attentive. Fried pickles and deviled eggs to start were yummy with tasty cocktails. Highly recommend the pork shank, so tender and delicious with the mashed potatoes. Live music set the mood for a fun evening. What a poetic ending to our vacation. Thank you Taylor and NashHouse!

Ok, so walking around Broadway at night as someone who sometimes and go into sensory overload can be scary. I mean if you can hear the music from across the street it's too loud, right? Most of broadway would disagree with you. Rippy's did a nice job of having live music that didn't overpower. The drink prices were very reasonable. The staff was friendly. This is the only place we went in and sat awhile because the atmosphere wasn't killer over the top.

Stopped by after a night on the town. Restaurant is connected to the Cambria hotel. Service was great as well as the food! Mike did a great job explains everything on the menu. I tried the Nashville Hot chicken and the quest. Both were delicious and my wife and I  will definitely be back. Also, they had the biggest TV I've seen so far in Nashville!

"Family friendly" apparently only applies to neurotypical children. If you have a child with autism, go elsewhere. This place is a perfect of example of how ONE BAD APPLE CAN SPOIL THE BUNCH.

We went on 9/2 for dinner. First, the two hostesses were happy and welcoming. Our waitress, Liz, was one of the sweetest and most helpful waitresses I have had in ages. Ask for her if you go- you will adore her. The bartender, Cody, was as nice as they come. The food was good. Not great and not bad but the menu has a lot more options than the other "family-friendly" spots and you're not going to any of these restaurants for a high-end meal anyway; you're going for the experience and the food is certainly acceptable. 

So why the bad review? I fled Florida from hurricane Dorian with my two children who have autism. My husband, a police officer, had to stay behind as all first responders were required to report to duty. Change is very hard on people with autism, typically. After driving down Broadway to show my children, my 12 year old daughter (with severe autism) was so excited to go to a restaurant with live music (she loves music- it's the most important thing to her). We selected Wildhorse thinking it would be the best option. When my daughter saw the huge stage, she was drawn to it. She was determined to get on that stage (she plays every instrument she has ever picked up extremely well and thinks she's a rockstar). Of course, I stayed with her and prevented her from climbing on the stage (although once she did get away from me and climb 3 stairs but I quickly got her down and profusely apologized and explained she has severe autism and doesn't understand). Instead, there was a large platform area attached to the corner of the stage off to the side that she sat on to watch the music and dancing. A bouncer, Dave, came over and in an extremely nice tone asked me if we could please have her not sit there. I explained my daughter's autism and, of course, agreed to get her down. He was very sweet and understanding. Here is where it all goes wrong....

While we were getting my daughter to get down this scrawny little nasty employee (I believe his name is Kyle) gets in my face and yells at me "get her down NOW!" First of all, Dave (a big dude) did not need backup from this tiny dude and certainly not for a 12 year old girl. I needed to get out of there asap (of course my dinner I took 2 bites of) and quickly paid the check and proceeded to leave. I did speak with a manager who was more than lovely. I truly hope a place that advertises as "family-friendly" would take time to train their staff on how to interact with families that are not typical. There's A LOT of special needs children who are learning to navigate the world and a little patience and understanding is so appreciated. Again, the majority of the people were just lovely, but this one guy ruined the night for us all. I wasted money on food and drinks I couldn't eat and jumped in the Uber to sit inside the hotel feeling completely defeated and sad.... all because of one very little boy who felt he needed to assert himself to a mother and 12 year old girl.

I love going to this place everytime I go to Nashville. They have the best pickle spears! Thats the reason I go there. I havent ordered a beer there in a long time because they were always warm and $6. $6 is expensive. Its outragous for a warm beer. I would have given more stars if it wasnt for the beer prices and temp.

Almost everything was great! Service was excellent, food was amazing. Live music was awesome! The drinks is where everything fell apart- every single drink we ordered had barely any alcohol. This was early in the night, too. Disappointing to say the least. Especially when you spend almost $500!

Went to NashHouse on Sunday morning before leaving Nashville and I must say I really enjoyed it. When we got there it was not too crowded at all and were able to get seated right away (there were 6 of us). The mimosas and bloody mary bar was of course great, and the Oscar Bennie was also very good. My friend had the shrimp and gritz, which I will admit was not the best I've ever had.
We didn't eat here...just came for the music and drinks.  The bands on both floors were great.  The service was fast.  Overall, our group had a ton of fun!  It was a great crowd!

Worst experience ever in my life!!! I've been in the hospitality industry for 30 years and never in my life have I witnessed a bartender be so racist! Lindsey was horrible and Adam, the manager wasn't much better ! We had a party of 25 people and the service was horrible and the food made us sick!!! Racism was over the top and I'm a white person!! They treated two of our African American parents horribly !!!  I would not even rate this a one At this point !!!!  Please don't ever go to this place!!!! Not sure what has happened to this place but it is horrible and our volleyball girls were looking so forward to having a fun night !

Good brunch and amazing drinks/bar selection. Very much appreciate the friendly staff and how hard they were working with what appeared to be an understaffed situation. 

Mac and cheese is amazing but the hash brown casserole left much to be desired. If they made the hash browns with all the trimmings of the Mac and cheese it would be amazing. Pancakes were also sub par.

BECKA was an amazing bartender. made my night. so sweet and amazing. also BARBARA are you fucking kidding? she's most amazing the bathroom attendant and person i've ever met. she deserves the world and i love her. please come here and be nice to her and give her lots of tips thank you.

It was my first time to Nashville this past weekend with a couple who have traveled their a few times. They herd that Wildhorse Saloon was a pretty neat, famous place to check out...BOY we were wrong! We walked up to the door and the bouncer told us it was a $6 cover charge, we payed it. We figured it was no big deal since the bouncer said that the bands that perform their don't come around with a tip jar like all the other bars in DT Nashville do so they split the cover charge with them, fair enough. After we payed our cover charge we walked into what seemed like a high school homecoming dance. (It was 11 pm on a Saturday night BTW). There were TONS of  high school kids learning how to line dance. We thought that was kind of odd for 11pm on a Saturday but stuck it out for a drink to see what the band was like. After the line dancing was done the "DJ's" stated that they would be back in an hour to do another line dancing session. They never said anything about a band come back from intermission or their even being a band for that matter. We immediately got irritated that we spent $6/person to watch high school kids line dance with not even a band afterward. As we were walking out, I got the bouncers attention and asked him why we were paying a cover charge to watch kids line dance? He immediately got rude and said that the band was on a break. I juts let it go, and walked away. But not after people in line over herd me telling the bouncer that I could not believe they charge people to watch kids line dance. So, needless to say a few other people did not go in. I clearly know the bouncer was lying to us because they was NO sight of a band or their equipment. If there was a band, don't you think the "DJ's" would of introduced them back on the stage after the line dancing session was over? I will never go back there. It is not because they charged a cover charge and its not because there were kids learning how to line dance. It was because they charged us a cover charge to watch kids line dance along with giving us false information about a band that was no where to be found in the building....at 11pm on a Saturday night.

Four of us went to dinner here. We ordered Rib's,, Chicken,, a wrap and I had a Hamburg. I took one bite of the Hamburg and had them take it away,,, it was terrible and I mean terrible. The other people with me loved their dinner's but I went away hungry. They  took the burger ($10.95) off my bill and did ask if I wanted something else but by then dinner was over for the other people with me and I didn't feel like eating alone. Our waiter from the start screwed up our orders,,, forgot our appetizers and we never did get them,, he never got our drink orders right and was slow,, very slow. So far in Nashville I haven't been impressed with the food
First stop when visiting Nashville for the first time and the food was outstanding. Brisket sandwich was awesome! Beer was cold and the multiple bands that were playing were good as well.
We paid a six dollar cover to find out we had no reservation and to be treated rudely.  Went across the street to  a more accommodating restaurant.

Went to this restaurant Sunday at 700pm.  Nick  the server was fantastic!(spilled my drink a time or two). Sitting right next to the hostess stand.  Blonde girl cannot be bothered with anyone who walks in the door.  I stopped to ask if we should seat ourselves or wait and she was like "what?????".  There is another 
 woman next to her....angrily interacting with people walking in.  Not very welcoming FYI.   Saw a number of customers walk in and out because they didn't know what to do. Kudos to those hustling.  Food was edible.  Thanks for a good evening.

My very first and last time at this place. My server was the rudest most unprofessional person I've ever had to wait on me. After talking to the manager about his disgusting attitude I was given excuses for his behavior. I am so disappointed because I've heard nothing but good things about this place. As said before, I will not be back into this establishment....this guy...my server Brian ruined it for me.

Really disappointed. Came here specifically for the line dancing. Sat in the back bar area because tables were on a 45 min wait this Thursday evening July 11. 
When dance lesson time came, the instructor took the stage. Could hear him and he seemed awkward teaching the dance moves. Did see his photo on the web site for instructors. 
It was so loud with people talking just added to the bad feel of the place. 
The singer/ guitar player was not very good compared to other venues in town. We left and found much more appealing music.

You walk by this place near Opryland. Very loud but the locals love it. Music was so loud couldnt even talk to each other. I opted for smoked chicken. Did not care for it at all. VERY expensive for a small piece of meat and a handful of fries. Also their drink prices are ridiculous!  It was like 12.00 or something like that for one mixed drink. I would expect that at a very luxe resort not a country western bar. Would rather just buy a bottle and some soda and kick back in my room.

Food was good. Zack was great. He knew the menu well and was very accommodating to our wishes. He made our time at Nash House super. We came in with a group of 10 and were easily accommodated. We ordered yummy appetizers.

Food 3.5. 
Line dancing lessons 4.5. Fun

Wife and I had the brisket sammy. Son had chicken strips. Four different types of fries- very good.

Line dancing lessons are about 20 min long starting every 45 min or so during day. Enormous place. We went mid afternoon so quiter. Its WILD at night  and weekends. 

Music more in evenings 

Go have fun

The wait staff was awesome!

The sausage, ham and onion pizza not so much. As one of the ingredients was definitely stale. The wings only came in 1 degree of heat and were nothing more than Kroger drummets with Frank's wing sauce.  The kitchen or chef put no thought or effort into that and it shows.

Ill definitely be back, but will give them a few months to mature.

Yeah. Do this place. 

So much of this insane broadway area is populated with great establishments with terrible service and the usual bar grub that is honestly not fit to consume. This place is different in al areas and it's a famous honkey Tonk to boot. The people here are wonderful. The bartender went out of her way to make an awesome jalapeño margarita in a town that, let's just say, isn't known for tequila. And the ribs? OMG. A great spicy but not too hot dry rub and some glazing that's simply wonderful. 

Did I say I recommend?

Legit, the Chuck E Cheese of "honky Tonks". It was quite amusing (very clean and large, loved that) and fun at first and then the line dancing lessons started. I wish i knew the girls name (it was a Friday night, blonde girl, hat). The line dance teacher could not have been less enthusiastic. She bordered on mean and condescending to the point where complete strangers were rolling their eyes, complaining and sitting down. People are in Nashville to have fun not to be treated like line dance idiots. At one point I started counting the number of times "the teacher" rolled her eyes. This is also the same girl (along with a number of men) the saloon adds to the dance floor when it's empty to create buzz. Her buzz was basically resting bitch face and a severe lack of authenticity and care. Would be nice if the person representing this place on stage and the dance floor at least faked it. It was discouraging. We ended up leaving and laughing about it, considering that she may have put her two weeks notice in and no longer cared. A word to the wise, and also to this management...you need a better cheerleader...Nashville is about music and show biz...let's see a better show.
Average bands, food, and drinks.  Above average drink prices.  Nothing special in this bar.

Told us it was first come first serve went to a table and sat for over 30 min ... No one came to take our order... And when someone did come over it was to tell us that this table was reserved and that they had no room for us ! Beyond rude! Kayla the employe was beyond rude and would not even try to help us sort it out!

This was the first bar that I had went to in Nashville, and I'm so happy that it was my first experience because not only was our bartender great and our frozen vodka lemonades needed but it was overall just a great place to start our weekend vacation at. At the time my friend and I had went it was slower and we were able to converse a good conversation with our bartender and the people next to us and they gave us all the information on what spots to go too and give us the 411 on the town. I wish I would've came back to the spot before I had left but due to it being such a short vacation and seeing so many things in just two days I wasn't able to but when I do go back to Nashville it will be the first but I go to, this place has my heart

5 stars on the delightful whiskey! So smooth and delicious. Their vodka is not bad, either. We stopped in for the tasting and the first gal that helped us behind the bar was great - she knew all about the product and was super friendly. 

However! She departed and we ordered the lemonade slushy from another bartender who should not be working in the service industry! We ordered two slushies with floaters. She produced them and then said they were for another patron. We were confused as we were the only people sitting at the bar, but we said we had ordered slushies as well, so she made two more for us. She managed to spill the second one all over the bar. She cleaned it up but did not refresh the vodka floater on it. No mind, the extra alcohol was probably not needed. So we're sitting at the bar and enjoying and the two original slushies, the ones that were for another patron, were sitting on the bar, lonely. Then the bartender looks at Larry S., who had been sitting there the entire time, and said, "Oh, these are your slushies". So Larry said that we just wanted two slushies, that was all that we had ordered. I mean, they didn't charge us for the extra drinks, but I'm not sure how the bartender screwed up a simple order for two drinks when there were no other patrons at the bar! 

The drinks were delicious and produced no hangover and we enjoyed the nice refreshment on a hot day.

This place is a tourist trap. After waiting for an hour to get our table it took another hour to get the food. Once we finally got it my order was Wrong and my side was on my fiends plate. I was then asked to just eat off his plate after the server made the mistake. I wouldn't have been so up set if the brisket I ordered didn't look like they just put three strips of beef jerky on my plate but it was so dry and thin. Glad I paid 50 bucks for beef jerky and live music so loud I couldn't hear the person in front of me.

This was my place 20 years ago.  I brought my family and it was terrible. I'm writing this review in my hotel room feeling nauseous and wondering if it's going to turn into food poisoning.  I hope it passes but I will never step foot back in that place.  Nashville has grown and Rippys is no longer on the radar.  Too many awesome places. Disappointing.  I have lots of good memories there.

Great service, fun place, food was so-so. It was good, not great. We asked for hot-hot chicken and it was quite mild, so if you want the spice, ask for the hottest they have! They introduced me to a tasty local beer that I really liked; Hap n' Harry's...a light lager.
YUMMO is all I have to say! The service was great, the food was great and the beer was awesome!! Live music too, what more could you ask for?!?!

The only good thing about this place is the live music and dancing. The wait staff were rude, there was a $6 cover to eat dinner, an hour wait for food, weak drinks, and they only split group checks into 6 tabs and refuse to do individual checks for our party greater than 6. Good place to try just once.

Loved the environment! We stopped for breakfast! The skillets were yummy, biscuit and jelly was delicious, hash brown casserole didn't live up to its name, they tasted more like buttery hash browns My latte was just ok. Service was nice!
We really loved it here! Great band! Great drinks! Right in the heart of downtown Nashville... highly recommend!

Beautiful venue that was clean and well lit. The pimento cheese appetizer was yummy with huge very light chips they call biscuits and the pulled pork sandwich was good as well but not as good as some of the local places that specialize in BBQ. My sweet tea cocktail was very strong and Not quite what I expected. If you are a bourbon drinker I'd probably give it a try. Our waitress was very friendly and outgoing and it appeared other waiters/waitresses were as well. That said, our food was super slow to arrive and it wasn't late or busy.  The main reason I only gave two stars though was that one of the people serving everyone's food wore her pants way too low and her undergarment stuck out among other things. Not exactly something you want to see when dining and/or knowing they handled your food.

We went there 2 times. Once for dinner and a second time because they had a great band playing. 

Dinner. I had the pulled chicken plate. Holy hell you get a ton of chicken. It was awesome and this place is saved for when I go back. I'll now be in Nashville 3 times a year and this place is on the "must stop at" list. They have 2 bars (maybe more I don't know) I was at both. They have different bands playing in both areas. 

Once time we sat and ate and another we sat and drank. It's a cool spot with great servers and great bartenders. Bookmark this place if you are heading to Nashville.

Great food, awesome music and exceptional customer service. I was in town for the week with my buddy and we decided to explore Broadway during the day and decided to stop at this place. There's two levels, both have music day and night, which is really cool. 
They have an adult slushee: Jack and coke, which was interesting. 
The environment was really cool as well. I will definitely be back, if I'm ever in the area.
Thanks for the experience.

I think Wildhorse has a lot of potential to be a go-to destination for people who want to line dance.  However, I think their charging a cover really deterred people from coming in.  

The night started off fun--there was a good crowd.  We were having a ton of fun but then looked around about an hour and a half later and saw that pretty much everyone had left.  

So just as crowds make larger crowds, the same is true on the opposite end.  We didn't want to be in an empty place on a Saturday Night (around midnight, which should be peak time).  So we left... 

The sight was actually kind of sad -- A good band playing for a completely empty dance hall.  I actually felt bad leaving.
The atmosphere was wonderful. Caitlin, the bartender, was horribly rude. We left after one drink.

Quite honestly this could probably be a magnificent place for Nashville. Unfortunately they need to work on their customer service. Everyone walks around like they hate their job and it shows in their service. Ordered food to go. Jake helped at the bar. Not the friendliest. Couldn't even offer water while I waited. Floor was a mess. Looked like they drug the trash across it and never mopped it up. Had the catfish. Food was decent but over priced for what your receive.  Of course that may just be Nashville.

So I did not eat so technically I am not rating the establishment but sat at the bar and listened to the  band. I was wading through a sea of people and heard this fantastic band and had to go in. They should be famous and will likely get a break. Can't wait to hear them again. The only problem is I do not know their name. Four really cute cool guys playing at 6:30 pm on Friday March 22, 2019 downstairs. Very talented, they get 4 stars.

We had a semi-private cocktail hour and dinner in the high top area and it was fantastic! The food was delicious and the servers - Seth and Rob - were so attentive and pleasant. We couldn't be happier!

This is 50 feet from cooter's garage.  It is large bar with big deck for outdoor seating.  Melanie was a great waitress. Very friendly l, fun and helpful.   

Medium selection of food. Ordered chicken Cesar salad and meatloaf with mashed potatoes and sucatash.  Fried pickles for appetizer.  The food was large portion and good.  Nothing to write home about.  Good beer selection option.  

Had 5 different live bands that could be seen and heard inside or out.  Great place for dancing and listening to good music. They played original songs and covers. 

I would go back for music, service and drink but not for the food.

Upon entering the restaurant, the sound of the kick drum and blare of the guitar resonated throughout. It matched the aesthetic that was presented with images of music legends all across the establishment. The live band added a great deal of flavor to the experience, albeit the noise was loud.

Our group ordered the crawfish bread as a starter, which was an excellent decision. The light crunch and flaky texture made the bread a great appetizer. The crawfish also added some variety of flavor to the bread.

Also, our table decided to order multiple pizzas to split in order to limit the cost and encourage trying a variety of types of pizzas. One negative of this restaurant is that it is most likely not meant for small groups because you would be limited to one pizza or having to pay $1 extra to customize your pie. We ordered the rainbow warrior, carnivore, and the alfredo pizza. The alfredo was easily the best tasting, followed by the carnivore and the rainbow warrior. If you are a skeptic of the trend towards adding pineapples to pizzas, then you will not enjoy this one.

One major drawback with the restaurant was its inconsistency in service. Upon asking for my water to be refilled, I was surprised as the waiter spilled water on my leg in an attempt to refill my glass. A simple mistake that could have easily been avoided if the waiter took his time. Overall, the pizza and bread was good; however, if you do not like loud live music or have a small group, this venue may not be for you.

living in Memphis for 3 years this is not very good Tennessee BBQ 
Staff was a little more concern with their phones then my service 
Sat on both the first floor and second floor and the music was good but I would not recommend the BBQ
Good pizza. Nice people. I'd go back.

Oh please, oh please, don't let the hipsters ruin this place!

We live very close by, and have been here a bunch of times, each time better than the last. 

It's a lot of fun seeing the place so crowded all the time. The music is absolutely top-shelf. Come here on a weekend evening and make sure you bring your dancing shoes, or just hang back with a beer and enjoy the music while folks tear up the dance floor. 

If you do go on Friday or Saturday evening, you may not be able to find a seat, although when the weather is nicer there is plenty of space on the covered patio adjacent to the space. 

The food is fine, but at least for me it's not the main attraction, or even what I think of when we go there. For me, it's the music. It's fun. 

The crowd tends to skew a bit older, with (I assume) plenty of locals and (probably) some out-of-towners staying at any of the various hotels nearby (it is right across the street from Opryland after all). 

So far, I haven't seen anyone who seemed to be there ironically, or to gawk. And, man, I hope it stays that way. It's a great, fun place.

Mom was so excited for the dinner and show to hear all of the classic country legend songs. Worst customer service! Show was so loud! Need earplugs. Barely any songs that we knew. Can't believe my mom paid so much for a show that could  and should have been in Las Vegas! Go see Grand Ole Opry for this price and see some good performers. Couldn't get a refund once show started-how could we know this would be such a bad experience?! ?!
This is my Favorite place when visiting Nashville, the Nashville Palace band is fantastic the staff is friendly and the food is good.
Had the opportunity to dine at NashHouse...  the apps and salad were great but the pork shank was even better!  If you have a chance, stop on by!  #TTFG!  Trust the Fat Guy!

After being so disappointed with FGL house we thought let's go to a tried-and-true Nashville legacy and that is the Wildhorse Saloon... I had been there over 20 years ago and this place has only gotten better!! It has the largest dance floor and all of Nashville, you can learn line dancing steps and also their food is top notch with awesome service the most friendly atmosphere! We had a blast! We walked in at about 9 o'clock or 9:30 PM on Monday night no reservations nothing just walked right in I had the ribs which were great my daughter had the chicken which was absolutely awesome incredibly tender phenomenal the servers were just awesome and we had an awesome surprise of a live concert going on! Josh Mirenda was performing and he was incredible! We got to meet him and his mom and it was just phenomenal atmosphere! I will definitely go back again the next time we're in Asheville my husband would love it! A definite two thumbs up! Prices were great too!!!

Very much looked forward to trying out this new place--attached to the Cambria hotel--before a Preds game. We are always looking for good options for a pre-game meal, and there are plenty east of the arena to choose from. This place just two blocks west of the arena showed promise but failed in the food. 

Service was prompt, friendly. Beer selection emphasized solid local choices. Thus far so good.

But then the food. The better half found the veggie plate lacking in taste but adequate. the Cowboy burger was another matter--when it arrived it was burnt--perhaps the driest piece of beef I have had in sometime. We were shocked-- the waiter asked "pink or not"-- we clearly said pink. He acknowledged that but then the kitchen had such poor oversight that order preference meant nothing--for a $16 burger. 

Game time neared so sending it back was not an option--a reality well apparent to the kitchen on a busy game night. So they sent out a ruined meal. Shame on them--they not only disappointed us but let down their waiters who were working a big room as efficiently as possible. 

Imagine I will stay on the east side of the arena in the future before arena events.

OMG this place is huge. It's as big as a full concert venue back in New Zealand. They had a full lighting rig and huge video screens. The band playing covers were really professional and worked the crowd. We were just blown away that this level of production was being used in a bar. Nashville does it big that's for sure.
The best ribs around. My squeester and I came here to eat after partying a bit.....will come back before leaving the area.

Ribs were excellent. Nice dry rub. Always a nice atmosphere with good live music. I've eaten here three or four times and the service is always friendly and fast. Great place to eat before hitting the bars!

Holy FRIED PICKLES Batman. I never order fried pickles, because they're just weird. But this place has hands down the best fried pickles I've ever had in my life. 

I like the venue, but the staff was way too busy to be friendly. Dude working the front door checking ID's was a jerk. The 3 floors are pretty incredible, and would've been even better had the other two bars been open and staffed. Sucks going down to get drinks to hop on a slow elevator back upstairs with them. 

Not to mention we had to wait almost two hours for a table when there were AT least 17-20 open tables the entire time we were waiting. Sad story. The band was a pseudo average cover band, the place was obviously loud seeing as it's like a concert hall. 

The best part for me. THE BATHROOM. It was soooo clean. The lady working the bathroom was incredibly attentive, she was on the ball. She had the water running, put soap in my hand, had a paper towel ready before I was done. It was amazing. All bathrooms should be like that. 

I'd go back only if my friends insisted because it was definitely a tourist trap.
, Fast service. Friendly staff. Good band. Right on main strip down town Nashville. Very good food

Great spot to slip in and have a drink. 
Wait staff is always busy and rude. 
I have been twice now once they weren't so busy same service and attitudes. 

Frozen lemonade is delicious, but not as delicious as the whiskey mule.

Opted for a plastic cup so I didn't have to leave my ID it took long enough to get a drink. 

Great spot, but don't be in a hurry and prepped for a rude attitude! Cheers.

Excellent place to come to eat, drink and have a very good time, do not forget to try the French toasts are from beyond and the chicken fried chicken ... OMG
Excelente lugar para venir a comer, tomar y tener un muy buen tiempo, no dejen de probar las tostadas Francesas son del mas allá y el pollo frito pollo...OMG

I had zero idea of this place's existence until my friend drug me here for some dancing. What initially was going to be a night of two-step (no idea what that is) turned out to be a night of swing dancing to rock-a-billy. My friend was a bit disappointed, but nonetheless, I full embraced it as I love east coast swing dancing. I do it frequently as my time allows it. 

There are two different stages. One when you first enter the establishment and another one in the back of the establishment. One this particular evening, they had rock-a-billy on both stages. This is greatly due to a convention going on at the Opryland Hotel Resort located near the Nashville Palace. I am not sure if my friend researched this before our outing. Regardless, we all enjoyed the music. 

My friend had a visitor in town whom she had danced with for years. They were basically professionals. Despite the music, they made a point to show off their expertise on the dance floor. Spectators applauded them once they finished one of the dances since the band was still warming up, but still played what I would consider a danceable song. He was flipping her around and on the floor; it was purely amazing! 

He later danced with me and showed off his moves.  I feel like I can't dance well unless I have a strong lead, and he was a great lead. It was very apparent that he and I were used to different dancing styles.

My friends ended up getting drinks and enjoyed what they got. I am not sure what the costs were, but I took a sip of my friend's cosmo, and it was tasty. There was no table service, but instead, they went up to the bar and got their drinks. 

The place is extremely spacious. We were in the back with a full-on dance floor with a stage for the band and plenty of room for standing and sitting to watch the band if you didn't wish to dance. It is also great for people watching. People were dressed up in full attire for the dance. Think, Dukes of Hazard prom attire meets Nashville Palace. It was definitely different from anything I had ever seen. 

I would definitely come back. We didn't pay a cover to get in and to be able to watch live bands without charge is always a plus in my book. Plus, after finding out that this place is so legendary gives me just that much more incentive to check it out again soon.

Went in tonight and sat at the bar. The bartender acknowledged everyone around me, some twice and just ignored me. We made eye contact and he turned away and asked the folks around me if they were ok. I wonder why???

Rippys was awesome! Only reason I can't give it a 5 star review is because they didn't have options to do things like 1/2 chicken and ribs. You can only choose one meat for a dinner plate. The ribs were delicious and everything is finger licking great! The ambiance, decor, vibe, and live music made you feel like a local. The best part of my Rippys experience was the impeccable service! Melody is a rockstar! She gave me a birthday shot, also showed and took a pic of her lipstick for my friend because she was curious of the color she was wearing! We all joked with a group chant, 'maybe it's maybeline.' And it was! Oh.. She also found the time to get our drinks and food at just the right time. Melody you're awesome and congrats on the engagement! Her fiancé is an actual rockstar! So stop by, ask for her, and then go see her fiancé play! Rippys BBQ. Nashville at its best!

Good food, awesome atmospher. 
Very expensive, probably not for everyone. It will have to be an occasion

Absolutely the most wonderful time. This place is hip AF! Great food, drinks, and atmosphere! Truly a "not so hidden dream"! We loved all the celebrities we saw there (and we even met a few!) On a scale of 1-10 this place is a 100! Cannot wait to come back!

The WORST bar I have ever been to in my life. I am TWENTY-THREE years old and they denied because they thought my ID was fake. I had a 2nd, 3rd, and 4th form of ID and they still would not let me in. The African American security guard even threatened my boyfriend for saying to call the police to verify. REALLY classy Rippy's. ARE YOU KIDDING ME?! Actually, thank you, because I would not want to spend a dime at this place. Came from Legend's across the street and wish I would have stayed there. Also, have fun being reported to the Better Business Bureau! Yes, I'm from Indiana, and you best bet I know the laws!

I ordered the breakfast Mac and they didn't tell me that they were out until they served everyone else at the table their breakfast. Others at my table had biscuits and gravy and they didn't bring the biscuits until 10 minutes later. They forgot the syrup for my mother in laws pancakes. Had to wait 5 more minutes for that. Hash browns were served cold, eggs were supposed to be over medium and they were runny. Coffee was full of coffee grounds. Very disappointed on our first Nashville breakfast.

Service is awful, but I'm beginning to think that it is definitely a Nashville thing.
We walk in and a guy says hi to us as we sit down at a table, 3 minutes pass when same guy comes over and asks what we need. Two draft beers, should have taken less than a minute....you would think...well if you live anywhere else In civilized society. Yet we sat, and sat and looked all over to find the guy. Nope, he completely disappeared, guess he decided it was his break time or something. Until finally after a hood 10 minutes from the time we sat, we just got up and left.
I cannot believe these places stay in business with the service they give, or lack there of. Guess because they cater to touriststs that will most likely never return they don't have to provide any kind of decent service.
So I'll take my hard earned money elsewhere.

This is the worst place I have ever been. The service was horrible and the food tasted like it was a day old and microwaved. The fries were stale, the pork was old, the brisket smelled foul and the wings were ice cold when brought to the table. Don't even get me started on their drinks. I got a margarita and it was watered down. If I wanted to pay $16 for water I would have stayed at home. On top of all the horrible food our server came over to the table at the end and had the nerve to speak back to me about the tip I had left her. I explained to her that the food was horrible and she rudely answered me and said she had never had any complaints rolled her eyes and walked away. I don't recommend this place to anyone visiting Nashville and they definitely left a sour taste in my mouth for this city.

Eh. This place deserves a strong 2 star rating. The food is mediocre that you can get literally anywhere. There was no wait, yet being sat took about 5 minutes. The music was good, enjoyed the live music. The service was slow, the waiter was very kind but slow. 

Side note: hard pass on the chips and queso. The chips were straight out of a bag and the queso was cold with the equivalent of bacon bits in it.

Huge restaurant with large garage doors that can be opened for an open air feel. There is a large stage one end opposite the large bar area for musical guests to sing. While we had dinner there was an acoustic singer performing which was nice during dinner. It sounded like they had a line up all night of 3-4 different people.

We ordered the queso as an app. Queso was ok... I pretend to know cheese, but I know liquid cheese and this queso wasn't top notch but never the less we still ate it and enjoyed the chips that came with it. 

For meals we had a Nash burger, meatloaf and salmon dishes. All were actually surprising good! My burger was amazing, although I wish they would have asked how I liked it cooked instead of well done. 

The reason I gave a 4 was because our server wasn't super friendly and because they use iPods or something electronic in their hand to order food electronically it seems a little weird when you are ordering and they are busy typing in stuff rather than making eye contact, etc. He did recommend the meatloaf though, which my mom loves... so good job!

Overall, I think I will definitely come back with friends or family especially if we're going to A concert at the Bridgestone! The location can't be beat!

Passing by we were looking for a place to eat and we came across Wildhorse Saloon. The place was AWESOME!!! Very cool atmosphere, great entertainment and customer service. The food was pretty good. In my opinion a little too pricey for what you get. I got a house salad added grilled chicken. The chicken was 3 bucks extra and it was cold. Kind of confusing. However, he had the brunch burger and LOVED it. For an app we had fried pickles and they were A M A Z I N G!!!

I think NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon is alright. It's very close to my Nashville office, so I have visited for lunch while there. I haven't been blown away by any part of the experience, but it's convenient, and not terrible, so it's likely I'll be back.
