This bar quickly became our go to bar on Broadway. Located right in the middle of everything, The Stage was just a great time. We ate and drank here for hours. I had my first experience with fried pickles and I am hooked. Also a great staff serves drinks at a reasonable price. And of course...the music was great.

To start with it took us 20 minutes to be seated when there where plenty of table open. Second the burger was cold, Mac and cheese was bad. I went through my entire meal before our sever came back to the table. I hadn't seen him since I ordered. Not good service.

The Sheraton at Music City is a well-kept hotel with convenient access to the Nashville airport and highways, serviced by friendly and attentive staff. There is ample free parking for guests, and a sizable outdoor pool and gym. Having ordered room service, I can highly recommend the buffalo wings but would caution against the steak as it was a low-quality cut of meat (not as advertised) and the accompanying French fries arrived soggy. My room was clean and orderly, and hallways were quickly cleared of any room service trays and bags of garbage. I took advantage of the continental breakfast in the Lounge, and was pleasantly surprised by the substantial and well-prepared food options. Besides your typical coffee, milk, juice and cereal bar, the buffet included pastries, well cooked bacon, fresh fruit and delicious sausage/cheese/egg breakfast sandwiches. The lady responsible for bussing the lounge was polite and efficient, always quick to serve and assist the guests present. I highly recommend you consider this hotel when you are planning your trip to Nashville, customer service is top notch and the location is very convenient.

Awesome honky-tonk! They have bison mounted on the wall, big barrels to represent whiskey (or crackers, or checkers), and a good amount of space to sit at. The Sprite was given to me quickly and I had a good time with the tourist visitors.

Fun, live music. Loved that they had a girl singer in the band. We had a large party and had a little VIP treatment for the deck upstairs, a little more private and the bartender helping us was very helpful and attentive.

Well-rounded CLEAN Nashville hotel that will be nicer than you expect BUT didn't get 5 stars because it's not the W in downtown Chicago & doesn't have free coffee available in lobby which is key to the success of my family vacations. *Note beer & coffee loving foodie IT husband (on that same note they need more local craft beers on tap.) WiFi costs $9.99/day if you don't have Starwood Preferred or aren't in the lobby. 

Love how all parts of the hotel have smelled amazingly clean! The large fitness center & indoor heated saltwater pool & jacuzzi were surprisingly clean. Our room was lovely & clean. There is ample parking & a cheap ($10 round trip) shuttle running downtown. 

I can not comment on value because we came for free as part of a work conference. Although we weren't terribly impressed with the restaurant (see my seperate review), the catered in house meals were better than expected. So far we have had pastas, breakfast, hamburgers & hotdogs. 

Staff have all been helpful & kind, especially housekeeping. Make sure you request a crib early if traveling with small children on a weekend. We got last one on a Friday at 1 pm. The balconies are a nice plus. Great location for Opryland pursuits. The beds are comfy. There is no microwave or refrigerator in our room. 

Overall, I haven't stayed at a Sheraton in awhile but I'm enjoying this stay & would recommend to relatives in town who want to avoid fuss & headaches of THE Opryland hotel. Thanks for the great family memories!
We loved this place! The live music was great, the bartenders we super attentive and the prices were slightly less than the other bars on the strip.

This was my favorite honky tonk on the strip!

Went to The Stage during a one night tour of Broadway with my wife the other night. As with most other places on Broadway, there was no cover and the drink prices were reasonable.

Even though it was a monday night, The Stage was rockin. The band that was playing seemed to cater towards a younger crowd, and people were dancing in front of the stage, interacting with the band, and just having a great time. They even sang a song for me which was a nice touch.

I noticed a few bouncer looking guys milling around, but there was no issues at all that I saw, just keeping an eye out I guess. Anyways, of the 6 places I made it to that night, The Stage was by far the most memorable in regards to having a true "Nashville" experience. Definitely check it out.

I stayed here for the BlogPaws conference. I was not stoked to get here as Sheraton is not my favorite, but I was pleasantly surprised. The rooms were standard for a Sheraton, but nice enough. Room service menu about standard -- nothing special. 

But the service is what makes this a 4-star instead of a 3-. I'm pretty picky. I want what I want when I want it, and the team at the Sheraton accommodated every request. Ryan at the front desk checked me in, and greeted me by name every subsequent time he saw me. That's a touch I would expect from a much higher-end hotel.

I think another time I'd pick somewhere downtown, just for convenience, but this was perfectly reasonable for what it was.

We stopped by for a drink and watched the band. It was pretty crowded on the night after Xmas. Not sure if the people are mostly locals or out of towners...it was cool but I was not super impressed. However I did get to see some crazy country dance moves.

We took our youngest daughter to Nashville.  Many of the live music venues are bars, so she couldn't get in.  We thought Hard Rock Nashville would be fun.  We've always had good experiences with Hard Rock, except for this visit.

The live music there was really cool, but the service left a lot to be desired.  Even though the place had a large number of empty tables when we walked in, we got greeted by a snooty hostess who thrust a pager at us and simply said "45 minute wait".

It was about that long of a wait.  I found myself and family standing virtually alone in the front lobby with all the other guests getting seated.  I finally walked over to the hostess and asked how much longer It would be.  She looked at my pager and said she had paged us but that the pager must have been turned off.

We were literally standing 20 feet away.  Why didn't she care enough to walk over to us and at least check on us?

The table she sat us at was right next to the bar, kind of in the way of the bar patrons.  I asked for another table and was told we couldn't be moved.  

Food was just OK.  I had the margarita flatbread.  It was really salty, heavy garlic and was very skimpy on tomatoes.  My wife got the nachos.  Skimpy toppings.  My daughter got the cauliflower burger with parmesan fries.  She liked her meal alot.

Overall, 3 stars mostly for something that can be fixed...service

To the two married dudes who were hitting on girls all night and paying for all of their drinks at the bar the weekend of June 5. Gross. I may be describing quite a few...not just two. But the two of you. Ew. Totally EW.

That said, this didn't feel like a sleazy place. Wouldn't have felt uncomfortable unless I wanted to.

Other than the interesting people watching, I had a great time at The Stage. Really liked the staff, they made the rounds frequently to clear bottles and glasses. And that was a lot to keep up with. The music was good. Probably not the best that I heard on Broadway...but heck music is going to be hit or miss in Nashville, and all a matter of preference.

Our group found ourselves here after being turned away from Wildhorse Saloon, which was closed for a private event.

My stepdaughter was celebrating her 21st bday, so we were drawn here as we walked up Broadway.  

Live band. No line.  Not too crowded. Friendly staff.  We're in!

The band playing covered a variety of music genres, varying from Country, 90's, pop, etc.  We were able to snag a table towards the main floor bar.  If you're interested in food, they do have a menu - which you can ask for from the bar staff.  We didn't order food, but others around us did...and it looked pretty tempting.

Date/time of visit: Friday evening, March 23rd

Stopped in on our way to myrtle beach! Food was absolutely delicious, we both had Jack Daniels burgers! Decor was modern and nice, was busy but they got us seated right away! & we had the BEST waiter, on his name tag it said "Yas qween". Good time! Only thing I have to say is that I expected a little more music memorabilia for Nashville!

After finding out the Acme rooftop was closed we decided to go to this rooftop bar. Big Mistake! I asked the hostess if I could go to the rooftop, she said it was full. I asked if there was a wait, "Nah people just sit there forever." Dumbfounded I asked if we could just go up and see if we could order a drink; "Sure." Upstairs we meet the second host and he says the bar is full but there is a table. I was super excited... that is until I sat down. There seemed to be some tasty mason jar drinks on special that included the mason jar. We asked about them and our server answered "Well, I can get you the drink but not the mason jar. I'm sorry they've just been so popular." Ok, perfect, I didn't want the glass so I asked what was in one of drinks and the server said they were an old promotion so he forgot so he was going to ask the bartender. I asked what the new promotions were, he also didn't know. He came back with the recipe of the mason jar drink but still didn't know the new promotions. I had had it so I ordered a simple Tito's with soda, lime and a splash of cran. He came back saying they were out of Tito's, I ordered Ketel One and got no splash of cran. I drank, paid, tipped, left.

Hey pretty cool bar. That plays good music. But if you get the tattooed bearded bartender, he will ignore everyone at the bar and joke with his friends all night you literally have to scream at him to get you another beer completely incompetent. What's the point of tending bar when you're not going to tend to anything

Great experience here. Staff was responsive and helpful, and the stuff they offer kids to do is way more than just a few crayons and a piece of paper.We used our hard rock coloring book at many restaurants after this trip!

Food was good, drinks were amazing. A really nice place to stop in Nashville especially if you're with kids and don't want to bring them to the local honky tonks.
Such a fun bar!! Very nice people that work there. The bands were amazing!! Thanks for a wonderful weekend Stage!!
The lobby was grand and beautiful.  Yet rooms were basic but the mattress is always a delight at sheraton.  The bar was nice and open until midnight.   Late night drink was needed for us.
Very nice place, very clean and worth the money. They have two restaurants inside the hotel and room service. This will be my place to stay whenever Im in Nashville

Wow. Really had a bad experience tonight. Made reservations on line for dinner on the roof top during karaoke which I included the specifics on the reservation. Called to even make a change with the number. Arrived tonight and told that the rooftop is private party only for $15 each. Hard rock could have called or even done a better job explaining but the hostess was so rude we left and went elsewhere. Why wasn't it advertised anywhere as a private party. We are on vacation and made plans around this. Very disappointing for a well established place. Unfortunately our family has a goal of visiting all hard rocks in the US. We are calling this visited. Really sucky.

I want to fancy myself 'too cool' to hang out on Broadway, but who am I kidding?  Enjoy the crush of humanity, an incredible mural of some country music legends and a rockin band.  They really do book the best bands that play a mix of country hits and 70s/80s/90s pop.  In 10 years I have never seen the dance floor not packed to capacity.  
You are not getting craft cocktails or hip indie music, you're getting the bar equivalent of the Nashville tv show.  And I'm totally cool with that.
This place was totally awesome!!!! Absolutely loved it! Cute atmosphere and the bands were awesome!!! My favorite place on Broadway!

Came here late night Monday. Nice gathering of people from tourists, students, to musicians who had just finished their gigs. What was really cool and unique about this place was the freedom in how the stage band could interact with the audience. The lead singer even invited some of the musicians and singers in the crowd to join onstage. We all enjoyed some guest performances!

The bar staff took care of everyone and were friendly to chat with. Will return when back in town. Thanks for a good time!

The food was really good when we got the food. It took a long time to receive the food. The waiter was very absent-minded. They did not know what they were doing as far as waiting tables. I'll food was cooked to specifications. The waiter seem to think that comedy was the way to wait tables. Apparently he was mistaken. This was an extreme disappointment.
Had lunch with parents here, had lil rock burger and ribs, was pretty awesome! But my dad ordered ribs and thought its steak Hahahaha, that was pretty funny

Great little BBQ joint!  We went there as part of my friend's bachelorette party, and the service was wonderful!  There was a good acoustic act playing out on the patio, the barbecue had a nice smoked flavor, and the fresh-cut fries were delicious.  Fun little joint to hang out and enjoy good food, cold beer, and awesome company!

One of the best honky tonks on lower Broadway along with Whiskey Bent! Their beer prices and drinks are still reasonable compared to all the bars that Dierks Bentley, Shelton, FGL and Aldean are opening!! These places are a downright rip off!!

Was having a great time with 7 people.  Late in the night we order drinks from 3rd floor bar and the female bartender rudely she doesn't want our 3 dollar tip on the 4 beers she opened.  Will never go here again.

So this will be my third review of Whiskey Bent Saloon. It used to be a solid five stars. The bartenders, bouncer, and band were all great when I first started going here. Since then, the staff has changed. This two star review isn't meant to call out any particular people, but in hopes that Whiskey Bent can improve and maybe even become the bar it was several years ago. For starters, the drinks are way too expensive. I don't want to pay $6 for a beer when top shelf liquor costs the same price at other bars. The bartenders also need to speed up their service. If there are only three people at the bar, it should not take more than ten minutes to get my order. Finally, the bouncer needs to accept all legal forms of ID at the door (e.g., passport, global entry card, etc.), not just a driver's license. Not everyone has a driver's license.

Fix these three main issues, and I'll give WBS at least a four star rating, or maybe even five, depending on how much improvement there is. I still enjoy coming here on Sunday nights because the band is awesome, but if it wasn't for them, I'd probably just stay home or go elsewhere on Sunday nights.

We went here for dinner before a concert, at first impression the Waitress was not welcoming and was non responsive to questions, I made a complaint and the Manager came over and went above and beyond to make sure our visit was the best. Thank You Sam!! your company should know they have the best management team and handles issue quickly!

3 stars cause I enjoyed the rooftop outside patio view and live band. Outside patio gets a different menu verses dining inside you get a bit more option. Basic american food. It was okay. Our server was new and she didn't know anything about the menu or if it was even on the menu. Our food took forever to come out. And we just ordered wings. They do have valet parking if your not wanting to look for parking.
Fun bar! Try the blackberry and/or Blue Raspberry moonshine cocktails. Great, relaxed atmosphere. Friendly bartender and musicians.
The hotel was beautiful! The rooms were clean and very roomie! The staff at guest services were very friendly in helping us choose things to do around town. Definitely will stay again when in town.

A group of 9 (finally) 21 year olds stopped here for our first bar in Nashville this past weekend & we had an absolute blast. While it was pretty crowded (like every bar on Broadway during Summer) we ended up near the front of the stage which only makes it more fun.
The band we saw was so great (Johnny T) & a lot of fun. Drinks were normal priced for Broadway & bring lots of cash because these bands deserve it!

Gimmie that sixth star. This place is fscking unbelievable! Their smoked wings are, bar none. The best wings I've ever had.five of us got the brisket, pork ribs, beef ribs, chicken and sausage. It easily would have fed double. The food is incredible. Go here right now!

Visited the rooftop bar while strolling Broadway.  The band was really nice considering the crowd was only about 8 people in the afternoon. They kept asking for requests and were not asking for tips even though most artists do during the show. We got to hear a few requests and made sure to tip them on the way out. The bartender was not very friendly and made it feel less than welcoming. The band and venue made up for it though.

The staff are ALL so cool and friendly which is a plus. You need to come here for super soul sundays if you love R&b, trust me when I say the R&B performances here are out of this world. This bar is definitely a hidden gem.
Wonderful service! Waiter with the large beard made it very apparent that he liked us, as tourists, in Nashville! The Original Legendary Burger was fantastic!

Place was half-empty when we walked in, and we were told there'd be a 20 minute wait.  Saw at least 2 managers or expediters just standing around, as well as 2 waiters who didn't seem too busy.  Maybe one of them could have waited on tables and cut down on that wait time...Cobb salad was only okay and half the cheese on the nachos wasn't melted.  Go to the Memphis location to eat and stop by here just to pick up your pins.
Great Moonshine.  If you go here you have to try the TANG, then you need to have them mix the chocolate moonshine with the banana moonshine.  Bartenders are cool and always some great live music.
Great bar! Bands were awesome and staff kept the place running smooth. Never a long wait at the bar and stupid annoying drunks were "handled" by security. Will be back!

Came here during the daytime after a day of shopping on broadway.  It's a big place with, of course, a big stage.  The dance floor is pretty spacious, and they have nice decor (I like the big guitar on the back wall).  They have an upstairs area as well, and a sectioned off elevated dining area on the side.  

The place was packed for a monday but pretty clean.  They do charge for water, so drink beer.

Jk

This is such a refreshing establishment to have on broadway. Although they stay true to their roots with live country music on the first 2 floors in a building that has had 2 tenants in the last 100 years, a boot store and a blacksmith; they offer a more non touristy feel on the 3rd floor for a dj or the roof top for a open air cocktails. 
All of the apps that i havd had were amazing. This place is definitely worth a trip

You know, I'm not a huge country music historian. I know some big names and that's about it. However, when I walked into the Stage and they were playing Sweet Caroline I thought, okay at least it's accessible. The next group that came on didn't play a single country song. At this point, I wonder what's going when it's a bunch of country looking dudes singing their 3rd TLC song in the set. If you're going to have a huge photo of the Highwaymen over the front door at least play one country song. Maybe it's just me but I could go anywhere to hear a cover band.

Beautiful accommodations. Loved the balcony off our room overlooking the courtyard. Found an amazing deal on the hotel tonight app. Comfy beds. The best feature of this hotel is the $10 shuttle that takes you to Broadway. I would patronize this hotel again.
Nice place in Downtown Nashville. Very pricy but food is good and nightlife is wonderful. If you come on Saturday night be prepared to wait at least 30mins.

The Stage is a great time! 

I like that they play a mixture of music, not just obscure country songs that I don't know, and the crowd is lively and fun. Although, it can be a bit TOO packed for my taste on weekend nights. The drinks are about what you expect on Broadway, not crazy expensive or cheap either, about middle of the line.

A couple things to remember:

- The Stage WILL be filled with out of towners and people visiting, so don't expect a lot of Nashville locals. 
- There is typically a line out front that is crazy long, so go to the back ally way for a shorter/sometimes no line. 

I like the Stage and come here when I'm in the mood to play tourist!

The bar was only 1/4 full but we struggled to get one of the four bartenders standing around to make us drinks.  When she did, it can with a snotty attitude and our drinks were in small plastic cups, mostly filled with ice.  $11 a piece.  Even when you said," thank you," they didn't respond.   Even though we were sitting at the bar, we couldn't get refills.   It's a shame because the venue was comfy and clean, and the cover band was great.

Another great stop on Broadway!  Cold beer, good music, good band!
Attentive nice bartenders too, we'll be back.

Shabby. 
Gym looked nice, didn't get a chance to work out this trip though. 
I stayed there 4 days. Forth floor has roof leak by elevators. It rained while I was there... They had rubber garbage cans and air movers going. SMELLED LIKE MOLD. Awful. 
Plan on lots of walking if the room you have is on opposite corner of front entrance, as the layout of the building is diamond shaped. 
Oh... And did I mention the breakfast? Horrible. 
The breakfast you would get for free at another hotel- ya, it was $20 first morning, $25 the next morning before I got wise and went out the next morning. Fruit, not fresh. Eggs, poured out of a carton. Terrible. That's too bad because the server, he was spot on. 
Wow, the more I write this, the more I realize how much that place sucked... And I'm not a particularly picky guy.
If you want to enjoy Nashville, do yourself a favor and steer clear of this hotel. You're very welcome.

The hotel was beautifully decorated for the holidays.  We were pleasantly surprised considering the price.  They have a nice restaurant/bar in the lobby and an indoor pool.  Our room was spacious with a little patio.  Definitely going back when I'm in Nashville again.

Nice décor in this bar. It is a bit above average in size, and the sound was really good. The staff was awesome at serving you, no matter how crowded it got. The place does get crowded, and they have awesome bands, as do all the bars on this street. Just a truly amazing music experience.

Go there for the drinks and live music. The service from waitress was less than expected. A group of 8 went there and the atmosphere is fantastic. We did decide to eat there as we made reservations. When the waitress walked up and asked what did we want, I replied please get a note pad. She told me she had been doing this a long time so I agreed with her. We got food brought out a little at a time as others waited. The waitress left off 2 hamburgers, fries and then told us we didn't order that. So I guess she thought that 2/3rds were eating but the others weren't. We did have a good time and will go back when in Nashville. The owner did come out and apologized, gave us the meals and did make it up to our party. If I can give any suggestions is waiters and waitresses, I do not care how good you think your memory is. Please take a note pad as too much is going on and you do get distracted. Other than that I loved the place.
Pretty average country bar in downtown Nasville.  We sat upstairs, where the bartender was less than friendly, but otherwise enjoyed ourselves.
TOTALLY FUN and intimate spot. JUST DO IT. Hahahahaha. Had a super fun time on a Saturday afternoon.

Was at this hotel for about 4 days for a conference and everything was really good. The hotel is a little older but well managed. Love it that every room have a balcony. I would in deed stay hear again.

The service was really good as well but was a little slow cleaning my room and understand the hotel was pretty full. May need to brain extra staff when hotel is about full.
Was out with a couple buddies and decided to come check the place out. Was very disappointed. The front door staff are struggling, very unprofessional. Do they even lift?
Best bruschetta I've had anywhere! My cousin and I always make it a point to hit up the Hard Rock in every city. Staff was very friendly. Great location!

I was walking around downtown nashville trying to find a good place to eat. This is our first time downtown. An male employee was standing outside telling his specials to walkers but gave us an unfriendly nod. I really hope this is a diverse restaurant. You had great reviews however that caused us to keep walking.
This place was the bomb. A great band playing rock n roll. Drinks are reasonable, people were great. Great customer service. Place got packed but the music was incredible
Great variety of whiskey, knowledgeable bartenders, live music, and central location. I definitely would come back if I'm ever back in town!
Good ol fashioned fun!!  Motown Monday was awesome! So much dancing, sweating, laughter, good music and great energy! Wish what places like this back home!

Pulls in a decent interactive crowd with their live music.  Space to both listen and to dance.  Drinks are average, bartenders only know traditional drinks and aren't the friendliest.  The crowd is fun though, very mingly.  There is a seating area too.

Went here on a recent holiday to Nashville. The bar girl was very friendly & helpful making different moonshine flavored lemonade & margaritas. 
This place is on the top of our list if we ever go back to Nashville. From the front it doesn't look to inviting but once side inside the place is great, with cool mason jar lights  & good music being played.

Rudest staff ever!  Loved how they took the guy's 100 dollars then asked him to get off stage and leave.  Most terrible place ever! Avoid! . Absolutely the worst place ever. can't wait to get back to arizona.

This was our first stop on Broadway, and it may have been my favorite. The band that was playing was super fun and played Zac Brown Band per my request, which I am all about.  They were really good, too! 

It was relatively busy, but still pretty early in the night. We got a seat on the balcony, but quickly moved downstairs when a table opened up. The beer selection wasn't the most stellar, but I'll let it pass. This was truly a Nashville experience. Come here if you are visiting.

We hit up The Stage on Broadway on our first night in Nashville! The music was great, the drinks were cold and the people were awesome. It was the perfect amount of people (not to crowded but not empty either) and the wait staff and security were great.

No refrigerator in a $200 room, air won't go under 72 period, king club access useless, coffee machine messed up 2 days straight, staff unsure of packages added to room for anniversary or honeymoon, I've stayed in Days Inn's that were quieter, every move next door or in hall you hear, bathroom really small, lobby nice and room clean other than that a $80 a night hotel and I had a king club room $550 for 2 nights, robbery!

Super crowded on a Friday night even though the bar is huge, but perhaps many were seeking somewhere dry to hide out from the pouring rain. The drinks are not cheap but not too bad - $7 for a well drink and $4.25 for a beer. The band was great, playing top 40 country hits. Their female lead was especially great playing lots of Band Perry and Miranda Lambert.

I signed up for yelp finally today just to write this review. 
Awful service. I will never be back here. Wait staff is rude and makes you feel like you are a nuisance for even being in the restaurant area.

We had to go to bar to order, ok no big deal. Then she doesn't bring us water or silverware and makes me feel like an idiot for asking then doesn't apologize either. If it's a staffing issue that is root cause maybe something to look into as management. 

Service here was ridiculous.

Best drinks in town!  Our bar tender/ waitress Faith was fantastic...friendly, mixes the best drinks in Nashville and a great waitress too.  We each had a Jack Daniels Low Rider... Totally wonderful !! The banana-strawberry Coloda was tasty too!
We had veggie burgers with salad. The burger had a huge, fresh portobello mushroom on it. The burgers were quite large and cooked  just right.  The salad was full of dried cranberries and bacon. Everyone was in costume for Halloween!!this is a 'must go' place when we are in Nashville,TN !

Above average service, exceptional memorabilia, very clean, and flavorful food with valuable portion sizes.  Biggest down falls is very little country music and no items priced under $11.  Two levels with adequate space.  Definite place to go for a drink and big meal.

Spent 4 nights here as part of a Haunter's Convention. yes, you read that right HAUNTERs. You know, people who run haunted houses.  The hotel is large, it actually wraps around itself and so getting lost is possible, but you will find your way back, eventually. 

The lobby is spacious and quite pretty, the elevators are at the oddest angles but stately and proud.  I was on the 2nd floor, which happens to be the club floor - We'll talk about the club lounge in a moment. 

While I was not in a Club Room, I had a friend who had one, so I was able to see the differences.  My room was 2 beds, with a lot of extra room, but the view, well, there wasn't much of one, except of the air handling units. Still I had a balcony.. *shrug*

My friend had a club room, King sized bed LOTs of excess room and a balcony that over looked the pool - Winter, so no one was out in it. And it was in need of a cleaning, but still, a better view than I had.  Because he had the club room, he invited me to the club lounge, the first thing I noticed in there was the overwhelming stink of the garbage can.  It needed to be attended to both times I visited.  Other wise, they provided a nice breakfast, with pastries, hot entrees and drinks as well as coffee and lattes for those at the club level. 

The hotel handled the convention very well.
The roof top is cool. Hailey is by far the best bartender we've ever! Don't stare in her eyes if you aren't willing to fall in love. Enjoy.

At first we were disappointed to find that this wasn't actually located downtown, but the service and for the price of the rooms it worked out well. The receptionist checking us in was very kind and helpful. She got us in early, but gave us the option of waiting to have a nicer room. We declined just so that we could freshen up and get started on the day. The room was a good size and had 2 armchairs, where most hotels might just give you one. We also got a balcony with a view of the pool. This wouldn't be good if you wanted to avoid hearing people outside there, but we were barely around. The bathroom was a bit tight, but it did the job. The fitness center enabled me to get my cross-fit work out of the day in.

My sister and I are at a Music City Hotel near airport. My sister made the reservation at downtown Nashville Sheraton for she is going to Music City Sheraton hair show and told reservationists wanted to at hotel hosting hair show convention. Now we are by airport and have to drive and no shuttle to convention from airport. No convention at Music City Hotel. Severely disappointing and no one is helping enough to find an answer for this totally inconvenience. Just told at 100% occupant cost is now$429.00 for room.

One of my favorite bars in Nashville. On a Monday night it's been my jam every time I'm in town. Let's just say - the energy -  I had more dance partners than close to any of the other bars I've been to around the world. Epic fun of massive proportions if you're ready to let loose and have fun without judgement. Great surf rock / 50s / 60s/70s music you'll know all of the words to.
I can't emphasize enough if you're a 20-something and want to have a blast how awesome this place is. GO GO GO!!! (and invite me!) 

I've been here so many times and have never had a bad night (or a sober one hahaha) Food trucks/stands also hang outside so after last call you can snag some grub after a night of rocking extra hard. Sometimes you can find a sweet after party - I'm never a local any city I travel in, but the local parties here are pretty bodacious.

This hotel was average as far as cleanliness and the location was random, but if you don't mind those things then you're fine, stay here. If you are traveling with a dog and think you have found the hotel for you, THINK AGAIN. We were told at check-in there would be a $100 fee if a complaint was made about our dog barking and we could not get there in a reasonable time to calm her down. They also claimed they would check on the room to confirm the complaint. INSTEAD, the hotel called us and said a complaint was made so we will INSTANTLY be charged a fee. We arrived within 10 minutes and our dog was not barking AT ALL when we arrived. My husband talked to the staff and they told him they didn't hear her barking either....but we were still being charged. If this hotel just wants to charge at automatic $100 pet fee, that's what they should call it up front. That way pet lovers will find elsewhere to stay. ADDITIONALLY, don't leave any items behind in your room. Sadly, I left my hair straightener behind and I called the hotel the next day, they told me I had to leave a voicemail with lost and found and they would contact me promptly. I called lost and found every other day for over a week and received NO call back. I finally had to force someone to talk to me on the phone and they said they might have my item. I told them I left a black Sedu hair straightener behind and 24 hours later they finally called me back about my REVLON CURLING IRON. Yeah, not exactly my Sedu hair straightener. Obviously I know you should always check your room before you leave, but I have left items behind at hotels on a few occasions and the staff saved my items for me. No such luck at this hotel.

Some of the best times we have had downtown nashville, there are so many different venues to choose from, but the Valentine nailed it. There are some amazing people that work there GREAT service an the food was amazing an very well priced! Thank you Nashville.
Pretty good spot. I believe they have the most spicy quesadillia in town. I had the cheeseburger and it wasn't bad at all! We really didn't like the fact the parking lot was chained off.

You got 4 stars just for you Brisket Sandwich. So after all my fellow yelpers said you had great brisket i decided to give it a try last nite. 

Smoke Ring was very nice
Smoke Flavor was Very nice
Perfectly sliced
I like the way you combined the fatty end with the lean end on the sandwich which gave a nice balance.

Guys, sorry but you need to have mom teach you something about tater salad LOL.Basically i did not need it after the sandwich

Thanks yelpers....

Visited Nashville for the Beyoncé concert for my birthday. Gorgeous hotel. The staff was amazing also. My room was clean and quiet. We ordered room service which came with a lot of fees which I didn't particularly expect - a $50 bill turned into $90. The food was good though! Otherwise - it was my birthday week and the front desk hostess noticed from my ID. After coming in from the concert there were chocolate truffles and a card in my room wishing me a happy birthday and well wishes for a fun time at the concert. Check-in was easy and we arrived early and our room was ready. Checkout was easy and everyone was pleasant. I doubt I'll be back in the area but if I happen to go I would definitely stay there again!

We were walking by and decided to stop in and were so happy we did. Such a cool place and Rochelle is one of the best bartenders ever! She's just the cutest and so incredibly NICE! Felt like we were best friends by the time we left. Got to hear some great music while we were in too. If we didn't have to leave for the airport, no telling how long we would've stayed! Can't wait to come back!

My wife, two kids and myself all stayed here at the Sheraton Music City Hotel in Nashville, TN for a week. The rooms were extremely comfortable, the staff super friendly and the restaurant and room service were F-A-N-T-A-S-T-I-C. Truth be told, the breakfast buffet is over priced, but the other meals were extremely fair price wise, so it averaged out.

The band plays a diverse genre! And the security is so cute  ladies, don't miss out! I went to the bar on February 28 and one of the security guys caught my attention... Best people best security best guys one security with a straw hat caught my attention you'll know who I'm talking about when you see him

We drove to Nashville from our area, three plus hours away, to eat here. My son wanted to eat at this location since he'd eaten st the location in Atlanta. He loved it so I was excited to experience it with him in Nashville. The atmosphere wasn't what I thought it would be, probably my fault as I was feeding off of his 16 year old excitement. The staff was friendly and the food was good, just good though.
We wanted to buy something for my daughter since she didn't make the trip with us but the selection in the restaurant was uber small so we were told that they bigger "gift shop" was not in the restaurant, but down at the end of the parking lot. That was different but the selection was indeed better. We did end up buying an over priced hat pin. We'll do a little more research before our Next trip. As I said, I think my expectations were too high. It was just good food and nice staff, nothing super special.

This place was totally fine! I was kind of worried given some of the recent negative reviews, but for 109+tax the result was completely reasonable. I checked with no problems around 11pm on a Friday night. It's a pretty accurate statement that this Sheraton has more personality than most hotels as the lobby has tons of stuff and a patio overlooking the courtyard is a nice addition to the experience. I got my room upgraded since I have SPG gold and it's pretty spacious, much more so than the Sheraton in Boston that I just got back from. The fitness center is probably the largest Sheraton one I've seen thus far and there is plenty of space and equipment. The pool is pretty decently sized and there is a hot tub available as well.

As far as food goes, it's pretty run of the mill. I got a turkey burger and fries from the restaurant for about $15 bucks. Nothing to write home about, but nothing that made me regret eating here. There is a shuttle that runs to and from the airport back to Sheraton, but service stops around 11pm so I couldn't utilize it on my way in.

The staff were super nice, rooms were clean, and I would definitely stay here again.

I come here often. Have gotten to know the staff and thoroughly find it to be one of the most fun, sanitary, inviting places in downtown Nashville, specifically on Broadway. Brunch on Sunday mornings is INCREDIBLE. Not to mention bringing in great company with me that can laugh, joke and mesh well with their incredible team of bartenders, bouncers, and management. I would and do constantly highly recommend this place as our go to EVERY TIME friends or family come to town. Thank you to the Valentine team for being so amazing!

Great hotel!!! Clean rooms,friendly staff. We ordered room service for breakfast.the service was fast and the food was great and reasonably priced. This is our new go to hotel when we're in the nashville area.

Great hotel. Awesome customer service from Ashley Hudson and Danielle Terry. Both of them went above and beyond in getting a special alarm clock for Deaf customers from another nearby hotel. Customer service was great at the bar as well. Definitely a good place to unwind at the end of a long travel day.

Molly M waited on me. I explained I needed a HRC pin for my shadow box that would match the other pins.  She went above and beyond to help me.  After I signed my receipt, I gave her my pen in appreciation!!!

When our flight was delayed causing us to miss our connecting flights with no hope of reaching out final destination u quickly hopped on the Starwood SPG website to find a good rated hotel in the area. The rate-to-quality of this hotel was a fantastic value. And it was cheaper booking direct compared to an online travel site. 

The hotel was of good Sheraton quality and the staff was fantastic. The room was clean and nice. Although being an airport hotel you did hear the planes frequently overhead. 

My wife needed some apple cider vinegar from room service, and while I was uncertain if they could, they not only delivered but extremely quickly. They said it would take a bit with a few orders in front of us so I requested if it would be done in about 30 minutes. It was less than 10 minutes before we had it at the door. 

The lobby was beautiful as well as the courtyard. Although I wish we had more time to enjoy this property itself. If staying from any length of time, schedule some time to just enjoy the property. 

The only thing that came up was that our last minute reservation done on their website didn't make it to the hotel before we arrived so they ended up having to rebook me locality. The rate was the same.

We had been to the HR last weekend and our server sold us on the HR's NYE private party. We decided to go with the least expensive ticket at $75 per person since we had to buy 3. We were told we would be outside, but it would be covered, heated and have a table/seating. It would also include access to the HR Café itself and the bathrooms. Luckily we had eaten prior to arriving at the HR for NYE. We were supposed to be let in at 8pm. After waiting in line the HR security finally let us in at 8:15pm. There was a very small covered area with 2 heaters. The area where the tables/seating was not covered nor were there any heaters. There was one bar and absolutely zero wait staff. We were given 2 drink tickets, but after we used those tickets we were only allowed to order from the limited bar outside. The HR had security at every door and would not allow us into the café, the bar inside or the store. We could only go to the bathroom and then had to leave. About 15 mins before midnight I went to the bathroom again and saw they were giving out champagne to the people inside. There was none provided outside nor were we given the option to purchase a glass. This was the only time in the night there was not security at the door guarding the café, so I walked into the bar and asked the bartender if I could get a couple of glasses of champagne. He looked at me in disgust and said "yeah, if you paid for it" and walked away. My badge clearly said "club level" so he knew I was not part of the $125 ticket for inside. I was completely offended. After I had just spent $100 eating there with my family on Sunday night, then another $300 for NYE. I was treated so poorly. I wasn't asking for it for free, I would have happily purchased it. I live in Nashville and am appalled that someone in our city would treat paying customers so poorly. There were 2, yes 2 heaters outside for about 100 people. It was ridiculous. Yes, we had a great view of the main stage, and yes we didn't have to fight for a bathroom, but after spending $400 at the HR in one week I would have expected to have been treated better. I was also told that the people with the $200 tickets were unhappy because they ran out of propane for the heaters upstairs on the balcony and they said the food was nothing special. Overall we had a good time, but the "private party" was a bit disappointing.

Stopped by here because of a conference I had around here. 
First the people: our awesomely cool and funny waiter (Chris) treated us like we were his friend and made us feel like we were special. The bartender had a cast on her hand yet was working hard and talking to us even if we weren't her customers.(that's how friendly they were) A super cute, adorable, (and a little shy guy (John?)) He and the rest of the staff made us feel so welcomed and loved! :D So customer service wise, I believe they hired THE BEST

Moving on to food:
Southwest Chicken is a MUST TRY. Dip it in the sauce, heaven. It may look small but it WILL fill you up. So the price is justifiable. 
Cesar salad was ok, nothing too special but the grilled chicken was good. This place is known for burger, go a little wild! 
The berry drink (berrylicious?) was also so good! Cute little decoration of strawberry and orange so you KNOW its fresh! Though a little pricey. it's really good. Just like Jumba Juice! 

If I lived here and not 2 states away, I would defiantly come again :3

Stopped in here for a very short amount of time on a Thursday night and it was your standard broadway bar playing live country music. Good crowd, room to walk around, average priced titos and beer, good atmosphere. I remember sitting at the bar listening to music and asking myself where we were again, looking up, seeing the name Whisky Bent on the wall and thinking that this place was pretty decent, wewould definitely come back to this bar next time we're in Nashville.

Great small venue to listen to live music and grab a drink. I walked up and down Broadway and Whiskey Bent is the bar I chose to sit into. Glad I did! The bartenders were awesome, friendly and attentive. The bands that happened to be playing were great and I had a wonderful afternoon sipping on drinks and listening to great live music.

Stopped in The Valentine for a couple of drinks. I liked it. Although it was crowded, the bartenders were very proactive and went out of their way to service the customers. Bartender in the back was great. Nice open floor plan to have drinks and watch live music. The upstairs is very cool. Huge chandelier occupies the center of the ceiling and you look down on the main floor. Lots of stools and tables upstairs too along with multiple bars. This place had a cool vibe and the staff was great.
Had most wonderful time here last nite with my girl. Music was just amazing crowed was very mature would definitely recommend coming here n next time coming back with my more girls time.

Eh. Our server was good. The food was mediocre. Which we probably should have expected. 

I ordered the twisted Mac and cheese with chicken and red peppers. It was okay, nothing to write home about. My girlfriend ordered a $30 steak that she could only eat half of. She asked for medium rare, thinking that places tend to overcook steaks a little anyway. (She eats steak a lot, probably once a week. She is not new to proper steak ordering). However this steak was RARE and cooked unevenly. We looked it up to make sure and compared. She basically just ate the edges because the center was cold. It was not medium rare. In truth, she did not say anything to the server because by the time she realized it was not cooked the way she asked, she had already eaten like a third of it (the more cooked side). She also felt bad and the server was so nice so we just didn't say anything. 

Can't say that I'll be hurrying back to a Hard Rock Cafe anytime soon.
Fantastic service from Letitia at the bar. Great drinks, and all around friendly staff!

We got to stay here by accident when we missed a connection on Southwest Airlines. It was a great experience. When we got downstairs to eat dinner, the restaurant was closed, but Jackie served us in the bar from the regular dinner menu. My husband enjoyed a delicious NY strip steak with mashed potatoes and asparagus cooked just right! We joined the rewards program, so we didn't have to pay for the wireless connection. Bed was very comfortable; they had plenty of towels in the room, and the shampoo, soap and hand lotion were totally welcome since our bags didn't make it! Way to go Sheraton. They also had complimentary bottled water!

My mom and I came to Nashville for a few days for vacation. We're not into the big touristy spots or spots where drunk people congregate.  We wanted to find a great place with music. We first came to bootleggers and we're very pleased with the music performances they had. The music is typically one-two singers and a guitarist. If you're looking for something more low key with amazing talent and friendly service (Janet was so sweet), then bootleggers is the place for you.
Great sound. Great food and nice drink.  Could spend the rest of the trip here.     Very impress with location and overall.   Staff really nice.  Thanks

What was once a shining star in the barbeque world is, as of this writing, for sale and not worthy of a visit until a new owner takes over.  Our visit started with not one, but two disappointments.  The liquor license expired, so they could no longer pour, and they ran out of the smoked Texas sausage (read: they aren't going to get any more).  Having no choice but to eat, the usually reliable brisket was dry and overcooked.  The service was good, but you have to feel for them; having to deal with the reality of a place on life support.   Here's hoping a new owner brings this back to its former self, but until then, stay away,

I am giving it 4 stars, because I really do not recall much. It was about 4pm on cinco de mayo, since noone does the Mayo here in Redneckville, it didnt matter. I had fun, i think.

The drinks are bit pricey for Redneckville, but I am sure it is because it is a tourist trap :)
Still cheaper than in Las Vegas for tourists haha
inexpensive locals bar. lots a reviews complained of the smoke but fret no more; smoking is outside only, in their newly fenced in back yard /patio area.

Just saw Luke Combs here!!! What a blast. Beers are reasonably priced. Venue is great for any band in Nashville. Had to wait online in the rain for an hour before he went on though. Other than that place is awesome. Highly recommend!!

This place was fun. A big group of friends and stopped in around lunch time on a whim and we were glad we did. Bootlegger's sells moonshine in multiple flavors and the bartender we had made us all different kinds of yummy drinks. I had the jalepeno margarita, which was good, if you like more of a savory drink and tried my friends' watermelon margarita and blue raspberry margaritas. They seemed pretty slow when we were there, but there was a good band playing and we received very attentive service. Also, I loved their mason jar chandeliers. Very cool!

Awesome bar with live music right on Broadway. There are so many places to choose from and I was having major sensory overload, but so happy we stopped here!

My family was so tired after a long day of doing as many touristy things as possible. We didn't want a jam packed bar but still wanted he live music scene. There was a great cover band that was very interactive with the crowd. Take note that we were out on a Monday night and it was still poppin'. 

Drinks: Lots of drink choices to choose from except for the fact that they don't make a Hot Toddy. Disappointing because it's not that hard to make one. 

Seating: There's an upstairs and downstairs that give you a great view of the band no matter where you're at. Plenty of room for everyone!

Two years ago I had a terrible time at a Sheraton in Florida. This week was my first return to one of their hotels.  I can't say enough good things about my experience. From check in to check out everything was taken care of, all of our needs met. Clean, maintained, great service and advice from many staff members, especially Tammy in the lobby area and Terrell in the Club Room.  So good that I had them book me a room for tonight in Birmingham.
Went to the country music museum today, this place is the best refresher of the past and makes me wish I lived in the Johnny Cash days!

Sunday afternoon fun!!! 
This was our fav bar on Broadway (out of the 5 we went to.) I didn't know what I wanted, asked the bartender to surprise me. No hesitation, except to ask if I like a particular flavor, and she went to work! Delicious cocktails. GREAT band, who I wish I could remember the name of, and fun atmosphere. Bartenders were on top of their game! A+

We booked this hotel via Hotwire.com and got a great deal.  When reading about the hotel, we saw that it was pet friendly so we were happy to know that we could bring our dog, since we were arriving here after visiting family in NC.  When we checked in, I asked if there was anything special I should know since we had our dog and they made me sign a form and said that we couldn't leave our dog in the room unattended, so that really put a damper on the entire trip because we were very limited on where we could go.  

I wish this was posted on their website so that we wouldn't have brought our dog on the trip.  

Otherwise everything was very nice, staff was good, rooms were nice and it was within reasonable distance from everything (driving not walking)

The Stage was perfect for my friends and me. It's very large with lots of seating and has a great set up for bands. I was also really impressed because they had a large bathroom that was clean. I wasn't expecting that on Broadway but I was proved wrong. I liked that the place had a large dancing area but also enough room that you weren't jam packed against everyone else.

DO NOT STAY HERE! I used to be a consultant so have stayed at dozens of SPG properties, but this was by far the worst. The property is old, run down, and just seems tired and outdated. I checked in and was given a room on the second floor. There is only one elevator bank and the hotel is a giant loop of rooms and the one they gave me was at the furthest point in the loop, opposite the elevator bank. I had to pass approximately 40 rooms to get to mine, which was not pleasant with all my luggage. The hotel wasn't full, yet they gave me the most inconvenient room to access. At night I was kept up for an hour due to loud noise from the room above me. So not only was I given a room that was difficult to get to, I had very loud upstairs neighbors. The hotel managers should know that sound travels a lot in the hotel and given it wasn't a full hotel, it made no sense to put me directly below another occupied room. 

The keys to the hotel room deactivated in my purse even when kept away from my cell phone. After two different occurrences of walking all the way to my room and finding out my keys were deactivated, I was naturally frustrated. The first time they didn't work, I called the front desk from my cell phone and was told, not very pleasantly, that it would take 30 minutes for someone to come let me in. I was told to come to the front desk, which I ended up doing. I explained I was surprised they didn't have a night security to unlock doors (which the man at the front desk did not respond to) and that my key deactivated. The man explained either the hotel keys deactivate or your credit cards. How is it that for the past 3 years I have had no issue with any other hotel keys being deactivated so quickly and from credit cards? The man did not apologize for the inconvenience! It happened my next time trying to reenter my room. After that I just would go to the front desk when I came back to the hotel to get new keys each time knowing they wouldn't work. 

Beyond the deactivating keys, general warn down nature, unfriendly staff, and inconvenient lay out, I wanted to get a yogurt to eat in my room in the morning. There are no coffee shops or restaurants within a mile of the hotel and I didn't have a car, so I went to the restaurant in the lobby. I asked for a take away yogurt. It was over $4 and the woman came back with a small light and fit yogurt! This is absolutely absurd. Even in NYC this would be crazy pricing for something that costs no more than 50 cents, but in Nashville! I was going to say I didn't want it, but I already paid and doubted I would ever be reimbursed. 

Also, free wireless internet is guaranteed for SPG members. I was not given an access code and I wanted to use my laptop, but didn't want to deal with the staff anymore given they were not helpful in any way.

I do not understand how this property can cost 7,000 point a night. This was the biggest waste ever. SPG should not keep this as a property or should put serious effort into getting the building and staff up to SPG standards!

Pretty large venue this one, with mostly good bands, at least when I've been. The drinks are reasonable and it gets packed with tourists on weekends. There is usually a super long line outside so go around the back to the alley and enter at the rear, you will save loads a time.  Bar staff are very efficient you won't wait long for your beer. Well worth stopping in this place for that true Nashville experience, you won't be disappointed.
Great place for drinkin' and watchin' live music. Intimate settin', stage is not so high that you feel disconnected with the band. Friendly bartenders and decent drink prices. Good times.

With a skeleton crew on for Thanksgiving, our waitress was working hard. She did a good job, considering. So did the kitchen. Food was out surprisingly fast, and we had no complaints. The menu seemed awfully limited and had no local feel. I had hoped to go to a non-chain eatery, but many of them were closed for the day. Better planning, next time!

Blow away by the awesome service!!! On a whim, we decided to give Hard Rock a try. Having our 3 yr old is always tricky, and since we were surrounded by bars, we figured we better play it safe.. So glad we did!!! 

We were able to get a table right away. Our server, Morgan was right there to greet us and take out order. The atmosphere was fun.. Music was great!! It had our 3 yr old dancing. Will definitely go back on our next trip to Nashville!!!

I've been to the Sheraton Music City twice, both times were for the Nashville cat show. I've never stayed at the hotel and my rating is only on the convention center part of the hotel. 

From the look of the hotel, I'd say this place was built in the 1980's maybe; but it's been well kept. The location of the hotel isn't downtown, it's more of an airport hotel, which is good and bad. Good being close to the airport and bad because there isn't much in the way of entertainment or restaurants. 

The convention/expo center has its own entrance on the north side of the building. There is a small lobby/foyer before you enter the ballroom area. Along the ballroom there's a hallway that leads down to the other ballrooms and conference rooms. The bathrooms are located along this hallway. 

In the foyer area is a small concession stand that sells sandwiches and salads, along with drinks during events. This is a great space for the Nashville Cat show.

The best thing about the hotel was the bed was so comfortable and the staff was very friendly! So friendly that they told my husband you can come out to Tennessee and buy two boots and get one free! Very pleasant! Next time we visit we will be back to enjoy a bit longer!

I have visited Nashville for business on a number of occasions and always come back here. I discovered it my first trip down a few years ago and was glad I did. The service and staff is always great which can always be hit or miss at venues like this. The music is also very fun - on a number of occasions i have been in here and heard covers of classic rap songs which is arguably the only country I can genuinely say I like. 

I always recommend that whenever someone comes to Nashville they add this to the top of the list to stop in at.

PARKING: street parking. 
OUTSIDE: visiting from CA so I had to check out downtown Nashville at night. I haven't been down here in at least 10 years at night. 

You can see from outside through the open door that there were a good amount of people inside with a live band playing and hear the good music and singer. 

INSIDE: free cover for men and women! YEEHAW says the hand stamp on my wrist. How appropriate for going into a country bar. Cowboy faces on the right wall painted. Live band directly on your right when you walk in. Ample floor space for dancing but only one couple dancing. 
Music was great so I wish more people were dancing. 

Everyone else was sitting or standing by he bar or the tables and chairs. Or upstairs where you can look down and see downstairs. One guy was dropping ice on a friend down below haha. 

BATHROOMS: decent, toilet paper and no bad smells, which is always a plus when out at a bar at night. 

MUSIC: LOVED the girl singer and the second band of guys. I'm no country music expert at all so he fact that I liked the music means a lot. They were taking requests and asking for tips of course but I know some bands don't take requests. Seems they knew a ton of songs. And if they couldn't play your song then they'd give your tip money back haha! 

OVERALL: I would come back for sure. Liked the stools at the bar instead of having to stand awkwardly with your drink all night. Music was live and not just a run of the mill DJ pressing buttons. No cover charge! Guy even re stamped the YEEHAAAW on my hand when I asked him to on my way out.
This was my favorite bar in Nashville! The different floors made for a fun atmosphere and the rooftop was cool. Casey Weston plays here a lot- she's so amazing! Highly recommended.

Preface: I'm an "Out-Of-Towner" by most definitions.  I'm from Denver, CO and I'm not new to the while country-thing; wearing flannels, skinny jeans w/splits on the bottom; cowboy boots, cowboy hat, etc.
I'm going in: Nashville offered very little in that realm.  Rather, everyone was overly dressed; blazers, dinner coats, sports jackets, and button ups.  LITERALLY EVERY MALE WAS DRESSED THAT WAY.  That was some try-hard fuckboy shit IMO.  Bunch of followers or something.  Anyway, like the rest of the bars downtown, the Stage was no exception to the rule.  Everyone there was rude AF.  The service was mediocre if it ever made its way in your direction.  The hoes were "so-so" and basic AF.  These wanna be "Nashvile" stars were pathetic and seemed to be living out some type of dream of getting a record deal or some shit.  The only blacks out there were workers.  Apparently, being black and working the door or security makes you bulletproof and scary AF to the Nashville-goers.  Call me Crazy with a K, but that shit seemed racist AF to me.  Anyway...  I was disappointed AF!  Every bar to include the Stage were supremely boring and tasteless.  Good luck to he who dares.

We stopped in while waiting for a nighttime trolley tour so we were only in there for about 20 minutes at 6:30pm. We had fantastic moonshine drinks! There was a terrific band playing and it just had a good vibe of a local, semi-dive bar. On Friday night I ventured down to Tootsie and man was that a mistake! For one I wasn't drunk and two, i was alone, anyway after leaving and zig zagging my way through the hoards of people down Broadway to fin somewhere else to go, I found myself back at Bootleggers and it was kind of empty but I just had a fantastic time! Again, another great band playing, had a few local beers and ended up staying until about 1:30am! Service was good, vibe was great. Chatted with a lot of others who were visiting from out of town. Just all over good vibe and a great place to go if the jammed packed bars of Broadway are too overwhelming.

Stopped in for a drink and music on a Thursday afternoon. Luckily got last seats available, place was packed but comfortably so. Got to hear Sean Rivers and Lou Molitch.  Recommend this venue, recommend the musicians.

Do not go here on a Friday or Saturday night. Actually all of Broadway gets CRAZY at night. We went there our first night out (on Thursday) and it was PERFECT. There was a band and a good crowd, but not crazy packed that you were getting knocked over. If I ever come here again, I will not be on Broadway during the weekend.

This place was pretty cool! Very much like the Tardis, in that it is much bigger on the inside than it looks on the outside. The first floor was overwhelmingly packed, but we soon found out that there were 3 other levels to explore! Each level was as fun as the next, and there was definitely more room to dance a little :) drinks weren't too overpriced and we didn't pay a cover to get in, so that was great. I've been looking for some actual line dancing places downtown for a while and can't seem to find one. Even though The Stage didn't fit the bill when it came to line dancing of any kind, I still had a lot of fun :)
This cool dive bar near 5 points is a cheap place to get your buzz on. Feels like a familiar locals bar and the night we went had swing night so it was like crashing someone's house party. Fun times.

We've been to other Hard Rock Cafes and found them to be okay. Since we were in Music City, we thought we would give this one a try. Went for lunch. We had salads (Haystack Chicken Salad and the Smokehouse Chop Salad), both were very good. The service was excellent. We were surprised at how sparse the memorabilia on the walls was, usually the walls were packed! Certainly, should not stop you from going.

A bar and a good band. Nothing wrong there...but the beer was overpriced and the service below average.  Still, the band was very good.  If there's a good band on stage, stop in.  Just know that you'll pay $5.50 for a bottle of beer and will have a limited selection.

Lol we had so much fun here. The band that played really had us going! A nice throwback set with 80s and 90s hits. I don't remember their name but the lady had big red Texas curly hair. We were on the rooftop and enjoyed ourselves. We came already buzzed so I think that added to the excitement lol. Oh! And it felt so good! It's always good to dance and not be drenched in sweat lol

Just went here to be a tourist and grab a beer, but it was awesome! The bartender was very engaging, and the atmosphere was amazing! I was by myself, and had never just gone to a bar for a beer by myself, but I felt very comfortable. Good beer, friendly bartender, how could anything go wrong?

Came here strictly for moonshine! It was delish! I had the water melon kind which they mixed into a margarita, and also a apple one and it was very tasty. They had a really fun band rocking the house on a Monday night.

Cleared out around 2, so wouldn't say it was quite happenin'. Loved the prohibition vibe inside and decor, bartender was super attentive. Many tables were extremely wobbly, and I was worried the elbows of my campanions would make it slide right off. Other than that, great spot in downtown.
I was born and raised here...the band tonight sang Brittany Spears...really? At the stage
Had an awesome time -- on a Monday night. Lots of people, fairly priced drinks and just an awesome vibe to the people there. Loved it!

Music all day err day! The house band here is great. They take requests and do originals. They're more on the bluesy country vibe, with some fiddle music mixed in, which I dug. And they engaged the crowd well. There's much more space here than other Broadway bars. They have outlets by the bar. It's a chill place to hang in groups. I saw both tourists, of all ages, and locals, hanging after work, which makes it a fun place to people-watch. No food or apps.

Went with some friends to celebrate his birthday, had a great time and the atmosphere was very authentic Nashville. Multiple levels of bars and live music on each floor. Didn't wait longer than a minute for a drink...great time!

Arriving the grounds seemed great but then the smell of stale smoke awaited us inside. We were upgraded to a pool view only to find a comforter that looked like a cat had been clawing, a dirty shower head and moldy or dirty door. After talking with management, Tessa, she agreed to refund our money in able for us to stay at a nearby and nicer hotel. She was the best part of the stay! Do yourself a favor and stay at the Marriott next door for a modern and clean hotel. This one is in serious need of renovation.

Food and service is excellent, Rooftop seating was closed for dining which is the only spot really worth eating at as the layout is very odd.
Store staff was super helpful and friendly, it's still a one visit stop for me.... 4 stars

This is a place I've started recommending to out of towners looking for a damned good bloody mary. It's also a pretty awesome place you can take your newborn to hang out that's not horribly loud, annoying, or you'll be in the way.

The patio is pretty sweet as well and I'm hoping that it will be available at some point when I go there (so far it's been raining every time)

Went there for brunch recently with friends and their crib monster, honestly had just a remarkably pleasant time. It's very hard for me to quantify why it was so pleasant, the food was a little better than average but not especially so, the service was fine, the bloody maries were great, but oddly a month afterward I'm still thinking about how I want to go back.

I'm not really sure why either as it's not the most vegetarian friendly place on the planet, but it's got something to it that seems to appeal to me.
Best on East Side if it were not for the smoking I would give it a 5, I use to smoke and always went outside. They have a great patio.

Came here for a couple drinks and appetizers with my friends. For $10 a drink, we weren't very satisfied. Our drinks were all very weak and tasted like they had no if any alcohol in them. I ordered the Margherita flatbread to eat, and it wasn't the best. The cheese on it was way too thick and the crust was super hard, kind of felt like chewing on cardboard. The rooftop is also a lot lower than a lot of the other rooftops in the area. I would recommend going to one of the local restaurants instead of here.

This was our first time in Nashville, we stayed at the Sheraton Music City. The room was clean and very comfortable. The staff was very friendly and helpful, especially Nolan. What a great guy with a wealth of knowledge about the area. This was a trip for our 20th wedding anniversary and wouldn't you know we found a nice anniversary card in our room signed by the entire staff. I recommend staying here if your travel plans take you to Nashville.
Relaxing, clean, and quiet.... but only 15 minutes to Downtown by shuttle or cab. Gorgeous outdoor pool setting, safe and friendly feel, would definitely recommend to travelers for business or fun!

The stage is one of my favorite venues in Nashville, but unfortunately it has become so popular that it was almost impossible to get in the most recent time I was there. I tried to stop by Saturday afternoon ( standing room only) and Saturday evening (mile long line out the door). It wasn't until mid day Sunday that when the strip was a little less crazy that I could get in. I have always really loved the quality of musicians that the Stage attracts and I've never not enjoyed a set here, whether it be classic country, contemporary country, or top 40. Service is fast and friendly and the bar exudes classic country ambiance. What a great place to go on your trip to Nashville, just make sure you go at an off time, or you'll be waiting in line for quite a while.

If you happen to be in need of killing some time and your stomach is in the process of eating itself, head on over to this lively dining experience. The wait staff members are very welcoming, accommodating, and attentive. The menu is quite diverse. I'm a pescatarian, so when we opted to have burgers, I chose to try out their cauliflower burger, which is a house-made patty of cauliflower, garlic, goat cheese, oregano & breadcrumbs topped with grilled zucchini, squash and Monterey Jack cheese with arugula, vine-ripened tomato and garlic aioli. 

While awaiting the food, I sipped on a Sierra Mist and listened to the classic tunes. A short time later, the waiter informed me that they were actually out of the cauliflower burger but they had a veggie burger that I could indulge in. When I asked what that burger was made of, the manager, personally, went to take an image of the container box and returned to read the ingredients to me. I decided to give it a go and it was amazing! The patty was topped with flat slices of squash and zucchini, melted cheese, leafy greens, tomato, onions, and blue cheese crumbles. It was, by far, one of the best veggie burgers I've ever eaten. 
The fries, however, came out a bit cool in temperature, but our waiter was quick to replace them upon my request. Unfortunately, my sweets ate one of their beef burgers but was unimpressed.

Should I happen upon the Hard Rock again, I will try for the cauliflower burger. If I miss out a second time, I will gladly take on the veggie patty version once more.
We were walking down broadway and Cullen Greer drew us inside the Valentine. We will definitely be back and hopefully to hear Cullen Greer play again.
Hit there for Lunch. Had a band playing  which was cool. Hefty brisket sandwich.

Visiting from the north and not a huge country fan, but this is hands down my favorite bar that we visited. Large stage with larger dance floor. People of all ages. The band playing at the time was amazing and played music of multiple genres. Relaxed atmosphere and decent drinks. A must go to bar in Nashville for music lovers.

Really enjoyed The Stage on Broadway. Came here three times throughout our trip to Nashville. The first was on a Thursday afternoon, we sat out on the patio on the rooftop and watch the band who was playing inside. It was a little bit of a tough view since we were outside and they were inside but they still took requests from us and this particular band was fantastic. They were not just playing country, but 70's, hard rock, you name it they could play it. The place was quieter than most rooftops on this particular afternoon and we liked that. Downstairs there was not much going on. We came back that night and again the following afternoon, again, good bands playing, nice atmosphere, I would recommend this place to anyone who wants more of a quieter atmosphere with great music.

Nice place, good atmosphere, good live band and great drink specials! Waitress was very nice & the bartender was nice too. The food was good. My first time in Nashville, TN. I'll definitely come back to this place!

Honky Tonk/Bar.
A good dive bar with good live music as it should be in Music City.
Nothing much to complain about...

This stop was more out of convenience. It was on our walk back to our car and we had stopped at a couple of places that had too long of a wait so we decided to try this place out. It was maybe a 10 minute wait? Not bad compared to the 45 minute wait at the other restaurants. It's overpriced food but it's because of the place and location. It is expected. We decided to just share the sampler. It was actually pretty filling for 2 people. It was well worth the $20 we spent. If you want somethin to share and on the cheaper side this is the way to go. Our waitress was sweet and everyone we encountered was very nice.

The bar itself was pretty cool. It is one of the larger venues on Broadway & that is great if you get tired of fighting twenty somethings for space to stand on the floor. The mixed drinks were poured very "heavy" and I was always able to get a bartender's attention at the bar pretty quickly.

Being a man, its easy to get looked over at the bar. I've been to this place a few times and hated it. But I have a woman that loves it so I came back. The band was great! Can not remember the name bc I had that good of a time, lol. Drinks came quickly and the band that played Wednesday, Sept 2nd was great! Very little new cuntry and lots of greats! Friendly service at the bar and daaaaaaaaamn good time!
Food was great very clean bathrooms clean portions perfect had the famous skillet was very good wife Had steak was perfect

If you looking for a lot of fun and good music, this is the place to find it. They have a lot of good bands coming in. A few of us walked in and ended up staying a while. It was to hard to leave. When you hear a good band it just makes the night. Hope you have as much fun and as we did.

Came across this great spot while meandering our way through downtown, Nashville.   Definitely felt less touristy than some of the other spots, people were really great, drinks were fairly priced and wasnt nearly as crowded, and no cover!!

It's 4th of July, things are crazy, and Tisha and Greg are STILL taking great care of us at the bar while pumping out drinks like a well-oiled machine for the rest of the restaurant. I always appreciate personable bartenders, but they have kept us well entertained despite a high demand. Tisha is the kind of gal I'd love to employ, as she took initiative where her coworkers left her drowning, and also managed to realize we had an incorrect check, and took care of us to make sure we were paying an accurate tab. I'd sit at their bar top anytime!
Excellent band playing! People dancing! Great drinks! FIREBALL!

Some of the driest pork, I have had in years.  Needed a steak knife just to eat the brisket but of course there's no knives. The brisket was closer to jerky. Five and half dollars for warm beer is a bit much too.

This place is so good to have the ideal Nashville experience. There are endless bars and venues to stop in on Broadway, but this one stuck out to us in particular because of how welcoming it was from the outside. The host outside was so friendly. The stairs inside this place to get to the top are brutal but the rooftop bar is so worth the hike. I love that there are stages on multiple levels of this place so you can decide where you want to enjoy your time here. It's a decent sized space and was very crowded but honestly what else should you expect from a great bar in Nashville on Music Row? The drinks were strong and the place was loud but I think that's everything you want in Nashville.

I have lived in Nashville for 14 years now and have heard about the 5 Spot and how awesome it is for years. Living on the other side of the river I just never got myself over there until recently when a friend suggested I go on a Saturday night when they had a Hip-Hop dance party with different DJs. 

First of all, my boyfriend and I had to wait in a long line out in the cold to learn that we had to pay a $10 cover at the door, so we had to hit up the ATM inside since we aren't avid cash carriers. 

Second of all, the place was so crowded and full of smoke. I know it's a bar and all but it is also a music venue and I guess I am not used to trying to enjoy music of any kind while inhaling second hand smoke. It was awful. 

Anyhow, we didn't have that great of an experience. I may go again on a different night with a different crowd and see if my feelings change about this place and then I will update my review.

I'm constantly on a quest to find a great spot to let loose and shake my booty.  While visiting Nashville, my best gal pal took me to the 5 Spot.  

Upon entering, we were greeted by great old 50's jazz/blues music and crap tons of people!  It was seriously packed in this place!
