There was a pool table and a decent sized space for dancing.  Naturally, I quickly made my way over to said dance floor.  I had a great time dancing with my peeps and I didn't even mind that everyone was sweating on me.  Gross...I know.  I think the only thing I wasn't super thrilled with, was the fact that EVERYONE was smoking in the bar (apparently it's ok in TN if it's strictly a bar).  

I will totally hit this place up again when I'm back in Tennessee, for sure!

Yeehaw, bitches!

This place was a blast! The band was great and we danced our butt's off. It get crowded just like any of the bars off Broadway get. It was a mixed crowd but everyone there was enjoying themselves.  

There was no cover and drink prices were typical.

I love people that rate this place 3 stars cause of the music and then they go on to explain how they know the band gets tipped to play these songs "the back street boys" lol. Well, if you know that, then tip the band and ask for a song or two you like. Cheapos.

Great bartender, great sound (upstairs), deck was great, drinks were strong and one of the better places we went to.

Awful. Badly in need of a refresh. Experience started with a front desk clerk who barely made eye contact, and was exceptionally indifferent and rude. The experience continued with a handicapped-accessible room that is so poorly designed that the walk in shower floods the bathroom floor....every time it's used. 
The icing on the cake was the visit from a good sized cockroach this morning. 
All this and more for $300 Per night. When I calmly explained these issues on checkout this morning- no apology. Amazing. 
Starwood/Marriott corporate: You need to take a good long hard look at this one. Disgraceful.

This is by far the best hotel I've stayed at. The room was just breathtaking and the staff was amazing. Every member of the staff was very friendly and knowledgeable. I would definitely stay here again and recommend to everyone.
I stayed in a junior suite which was well worth every penny. Stayed for 3 nights. Wanted a date night with my wife and asked the front desk best places to go and they deffinently pointed me in the right direction. Hotel offers shuttles to downtown and back all the way till 2 am. That's awesome! The beds in the rooms are to die for. Seriously never slept better in my life. The shower is like tears from the gods. If you're in Nashville you must stay here!

Thoroughly enjoyed the spicy Diablo shrimp (wrapped in bacon and a smoked jalapeño), super-tender brisket, snappy sausage, and beer on a random Monday night. Ahhh, beer...the excellent selection on draft immediately betrayed the "dive bar" edifice despite the Jaegermeister shot machine lying fallow on this night in the corner. Blackberry cobbler was well-conceived, but something about my portion tasted distinctly of BBQ sauce, and not on purpose. Personally, I think they're trying a little too hard to compete with the kitsch collection on the walls at TGIF's around the corner, but foodwise there would be absolutely no reason to go to TGIF with this place literally steps away. In my opinion, the appetizers are 20% overpriced and the entrees are 25% underpriced, and should include a side...but maybe the Judge knows best. I'm not local so I'm not sure where the pit expertise is coming from, or headed for, as this relatively small joint in an out-of-the-way location seems like too small a venue for meat this intense and labor-intensive. Perhaps it's a small chain under many names. If it isn't, it should be. Good stuff, I look forward to coming back the next time I stay at the Loewe's, and I will take Chelsie's recommendations once again.

After 3 days that we had checked it out too many bars on broadway So last night we chosen this bar bcoz the band that playing sound awesome.First we want to stay there enjoy the music,drink or whatever that why i opened my card...,but later we were ignored by server! we tried to looking for her to pay my bill after The band left..,finally she came and asked for another drink but we're leaving..,So i paid $13 buck plus tip Then i checked my account in the morning they charged me overprice.The bar is wasn't busy at all!
First floor very clean and neat.   Excellent bar tender and they offer Italian natural spring water! Great option

It was pretty good, the bar staff was very friendly and even remembered who I was when I went to close my tab! The band "Kid Freud" did a good job as well. Kudos! Anyways, no complaints towards this establishment except they could have done a slightly better job in the "WOW" factor department.

Hasn't let me down yet. If you want to have a funky goos time. Then this place will tickle your fancy. The 5 spot offers a diverse crowd, a variety of DJs from around the country mixed with live entertainment, and people that actual dance. I could go on forever baby (*home alone rip) Smaller venue but that adds to the essence of what this place brings to Nashville's jolly ole "Honky-tonk" scene. Blah! Cool place, great vibes, and normally its a food truck somewhere close afterwards. Check it out. Peace

We stopped here while on vacation in Nashville and it was a great choice! The service was very friendly and very good! Both our waitress Shavera and the manager Molly were awesome! My husband and I split the ribs and it was a huge portion! They were falling off the bone and they were amazing! The prices are a little higher but they are this way at all of the Hard Rock Cafes. You expect that when you go there.
Awesome music venue! Went on $2 Tuesdays, $2 cover and $2 Yazoo on tap. Best time ever in Nashville. Great music, fun times!

I had a lemonade made from scratch right on the spot by the bartender! That alone was so awesome for my experience at The Stage to be one for the ages! The live music was really good; it's refreshing to hear a fiddle from up close and also for a band to play "traditional" country music! There is a big crowd but it is a great time!

I was wary of this hotel because I had pricelined the room and didn't know what treatment I might receive.  I had NO reason to worry--they treated me like royalty--gave me an upgrade, threw in internet.  The room was beautiful and the king sized bed was amazingly comfortable.  I enjoyed both pools and used the fitness room (which is excellent--seriously) frequently.  Suggestion:  if you can, upgrade to the Club membership--breakfast and substantial appetizers (along with sodas and snacks at any time throughout the day) are included.  Loved this RESORT. :)

Wandered into the Bootleggers Inn on a Saturday afternoon while waiting for friends to tour the Country Music Hall of Fame.  Liked that the bar was not crowded like most of the others further up Broadway.  Bartender and patrons were friendly.  Shortly after arrival a busload of two bachelorette parties arrived and decided to sample the "moonshine".  Livened up the place and took lots of pictures.  Hung around for a while before wandering on, but will definitely be back.
Food was good, service was ok, about average for a Hard Rock. Always a little too loud and crowded.
Great service great things to look at    Great band selection.   Awesome time and experience. Will check me here again

Went to listen to music a year ago and had a great time so this week on my recent visit my friends and I decided to check out the band that was playing. We ended up giving the band $20 to sing some country songs and they sang one per my request. Then went back to rock. Well I thought I was at the stage which is known for honky tonk and at least having a band that was friendly to the customers. Instead I got a band leader that was rude and tried to be a comedian and embarrass me after giving cash to them which they indicated was required for a song request. And to top the evening and I most likely wouldn't even have bothered with this review but after ordering a corona, well vodka and cranberry juice and a vodka soda which cost $42, which was different then when purchasing the same drinks is upstairs it made me curious if anyone was running this place or if the employees and band were in charge. I Won't be stepping in there again.

Whiskey Bent is my favorite place to be on a Sunday night! Hushpuppy's Daddy is a great band with a mix of old country and 50's and 60's rock. If you like to swing dance or just to watch, you should be there between 6pm and 10pm. The bartenders are great too! Everyone is friendly.

The hotel itself (lobby) is beautiful. As a tall person, I enjoy the high shower heads. In terms of convenience: If you enjoy having a close distance(only to the airport) then you'll love it. Nothing else is convenient. There are no stores within walking distance. This hotel luckily also doesn't have a gift shop. There is a shuttle that takes you downtown or to markets, but that's it. For anyone reading this and thinking "Hey I liked that hotel" or "Quit hating" or whatever, I've heard the same complaints from numerous people during my stay here. Unless you're planning on intentionally inconveniencing yourself and your family during your stay in Nashville, don't stay here.

Offered valet parking service at the front door.  Usual HR decor that seems a little less then others. We stopped in for an early dinner and even though there were multiple available tables; we ended up with a 45 min wait.  It was apparent that they were short staffed during our visit.  Drinks came out quickly, but the food was slow to arrive.   We had one round of refills and then the waiter was MIA.  Very nice waiter, but they had him with too many tables and then their computer system went down.   Food was good, nothing spectacular and the pricing is what you expect from this chain.  Overall, too many great places to choose in the downtown area to come back here.
The hours listed on this Yelp page are not correct. We drove 40 minutes to try this place out and they were closed. Was pretty excited to try it out though. Too bad.
Band was fun and rockin the house.  Drinks were expensive and weak. All in all an average place.
We hung out here both nights we stayed in Music City. Great bands, friendly staff, and great spirits! I would recommend this to anyone looking for some live music that's not all country.
This bar wasn't so jam packed on this lovely Sunday night, which was nice. Cool country theme decor and a great sized stage! No cover charge after 6 was a plus!
Great music, friendly staff, good vibe.  Went back twice in one day we liked it so much.

Located on Broadway, in the midst of a ton of bars and shops. Great live music scene, and nice inside, too! Not a dive bar at all. Gets very crowded, even the afternoons! Then there's whiskey, and more whiskey. If that's your poison this is your place. 
As a fellow Yelper noted, there is no food served here, and sometimes you need a bite, if only so you can have another and still be coherent! It was fun!

For the brief stay for YELP SPRING BREAK Nashville, this was a nice place.  It had cocktail hour, free shuttle to the airport.  

It's distance from downtown made it expensive to trek using a cab which I only had to do once when my phone died and I couldn't use UBER or Lyft.  However, the rooms were wonderful, the pool was close by (although I guess there was another pool indoors which I didn't see).  But it was a perfect spot away from the busy Nashville Downtown.

I think this was designed primarily for business visitors since it's location is close to the airport and near to some big businesses in I might consider the Nashville suburb.

Maybe I can say, this are one of the few delights I had in my visit to Nashville, the events I attended were so so and I didn't feel the welcome vibe we had when I did YELP SPRING BREAK Las Vegas several years ago.  Hopefully, lessons learned.  

Now if they only can do Spring Break in Europe...

Service was the slowest I have seen. We ordered and it took and hour to get the food on a Thursday night when it wasn't busy at all. My wings were ice cold and I sent them back. Not worth eating. The menu is limited and not worth it. With So many places to go don't waste your time at Hard Rock. .

Fair to middling at best. As much as I wanted to love it, it just didn't deliver. Tried 5 different meats. All had a good smokey flavor but were either overcooked or tasted like they were cooked days ago and put in steamer or banquet tray. The scorpion app was good. Brisket wrapped sausage jalapeños and bacon wrapped shrimp jalapeños. The smoked mushrooms were great. I was hoping this would be my go-to BBQ joint, but nope still searching middle TN. I was torn between 2 and 3 stars since its about a 2.5. They get a 3 for having Blue Bell ice cream. Will probably give this place another try in hopes that I hit them on an off night.

I had the BEST time at this bar during my recent trip to Nashville! This place will be the highlight of your vacation especially if your a drinker! 

I am fm NJ and came across this place while searching for a location for Whiskey Tasting! Sure enough, after searching and searching, I finally found one, THIS PLACE!  

Before heading down there i called the place and talked to the manager of the bar via email and let him know I when coming down and the number of people in my party (which was only two). 

When we arrived at the bar around 5pm, on a Tuesday and it was pretty empty. The decor was very interesting and fun. I went to the bartender and inquired about the Whiskey Tasting and this very nice girl (who was new) was not aware the bar had a Whiskey Tasting. I told her who I spoke to through email and she politely excused herself and got us another bartender. Another bartender came to help us who was also very nice and brought us two Whiskey Tasting sheets. On the sheets she put 5 large shot glasses on it (ten all together) and told us it was only $20 per person  for regular whiskey and $25 for premium Whiskey. 

Either way your getting 5 shots of Whiskey each for that  prices is just AMAZING! 

I wound up getting the premium and my bf got the regular. So we able to try 10 different whiskeys all together! She would pour us the shot and explain what that specific bottle was, how they made the whiskey, where its from etc (very interesting!)  After pouring the shot she left the bottles in front of each shot glass so we knew what we were drinking, which was very nice of her. One of the shots were moonshine and she also took the time out to explain the history of moonshine and what was so special about this specific bottle she was letting us try. We allowed her to pick out most of the bottles we tried because obviously she knew her stuff and we picked out maybe three of them. 

When my boyfriend and I tasted d the moonshine she laughed because it was very strong which she knew. She then gave us some really tasty berry mix in a different glass to pour our moonshine in because there was no way we could drink that straight which again was very nice of her. Every time we finished a shot she would take away the bottle and put it back behind the bar. 

For the next few hours we took our time tasting the whiskey and drinking some beers. The bar slowly started to get more crowded throughout the evening and before we knew it the bar was packed! I was so happy we got there early because eventually when we looked around there were no more seats at the bar. Keep in mind i was here on a tuesday. 

That night they had a live performance from a man named Brandon Giels, totally entertaining. He would play his piano upside down, blindfolded, played with his boots and even lit his piano on fire. He was so enthusiastic and extremely fun to watch! At this place they also have bar snacks just incase you get hungry. I wound up getting a pretzel it's warm cheese which was great after drinking all that whiskey. 

We left this bar feeling very nice and couldn't be happier I found this place! If your going to Nashville I highly recommend coming here! I will be back in the near future and will absolutely be making another stop here. Keep it up Whiskey Bent Saloon!

Just left this bar and someone stole my jacket while I was there and the wait staff was very inattentive.   They told me I needed to leave because my jacket was not there and kicked me out of the bar.

I had to walk home with no jacket on in 30 degree weather. Needless to say I will never be going back to this bar again.  Too many better places in Nashville to go.

good servers and service. good atmosphere. its loud, but the normal and fine loud because its just everyone talking. the food was alright, nothing special, but definitely not bad. but the expensiveness doesnt justify the food or amount. $12.95 for 5 chicken tenders. they were ok, but the breading sucked, to crunchy and to much. the menu doesnt say how much. i didnt know how many tenders i would get. i looked at getting wings as well and didnt know how many i would get. and the parking is awful! theres a small lot in front, but its only valet, and thats $10! then theres nothing else until a parking garage that doesnt tell u prices, and a small lot that is $27 for 4 hours. overall, if they had had a parking lot, it would have been a good enough time from start to finish

Beautiful hotel.  Fantastic service! I returned from an outdoor concert with a group, COVERED in mud, and we were still welcomed to join in on the fun at the bar by giggling staff members.  Our room was spacious with a great view of the courtyard. Would definitely stay again.

The airport is 5 minutes away. Downtown Nashville is 15 min away and there are zero stores or markets within walking distance. Their gift shop is puny, so be sure to bring your own snacks (they have a fridge but no microwave in the rooms)They only have one restaurant, which is pretty good. Their showers were comfortable to bathe in though. Their bar is thinly stocked and pricey [a Makers sour cost $13.00]. One last thing. Breakfast isn't complimentary, or cheap. Prepare to pay $15 for their breakfast buffet

I travel a lot, and ask very little, yet when I check in I ask for a quite room (I know this is relative to where the hotel is located, but there are nosier and quieter locations in a hotel).

I knew this hotel backed up to the freeway, so I asked to not be on the freeway side.  This is a big hotel, so there are plenty of rooms (80% or so) not facing the freeway, and I checked in early.  The guy who helped me said you are not on the freeway.  In the room all I heard was freeway, it was most exposed side.  I had a meeting right as I checked in or would have asked to change my room.  I was very polite/friendly when I checked in, yet he just blew off my request.

I didn't want to give this place even 1 star. The prices in everything is outrageous $3 for a 20oz drink. We booked our room a month in advance and when we arrived to check in the front desk tells us that we have been downgraded on our room. We had no other choice to stay because we were there for training.

On a recent 5 day trip to Nashville, checked out The Stage a number of times.  I liked this place a lot!  The bands here seem to be a little different than the more party-style bands at Honky Tonk Central or Tootsies. 

No cover (at least not when we were there) and drink prices seemed to be about average, compared to other places on Broadway.  If you come early in the day, they have tables and chairs set up and kids are allowed in until 6 pm. The space is pretty wide open and they have an upstairs loft area to sit.

We saw a few different bands play but my favorite was the Wes Cook Band.  I think Wes must be about my age because he was playing all the country songs I listened to in my teenaged years.  Loved him!

This place is absolutely fantastic, great bands, great atmosphere....and unlike tootsies they don't wand you down like a criminal or have no weapons signs everywhere...this is the south leave us alone.

Would never come here again, the guy at the door spent 30 seconds looking at my ID and my friends ID's. He  bent my ID in half and almost  broke it, then looks at my friend and tells him it doesn't look like him and says its fake. Even offered a second form of ID to show him. I'm 30 and my friends are both over 26. Incredibly unprofessional, never even giving this place a second chance.
This bar is a well-needed break from the hustle and bustle of Broadway. The bartenders are real people - super friendly and give great suggestions!

The Valentine was a pretty cool place, once people started showing up. When you first enter, you'll notice a beautiful chandelier hanging from the massive ceiling. There are three levels. The first level when you walk in is where the live band is playing and there's a huge dance floor. Of course, we decided to go to the second floor so that we could sit down and look down at the folks dancing. However, when we initially got to the second floor, the guy told us that it wasn't opened yet. Disappointed, we went to the third level which is a rooftop bar that didn't have live music, it was more like a stereo playing Top 40 music. We came to Nashville for live country music so although it had a great view and we took some pics, we decided to go back down to the first floor. On our way back down, an older gentleman said we're going to make them let us in the second floor and we were down so we did! We told the guy that we wanted in and he opened the red velvet ropes and we got in. It was a big party from then on.

This is a standard conference hotel. We stayed on the 4th floor and it smelled like wet towels the entire weekend. 

I took the kids to the pool, which I do not recommend. The pool looked like it hadn't been cleaned in a few weeks. There was LOTS of hair floating around, bugs, dirt, etc. The clientele at the pool matched the unkempt conditions. 

Our room was perfectly fine. Clean, no problems, low noise. Free Parking, which is easy to find as well.

First off, the people who work there are outstanding! Everyone asked if we needed help with a smile on their faces. 
The room was fine, clean, nice linens, just what I would expect. 
Here are my complaints. For a GIANT hotel, 2 handicapped spaces out front. The hotel is so large I had a hard time getting around. It was a hike from the lobby to our room, then another hike back down to the freezing cold pool. We were the only ones foolish enough to get in it. I asked a lady walking by if they had a wheel chair available and the VERY nice lady said yes, she would get it. IT was nice, but belonged to another lodger! They were so sweet about it, exchanged it for another one (after they tracked us down). Easy mistake to make. 99% of the time I can make it to the room and pool without one, but hate unloading mine from the back of the suv. 
THEN, after traipsing around, we thought we would just have room service. Uh oh, no menu in the room. We called and said we wanted a burger to split with extra fries. Neither of use want to eat a lot before we go to bed. So we got an "Angus" burger (read: no flavor), 10 French fries, for $35.

I recently traveled to Nashville for the first time with a group of friends. The music was great. Wandering around from bar to bar we found Bootleggers. It wasn't too crowded, you did not have to fight your way to the bar, and they had a good band. We stayed until they closed at 2. Would definitely return.

New to Nashville the hunky tonk bars are Rad...

Pros
Big open area for dancing
Bar girls are super cute and hot
Food bands and great sound
No cover 

Cons
And this is why 4 star then 5.  Bathroom is down the stairs BUT there is a dip in the floor to where the stairs start.  Saw folks  almost take a header down the stairs 3x in 10mins.  They need to fix it before someone gets hurt. 


Meh
Bartenders are AWESOME! Jacki is the best! Food is fantastic! Music was great. The restaurant is just amazing

Staying over on our way to Atlanta. The staff were very polite and helpful at the front desk and for room service. The beds were comfy, nice view from the patio, good coffee and creamer in the room. The bathroom was very clean. I love that they have two toilet paper rolls hanging. 

We enjoyed our stay overall, the only downfall was my lady and I were lost each time trying to find our room on the second floor. We walked in circles, and I can't even imagine how we'd find our rooms if we were intoxicated. Don't forget to put the do not disturb sign on the door before you go to bed. Check out is at noon and they start knocking on your door around 8am for house keeping. If you forget the sign, she'll tap tap tap and whatever you respond with, she'll say, "Ok, come back later." I listened to this for a good 10 minutes since you can hear a lot from the rooms.

We checked in around 10:30pm and were quite pleased with the expansive and well-maintained lobby. Nice bar with a number of patrons enjoying their drinks, fountain, clean floors and soft music. 

We were put in the hospitality suite, which just meant the bed was lower to the ground than the standard hotel bed is for easy egress and ingress for certain patrons. Not a problem at all. 

Okay the room was frickin huge. Like, frickin huge. Outdated and a little shabby, but frickin huge. The king sized bed fit two quite comfortably considering three more could've fit as well. 

So why the 3 stars? The rooms, if they're the same, require a serious update. The room service pamphlet was sticky and very very worn out, the couch/pull out was serviceable and the carpet is very dull. 

Oh and there was also a rather sizable centipede hanging out in the bathtub. Nothing some toilet paper couldn't handle, but yeah. That was nice. 

It was a great shower though. Hard to find hotels with good water pressure, but they definitely did. 

After we woke up, we enjoyed some Starbucks coffee courtesy of the pod machine in the room, some complimentary water and headed on out via video checkout. 

I miss the bed. Don't really miss the hotel though.

Wonderful experience and will definitely be returning. Took advantage of an incredible room rate on Priceline. Actually the best rate in town on a Monday night. So nice to have a balcony and although cold out I look forward to returning and using the pool. Additionally they serve dinner u until midnight and the bar stays open until one. Had cocktails served by a welcoming bartender named Michael who was happy to offer peanuts and snack mix because we arrived after the kitchen had closed. He didn't rush us on drinks even though we were the last thirsty customers. 

TIP: our room was a lengthy way from the elevator  and with luggage, you will break a sweat. Mention to the front desk a request to be as close to elevator as possible.
Bonus: Free WIFI and free parking
Queer dance party is a blast. Definitely a great dive bar for the east siders.
The bands here should all have record deals. Plenty of room for dancing to the outstanding music! I almost feel guilty for seeing a free concert!

Cool place.  The band that was playing was legit.  Great vocalist, and the guitarist was on fire.  So much fun.

Drinks were not too expensive.  

Lots of space inside, which was nice.
Got the banana berry pina colada, brownie sundae, and a side of fries after a late night. The drink and food were okay. Cool band and very laid back atmosphere.
Gorgeous space. Great for large parties and brunch menu was on point! Highly recommend the hasbrowns!

So I went here on a whim to have a few drinks with a friend I hadn't seen in a few years. There was a nice crowd and a beautiful and amazing singer with a banging band performing. This woman was outstanding. Now mind you I am not a country music fan at all, but I can't help but love good music especially coming from a great singer. To my surprise it was Haley Vaughn from American Idol! I do not watch television aside from occasional movies. I found out it was her when I did a Facebook search of her name. Haha to think I actually sat in on someone that once debuted on the big stage. I can't forget to mention that the Valentine had good service, attentive bartenders, and strong drinks. Gotta love it!

Let me start out by saying The Sheraton Music City has the potential for greatness. The lobby, check in area, outdoor patios, and pool were nice and inviting.

But my complaints start with check in. First, my friend and I arrived late morning to the hotel. We anticipated that our room would not be ready right away, however, because we were heading straight to a conference we needed to know when we could drop our bags off before heading out. For some strange reason, the hotel staff gave my friend and I tons of attitude when we tried to ask what time we could go up to our rooms. Is it that hard to give us an answer? Finally, the desk staff said it would be ready by 3pm. Meanwhile, my friend and I ended up having to check our bags with hotel security since we needed to make our Conference downtown.

Once we did make it to our room, my friend and I were extremely disappointed with the lack of cleanliness. We found clumps of hair in the corners of the room and in the drawers! The rugs smelled like wet rags, and we could never tell if our room had actually been cleaned when we returned for the night. Two or three times we had to call the front desk for clean towels. Also, this particular hotel has crazy old electrical outlets in the rooms because none of my device chargers fit! I had to go to a cafe to charge my smart phone each night...insane! 

Hands down the worst hotel experience I've ever had.

Great experience! Their customer service is outstanding! I bought a living social deal but had to cancel one of the rooms. Tessa at the front desk helped me figure everything out and made it work smoothly. The staff was very friendly and the hotel was beautiful. Rooms were comfortable and the courtyard with the pool was very pleasant! I would definitely stay here again the next time I visit Nashville!

We stayed here the last week of July and although a little pricey, it was well worth every penny. The landscaping is beautiful, the lobby is gorgeous with a wishing fountain in the center a lounge and business center and a gift shop to the side of the check in counter, staff was very pleasant, courteous, accommodating and friendly, all rooms had a balcony over looking the gorgeous pool, my only complaint and very small one at that was the ice maker was broken on my floor so it was a long walk to get ice, other than that the next time I'm in Nashville this will definitely be where we stay! Absolutely loved it. Oh yeah and very accessible to downtown and other Nashville attractions!
Great atmosphere, fantastic live music, but Sarah, the bartender was AMAZING! Crowded bar but she handled it solo like no one I've ever seen!!
The "Moonshine Margaritas" are to die for and moderately priced. Wonderful little spot and always great music.
First time in Nashville, blown away on a Monday night. And the football coaches conference was in town, could not get any better!

Came here on a Saturday nite.

Had a fun time in this bar. The bf and I were in Nashville for only one night. He's a 
Real-Deal musician. The kind who has made a living doing it so we wanted to see some great live music while in Nashville. This place wasn't our scene but we badly needed alcohol in us after driving from Philly for 14 hours. 
The Bartender in our hotel recommended this downtown area and row of bars. Honestly, I avoid this kind of place like the plague but wth? 
The bouncer was polite, and smiled which was a nice first impression, I guess living in BK the last four years has me sort of jaded. 
The main bar was pretty crowded and there were some douchey frat type bros that stepped in front of me while I was politely waiting to order...where's the chivalry at??? but there is another full service bar in the back. The bartender there was friendly and she definitely poured a good drink. I don't recall how much the drinks were so probably average.

I thought there was a pretty mixed age range but my bf remarked that it was an older crowd - however he's a young'un so everyone's old compared to him. The band was energetic, pretty typical cover band. I wasn't interested enough to find out their name or anything. They had people dancing tho.

We left after one drink in search of something with a little more depth to it.

Came here quickly for a drink on a Friday afternoon and had to make it up some serious stairs to get there. This rooftop was much different than any other rooftop I had been to on Broadway so far, much smaller, there was an overhang with a bar underneath to get drinks, very minimal seating in my opinion and the person performing was high up on a super small stage behind the stairs so it was a little difficult to see him without looking up. I didn't love the feel of this place, maybe because it was so different than what I expected but I would check it out again next time I was in town. Standard prices on drinks, nice enough staff just a different vibe upstairs.

nobody in vip section so we go upstairs to vip and we are told minimum drinks to be there ok then waitress doesn't come back and we have to get drinks ourselves then told to leave vip section at 1030   thus place doesn't care about customer service or anyone that doesn't throw money at them

My husband and I were staying at this hotel for a marriage retreat and from the beginning they were so pleasant and the bar was excellent. Their restaurant has delicious food and the rooms were clean and cozy.

We stopped here in our road trip and we were mind blown by the hospitality. It was a quiet evening so we managed to have the best out of the staff. 

Food is great. Plenty and tasty. We ordered a mix of everything and if you love BBQ there's nothing here that will disappoint you.

Looking forward to stop by in our next trip to the area.

My friends and I recently visited Nashville for a bachelorette party.  We visited whiskey bent during the day on Friday and really like the music, plus it seemed pretty clean comparable to the others in the area.  We came back Saturday night completely prepared to wait in the line.  When we finally got to the front of the line after patiently waiting for 30 minutes (We had a group of 8 girls), we watched as the bouncer on the left of the door let a couple guys in in front of us that weren't waiting.  I asked the bouncer on the right and he said "they know people inside".  which I was fine with. I understand the owner probably has friends and they would get preferential treatment.  But then we continued to wait, and another group of 4 men were let in in front of us.  At that point I jokingly stood in front of that walkway next to the bouncer on the left and said "no one else comes in this way until the bride gets in"  to which I was told "they are paying me".  At about that time, ANOTHER group of 4 MEN,  came up,.  The bouncer told them it would be $40,  which they slid him.  I wasn't moving, but the guys physically pushed me out of the way to go in , and me and my 7 female friends were left standing outside waiting to get in. 

Don't get me wrong,  I know things like that happen, and I know bachelorette parties in Nashville are a dime a dozen.  But bachelorette parties spend money.  LOTS of money.  And the guys paying the doorman $10 to get in, are probably going in to get free drinks from their buddy at the bar. Not to mention they were GUYS.  aren't bars supposed to want to have a higher woman to man ration? My group decided not to wait any longer watching people pass us , we walked down the street to another bar and gladly spent our money there. 

Whiskey Bent is a good concept, it has good music, a good location, and pretty good drinks.  But you need new management and new staff if you are going to blatantly allow that amount of "bouncer paid" walk ins.  2 people is one thing.  10 in a row is just ridiculous.

Customer service was good and the rooms were clean. However, the walls are so thin I could hear the conversations of the people next door! It especially sucked when they were getting ready to go out at 11pm blasting music and having incredibly loud conversations the entire time.

Stopped in here for a quick couple of Jack & Cokes the other day.

No complaints.

Great rooftop bar! 
I'd prefer to give them 3.5 stars. 
Went on a Sunday night, there was a band downstairs and another one on the top floor, it was nice to have a choice of so much space. There were heaters on the outside deck so even though it was chilly, we stayed nice and warm.  Unfortunately, they stopped serving food pretty early, so we had to go somewhere else although we were enjoying the view and atmosphere.

We stopped at Bootlegger's as part of a guided tour of Nashville. Live music flowed from the establishment out on to Broadway as the band played Chattahoochee. It took a while for the bartender to take our orders, as he had just been bombarded from everyone on our tour bus. While I waited to get my drink, I took in the country chic decor, complete with mason jar chandeliers. A group of soldiers stood nearby letting their hair down (so to speak),  delightfully enjoying their day drinking. This is one thing I love about Nashville. While other cities may turn up their noses at such behavior,  Nashville establishments welcome day drinking with open arms and a "Come on in here, Y'all" mentality. I ordered the sweet tea moonshine because seriously, you're in Nashville. Why would you order anything else? This was not the authentic, take the hide right off your tongue moonshine that your friend's, friend's cousin makes illegally in a homemade still using God knows what, God knows where. No, this is not that. It will barely deliver a buzz. I think it was really just sweet tea. None the less, if you want a cool place, with cool decor and good music to day drink with your friends, Bootleggers is  a chill place to go.

DO NOT GO!! The bouncers and manager were extremely mean and aggressive. The bouncer ripped the plastic facing off my legal, government issued license on purpose and refused to repay me to get it replaced. When asked to speak to the manager he was equally unhelpful and aggressive and the two of them started yelling at us. The bouncer then grabbed the license from me and started ripping the plastic off even more. I finally left in tears. I now have to go home, wait at the DMV, and have them replace my LEGAL ID that was destroyed by this awful establishment. Do not go unless you have multiple forms of identification or a back up ID after they destroy yours.

I guess it's been featured in the show Nashville (I'm afraid I don't watch it), and I now know Lady Gaga recently made a stop on her dive bar tour here (how cool is that?), but we were being brought here for neither of those reasons.  We were brought here because it's a solid spot to get up close and personal with local music, and knock back some local beers.  The folks performing when we were in were fun, and clearly had a following of dedicated fans that shouted out for their favorite songs, and took to the front of the floor to spin their partners round and round a time or two.  Since I had JUST said the music made me want to dance, I was a little bummed that none of my partners took the hint and took me for a whirl, but the dancing didn't last long, so I didn't stay wistful for long.  We did not peek outside to the patio, nor partake of the food truck, but I love that both of those things exist here.  Solid.
There seemed to be several other spots nearby to easily wander to as well, if you wanted to make a night out of one location.

Food is consistently delicious. The wait time on 4th of July seemed to breeze by. Bathrooms were clean. Our server was new and that explained the lack luster service- ex: soda syrup ran out so we waited for a long time for him to go to the basement to change it he said.

Been here 6 days and checked out all the bars, even the so called famous ones. At 50 yrs old that easy keeping up with these young folks, but Whiskey Bent is the Best, good atmosphere, talent on stage and of course the hardest working bartender in Nashville "Bri" she remembered mine and wife's drinks and she shovels out thousands of drinks while I was in town. That is dedication and a perfect smile to boot

I'm spending my summer in Nashville and wanted to take my parents somewhere that they enjoy for dinner... So Hard Rock, it is!  We really enjoyed the service here.  We wanted to sit outside, but that area wasn't staffed with a server at the moment. It wouldn't have been an issue for us to be seated inside, but the host spoke with the manager to see what he could do.  We ended up being able to sit outside and had a wonderful server.  Our drinks were great, and the food was timely.  A major pet peeve of mine is when the appetizer and entree come at the same time (Ugh!)... So glad we did NOT have this issue (food was great!).

The only downside, and reason for 4 stars, is the parking issue.  While there's little the Hard Rock can do about this (they are right in the middle of the busiest part of downtown Nashville), it was a bit annoying trying to find suitable parking that didn't cost an arm and a leg.  However, I do believe the restaurant offers valet to ease the stress of finding parking on your own.

Several empty tables and we were told there was a 20 minute wait. Person in line ahead of us mentioned it to hostess as we did too and hostess kept stating "we are so busy" they walked out. We walked out...

The setup of the place was very good and encouraged a lot of movement. The chicken fingers were pretty good. My girlfriend ate the cheesesteak and it was ok. I went in the lull of the afternoon and I thought the service would have been a little better. It is not a bad place to sit and enjoy group company.

Newer and clean. Great location downtown. Nash chicken sandwich was a great spicy chicken sandwich. Slaw was good also tasty. Burgers are 100% beef. 
Menu is very simple, one page with something for everyone. Staff super cool.
We also had excellent family friendly live entertainment from Tyler Baily & band.
Bathrooms were well kept.

Born and raised in Los Angeles, California. I stopped off at this place on a Friday evening around 8pm. I could tell that it's the type of place that gets packed. There was a live band playing Country music and some typical bad 80's covers. Everyone looked like they were having a blast and I was having fun people watching. Country girls dance silly and when they know a song they serenade their boyfriends, hard. It was nice to see old people and young people hanging out together in the same place, there is really only a handful of genres that allow that to happen and country is one of them. I had fun here. If you're visiting, sure check it out.

The hotel is ok.  We have a king bed room on the fourth floor ( highest floor they have) & it faces the parking lot.  The bathroom is soooooo small we can't both fit at the same time.  The bed is comfortable but that is all that I can say that is positive.  They are WAY out of town & the concierge has taken a permanent hiatus.  The shuttle is AWFUL & what made me write this review.  The hotel is WAY out of town & not convenient.  The restaurant has awful food & no other options since you aren't near downtown.    Research Nashville if you are planning a trip.
We made one last stop a Hard Rock Cafe before heading to the airport back to ny. Drinks, food, service was excellent ! Even better was the bartender Logan!!! We had such a fun time. Good send off!

Great venue where the band isn't smashed into a corner, friendly staff and some great live music 
And...and actual area to dance to the live music which a lot of the bars neglect to include
What a fun place. Great bands. Reasonable drink prices. A lot more spacious than other bars, even when full. This is in top 5 of bars to visit while in Nashville

This hotel was very disappointing. There is no continental breakfast included and we ended up paying $16 per person for a very unsatisfying buffet. The remainder of our stay was spent eating at the local Waffle House, which you need a car to get to. There is also no free WiFi, it is $10. There was no mini fridge in our room to keep drinks cold or leftovers. The outlets in our room were very old and when we plugged in our phones/computes they were all "loose" and at times did not keep our devices charged. For the price paid for a decent hotel I was disappointed. With taxes and fees $220 a night should have basic amenities.

One of my favorite bars on Broadway. The 3 floors and upstairs open patio makes for a comfortable environment if you need to catch breath and get some fresh air. Decor is more of a lounge/club than a honky tonk bar. They also have a bar on all floors for easy access to beverages. Music varies between EDM, hip hop, and pop on the nights we went. Definitely a good alternative to our usual country music scene.
Ate here after a Titans game. Arrived 5 mins before close and the staff was happy to seat us. Food was really good for a chain restaurant.
Maybe the best ribs in all of Nashville! I have yet to all the ribs in Nashville but they would totally be in the running.
We kept coming back to this place! The music and vibe was great! The artists were amazing every time we walked in!

Tonight some friends and I went to the Stage. We were in town for the weekend. When we arrived we went up to the top floor and had drinks. Then decided to go down to the first floor for some country. We ordered drinks and were surprised the cost for the same drinks from the top floor was more expensive on the first floor. Two bottle beers and one well drink ($43. Downstairs and $$23 upstairs) then the band would only play country for $$$. We have  them $20 and requested one country song and instead they played a different song which was ok however they then proceeded to be smart and say only rock n roll no country. Well I thought I was at the stage which is known for honky tonk and a good time. Instead I got a band leader that was rude and tried to be a comedian and embarrass someone giving cash to encourage good music. Won't be stepping in there again.

apologies in advance for the low rating, and i am so disappointed that i couldn't rate it higher, but as a nashville newbie i was really looking forward to checking out the great music-listening rooms.  this place in particular was recommended by a number of folks in the neighborhood, but i couldn't handle the smoky atmosphere.

attention nashville club owners:  get with the program!  communities across the country are going smokefree!  this incl:udes not only large cities but but even small towns who understand the health risks to customers and employees of exposure to second-hand smoke!    let's enter the 21st century, ok?

The food was okay nothing that was so great but it is what you expect when it come to a Hard Rock Cafe,   The service is what I am commenting on here,  it was excellent!   Our server was very responsive and out going.  The restaurant was clean and cold and that is what matters the most after you have been baking in the sun at CMA Festival.  The only negative is that the prices seemed to be exceptionally high for this category of restaurant.
Go here, go here, go here. Three floors of live music. It's a don't-miss while you're on broadway!

So this place has a great location and the atmosphere is really cool.   I ordered the brisket (that's what they said was their specialty) the brisket was nothing special, I mean it wasn't bad it just wasn't memorable.  Now the coleslaw was terrible.  I would suggest a different side.  Sigh....I wish the food was better

Very nice hotel super cheap... Groupon baby!!!! 4 days under $300. It's In the middle of a industrial park but it is very very very nice. Restaurants are near by and it's not too far for downtown where the party's are!!!

I normally wouldn't give any Hard Rock four stars.  Their food is usually bland.  This Hard Rock cooked a really good burger.  The server was very friendly.  As others have commented, this location is sort of sparse on the decorations that Hard Rocks are known for.
This hotel is beautiful and the staff was amazing. Not to mention the beds are more  Comfortable than mine at home.

Great decor.  Love the wall with all the old rock n' rollers!  Little bit of a younger crowd than I would expect for a Sunday night but drama free!  
Great music and plenty of space.   
The air is on full blast.  Loved that!  I'm one that never sits still for good music and love that I'm not more of a hot mess than I usually am

Food is good.  Overpriced.  We went here because it was downtown Nashville and we are vegetarians and there were a few options for us.  Veggie burger was good.  Veggie springrolls were good.  Salad was good.  My husband enjoyed his mushroom burger.  Lots of transients nearby.  We saw one bothering guests that were eating outside.  He looked like he was selling a newspaper or something.  The guest gave him money.  We didn't sit outside for that reason.  My husband came back from the bathroom and told me there was a bum in there washing his hair.  He told the manager and the manager immediately removed him.  Three stars because it's overpriced and the bums.  I guess you are paying for the name.  The waitress was super nice.  She got a good tip from us.

Sorry I can't give a zero!!! One bartender is OK but when someone comes up beside me with 2 glasses and she fills their order first and then tells me I'll be right back and then serves other people at the bar!!!! Tell the bouncer and he looks at me with a stupid look!!! Too many good places to go  in this town! Do not go here!!!! Go somewhere else that wants your business!!!! Will never step foot in this place again!!!

Really!!! 

I order an combo PLATE!!!! I asked for Brisket and Sausage. My plate gets delivered to me, I already been told it did not come with sides for 7.99. But really no BREAD!!!!

I am sorry!!! I have never been to a BBQ place anywhere that did not server bread on a plate. A matter of fact, i never been anywhere where PLATE did not mean 2 sides!!! The person i was with ordered cole slaw for 2.25. This is the smallest dish of slaw for 2.25 i ever seen. You would think there was gold leaf in this slaw at this price. 

I got my bill and i even got charged for water!!! Had to have that taken off.... 

The brisket and sausage good..... But not for 7.99 and no sides or bread!!!!

Guys i lived 3 times in Texas.... believe me they know what bread is.....
We stood at the door for 30 minutes Saturday night. When we watched the bouncer take cash from 8 different guys and let them in before us we left.
Cool place. I had allot of fun here while in Nashville.
So this place was so much fun. The band was amazing and the "moonshine drinks " were awesome.  I had the blue raspberry. My Friend the apple pie. The ambiance was great and the bartenders friendly.
Not great. Kind of dirty. Over smoked meat. Brisket was not delicious. Ribs were ok. Not impressed. I think there is probably better.

Not close to anything. Very inconvenient. Had a game the next morning that ran from 6 am to 2 pm and asked for a 'late checkout' at 2.30 pm. Given that I had checked in at 6 pm this was a pretty reasonable request. Was transferred 3 times and then got voice mail. Left a voice mail. Got a return call from a not so friendly manager who said that I'm welcome to checkout at 6 am. I explained the situation about the game. No mercy! 

Terrible hospitality. Sheraton could learn a thing or two from Hilton and Marriott around customer service.

Was absolutely disappointed in the security staff here.  As a former bouncer you've gotta check your ego at the door.  They tossed my buddy last night for absolutely nothing.  He accidentally bumped into one of the bouncers and the guy decided to show how manly he was and escort my friend to the door.

This may actually be the most punk rock bar in America...and I've blacked out on Ass Juice at the Double Down watching The Bronx. It wasn't just the vast array of beer and liquor, every person there was incredibly friendly and awesome. It's so rare to see anyone wearing a G.G. shirt, let alone a guy in a G.G. shirt with a really big knife on his belt...grade A. The patio was awesome, the decor was fuggin perfect, I literally felt at home due to the fact my really crappy Crimson Ghost tattoo was not judged. If you like cold PBR & people who look like Lux Interior dressed them, this can be your spot.
Music was great! I Ordered a old fashion at this whiskey / bourbon bar and they told me they don't make them. Really!!!!

I was in Nashville for the first time this week and The Stage had everything I was hoping for. Drinks. A good crowd (all ages). Great live music. The band was awesome and it wasn't just country music. I highly recommend The Stage!

It wasn't poisoned but the whiskey was watered down. It wasn't just myself who thought so... I can't shoot whisky for the life of me and I didn't need to chase this Jameson. For a place with the word whiskey in the title this was disappointing. Our first go at ordering shots the bartender interpreted a pickle back shot order as a mix between pickle juice and alcohol.
Service was very good. Hot chicken sandwich and southwest rolls were good. Came with a citrus slaw that was very good.

We stayed here for a 2 nights three days small group weekend conference. It was excellent in many ways. 

Room:  we received an upgrade to a suite. Very spacious and comfortable room overlooking the inner courtyard/pool with a veranda. Very nice accommodations with added amenities like mini frig. In spite of being close to an airport, we enjoyed excellent sleep quality. 

Great Customer Service: everyone was so nice. I really appreciated the fact I felt staff were really paying attention and willing to meet to our needs. It definitely communicated that it was a customer-service-oriented organization. From the management to the housekeeping staff, they are bar none the most gracious and pleasant people I dealt with in a long time. They really took care of our group. 

Amenities: since it was a very hot weekend in September, we enjoyed ourselves in the outdoor and indoor pools. Hot tub was very nice to relax in the evening. Gym is well equipped and better than average facility compared to other similarly-priced venue. 

It might be a small thing, but the quality of towels was very good. Even the pool towels were very nice. Complimentary wifi in room was more than sufficient for me. I had no issue streaming some videos.

Now there are some signs of aging facility, but overall the rooms are well-maintained. I have no complaints. You'll enjoy your stay here. 

I just want to give a shout out to Troy and Ivanka (sp?). They really took care of us especially for our meals. You made our weekend very memorable and pleasant. If I had a choice to come back here, I'd certainly do so.  I will recommend you for anyone who's looking for a venue to conduct their group meetings and conferences.

This place was ok. The servers and host were funny and right on us. We went here for lunch and they didn't have a lunch menu. $20 for Mac and cheese with chicken is insane, but I suppose that's what you get for eating at a chain kitschy restaurant.

stayed here 2 nights on a Hotwire deal.
Lovely hotel. Excellent service.  I wish I had packed a swimsuit because the pool was lovely (AND IT WAS HOT!)

A little out of the way for touristy things, but I've come to the conclusion that everything in Nashville is 18 minutes away by car.  

We only heard planes on occasion.

I think this place is a little over-rated. Yes.. its historic.. and yes.. all these famous people have played there.. but they're not there now. Not much to offer at this place. I gave it 3 stars because the bartender was nice and I liked the beer. Really.. nothing special here.

Okay so last night I celeb related my bachelorette party in Nashville with my girls. We had no clue where to go first so I decided to ask our very friendly bus driver Devon. He told us to go to THE STAGE! I was ready for anything but waiting in a long line for 40 mins and then be held up at the door by a very rude bouncer just about made me walk away all together. The drinks were very pricey at this bar and there was absolutely no space to dance or stand. The bathrooms were disgusting as shit too! This place could of been a great start to our bight but because of the rude people and over priced drinks I can only give this place two stars. The band was very good and honestly that is why it is getting 2 stars instead of one.
This is a great venue the band was GREAT. Dancing, drinking and fun. The A/C works good and the bathrooms are clean.

Without a doubt my favorite honky tonk bar on Broadway! I have always had such great experiences at The Stage. The band has always been able to get the crowd fired up! I also love the multiple levels. The drinks have been pricey (average for Broadway), but have always been made pretty strong! 

I love The Stage and will be there every time I venture down to Broadway!

What. A. Dump. And super scary with balconies that run the length of the hotel so that anyone can walk by on the outside. On the direct flight path by the airport. Slow and cranky service. Out of everything, including soap. Hairballs on my bathroom ceiling. Everything in the room was disgusting and covered in stains. One of the people I was with was given a room with a murphy bed only. 

Not enough money in the world to stay there again. And for all that, I got a special rate of $240 a night.
The bands were fun and there were two stages. It was nice to have two options to listen to. The drinks were a bit over priced but it was still a nice place to spend a little while and visit a roof.
Awesome place. Second floor is where it's at. No crazy loud music where you can't hear the person singing. First floor is always packed, but second floor is the spot!!! Nachos are legit too!
Broadway is a must when in Nashville. The amount of bars with live music may be too much for some to navigate, so hopefully this will help you out. WB is a winner!

Smack next to the airport, but you don't hear a thing. Location is nice for us because we wanted to tour several cities. The hotel is pretty and we used the pool and jacuzzi. Unfortunately, our first room was falling apart so they "upgraded" us to a 1970 suite. Each room has remnants of prior guests. Thankfully, the bed was very comfortable. I paid $747 for 3 nights, top $ for Sept. We specifically reserved the Club Room, but there wasn't a Club Room as we were informed at check in, so we were given vouchers to the restaurant. $14 for 5 shrimp tossed in a glass, not arranged. The breakfast did have a wide variety of foods. The first floor was under construction. Manager listened, but offered nothing. Next stay will be elsewhere at because I'm sure I can be more comfortable at another hotel.

Tuesday night, Live music, $2 beers, good vibes
Great bar

Alright, I get it this place is a moonshine joint. I am a whiskey sour guy, and in Tennessee you expect 1) good whiskey and 2) to get what you order.

Usually when the bar will not shake the drink they will tell you. Instead, the bartender said nothing and handed me a whiskey lemonade, light on the whiskey and definitely not Jack Daniels, which is what I expected (I'm in Tennessee!!!). Yeah, I was not impressed.

This place is great for a crowd looking for more classic country flavor. Less Sam Hunt, more Highwaymen, Conway, George Strait.  Personally I really enjoy that and if you do too you should stop by here. If you are looking to get wasted scream and black out, maybe head on up Broadway a little. This place is based on mountain made moonshine and the atmosphere and decor reflect that.  I plan to return whenever possible.
満席で立ち見客で溢れてた。音楽はロック。音楽はいいし、近くで観れるし最高。ビールは買えても食べ物を買うのは至難。

This bar was so much fun! This bar had two really good bands that played a wide range of music from pop, to country, and rock. The drinks were good as well. My friends met these guys from Canada at this bar who were such flirts and we found out later that they have girl friends back at home. Ladies don't trust some of the guys in this bar! Just dance the night away with your girls!
Came on a Saturday night. Glad we picked a night with an awesome DJ and lots of dancing!

Once again, the Judge's Vinegarroon does not dissapoint one bit.  I consider myself to be a Porketarian to the core --- other than an occassional piece of chicken I eat 90% Vegetables and the rest is all Piggy Products.

Today I had the smoked pork sandwich.  Talk about BBQ done right.  The meat was tender and had the right about of smokiness.  I love the housemade BBQ sauce on the table.  It was the best compliment to the food.   

They have a great outdoor setting area so with the new swing in nice weather, I hope to go more often!
The service was great and the food is good.  It's the standard Hard Rock fare.  It's priced for tourists, but every visit is entertaining.

The atmosphere at Whiskey Bent is great and the bands have always been fantastic each time I have been there. I especially love going when Amber is bar tending. She's got a wonderful personality and knows her drinks! Thanks for making the night that much more fun, Amber!!

We stayed at the Sheraton last weekend and were woefully disappointed. The lobby leads you to believe that the hotel is going to offer above average accommodations. This is not the case. Our room was nothing special, the bathroom was small with terrible lighting, no fan/vent, water for the shower barely got hot.
The first morning there I tried to brew a cup of coffee. The next thing I knew, water was coming out everywhere. I've used many hotel coffee pots and this has never happened. We called the front desk and were told that they'd bring another coffee maker right up., which they did. Same concept-large packets of coffee did not FIT into the tiny filter and once the filter got wet, it became too big for the coffee pot! AGAIN-water went EVERYWHERE.
My fiancée called guest relations. A lady came up w/yet another coffee maker. This time, (before she left) he tried to brew a cup. The THIRD coffee maker did the exact same thing. Water went everywhere. The lady from guest relations made a phone call from our room and said, "These new coffee packs are TOO big for the coffee makers. We need to send them some small coffee packs." 
At that point we did receive a phone call offering us a free breakfast.
While gone, we received another of the SAME coffee makers...tried using it the next day and got the same result. 
I personally took the coffee maker to the front desk and explained to them how many coffee makers they'd brought me.
They apologized. 
We stayed 3 nights and our room wasn't cleaned once. I asked the front desk about this and they said that we 'signed up' for no room cleaning. WRONG. I hung a paper on the door on the very first night saying we didn't need clean towels. Room service, we would've appreciated. 
When we made the reservation, we were told there was an indoor pool and hot tub. We went to a local store to purchase swimming suits. Imagine our surprise when we went down to the hot tub to find it was drained of water. 
Our "free" breakfast buffet was barely edible. 
We were not at all happy with our stay and will not return.
SO FUN! were in Nashville for a bachelorette party and stayed there most of the night. Awesome music and great drinks.

Worth it! Little pricy, but burger was excellent. Drinks were yummy. Good customer service all around. Really neat atmosphere with the music and memorabilia. Not the biggest hard rock I've ever been to, but not terribly small. I recommend going! You won't be disappointed!

One of my favorites on Broadway! Good moonshine shots and drinks. The bands are always great. I've been here several times and two times they've been accommodating to Chicago Blackhawks fans and even the bands had hawks jerseys on. Fun place to get the party started!!!
Wow - what a great night and great band tonight.  The place was packed but happy environment. I would definitely go back.

So the entire strip of Broadway reminds me of downtown, old school Vegas. And I mean that in a good way. It's kitschy and a little cheesy but a lot fun! 

This bar was no different. I may have been born and raised in the city but I love me some country music. I really liked this bar. 

We were there on a Monday night and it wasn't too crowded. My friend and I went to the top level, which gave us a great view of the whole bar. We did some fantastic people watching.

This is an over due review when I was last there last for the Country Music Awards. The atmosphere was great, music was great but was packed chest to chest which isn't always a bad thing but I don't need to know what kind of soap you use close.
Drinks were cheap and when the right band is playing that place cranks it up.

Great place with excellent music, stiff drinks but most importantly, an honest staff and clientele.  My girlfriend left her purse, and the manager, recovered it, called me from her phone (thank God she doesn't lock it, lol) and even charged it when we picked it up for the morning walk of shame.  All cash and cards in place.  Thank you, we'll be back.
Had a great time until the bouncer said "I have to clear out four tables" and made us stand up to put our table away.

Cons: No in room safe and no mini fridge, and the only customer accessible microwave I found was in the gift shop. The walls are on the thinner side. Wifi is paid (to get free internet you have to use the computers in the lobby). Pepsi products only, no Coca-Cola. There is no soundwall between the freeway and the hotel (only a problem if your room faces it, which mine did) and still don't understand why they didn't put heavier curtains on the windows to muffle the sound better. 

Pros: The bed is extremely comfortable at least! I was also pretty pleased with the fact that they had two sitting chairs and an ottoman, especially since most hotels usually have only one sitting chair and a desk chair. Really close to the airport (selling point for us, but could be a con for others).

The overall service was good. They delivered a toothbrush to the room when the front desk ran out of the toothbrushes that they kept up there, and included toothpaste as well. They also rebooted the printer immediately when I couldn't get it to print my boarding passes.

Lisa is awesome!!! We came in 2 minutes to close and the entire staff welcomed us in totally warmly. They served us until we were done and the food was awesome! Faith is an excellent manager and took great care of us too. Everyone here was happy and service oriented. Definitely recommend to anyone!!!
Very cool atmosphere and fabulous bar! Better priced drinks compared to other places! Really enjoyed the bands.

Was at this hotel for about 4 days for a conference and everything was really good. The hotel is a little older but well managed. Love it that every room have a balcony. I would in deed stay hear again.

The service was really good as well but was a little slow cleaning my room and understand the hotel was pretty full. May need to bring extra staff when hotel is about full so when you get a break your room will be clean....

Guy checking my ID bent it in half and asked if it was "real". I'm 26. Also took all my friends ID and did the same who are 30 and 35. Don't recommend. Even offered my debit card as a secondary form with my name on it. Such a shame. Was here over the summer last year and has a blast with a good band. Need to revise their security team.

Pro's:
*awesome indoor and outdoor pool!  And indoor hot tub, 24 hours!!!!!
*amazing workout facility!
*Nice bedding
*starbucks coffee in rooms

Con's:
*Older, and pet friendly made for an allergy HELL for me (and I'm not that sensitive)
*funky smelling rooms
*no fridge or microwaves
*an "airport" hotel in disguise.  Not near anything, "Operyland" is further than the airport. Awkward to get to off the nearest main street.

The stars go out to the acoustic duo that played there from 12-3 on 3/25/13.....Tom and Brandi. A male/female guitar/bass duo that were just fabulous! We came to Nashville looking for great music and found nothing but bar after bar containing the same honky tonk cover bands. But this duo was fantastic! They also played covers but   played them soooo well!!!! The service and drinks are pretty typical of the stretch it's on...nothing special and overpriced. We returned to the bar later to try and get more information on them and the bar back was rude and just said "there's a sign outside." 
So, if you happen to be passing by this place and see the names "Tom and Brandi," written outside- go in and listen!!!

We went Sunday night to hear Heath Haynes' cover band. It was perfect: great music in a divey sort of atmosphere -- exactly what we wanted out of the place. There was no cover charge, and our drinks averaged $5 a piece (beer and whiskey). If you like hearing Waylon Jennings, the Allman Brothers, Elvis, etc., Heath and his band are your fellows.
You pay a luxury hotel price for a fairly standard hotel.  Not worth it.

We had an amazing time here! 

Ended up here on a Saturday night because all other bars were too crowded to walk. This had the perfect amount of people in it. 

The band was amazing, Moonshine Outlaws. Good music, good beers, and friendly people make for a fun night. I will be bac

First time in Nashville, and we just had a great time and AMAZING food here! Tommy our server was very hospitable and engaged genuinely with us! Molly came by to check on us and she was also very genuine. Great food and great service is a WIN WIN for me! Keep it up team!

*DO NOT TRUST THIS HOTEL TO SHIP ANYTHING OR DEAL WITH FEDEX, UPS, ETC* 
I would give this hotel a ZERO if I could...
 
I needed to ship out a large, heavy pelican case containing expensive equipment. Last Sunday, before taking off to the airport, I went to reception to have this taken care of. The hotel did NOT have any FedEX Ground slips so I left my info on an express slip + my email.
I asked MEGAN if she could just schedule a ground pick up with the info I gave & email me the tracking number. She said that wouldnt be a prob. Come to find out by another employee... she is new in that dept and totally messed up.

Now I'm dealing with PEGGY. Horrible customer service. Guys - I left this package last Sunday.. its Friday and im STILL chasing a tracking #. 

I've been calling, emailing, this is just ridiculous. They promise to get back to me by a certain time & never do. I've probably called and explained my story 20 times.
Really great food and service. Thanks Morgan and Faith. Especially love the Twisted Mac and Cheese and cheeseburger.

This is out of the way from downtown Nashville but I'd say it's worth it if you have your own car. About a 15-20 minute drive depending on traffic. It's a safe parking lot, up a big hill and way off the highway. 

The room was really nice and super ... roomy. It overlooked the pool that is nicely lit up at night and even had a balcony you could sit on.

Bar/lounge in the lobby had a nice bartender and doesn't close until 2am?? Don't quote me on that. It was really late when we checked in (like just turned AM kind of late) and we still had time for a drink. 

We did have to walk quite a ways to our room. Seems if you get certain rooms they're right in the middle and you have to walk around a big circle to get to the elevators.

It was a amazing stay and service, we had a late check in and everything was exactly what we needed. There food and service was amazing. We will come back. Parking is free and there front desk is always happy to help.
The butterscotch moonshine is to die for.  I got the Peach which wad good; however, the wife had the butterscotch and it was awesome.

The food was mediocre at best.  The wait was only 30 minutes for 9pm on a Saturday night and now I know why.  To add to it, the waiter had the worst B.O.  He didn't write down our order and he didn't get it right. My daughter ordered a virgin pina colada, and it took almost 15 minutes just to get that.  My mother got a caesar salad without chicken and it was about 1 1/2 cups of greens for $12.  I don't recommend this place unless you are just wanting to say you've been to Hard Rock in Nashville.
Oh yes it is a good place go Faith and Sam! The wings are always a hit. But if you are looking for a bit more, the ribs are awesome!

Such a fun honky tonk (i will use this term this one time in my life, because it was nashville)! The atmosphere was very fun and enjoyable, decent beer selections, friendly people, great music, and lots of dancing! The place completely changed vibe after 11 pm, with the awesome country music band (which, to point out, played some incredible riffs including pink floyd and others) packing up and the music switching to club like, at which point we left. Still, really enjoyed the spot, and highly recommended for good music and a chill honky tonkin' vibe (i lied above, i used that term again)!
Super food, super wait staff.  Noise level is high, but enjoy the experience, that is part of it.

A fun place in Nashville. I was there around the Country music awards. This place was a lot of fun and packed full of people listening to country music( live ).

Except for the wait to get in is was a fun time and drinks were reasonable priced.

I give this place zero stars. Walked in the back entrance where a man in a stupid hat took our IDs. My husband joked about it being a nice night even though it was raining. And the guy laughed. 2 minutes later we're at the bar and a different guy in a stupid hat said that my husband was intoxicated...for making a sarcastic comment. When asked why, we couldn't get an answer. This is an example of someone with "power" taking advantage of someone else. Unfortunately for them that we can walk next door and be treated better.

I have always stayed at Sheraton Music City before I fly out of Nashville Airport. Will never again, have never been treated so poorly by the manager, Megan. Hotel shuttle was 50 minutes late picking us up. Megan said sorry about that, I can help you out, but when we finally got to hotel and she saw we booked thru Hotel Tonight her attitude totally changed and said we shouldn't have booked 3rd party??!!!  That there was nothing she could do for us. We had stayed last week and left car there but she could have given us dinner tickets for next time we come, but nothing. If they have a contract with Hotel Tonight to sell rooms then why am I treated any differently than someone who booked directly thru the hotel?! She mentioned 3 times we should not have booked 3rd party! Very unprofessional and should not be in a managerial position!

We went here after Tootsies (my apologies! :)) But it had a ton of great performers and plenty of room which I liked. It is dark in there so I could have probably taken a nap, not realizing how nice it was outside! But liked the venue feel to the place! Bartending staff was super nice and quick to our orders! Definitely a place you should check out if doing the Broadway thing!

The dining room was virtually empty but the food took more than an hour to arrive. When it did everything was stone cold. Heard a couple at a table behind us complain that their food was also cold. Too expensive for the serving size and mediocre food. Service was friendly, though slow. It did take a while before our water was refiled and the appetizers came out with the main dishes. Would not recommend.

This hotel is awesome! I gave it four stars because the pillows were really soft and didn't give my neck support. It was a bit uncomfortable for me even if I doubled up my pillows it was just too flat. The mattress was pretty good, nice and firm. The bed sheets were very soft and good quality.  The hotel itself is super clean and elegant. I loved the breakfast buffet and the room service is outstanding. We ordered room service for dinner and everything was ready it 20 minutes. They have a great dinner menu lots of veriety. Hubby and i ordered the Tennessee bbq pulled pork sandwich, it was great but a bit too sweet for me. We also ordered the chicken panini and it was very good and it came with fries. The Bread pudding was also good. I have no complaints as for food, and atmosphere. Location is a plus it's close to downtown. I will return and it's a pet friendly hotel with no pet fee. They even give you a doggie bags to dispose their waste. Our room was super clean, they even had an orchestra playing live music in the lobby. I wish I could have given this hotel 4 1/2 stars instead of 4. We shall return.

We ordered the nachos appetizers and the half roast bbq chicken....huge portions! And delicious! The bbq chicken was alright, but the nachos were excellent. I haven't been to many Hard Rock cafes but I enjoyed the experience at the Hard Rock Nashville. There were photographs of famous country singers adorned on the walls and great, live music...really made you feel like you were in music country!

We went in to the STAGE...and it is one of the larger places on Broadway but they only had one bartender and no waitresses...so it was hard to get  a drink. we stood at the bar for about 10 minutes and still not noticed so we went somewhere still packed but NOT understaffed..
somewhere just as dirty, divey and wanted our money...
or at least our business....

NOT very happy with this place..
they sucker in the tourist...charge high prices ..get free entertainment 
and still don't spend the money to have enough workers waiting on the customers..
come on guys!!!
Spend that money...we are spending and you are pocketing it..
so hire someone!!!

My quest to try brisket everywhere I can continues on. The brisket here is very smokey and spicy form the dry rub. It's very tasty, but just not my favorite way to enjoy brisket. I got one piece of the brisket sushi and it was pretty good although I probably wouldn't order it again. I also got the brisket nachos and they were good as well. Service was a little slow because a table of 20 had just been seated before us. Our waitress was friendly and apologetic and even bought us 2 beers on her for having to wait. It's a cool place and I would totally go back if someone else wanted to.

Heard some awesome music coming from here so had to stop in. Ended up staying for almost three hours listening to Brit Stokes. 

It was early afternoon and it ended up being a great place to stop and take in some great music. Friendly and attentive bartenders. Local beer. Comfortable barstools, not the cheesy, uncomfortable metal ones that so many places have. 

Loved the variety of music that was played. You could even carry on a conversation if you wanted to. 

Whiskey Bent ended up being one of my favorites on Broadway.

The place is great, the music was good, bartender very friendly, would've given them 5 if they would clean up a little better, empty bottles an tables and no one cleaned up. 
The Johnson bad was great, would've tipped them better but their ATM doesn't work sorry!

I came here the other day with my mom (who was visiting from California) to try and give her a feel for the Nashville live music scene. We grabbed some beers and listened to the band for about an hour and a half. The atmosphere has a very country vibe and the bartenders were great!
