My only complaint was that the band wasn't that great. I'm sure they rotate bands throughout the week so I'm thinking we just caught them on a bad night. Needless to say, this place was fun!

I live in Orlando, so we have fairly large Hard Rock's here and I was expecting the same while I was here. This wasn't so. It was fairly small, there was no area for a live band (that I could see), which I thought was strange considering we were in the music capital of the world. 

However, the staff was friendly, especially the valet who was more than happy to help direct us to our next venture. The server was kind of pushy when I didn't order a drink, but I think she was just trying to be friendly, but I was a little put off by it, because it made me feel a little guilty for not getting one, even though I was the designated driver. But the hamburger I ordered was fantastic and it was quiet besides the music playing. But it wasn't obnoxiously loud. As these places tend to be. 

I wish their store was a little bigger and had more merchandise. They didn't even have the special shot glass for their store! 

But otherwise, it was pretty much the same as all the others. I kind of feel like, if you've been to one, you've been to them all, but still a great place to eat.
LOVE IT HERE. A mist stop on broadway. The music was great and decor is on point. Janet made yummy drinks for us. would recommend to a friend

Alexis was great taking our order
With a cheerful smile and recommended the souvenir glass to take home - thanks I love cup collections and the food was good.

My biggest issue had to do with the manager and our server. Pointed out that the shots served were light. They claim there is a certain amount for a shot. Snotty server poured out plastic cup shot, in front of manager into shot glass and indeed it was short. Manager was not a nice guy at all. I told him his customer service was not good. He asked if I wanted to step outside to discuss it further. My friend also indicated his buddy or bouncer was ready to help and looked like he wanted to hit me.  I told the manager that I did not want to discuss this further. Proof was already too clear. Moral. Enjoy the music. Great. Booze of course is good. But don't point out a fault. They can't handle it. Lots of choices in Nashville fortunately. I simply can't recommend a place that employs people in customer service with bad attitudes. Go next store or across the street. Or wait a month I'm sure neither worker can last long there and hopefully they don't grace another place with their style of service. Sorry Bootleggers perhaps you should help your manager from this past Saturday night. He needs some training or a leather boot ride.

This was my first time visiting Nashville and I tried most of the bars on the main strip of Broadway and this was by far my favorite. Although the drinks are a tad pricier than the other bars (or at least it seemed that way), it was still a great time. I was impressed with the bands they had and also the place is open and space compared to all the surrounding bars. Loved it here!

Burgers are huge.  I would suggest sharing.  Love the variety of rock music playing. Onion rings are great;however, the burgers were to be cooked medium well and these were cooked more then well done.  Very burnt and not good.

I booked this on points so if was free and that is really the only price I would pay to stay here again.

We stayed in a junior suite and like many other reviewers stated, this place needs some serious updating.  Our room overlooked the parking lot and I'm debating if I would have preferred to just stay in a standard room.  The suite did have a fridge which I guess was a bonus.  It also had a couch area,  but I really didn't want to sit on it.  There is no in room safe which is so odd so we opted out of room cleanings because we had no where to put our valuables.  The black out curtains are velvet and were connected to the ceiling so you could not pull them shut.  I'm gonna make one more comment about the curtains because out of everything this was my biggest peeve.  After dark I felt like I was giving a peep show to the cars below since we couldn't draw the heavier curtains and only and the white sheer ones for privacy.  My theory is if I can see the cars through the curtains I'm pretty sure they can see me.  I also requested a crib and they brought me one that reminded me of one in an old movie with metal bars and a zoo cage feel.  My 5 month old son would grab the bars and banged his head a couple of times.  The doors don't have deadbolts but just the little latch at the top.  Our closet had no door and there was no full length mirror.  The club lounge was just sad.  It's pretty much a converted hotel room that had a terrible view of some machinery. The sever was lovely the food was not.  Frozen appetizers that aren't heated all the way and a lounge that doesn't really operate on the weekends.  Loved the specialty coffee machine though. 

The pool is decent with a fish bowl feel since it is surround by rooms.  There were a lot of leaves in it and it was pretty chilly until the afternoon when the sun would heat it up.

I only had the breakfast buffet in the restaurant and it was free.  Otherwise don't waste your money,  it's more like a continental breakfast with powdered eggs and overdone meats. 

I agree with the reviewer who compared this hotel to the one in the Shining.  Walking down the hall with the outdated decor makes you think you are in a horror film.   Location is great though and is about 15 minutes from anything and there is free parking.  Being a platinum member I have stayed at many hotels and this was easily one of the most run down.  Starwood please give some love to this property!
We had such a good time here our first night visiting Nashville that we have now gone for 4 days in a row. The music is killer and the beer is pretty cheap. It's a super fun bar, day or night

Love this hotel, it wasn't over priced and the look and feel of this hotel was luxurious! I actually wish I could of stayed longer to enjoy it more. Their food was good and customer service was very friendly and welcoming. Only downfall for me was their parking lot is just in front and it feels like a longer walk if you have a lot of bags.

I'm not the bar hopping type but in Nashville you must. There's live music everywhere! Some better than others but overall great. We decided to be deaf here the longest. We left because the singer changed. It's packed with energetic people dancing and singing. The style is similar to a concert. Everyone faces the stage and sings along and dances in their spots while being considerate of their surroundings.

Decent Sheraton, the public areas are better than the rooms. A little off the beaten path, but convenient to the airport. Staff was friendly but a tad slow. Overall, a pleasant stay, and a little more character than the average Sheraton.

I had a great time at the Valentine! I was able to get my dance on! The DJ  did a great job of playing a variety of music including top 40. A group of us came out on a Friday Night and it was awesome. The ambiance was eclectic and perfect for a great Night Club Scene. So if you want to get your groove on then get ready to get your dancing shoes on.

So, we have been going from place to place on Broadway and the music here has been the B-E-S-T. Wow, I can't believe there was no cover charge... if we had been anywhere in NJ with this quality of music we would have paid $$. Love, love l, love this place..  there are so many places I should see but this could be my last stop tonight.
The rooftop bar served food which was nice. The bartender was friendly. Totchos were really yummy. The chicken was hand battered and yummy, but the fryer oil needed to be changed for sure.
Hung out here the first afternoon we were in Nashville. Great music and cheap beer.  Older looking bar inside with dark wood paneling.  We enjoyed ourselves and they allowed kids.

As far as dive bars go, this place rocks. It's fun! It's unique! It's popular! ....but it's always smokey somehow even though people don't smoke inside. I go on Monday nights for swing dancing and HOLY COW people are wild! I'm a professional dancer so I'm very aware of my surroundings, but not everyone that dances here is. I've had plenty of people SLAM girls into the back of me because they weren't watching where they were leading their girls - they just dance and give no F's. 

The outside area is wonderful! A nice place to cool down and chill in the winter. A better place for fresh air than inside. 

The door guy sometimes seems to have an attitude... But I suppose he's dealing with drunk idiots all night, so I can't blame him much. Bathrooms are tight. But I love the music they play, the dancing, and the overall atmosphere. If you're visiting Nashville it's definitely a place you should check out.
Came in on a whim, and I'm so glad I did. Bartenders were friendly, band was great. Great energy, even in the middle of the week.

Nice rooftop bar with a good view of Broadway, but the drinks aren't anything special - I wouldn't classify this as a cocktail bar, just your average rootop bar with well drinks. We were here around 5pm on a weekday - nice place to get a drink after work on a nice day.

The staff was so very helpful.  The rooms were clean.  The courtyard with the pool was amazing.  While it is not located downtown the hotel offered a shuttle called the Monarch for $10 round trip.  The breakfast buffet was ok, nothing special.
I went there on a Tuesday night and the band was slammin'.  I paid $7 for a Jack Daniels neat. I like that there's actually parking in the back too. Check it out!
The stage was super fun! They had a great band when I was there I believe his name was Jerry Jacobs. It was one of the best nights of my life and the crowd was very friendly. What a legendary place.
Stopped here during a tour of the city. First time I've had moonshine. I had the blue raspberry and lemonade concoction which was delicious :) Good environment, live music, friendly bartenders.

We always love playing at the 5 Spot on our tours through Nashville. Great stage & sound. Come see us on August 16th, 2016!
Watch our music video here:
https://youtu.be/X01MtEiuNP8

Whitherward
www.whitherward.com

This is my second time in downtown Nashville, and both times we started out our evening at this bar. It's a very busy and happening place. The bartenders are on point, and the live music is great. The layout is also different. It's got 3 floors. I love the second one because you can still see the stage from up there. And the chandelier right in the center is gorgeous. The drinks are very expensive, but it is downtown Nashville... I would definitely be back. I like the vibe of this place.

Cool place. Really big, insanely crowded when I went on a Saturday night around 11pm. There was a band playing country covers. They were good. They only have bottled beer, no drafts. Not sure if I would come back, just because it was SO crowded. We went upstairs and it took a long time to make our way through the crowd.
I ordered my food and it came back in a reasonable amount of time but, that was the last I saw my waitress and the food was tasteless and under cooked. Will not be going back for sure.

Good crowd and beer was cheap. Had the Yazoo, I would say check it out. Only one server so she was running but still attentive.  Music was good, I will say there were other stops I enjoyed more but worth the stop.

I usually don't post reviews on here but I am very upset with this hotel.  The AC in our room is not working and the temperature is extremely hot. We had to have someone come assist in the middle of the night and he just in fact confirmed it was not working.  I called the front desk again and I was basically told just to deal with it.  I was very nice to the front desk associate but she did not provide me any sort of resolution or understanding. I will be speaking to a manager as this could have been handled with much more professionalism!!! I am now stuck attempting to sleep in an extremely hot room that we paid a lot of money for.
Good music, good prices on drinks and a good crowd.  Went here 3 nights in a row. Not a meat market.

Only in Nashville can you hear someone you would pay to see at the 5 Spot. You want the WOW factor. It's only Tuesday and this first band is absolutely crazy. What a great place, good beer, and outstanding music. I will post band info soon.

Alright so YouTube Daniel Nicholls. She was great.
My favorite bar. That's all I got to say man. They put on great shows and the Country and Western Wednesday is a perfect night out in east end.

I found this hotel and and the staff to be extremely pleasant.  For a family get together, we had a total of 5 rooms over the course of 4 nights. We were on the club level, which was so nice. We had access to the lounge 24/7 so we took advantage of that as much as possible.  Even when there wasn't free appetizers being served, we used the space to gather and order pizza.  The weather was great, so we also spent a lot of time out by the pool.  Staff members that stood out: Kendra, Ballin and Tessa at front desk as well as Terrell in the club lounge. These employees went above and beyond to make sure we had a great experience.

They serve local beer and whiskey, and most importantly, great music. I love the fruity whiskey and the vibe so much!!! That was really a relaxing and unforgettable night. There were a fantastic band with two singers, one male and one female. We are all fans of country music now!!!

Update***

New ownership, and they have returned to overpricing. Not gonna eat here often.

They have the best brisket around. Better than Edley's, Jack's, the Farmer's Market, Swett's, etc.  

Relaxed atmosphere with a deck for when it's nice.

Popped in here for a drink and to check out the band. This is not a country bar. The band was a little rock a little blues. They were great. The crowd was really into them. 

It was a full house. They have a nice long bar but there wasn't a ton of access since the room was crowded. Be patient. You'll get there. They have a really nice patio out back that wraps around the building. Nice and quiet for chatting compared to inside. 

Definitely worth checking out.

Low key. The band was rude even though we were the ONLY people in the place. I thought the moonshine really wasn't that good. 

Yes it is a small place. Yes it isn't as full as some of the other bars. The staff was friendly. I'd probably go back if I was a local and wanted to be in a place that wasn't full and listen to decent live music, which I hear there are not many in Nashville (haha).

As a tourist, someone who came in to Nashville for a couple of days and wanted to see and hear some music, skip it. I'll probably never go back.
I have been to Judge Vs twice and both times the food is good. The smells from the sidewalk are very intising. The BBQ is good, service is mediocre. I think the sides items need some work.
Love this hotel, but not happy where they put us.  Our room overlooked the air conditioning units.  Not the best view.
Loved the rooftop! The bar was clean and the music was awesome. We will go back when in Nashville!

I came to the Stage twice during my trip to Nashville for a friend's 30th. First day, a Thursday, was fun and the music was good, but the crowd could have been better. It was low key & smaller that night, which I think is why certain people wouldn't take a hint. Also broken glass which never got cleaned up.
Saturday night on the other hand was a great time. It was surprisingly so too, because I'm actually easily claustrophobic and it was so packed you couldn't move without the whole crowd moving, but it didn't faze me at all. The crowd was all friendly and the music was great. I'm definitely going again next time I'm in Nashville.

This was my favorite spot in Nashville. We were walking by, heard good music, and paused. The doorman told us he works Sunday afternoons just because the bad that plays is that good, so we went in for one drink and stayed for the whole set! The layout is open and comfortable, the Sunday afternoon staff and band are the best we experienced and it was overall just a great afternoon.

The service was extremely slow. We waited almost 25 minutes to be sat at a table when there were over 15 tables free. Then we were placed on the second floor where we waited another 15 minutes to place a drink order. Over 45 minutes later our appetizers came out and we were missing one of the three (we were told it was sent to the wrong table by mistake). Another 15 minutes later the missing appetizer came out and was brought to the wrong table again before being brought to ours. Over all an extremely disappointing experience.

I've been here twice have been consistently blown away by the music I've heard here. A great place to hear original music (not Johnny Cash on a loop) that is NOT country. Great place to dance, drink, and have a good time.

We took an Uber to 3 Crows only to find out they weren't going to have live music so we walked up around the corner to The Five Spot.  Soon after entering the place, we got to hear a few songs for the cover before the band called it quits for the evening.  We enjoyed some beers and popcorn before giving up and leaving to find music elsewhere.  The bar itself felt quaint and quirky.  Our timing was just off to enjoy the full ambience.   They have both indoor and patio space available.
So much fun! They had great music-and on a Tuesday!- plus good drinks. Slightly older crowd, but still a super fun night!

Really fun vibe, but the DJ was honestly kind of annoying. He interrupted every song and was pretty degrading--overall obnoxious! Brought the vibe down a bit. Katie, the violinist, was incredible though. Will definitely go back in the future!

So this is only the third time I've been here the first two were OK but this time I got the hot chicken salad and it took almost 25 minutes to get the salad. And then when I got it I think it had been sitting for a while because it was soggy with tons of tortilla strips (I took most of the off) And when I told the waitress she said oh I'm sorry. That's it and then here's your bill. Don't think I'll be going back anytime soon. Too many better places in downtown Nashville to eat.
Best bar on Broadway! Angela - the hot blonde bartender is the best!!!! The bands are always entertaining and the music is always upbeat! Love this bar.

We had a good time here! Came to Nashville, specifically Broadway, in search of great, live country music, which seemed hard to find on a Thursday night (shockingly!) but this place came through. They had great live bands on both levels and we really enjoyed it. Liked how they had a nice patio and a pretty big bar. Spent some time on the main level people watching over Broadway, they have nice windows for that if you enjoy a good crowd, ha! Overall a great experience!

Abysmal service. Ordered an appetizer at the bar, after AN HOUR, went up to see what the wait was. Bartender told me, only when I came to ask, that the food was brought out cold and did I still want it. If that was actually the case, why didn't she tell me at the time? Waitress for the table we took was equally as bad; brought a menu to the table for a late comer to our party, but never checked back in. Not at all. Not until she brought the check almost an hour later without even asking if we wanted anything else. What a shitty, shitty place. Don't even waste your time.
Nice place and super fun when watching live music. Too bad the bartender was rude and paid us little to no attention!

Cool bar. Sooooo mannnny floooors! Kind of irritating that the bars on each floor do not communicate with each other so you have multiple open tabs but need to make sure you close out of them all! Great band and each floor has a different vibe for whatever you're into.
This is a GREAT place to come when in Nashville! Great music, good booze and an awesome Atmosphere. They have different guitars along the bar, some of them signed.
Nice place! The live music was great. Brit Stokes was fantastic. The beer selection was really good. I wish they had drafts but I can understand why. Nice spot!

5 Star service from Meagan on Sunday , July 20th!! We felt like we were family sharing stories about Memphis and Nashville. Thanks for great conversation  and laughs!! Even came back for the excellent band after 3pm.
Nice place, very convenient to all Nashville locations.  We were in town to see Wicked with our oldest daughter

This was my favorite place on the Broadway strip. The live band was so talented and they just threw you for a loop of dancing and laughing and overall great time. The place was spacious to dance and not feel crowded and the bartenders were nice and fast with service. I would love to cone back to this place again
Best place we have been to in Nashville! Great service...GREAT music! And we have been here for a week.....

stayed here last week for a vacation trip. very business oriented hotel. everything was clean and staff was friendly. Scott the bell man and shuttle driver was the best!!! very nice and helpful always smiling!!! pricey food but pretty good! restaurant staff needs some work but overall good and clean hotel!

Nice hotel. Be prepared to walk your ass off if you need ice bc the machines are sooooo far apart. 

That said, is a nice hotel. Cool pool in center of courtyard.

Jacuzzi is 24 hours in gym :)

As I'm not a huge country music fan, it was great to hear some rock'n'roll!  They also have a huge beverage selection including top shelf liquors. I would definitely recommend this to people looking for live music outside the normal honkytonk!
Both brunch and dinner is awesome.  Always a place to go. All of the foid with live music makes for an enjoyable time. The waffles are good and crispy, nothing better... and maple butter.

If you're trying to go to a place that has the OPPOSITE of customer service then this the spot for you. Terrible service, wrong drink orders and bad food then COME ON DOWN TO FOOBAR. A Sorry excuse for a bar, not only is the staff incredibly inconsiderate, they also have no idea of what beers they have on Tap,let alone any knowledge of the ingredients in their menu options. All they seem to think about is their next tattoo or piercing, not customer service. Two thumbs way down.

          Get. It. Together.

We were here last week. I loved the style of the place and the big tables on the second floor for larger groups is nice. There wasn't however any assistance at all to get a drink or menu. The bathrooms are incredibly small with just two stalls. I do like the multiple levels and the vibe of the place. Nashville is busy and it just would have been nice to get a drink quickly and service. Being new- they have the opportunity to impress and not just be like all the other bars. We will be back just isn't our absolute favorite.
Steady ship in a storm. Downpour out side and Southern Rock inside. Always have a good time, great food and awesome drinks. Haven't been in a Hard Rock in any city that disappointed us.

I've been coming to Nashville annually for the last 5 years and have never been disappointed.  Well, thanks to Whiskey Bent, the streak has died.  When our group went there last night there was a crotchety old man at the door who asked to see our I.D.'s even though everyone was in their 40's/50's.  Well, since my wallet was stolen a couple weeks ago, I did not have an I.D. and I tried to explain this to the idiot at the door.  I also told him I had been in Whiskey Bent the last 2 nights with no problem.  After getting no where with the old bouncer, I asked to speak with the manager so I could hopefully plead my case to someone who would treat me with a little more respect.  That didn't happen.  My vision of southern hospitality will forever be tarnished after that encounter.  Total bitch on wheels.  She was acting like I was some sort of con artist and actually threatened to call the police on me for trespassing.  Not sure how that was going to play out since I was standing on the sidewalk.  She was bitchy and stupid.  I could clearly understand their position if I was hanging with a young crowd and looked like I could be under age.  Not the case. I just think they could have made an exception but at the very least they should have been more polite to me.
I like this bar because it has the feel of an old saloon. Great music played here! I like the drinks and the friendly service

What a fun night we had dancing to many bands on multiple floors.  This is one of the many places that have been around for a long time on Broadway.  

I liked that there is no smoking.  We started on the first floor, but it was a tad crowded so up we went to the 2nd floor. Great band with a sax, 7 string electric fiddle and other standard band members.  They played popular sing-along country, Bob Seager throw backs, some slow songs and even Beyonce's All The Single Ladies.  They have a good sized dance floor and big bar.  Tables with stools, but you go to the bar for service.  Lots of security so you feel safe.  

We went up to roof top last.  It is part inside and part outside.  Outside they have heaters.  The band there was funky soul with a young version of Tina Turner.  

Enjoyed it so much we did not leave and go to other bars on Broadway.  This is a one stop, all night, don't need to leave bar.  Enjoy!

your average broadway, neon signed, country music cover band bar.  not complaining since it's everything you expect on this street, just hard to give it 4 stars.  congrats to tin roof for getting many small things correct, good drinks served quickly to a well behaved crowd.  you should probably eat somewhere else then head here for music and drinks.  probably a better place to listen to music than say tootsies, but it also lacks a certain flair.

Let me start out by saying I only come here on Sunday nights.  I've never been here on any other night, so I don't know what it's like then.  But I can tell you this much:  Sunday nights at Whiskey Bent Saloon are absolutely incredible.

Every time I take my first step out of Whiskey Bent Saloon on Monday morning at 2:00 AM, I eagerly anticipate the next Sunday night.  This goes on for the entire week.  Thanks to Whiskey Bent Saloon, Bryan Wain, and Sarah (I'll get to them in a minute), Sundays are my new favorite day of the week.

This place is a bit hidden.  It's not impossible to find, but it doesn't have a neon sign like the more popular venues on Broadway do.  It has huge doors that remain open throughout the night, and the "sign" is right above those doors in brown lettering.

Anyway, back to Sunday nights here.  Starting at 6:00 PM, Bryan Wain and his band play some great rockabilly, swing, country, and blues music for about four hours.  He is one of my favorite local musicians.  Some of his best songs include "Run Around Sue," "Hoochie Coochie Man," "Blue Suede Shoes," and "My Wife Thinks You're Dead."  Usually about an hour into his set, a bunch of the swing dancers from the area (myself included) come in, crowd the floor, and dance our blues away.  After Bryan's set, Brandon Harris and the Good Ol' Boys set up and sing for another four hours until closing time.  They're a more modern country band.  Brandon sings a lot of Vince Gill songs like "Liza Jane," "One More Last Chance," and "What the Cowgirls Do."  About half of us dancers will stay for him, and some people will even get out and do a little line dance.

So that's enough about the music and dancing...this review is supposed to be about the saloon itself, right?  This is a very classy saloon compared to the other saloons and honky-tonks in the area.  Don't get me wrong...it's very country, but also very classy, if that makes any sense.  There's lots of rustic decor there like whiskey barrels, wagon wheels, and even a statue of Jack Daniel himself in the window.  The hardwood floor is slick and very ideal for boot scootin'.  There's no real "dance floor" designated for dancing, but the front third of the saloon is empty and open to dancers.  The back two thirds is a bunch of tables and chairs for relaxing and watching the band.  The right side (or left if you're looking in from outside) is the bar, which stretches from front to back.  It's huge!  They serve beer, wine, and just about any liquor you could imagine.  That's a huge plus in my book since so many bars only serve two of the above.

This place is completely non-smoking.  That's one thing that adds to the "classiness" that I mentioned earlier.  If you do smoke, no worries though.  You can just step right out the huge, open double doors and come right back in when you're done smoking.  They don't even ID here, at least not on Sundays.  You can even bring your kids if you want...I've seen people do it!

One of my favorite things about Whiskey Bent is the bar staff.  Since I'm only there on Sundays, I'm not sure who's full-time or if the staff is even the same on other days.  But Sarah is the best bartender I know.  She's friendly, helpful, and prompt (not to mention HIGHLY attractive ;-)).  She's got brown hair and always wears a black Whiskey Bent hoodie, so if you see her, make sure to order from her.  If she's not busy taking orders, she may even dance with you if you ask!  The other bartender is fine too, but not quite as friendly.  And they always have a cleaning guy back there too helping put away all the glasses and such.  I'm guessing on Friday and Saturday nights, there's probably more.

I know some people can get paranoid about bathrooms, so let me assure you that the bathrooms are clean and fine.  The men's bathroom has two urinals and a toilet, so they aren't huge, but they're fine.

Parking is very tough here.  Of course, it is anywhere downtown.  You either have to find a metered spot on the street or pay.  I usually park at the library garage.  It's down on 6th Avenue, and you can park there for just $4 for the whole night.  Sometimes you'll get lucky and find a metered spot, but don't count on it.

Whiskey Bent Saloon is easily on my top two nightlife venues in Nashville, being tied with the 5 Spot.  Of course, they are two VERY different places with VERY different crowds.  But I can't pick one over the other because of that...it depends on what mood I'm in and what day it is.  Whiskey Bent is my favorite spot on Sunday nights, and 5 Spot is my favorite on Monday nights.  So take your pick!

El fin.

This is my favorite broadway bar.  I don't like country music or the broadway scene, but the band they had here was great.  Sadly I don't remember the name, I wish I did.  

A bar that specializes in whiskey?  YES please!

I wanted to give a 4 because I would LOVE the option of a Moonshine flight! There are so many options so it is hard to decide. Molly was great and was able to "guide" us in making the right choice! The Moonshine Margarita with Jalapeño or the chocolate/vanilla combo with a splash of soda.

One of the beautiful things about Nashville is the live music ! I love that is a smoke fee place so you can enjoy it without feeling the smoker heaviness and smell. The cover was $10 and the show was great that night. They have a full bar and also they had a food truck but you can make the orders at the bar and pick it up at the food truck outside. It's a great venue to enjoy some music and maybe do a little dance is you feeling it too.

Highest recommended music venue in Nashville.

There was a fairly large cover when we arrived ($20) but it was certainly worth it. They had live music the entire night with up and coming country artists as well as many already famous performers. The performances were outstanding all within a small, intimate venue. In a way, I felt like I was accidently invited to a private recording studio with top talent. It was truly an amazing experience.

They also had great local beers on tap at great prices. Excellent service. 

Overall, A+ all around.

Room was clean.  Entry was nice.  No coffee stand or shop, so if you want coffee in the morning you have to go to the restaurant.
Room coffee was missing the actual coffee (had cups and everything else).
No bathmat in bathroom.

I've been to Judge's a number of times since it opened. At first I was crazy about the food. Always good, always abundant. In the past year or so consistency seems to have slipped, in both quality and quantity of food. Having said that, when they do get it right, they get it REALLY right. The smoked sausage is about the best I've had. Always had good service at the bar too. There's the good, here's the bad...

You're NOT a music venue. I'm in the music industry, and have been for better than 20 years, and if I want some good BBQ, there is no way I'd do anything other than drive right by when I see and hear an obscenely loud band ripping people's heads off on the patio. Even if I wanted to escape the noise, I'd have to walk through the din to get to the front door. If the idea is to perhaps entice some of the music row types into your restaurant, loud live bands ain't gonna get it done, even if they're great bands, and what I've heard, sometimes for blocks around, isn't so great, just loud. It's enough to keep me away. That's why I can't give the Vinegaroon more than two stars. Please concentrate on being a fantastic restaurant, which I know you can be,  instead of trying to be a venue.

Just a constructive thought... If you are going to have live bands, perhaps make it an event, and just do a couple Fridays or Saturdays a month. There are AMAZING bands in town who will work for pretty little base pay if they know they'll move some CDs and have a decent shot at filling the tip jar. Serious pros too.

As a rule when I'm travelling I tend to stay away from large chains however I was starving so I risked it and bloooody hell im glad I did. Been away travelling for 2 months so far - ordered a cheeseburger with a side of the twisted Mac n cheese, - best meal I've had yet. Ordered Mac and cheese several times from different places usually as a side and gave up as it always tastes like it's out of a tin, practically anaemic it's that pale so I nearly didn't order it here but I'm soooo glad I did  must visit !!! Staff are so lovely and kept refilling my drink without needing to ask. Great!

Fun time with a great DJ on the rooftop. It was so PACKED at one point that it was uncomfortable so we left. The rooftop bartenders were very patient and efficient. Would go back at a less hectic time.

Decent hotel with a very friendly staff, but service in the dining room for breakfast was agonizingly slow on 6/10/16. They appear grossly understaffed. If you're in a hurry, go early or make other breakfast plans.

Wanted to check out the rooftop - went in late afternoon. 
Great atmosphere - live music, comfortable couches.
Food was great!!
However, bouncer who came on duty & positioned himself at the entrance to the hallway (EXACTLY where the bathroom was) could have had a different attitude.  "Where you think you're going?" is not so hospitable buddy when I've been on your roof for over two hours eating & drinking with my husband.

Check out the live bluegrass jam here on Saturday nights 8-9:30pm! I got to sing a couple songs when I was there this past Saturday night. Really great musicans from the east Nashville area hang out here. Their beer selection was really great and the hummus plate has fresh veggies and warm pita. Yehaw!

The restaurant is extremely loud. Not family friendly at all, or even friendly at all if you want to have a conversation with the person you are dining with. The food is below average, nothing about our experience was enjoyable or memorable.

"The Reverb Room" at the Hard Rock Cafe Nashville is one of the better rooms for music in the downtown area. "The Ledge" (the rooftop patio) is a great place for cocktails or muchies. 

You might have to ask the hostess how to get up there, but Check it out!

Pretty fun place.. Had a good time.. Nice bar lots fun people dancing and having fun. Did not happen to care for the band that much when we where here.. Just to much blending of different songs.. But lots of folks like that sort thing.. So if that's your things stop in here..

Great rooms and workout facilities.
Breakfast buffet was terribly overpriced and hostess was extremely rude.

The Stage was a great time! Three different floors of fun! The music was on point all night and this was on a Wednesday night so I cannot imagine on the weekend what it is like. I lost my wedding band and The Stage personnel contacted me without delay after I called. They took care of me and the bartenders did the same the night before! Must go in Nashville!

This is a massive hotel. But it is kept flawlessly clean. The staff is friendly and accommodating. The location, unfortunately, is in an office park. The gym is spotless and all of the equipment seems new and in good repair. There are very few restaurants within reasonable walking distance. The hotel restaurant and bar are, in my opinion, expensive. The only other downside that I can find for this property is that there are no power outlets bedside.

Went to a few different bars on Broadway and this was my favorite. Great music, nice inside venue and I was lucky enough to find a table with my friends and we had a great time. This bar was recommended to me by some family members as their favorite too, so I'm glad I checked it out. 

Only negative was when we went to leave there was a jam at the door. We could not get out and people probably figured we were just trying to get close to the band, but weren't understanding we just wanted to leave. People were coming in and there was a jam of so many of us trying to get out. It was a crowded stand still until the security guards came yelling for people to move. It was scary for a few moments being trapped/sandwiched so tight amongst everyone.

Overall, this is a solid Sheraton. I've stayed at the Sheraton Music City Hotel a few times over the last year each time I visited Nashville. The service is consistently friendly at the front desk and the onsite restaurant and bar are open late! I'm not totally in love with the design of the facility but it is my go to hotel choice in Nashville at a great price. 

It is close to downtown Nashville (about a 10 minute car or taxi ride) without the hassle of traffic and close to the airport if you are flying into town. Check out the great features if you head to Nashville soon. The hotel has on site taxi service, two restaurants and a bar, free parking, indoor and outdoor pool/jacuzzi, gym, and is close to the area airport! You cannot beat this package with standard double rates routinely available at under $150.00 a night with an optional daily meal credit!

Fun, fun, fun!  Place was not overly crowded for a Saturday evening. It was packed but not like sardines. We got there around 7 and were able to score a couple of seats at the bar. The band was great, the bartenders friendly and efficient, and music volume just right. 
My next visit to Nashville wouldn't be complete without a visit here.

Nice hotel. Clean with solid amenities. It could perhaps use a little updating in the common areas. I really liked the courtyard style with the outdoor pool in the center. It made for a nice setting with local foliage. This property has a lot of stairways leading to different levels which is odd. To get to the fitness center, you must walk from the lobby to through a maze of hallways up a half flight of stairs then down another flight of stairs. Very strange setup, but a decent hotel none the less. The shuttle to the airport is always a plus.

As a Texan, I can safely say that this is the closest I've come to home cookin' since I've moved to Nashville. Holy guacamole, this was some delicious food.

I came here for brunch with a group of folks last weekend. I believe I got a breakfast platter. Sausage, jalapeno bacon (spicy, be warned! They also have a bourbon option, which I want to try soon!), eggs, Texas toast, and potatoes with gravy all arrived sizzling on my plate, and nothing survived on there long. I know I saw breakfast wraps as well, but I was mostly too focused on my own plate to notice what anyone else was eating.

To all my carnivores who enjoy their drinking - the Bloody Mary here comes with, and I quote a friend here, "an entire squirrel in it". They stuff some delicious barbecue into that glass - but don't worry, I'm pretty sure it wasn't squirrel. They're pretty hard to catch.

The place is a tad on the pricey side, but for going once in a blue moon, not too bad. Also it has a parking lot, which is extremely exciting - I hate searching for parking. The staff is super friendly and very good about making sure you're completely satisfied - the cook did my eggs over easy instead of sunny side up and my waitress was more than ready to have her redo them for me! (I didn't care!)

A final note: You will wander around all day wondering where the campfire smell is coming from. It's you, from sitting amidst all this deliciousness.
Came here for lunch before the Music City Bowl. Service was great and food was good. Would return for sure!

So much fun! My boyfriend and I came this past Friday night so it was pretty crowded, especially near the stage and main bar, but we were pleasantly surprised to find there were two other little side bars towards the back. The bartenders were cool, drinks were surprisingly affordable, and the band was great. We will definitely be coming back on our next trip to Nashville.

Only impressed with the lobby which was beautiful. 
The front ambassador stated that we were in the updated art of the hotel. Hmmm, phase 1. Lol do you all know what phase 1 means? It means they just began the renovation. The carpet was old and there were no baseboards on the bottom of the walls. No fan in the washroom, the air conditioner was set at 65 and it was 75 in the room. Small refrigerator with no cold setting. No extra towels, toilet paper of shampoo. We had three in the room. Basic TV everything else extra. No breakfast as posted in the first floor lobby. The swimming pools were not clean. Very slimy water. 
Pros:
away from the big city noise 
Takes animals
Free parking

Cons: read above

Would I return: No 
$900 for a run down Hotel
Great bar that seems to feature classic rock and blues. The drinks are good and the bands we saw here were awesome.
Wonderful time at Whiskey Bent Saloon tonight, Bre was fantastic!  Great tunes, cold brew, outstanding service!Can't go wrong coming here if you're in town!

This is a different looking Hard Rock. It was more modern and not the classic rock type theme. Still has the awesome typical outfits and guitars on the walls but the rest was more modern. We really enjoyed that they had the music just loud enough to be overly loud but still low enough that I could actually talk to my husband in a normal voice. Dae was our server and she was really nice. She welcomed us, laughed with us and kept the tea full for my husband. We love Hard Rock and the foos is always fantastic at everyone of them; including this one. I think the only complaint someone might have is the parking lot in front of the restaurant is for vallet only and other must find parking within the city blocks. This didn't bother us since we decided to use the vallet parking. It was worth it.
On a trip recently to Tennessee this is one of the highlights of the trip great location in downtown will definitely be back to check out the city

This hotel is horrible! I would give 0 stars if I could. They cancelled our reservation for 3 rooms that we had for the weekend without even telling us!! We arrived to the hotel and they told us that the rooms were cancelled because they were booked through a third party and I regularly use Expedia to book and have never had this issue. I think it is absolutely absurd that the hotel never even contacted us to notify us!

Spent a couple hours on a Tuesday afternoon here and Casey our bartender was awesome and the music was great. New place with a new place smell but I believe it will be a Nashville "go to" place soon. Come by and have a look, I think you'll like it.

This was my favorite bar we went to! Great music, good drinks too. We were dancing and having a great time on the top patio. However, this is the first bar I've ever been to where the band actually walked around asking for tips. Never seen that before. Didn't bother me that much, we were having fun.

This place is always a favorite! Even though it's downtown it's not nearly as touristy as the other bars. The live music is always great! The atmosphere is great too. You never feel overcrowded, but there is definitely a big enough crowd to keep it interesting. Drinks are reasonably priced too. Great place to hear live country music!

Was in town for a conference and looking for unique/interesting places for some BBQ or Southern cooking. Judge's is a bit of a dive, but that's often what I like. The place has just changed hands and some of the more interesting menu items are no longer on the menu they still have on line. That was a bit of a disappointment but there was still a good choice of traditional BBQ items. I had a combination plate of brisket and sausage. Nicely cooked with a choice of sauces on the table. They even had Yuengling (a nice lager from my neck of the woods) on tap. If your looking for fine dining, this is not it but if you looking for some good BBQ without the price and crowds of Broadway you should give Judge's a try.

Favorite bar on broadway -- don't be fooled if it is less crowded to start the night.  Most folks don't walk down to 2nd when there are events at Bridgestone but just do it!

Great musicians, friendly bar staff and moonshine via the Popcorn Sutter legacy.  

There is a back door for busy nights and a 2nd story. 

Make sure you tip the gals/guys on stage !!
We were a bit disappointed, most of our food came out cold and we had to ask for it to be reheated. The service was fine I guess. Don't go in if it's empty is what we learned from this experience.

Terrible. Not a fun place for your bachelorette party. Overpriced. Mediocre food. Dull atmosphere. Lame music. Piss poor service...especially at the bar.

We tried to make a reservation for my friend's bachelorette night the day before and were told there weren't any more and we could try our luck. When we arrived, there were two large tables open with the correct amount of seats in sections that were open, but not busy. We were told the wait would be an hour. Then a group of men without a reservation walked in an were seated at one of the tables. Maybe they're regulars? Whatever.

We go to the bar and get a round of drinks while we wait. Despite there being 12 of us, it took the bartender 15 minutes to even acknowledge us to say "I'll be back." 10 minutes later she took our order. I offered to pay for the round to make everything easier instead of splitting checks, but because I was traveling, my bank's fraud detection kicked in and a temporary flag was placed on my card.

The waitress didn't tell me the first time it didn't go through, but ran my card so many times (I found it later) that a hold was placed on my account. Then she came back, slide my card onto the bar, and announced that my card had been declined, and promptly walked away. She practically yelled it so loudly that everyone in the party began reaching into their purses to pay. When I asked her to run it again, while I called my bank to get the hold released, she said she'd already run it 4 times. 4 times!???!!! Without discreetly approaching me first? After I got off the phone with my bank and the transaction went through, I informed her that while I was still going to tip 20% despite her lack of tact, she said curtly and attitudinally "I'm sorry you feel that way."

We continued to have a terribly long and mediocre dining experience with crappy food. While the waitress at our table was far better than the bartenders, the night was a complete bust. We didn't even go anywhere else after because Hard Rock killed the vibe. I'll not be going back to any of them.

One of my favorite places on broadway! It has room to dance and socialize. Long bar and enough seating! 
The music is great and fun and friendly people.

Visitng TN for the first time, my friend brought me to downtown Nashville on a saturday night.  That place is poppin'.  The experience to be downtown was so much fun. Everything is new to me so I was checking out the scene.

We went into The Stage. The place was getting busy and filling up. Young & old were all having a great time.  Cort Carpenter was performing.  

I enjoyed the live band, no cover, casual dress & everyone just having a great time!
One of the best bars in town. Will always visit when I come to town. Great music, drinks, service and talent. A 'must visit' bar when you are in Nashville!

This sh!t will knock you on your asp and it tastes so good.
The bartender suggested the oatmeal cookie moonshine. Smelled like cookies, tasted like cookies and then wham!
You're on your cookies.
Lots of great tasting moonshine.
Friendly and quaint room.
Not huge like the other places on Broadway.
Stop in, grab a cookie.

I'm only recommending this place because of the live music and it was close to where we were staying. Even though the bartender was a total jerk, you could totally tell everyone there was having a blast! Didn't stay too long, but I'd be down to give it a second shot.

Everything was good until the bar back decided to act like an ass to 5 girls for no reason in our group.  Then the bartender decided to back him.  I spoke to the GM who was cool about it all - but ultimately we all decided to leave.  So hears what I would say - there are a lot of different options and bars and I would spend my money somewhere else!  Better service, better bands, better service.  So our group of 16 took our business down the block and ordered food and drinks for over $600 - I'd say you pass this up - they are good - but so is every other honky Tonk and you don't have to deal with their shit and bad employees that don't want to be there and have no interest in being polite to their patrons. Just my 2 cents

Worst meal of my life unless you want to eat out of an ashtray.  Everything tasted waaaay to smokey and was burnt to a crisp.

Onion rings and waitress were good which is why I can give 1star instead of 0.

We came in Friday & Saturday of NYE weekend. Friday night there was two awesome bands and the atmosphere was fun. However, the service was just okay. The bar has a monster list of flavored liquors but no menu or drink suggestions. The lack of a menu is fine but when asked for suggestions the upstairs bartender (Saturday night) simply said "whatever you want" to every customer who walked up. Both Friday & Saturday night we encountered a young guy working as the bar back who was fairly unprofessional. Friday night I asked him for a round and he just said "that's not me" and pointed at the bartender. Saturday he was arguing with another girl working while behind the bar. Okay, you aren't here to serve AND customer service is everyone's job. He didn't even attempt to get the bartender's attention for us as she was standing at the other end of the bar (not helping anyone at the moment) too far for us to politely get her attention. Saturday night we were upstairs with another bartender who refused to suggest any drink at a bar that had nothing carbonated behind the bar for a couple of hours. We were there for NYE and the band didn't even stop for the countdown. The bartenders didn't acknowledge the countdown except for grabbing a single popper right after the nite drop, kinda. The band forgot where they were and were stopping & restarting leading up to it. Complete letdown on a night where we are out for the sole reason of ringing in the new year.

Overall: Decent beer selection, BBQ and service with a great outdoor patio.

Food: They hit all the main meats -- brisket, pulled pork, chicken, sausage and ribs and also have burgers and sandwiches. I went with the combo plate with brisket and pulled pork. Both were moist and flavorful (i did add some sauce.) The portions aren't humongous, but still filled me up. A note about the sides -- they are not huge. My husband ordered the mac & cheese and it came in a very small little container so be sure to get a couple sides if you're hungry. Personally, I'm a huge fan of the onion rings -- but then again I'm an onion ring girl. There's LOTS of batter and they're very crispy. Gotta say, not as good as the rings at The Dog, but they're a strong second place. 

Drinks: There's a decent selection of beers on draft as well as in bottles. I also saw on the menu they have apple pie moonshine... i'll have to go back for that ;)

Service/Atmosphere: Our server was attentive and made good suggestions about the menu. We were parked at a table outside on the patio and while the view isn't much, I'm always a fan of eating outside.

Parking: There's a small lot to the side and some street parking the next block up.

This is by far one of my favorite "honky tonks" downtown.

Why?

1. It's non-smoking (!!!)
2. Better liquor selection than most
3. Good sound
4. Usually has great bands
5. Staff is nice
6. Has clean bathrooms & the entire place clean too
7. They don't serve cocktails in flimsy throw away cups

Not many of the downtown Nashville "honky tonks" have all 7 of the above that are important to me. Tourist central! It's definitely a great place to people watch but what bar on Broadway isn't?

This is by far the worst place I have eaten at. I think McDonald's is a much better food and I do not like McDonald's food.  
Server was nice but the service was slow, buffalo wings were microwave cooked cold in center. 
To make it less painful let's say I do not recommend nor would I repeat.

I enjoyed the experience at Nashvilles Hard Rock Cafe and I would definitely go again. I got the twisted mac and cheese, it was delicious, though a bit spicy if you're not interested in that. It was a classy atmosphere, with all the typical pictures, guitars, and outfits Hard Rock is known for decorating the walls. Our waitress was wonderful and helpful, refilling drinks without prompting. She also stated that we could wander around the restaurant and have a look at everything along the walls. Parking is valet, costing 15$ for 0-3HRs but that didn't deter us. Even at 9PM on a Wednesday night the street leading up to the restaurant was lively with people and music, lending to the happy atmosphere.  There was also a small gift shop inside the restaurant for anyone interested in purchasing souvenirs.

With so many options on lower Broadway frankly on my second visit to Nashville I was surprised to see this place still open. Compared to other places on Broadway one word comes to mind "boring ". Sort of forgotten on a prime corner location overlooking the river. No rooftop bar, bands have not been particularly good, and the food certainly isn't a draw.  When I have been here I feel like I could be in any of the cookie cutter chains, TGIF, Applebee's, etc. Only plus is valet parking, but I usually don't have a car in Nashville anyway. So basically bang a left on 2nd Avenue and bypass this place.
The logo on their employees shirt about says it all "I see you- I'm just ignoring you"

First off, I wish there was an option to give no stars. Honestly one of the worst establishments I've ever stepped into. Not too sure why this is such a big chain restaurant cafe whatever it's supposed to be, it's not. Worst chicken on the block it was more like rubber than anything else. Mac and cheese was cold, burger tasted like cardboard and we weren't even offered boxes to bring home our foul food. Will not be returning ever again for the rest of my years.

Service is vey poor here. Our waitress was very flighty and messed up on several occasions. The first mistake she made was she forgot to replace my side of fries with the mac and cheese side I ordered. That caused me to wait until after my whole meal was done to get my mac and cheese. The second problem was she would just disappear and take forever to replace our drinks. The last and biggest issue was my dad is a diabetic and his blood sugar was very low and when we asked our server to get bread or something she made us order garlic bread which took forever to get. My father could've passed out in that time. Overall food was ok and atmosphere was nothing special compared to restaurants around this area. Only go if desperate!

First time guest to Nashville and I couldn't have asked for a better experience! After many hours of research and reading reviews, I selected the Sheraton Music City Hotel for our NYE get away. I was welcomed right away by both staff at the front desk. I explained I was new to Nashville and awaiting my friend's arrival. The front desk sent a special surprise to our room to make our weekend stay memorable. All of the rooms have been remodeled! It was like staying in a brand new hotel. The lobby has not been renovated yet but they explained it would be renovated next. I did hear an occasional barking dog but that was only once we were awake and getting ready to leave. We had a mini Bluetooth speaker we listened to as we got ready and slept so we never heard anything through the walls. Bed and pillows were super comfortable! The shower pressure was weaker than what I'm used to but nothing to complain about. I ate at the on-site restaurant twice and had room service once. My lunch at the onsite restaurant was a burger and fries. It was amazing! A lot of food for the price. Service was okay at the restaurant. We also had brunch at the hotel. The brunch is a breakfast buffet (that you pay for) and it was really good especially if you needed a good breakfast after being out late. For room service we ordered a pizza. The pizza was not good, so I would stay away from it. My friend arrived just in time for pizza and asked me if it was frozen... so if you like frozen pizza maybe you will like it. We had a magnificent room view of the courtyard as you see in the photo. We also fell in love with the little charging station on the couch. We took Uber everywhere we went and besides NYE night, it was $11-13 to get downtown to Broadway. I felt 100% safe. The hotel is not within walking distance of anything but with Uber you really don't need much. We booked through Hotels.com and I feel we received an excellent rate. When I return I will definitely stay after at the Sheraton Music City. I was sad to leave Nashville. For two women in their 30's, this was the best NYE we could have asked for! Thank you staff at Sheraton for making it magical!

My numero uno Nashville hangout. Have had many memorable experiences here. Can have a drop dead serious Americana/Country/Blues/ artist at 6:00 and a 80's for Ladies dance party at 9:00. For example, at 6:00 on Fridays they have a Happy Hour with a player named Tim Carroll, blues rock with an edge. There is a different theme every night from Motown to Twangy Country to Gay Dance Party. Halloween, Valentine, New years parties! Also, many known writers and musicians show up. Go to their web site, http://www.the5spot.club/ I could go on all day about the 50+ times I have been there.
Terrible place. Showed up with 12 girls. Wouldn't let one of us in because she had a backpack. Despite the dozens of backpacks seen inside. Epic fail.
Good food. Great time out on the patio with the band they had on Saturday night. A good place to check out if you want good BBQ and Brisket.

I'm an artist performing all weekend. There is no one to service the room after 4pm. Also I had security knock on my door 2100 last night at 130am to tell me I'm talking on the phone to loud. I travel for work and need to talk to bookers and agents all over the world so the times vary from time zones. I was on an important work call schmoozing a booker for a potential job and I had to put them on hold to deal with this situation. The security not only told me to keep it down he told me that I was loud and that someone was trying to sleep mean while I hear people running and screaming in the hallway all day and night people partying intoxicated I put in ear plugs no biggie but lets not do anything about that lets pick on the sober guy in the room trying to make a sale. I showed the security my room there was no woman booze or anything shady going on I said I'm on the phone he also reminded me of the time. Gee thanks Dad I'll try to get to bed at a decent hour for school. For what I'm paying for the room, this just sucks. The room service food is very dry the chicken especially and they forgot the salad dressing and had to call and have them bring it up.
Came here after leaving another restaurant with terrible service a couple blocks away. It was late on a Saturday night and we were seated immediately. Our waitress was awesome and the food was great!

First positives: beautiful lobby, large room with a comfortable bed,  starbucks coffee in the room, polite service,  and finally a restaurant in the lobby with alcohol. :-)

Now the meh:  everything costs extra (wifi,  no comp breakfast), restaurant in lobby has very bland food (how does anyone make fish tacos taste like a slice of bread?), although not hotels fault there is a lot of 'crying children noise'as you walk down the hallways,  and the carpets need to be cleaned. 

Not against staying again however it won't be my first choice  compared to similarly priced options.
Great bar, excellent music and fun atmosphere in the heart of broadway. Rooftop bar has excellent views but of course gets crazy busy.

Well...it's a smoky hipster dive bar that has a DJ on the weekends. If you are confused...you should be. These two do not go together. I was brought here by some friends who raved about the "dance party" that happens on the weekends. We were the only ones dancing until about 12:30am and even then, only a few people were on the "dance floor" aka.... empty space in the middle of the bar. 

There's a separate area of the bar with pool tables and giant Jenga. The drinks are fine...strong and not too expensive. But you are nowhere near any other bars in East Nashville. Bless you Lyft for coming to pick me up. 

FooBar is a perfectly fine hipster dive bar. But unfortunately, that's not my favorite place to hang. Enjoy hipsters!

Was looking forward to eating at the Hard Rock Cafe for lunch but when we arrived they had shut the entire restaurant down for a private event. This was on a Monday and we had checked out the website on Sunday. Would've been nice to see the closure listed on their webpage before we wasted $10 to park only to have to leave and find someplace else to eat. I expected better.
Great food!!! Terrible service. Takes way too long. Waitresses are rude

I am only writing this review to save people from the nightmare we endured. The display of Rock & Roll art and collectibles is beautiful. I could feel the history. But the service was terrible. We waited on a waiter for 15 mins. After a long wait the food was cold and had no flavor. After looking at the last review We will agree ,.McDonald's is better. Save your money and stomach. Overpriced and Overrated.

Now this is a place to watch a band, have a drink and get your people watching on!

I didn't eat here but spent some time listening to a pretty good duo (coming from a guy that really doesn't like country music), having a beer and watching the pretty mixed crowd. This place is just a well run, good feeling place for a drink and some music. The bartenders were very good, seemed to keep everyone happy with a pretty good smile (one for sure prrrrr). 

I would definitely stop in here when back in town.  Of all the places on the main strip this was a very simple place but the one I felt the most at home in. 

KT

This place is a "joint" so don't expect anything fancy, pretty, or especially clean. They do know how to smoke some meat! Delicious brisket and sausage, spicy cowboy beans, beer battered jalapeños, cold beer.

Older hotel. Stayed in for one night on our way to PA. Large room, semi clean. Walkway carpet was dirty. Curtains had stains on them.  We got it on Priceline so it was the cheapest we could find on a short notice.
Nice spot. Wish they had more of a variety besides country though. I ran into Ron Jeremy here which was weird haha

They pick their artists well here. Brit Stokes Band is everything. Just, everything. 

Bartenders are also friendly and the atmosphere is geared more towards the music. Everyone's focused on the live show versus anything else. Must stop on Broadway for any country music lover.

This place has great music on every floor and yummy drinks! great place to dance and have some drinks. The bouncers aren't that friendly but they make sure nothing gets out of control. Right in the center of downtown Nashville , stop by and check out some bands and have a good time.

I had a very strange experience here. Due to flight delays, I didn't arrive at the hotel until about 2:30 am. When I walked up to the desk, I stood there for a long while before someone heard me in the back room and came to the front. I said hello and that I was checking in. The person working looked up at me with super angry eyes and didn't say a word. She shuffled through some papers then went back to the back for about 30 seconds. Obviously I was confused. When she came back she asked if I had ID & a credit card. So I handed each to her and she didn't say anything but walked into the back with both. She came back about one minute later and handed me a room key. Still saying nothing. I asked how to get to my room and she said I turn right and go down the hallway. I said thank you and went to my room, excited to relax, after a long day of flying and traveling alone. I open the door to find luggage and a men's suit on the bed and the bathroom door was closed. I was so confused and realized I was potentially alone in a room with a man at almost 3am. I immediately went to the front desk to tell her about my experience. This time I was helped by another woman who kind of tried to laugh it off and gave a crappy reason for the mistake. I was so tired from traveling that I just wanted to get to a room without anyone else in it. However, I had a hard time sleeping after realizing this is an establishment that gives out multiple room keys to different guests for the same room. I woke up early the next day to check out and asked to speak with a manager about what had happened. The morning front desk staff seemed mortified for me, but said no managers were available because they were in a meeting. They referred me to someone else, but not a manager. To ease my terrifying situation of being a lone woman traveler in the middle of the night who goes to find a mans things in her supposed hotel room, he asked me if I wanted a coffee... or maybe a bottle of water, because he sees I already have the water they carry, so why wouldn't I want more. I tell him no, thank you, and by this point I'm clearly shaking from being so freaked out by this weird situation and his lack of understanding how scary it was for me. He told me there was nothing they could do but apologize. I obviously was not impressed and was going to leave. He offered to sign me up for the FREE rewards program to make me feel better. I travel frequently and I have been meaning to do so, so I agree to sign up but let him know it doesn't really make anything better. So they added some points into the account. Not enough for a room though, which is fine because after that, I would have a hard time trusting another Sheraton. I left right after, and don't see myself returning here anytime soon. 

Also, the room smelled musky, they put me on the first floor with a back door leading right into the pool area, and the shower flooded. No thanks.

Stopped in for lunch. Good BBQ, it had a nice smoke taste to it. I added some of the sauce, WHAM. Good stuff. One of the locals brought me here. Said it was good food. They were correct. We got the nacho to start and could not finish it. Could of just ordered that, but glad we didn't. I would say give it a try.

Good, but not great.  I always have high expectations for any Q.  Really liked the sausages.  Ribs were meh and the bones were soft from sitting too long.  I'll be back to work through more of the menu and hopefully some of the live music.

To start, me and my wife got married on their rooftop. Came back 2 years after to have a drink and celebrate and the manager was unbelievably rude. This place is trash. We have been ashamed for years just being married here and tonight's situation validated it. Nashville has amazing places. This isn't one.

Not very crowded sat at the bar and able to get a beer quickly. Ordered the Yazoo beer but not very cold. 

The live band playing country music was really good and kept the crowd entertained. A good place while enjoying good music and a couple drinks before moving on to the next place.

How do I start the only reason we went was my granddaughter wanted to go. To say the least it was a disappointment we
Started with the sampler appetizer, actually it was really good hot fresh and was delivered to the table quickly. The noise level was such you could barely order not because it was crowded mind you there was probably less than fifteen people in the place. I know the name implies there will be music but there are limits. We decided on the cheese burgers that were supposed to be legendary, they did resemble the menu art but they were cooked dry and heavily charred needless to say we were not happy. We didn't understand why the parking lot was full and the dining room was empty, we soon figured out at fifteen dollars to park it was a great deal for parking downtown. We won't be back.
Awesome vibe with good drinks and friendly people. The band was a crowd pleaser. Hopefully will be back soon.

Great place to hear live music. They have a limited food menu I've never tried but looks appealing. This is such a fun area of town with all the music venues and restaurants close by. To be in an area with so many businesses, parking is typically very easy to find. There's a paid lot next to the 5 Spot that's pretty reasonably priced. Love that Lady Gaga played here on her Dive Bar tour, because now I can say she and my husband have played the same venue.
Fun place with great live music (not just country). Drinks are a tad bit on the pricey side ($8/ea for jack & coke for example). Overall, definitely recommend stopping by.

Very nice hotel. The 2 queen rooms were very spacious and the balconies were great! Comfy beds, roomy bathrooms. Restaurant and bar on site which was convenient. Staff very helpful and nice. Close to the Opry. Shuttle service is offered to get downtown as well at $10 per person. I highly recommend this hotel. We also got my birth year rate ($79) for 2 nights out of 3!

Really question the 4-star rating. Showed up on a late Monday evening, yet took 30 minutes to get checked-in. If you like nostalgia the, you'll love the 70s era hallway carpet which smells of so many failed Nashville dreams.
Best spot in town. We went 2 different times during the weekend. Bartenders were friendly and music talent was awesome. Small and more intimate then most bars on broadway.
One of our top three picks for fun places on Broadway. The band we saw while we were there was fantastic! Good service and great atmosphere! Terrific experience....

This hotel is quite beautiful from the outside. The gardens are very well maintained. Although it's not in the downtown area, it's extremely convenient to all mains areas. The rooms are in the process of being renovated, with simple modern updates. The indoor pool is large and well maintained, as is the workout area. The beds are extremely comfortable. Our 2 queen room was well sized with a small fridge and balcony (facing an empty parking lot). My biggest complaint is that the lay out of the hotel requires quite a bit of walking to get to your room from the elevator or front lobby area (main entrance). I supposedly got a good deal on this room through a travel website but had I paid full price I may have been a bit disappointed.

I booked Sheraton Music City for a meeting that was subsequently cancelled, two weeks prior to arrival.

I made the mistake of booking through BOOKINGS.com.  

I assumed that a legitimate company like Sheraton would not partner with scammers, like BOOKINGS,COM.

Upon cancellation, I expected a reasonable, non-refundable fee, 15% - 25% (even 50% a couple of days prior to cancellation); to be shocked that Sheraton's cancellation fee is 100%!

I was a long supporter of Sheraton as a legitimate company, much like Mariott and Hilton. I am shocked that Sheraton would align with scammers like BOOKINGS.COM!

I will NEVER book another Sheraton, as they displayed their lack of integrity, aligning with BOOKINGS.COM.

Also, I will advise my associates to avoid both for their lack of Corporate Inetgrity.

Regretfully,

GW

Such poor service at the Pride Festival!  This isn't just a rant against Nashville's trend to profiteer off of alcohol sales at their local festivals. Though the trend towards having only one alcohol sponsor for these festivals is both disturbing and irritating, many providers can pull it off adequately. But Hard Rock's monopoly at this festival has demonstrated a new low in service. If you're going to be the sole provider of alcohol at these events you shouldn't be so blatantly capitalistic to be providing such few locations, options and bartenders as to maximize your profits. P.s. Festival planners... it's only a matter of time before we Nashvillians revolt and just start bringing our own alcohol!!

I visited The Valentine during the CMA Music Festival and that's when the place had live performances by Aaron Tippin, Darryl Worley, Ronnie McDowell. The entertainment was Fantastic and love the place too. A great place to go when visiting Downtown Nashville.

I really enjoyed coming to the stage to hear live music and enjoy some beers. They didn't have a cover on the night that we went. The layout of the space was great: a large open dancefloor/seated section facing the stage, with a bar to the side. I think the openness of the venue makes this place lively without being cramped. It was a really fun time to hear a local band play country covers. I think the stage attracts great talent, so you will be getting a great musical experience no matter which night you come.

this place is full of crap we were treated horribly the service is so bad 0/10 i would not return here if i was paid the big guy was being rude to me and my friends like all night and we were just sitting drinking calmly i did like the employees AT ALL
Food was awesome! The chicken mac and cheese was VERY good! Service was very good also. Good music, good food, good service..can't go wrong!

If you want to wait forever for your food, get a stomach ache and over pay you should eat here. Their Nashville hot chicken sandwich was disgusting it was over peppered, greasy, and just plain gross. Our server was nice but whew it was just a eh experience. I normally love hard rock! We go to our local one a lot but this one was just blah.

This place is just old school and cool.  I honestly wish they allowed smoking here because it would remind me of the way neighborhood bars used to be in the 90's (and probably before, but I was not old enough to get in).  This is not a trendy place (thank God) so you don't have to get all dressed up and there is not fancy food or crazy prices.  Just come as you are and hang out with other people that have come as they are to listen to some great live music.  I have been there twice, both on Saturday nights.  The other night, the Mark Robinson Band was playing and they are a fun Blues Band.  The sound was great.  The time before was older country music and it was also fantastic.  I am looking forward to trying the Friday night 80's dance party which is the first Friday of the month, I believe.

The food was "popcorn only" the two nights that I was there...microwaved in a bag....so that could get better, but there was only one person bartending and doing the popcorn, so I get it.  I heard there is a food truck sometimes.  They pour good drinks, so can't complain.

There is a cover charge so be ready!

Walked in off Broadway and ordered drinks.  Very good service.  The music was entertaining.  There is a dance floor and many people were dancing.  There are lots of stuffed animals and a big bear is in the front where lots of people had their pictures made.  This spot is in the middle of Broadway!

We really enjoyed our stay here. We had a King Suite with the view of the pool from the 4th floor. The room came with a dining room table, full couch & two chairs and desk & chair. The room was clean and bed very comfortable. The lobby is Grand with nice staff to greet you. The price is good and I didn't notice any children running around and this was good for us as we are seniors. I will definitely stay again because the price is good, near airport and short drive to downtown. The only thing I was missing was a Gift shop.

The food was good.  The service was great. We had the veggie burger. I had one at the London Hard Rock that was awesome!  This one was okay...descent. We ordered a salad with dressing on the side.  The salad came dressed.  Ambiance was a mixture of typical Hard Rock and new chic.  Chocolate milkshake was delicious.

Vegan?  They were able to confirm that the veggie burger is vegan, however they had no idea if their buns / bread options were vegan.  I had to order the burger without a bun because they were not able or willing to verify this for me.  Very disappointing.

The restaurant prices are ridiculous, especially for the quality of the food. There's been what appears to be blood in the entrance way for about 45mins now. The staff seems overwhelmed by the convention patrons, I can't imagine booking these types of events without having an adequate staff.
Great food and great service! Kyle the waiter was awesome and had awesome recommendations! We all had burgers and were completely satisfied! We will be back the next time we are in town!
Great music on every floor , very clean and up to date inside , good drinks , had the pretzels app and there were delicious the dipping sauce was real good .

Music was excellent, and was what drew us in.  This is very much a no nonsense broadway bar which has a handful of tables and bar seats, so if you hop in at the same time as a cycle bar it's going to be rough going.  The bathrooms also leave something to be desired.

Drinks and music were great, and if that's what you're looking for stop by.  If you want a seat to rest your tired feet, another stop will be better for you.

What year is this? Build wise the place presents well, staff really isn't amazing and that's fine because I expect a few employees(anywhere) to be lame. The room was clean and spacious, oddly dirty small vent in the bathroom. 

I visited the Antique Archeology, bought post cards, intending to send them out from here and be home around the time of the delivery. NO STAMPS, I ask the front desk, they don't sell stamps. No explanation, barely eye contact, but a hotel that seemingly caters to business and frequent travelers THAT HAS A BUSINESS CENTER IN THE LOBBY, doesn't offer stamps.
