The internet, THE INTERNET!! It is an insult to internet. The cellular reception here is mostly miss, as far as hit and miss connectivity goes. Boasting that complimentary wifi is available and neglecting to mention the fact that it's atrocious @ a blazing 2MBPS MAX! You can opt for a "high-speed" connection for $4.95 per 24 hours. They offer an option for $12.95 that I wasn't even considering entertaining. 

I was enjoying the balcony view from the 3rd floor and even threw away some money at the overpriced offerings from the guest services store and the bar, but was possibly more annoyed than I should've been when I couldn't stream a standard definition movie on Vudu. 

I'll be avoiding Sheraton and SPG properties entirely if this is their standard of service. The other reviews I've read are on par. It's an OK at best. Take care folks.

I went to this place last night. One of the best bands I have seen in 10 years  they were very entertaining, which is odd for a Tuesday night. I went for a beer and stayed for the band and did 15 shots. Lol. First time in my life I stayed at a bar because of the band.

3.5. Good music, no cover. Was easy to walk to from the [ahem: "ho-tel, mo-tel..."] Holiday Inn [Express]. Enjoyed it with the boy and his cousins on a not-too-packed weeknight one our way to the midwest Thanksgiving.  The crowd was weird though (mid-40s plus and early 20-somethings...not really any late20s to early 30-somethings).  Drinks were good and strong though, even if it didn't have a noteworthy bourbon list.

The second stop on our Broadway bar crawl. No surprise here "the stage" is the main attraction here. The musics loud, and everyones "got a cup in there hand". This place makes you feel like your at a concert, everyone knows the words to all the songs. The band was great here, maybe the best we heard in all of Nashville.  Simple concept here but surprisingly fun.

A real honky tonk. No food, just music and alcohol. Another one of the Broadway must visits on a visit to Music City. Music all day. Stop in for drink or two and see some good sounds. Not much to say about a bar only establishment. 

You want to say you've been there.

This place is rather eclectic with the music. Nothing outstanding to remarkable about this bar. The sound system is great. Nice back patio. Parking is a bit challenging. Bathroom could use a good cleaning and the painting of Elvis is rather creepy. The menu was posted in the bathroom. Lol. A bit expensive for drinks. The music was good from the first band. The second band needed a lot more practice. Not up to Nashville standards by any means. For a cover charged bar, I'd expect better. The doorman was t very pleasant. The bartender worked his butt off. Not really a favorite spot for me.  We will probably try it again sometime with vetting the bands prior to going.

Overall it was very good. They forgot to make my husbands food but our server was very nice and the manager took care of us.  My salad and Mai Tai excellent!!!  Tour kids also always have fun at Hard Rock.  The kids were given amazing activity packs.  Nice touch!

I'll start by saying that I've stayed in Nashville twice over the last year and stayed here twice.  I'd stay again if I ever come back.  At first glance it's on a hill and you drive through these gates to get there.  Once inside the lobby is pretty nice and everything has an inviting feel to it.  The rooms are clean and the bed was a pleasure to sleep on.  

As far as the location, it may seem kinda far away from downtown, but I'll say this.  The entire weekend I was here, no matter where I saw starting from and where I needed to go literally everything was 15 minutes away when I plugged it in the gps.  And you can't beat the price.  Staying downtown was ridiculously expensive compared to this place, and that's without including the $20 parking fees most places can surprise you with.  Parking is fee here.  If I'm coming to Nashville again, I'm most likely staying here again.

The Whiskey Bent Saloon on Broadway is our go to saloon when we come to Nashville reason being is none other than TARIA LONG!!!! We LOVE Taria and the boys! She sings from the heart & has an amazing voice, plus, her music is very relatable. Taria & the boys are fun & get you involved with their show/music. Make sure to get a copy of her CD "Everybody Wants Some". Whiskey Bent Saloon invites you in and treats you like family. The saloon is clean with friendly bartenders, top shelf liquor and ice cold beer! You can't ask for anything better then cold beer, good liquor, friendly staff and of course TARIA. Make sure to put Whiskey Bent Saloon & Taria Long on top of your list when visiting Nashville Tennesse they don't disappoint!
Cheap beers and live music. Different themed nights and a small cover. Went on a Friday night for happy hour. The band was great. I'd go back!
Very charming place with great moonshine cocktails! The blackberry was delish and the bartenders were great!

Music and atmosphere were awesome, service and food left something to be desired. 

Went with a friend and sat on the rooftop patio, grabbed menus and from there no service. 
Went to the bar to order drinks and food, asked about specials but told there were none, even tho I found out later there were. 
Got the turkey club, the amount of bacon on it was the smallest I've ever seen. Says it comes with avocado but really it's brown guacamole. Flavour just wasn't there. 

Despite the food they have a great selection of alcohol and you can't beat the patio!

We went here 2x while in Nashville, it's live music as is MOST places on the strip, we liked it, it seems to pack out but - again - what doesn't down there?

They have an upstairs area that lets the smokers smoke and it is well ventilated and while the downstairs was TOTALLY packed out this area was kinda emptyish, I assume because you're not able to enjoy the music so much up there.  It has a bar though, and we were happy with this spot.  

No cover.

I visit a lot of hotels for my job. I used to like this one, but it seems to have made a steady decline. The attitude at the front desk is deplorable. If there's a conference at the hotel, service of any kind takes forever (from sit-down to cash-out, dinner took over 3 hours)! It seems the hotel is just not prepared for large groups. Oh, and take a parka to dinner. It was uncomfortably FREEZING in the the restaurant.

This bar is down music row a bit but man is it worth going to. The talent that played there yesterday was on point. The bar was busy but the bartenders were moving so quick they made a minimal wait to get a drink. We grabbed a table in front of the stage and enjoyed the female and male singers who switched off every other song. The atmosphere was welcoming, relaxed, and somewhat calming. We did not eat here but there food choices did look good. There are TVs above the bar that we're showing ESPN and baseball. They did have a happy hour from 4-7 which highlighted 4$ domestics.

Recently spent a long weekend in Nashville and after quite a bit of deliberation decided we'd stay at a "nicer" hotel instead of the many nearby motels that'd cost half. Overall, this particular Sheraton was pretty disappointing. Our room had that weird old musty hotel room smell to it, and we got a real odd handicap accessible room which apparently was all that was available which seemed sort of unlikely given just how easily in the day we were checking in. A friend got upgraded to a suite which was laid out super odd, it was like it had the same amount of furniture as a normal hotel room, but instead just had enough room in the center to set up a boxing ring or something. I don't get it.

The hotel bar was absurdly expensive for how watered down the drinks were, and the hotel food was pretty terrible for how expensive it was. Overall, a super mediocre experience and considering how much we paid (compared to the rest of the Nashville area) it was pretty disappointing.

This is amazing honky tonk! It has such an awesome vibe and my favorite thing is they have the cutest security and bouncers. I mean honestly 10/10. They always have great music playing and there's always something new to see. It's similar to other bars on broadway but this one is a must see!

We visited this place around the New Years Eve time frame and had a blast! The service at the bar was very friendly! In addition, the staff members who came around were incredibly funny and quick to clear away any empty glasses (and answer all our questions about their trendy cowboy hats :P ). We had a party of around nine individuals, who were able to all hang around one of the tall tables with a few stools without feeling cramped. The bands playing were very good and played a lot of popular songs! Overall, I would absolutely recommend this venue and look forward to visiting again during our next Nashville trip!
Key was capital A AMAZING!!!!!! Absolutely loved her spirit! Thanks for helping us today!
I had an amazing stay! They treated us like royalty and gave us complimentary breakfast!

Not bad. 

We decided on this place because we wanted to sit outside on a lovely night but the 4 person band playing outside was quite loud, so we opted to have dinner inside instead. Our group of three had a bit of an issue ordering; I think our waitress was the only one working inside and she had a number of tables, but once we snagged her we ordered the fried jalapenos, hot dry rubbed wings, brisket, ribs and sausage. 

Everything is a la carte and the sides cost $2 and some change extra and they are not large portions at all.  I wasn't blown away with the cowboy beans as a side, and whatever you do, DON'T order the corn on the cob. It is not grilled but rather dumped into boiling water and cooked. Oh, and it's tiny. I enjoyed my wings but I have to say I prefer the smoked wings at Neighbors better...sorry. The brisket is pretty spectacular and I enjoyed the ribs as well. 

Overall, food was pretty good but the highlight of the meal for me was the fried jalapenos. Those were killer. But...should those really be the highlight of the meal? I think not.

I'd come back but would focus on the brisket or choose another dish instead.

Never order the nachos, for they have little to NO toppings on them. Paid $9 extra for steak for there to be the smallest amount of steak I could have possibly been given. Josh was my waiter and was extremely rude and slow about refills. When I told him my meal was wrong he said that I was in the wrong for not asking him about when I first ordered and my meal was not changed.

We visited the Hard Rock Cafe after our trolley tour for lunch.  I wanted to go to Acme but the wife had never been to a Hard Rock before so we went there instead.  Since we were there during lunch we didn't have any wait as the restaurant was about a third full.  Our server was very attentive (can't remember her name) and brought drinks and food out promptly.  We all had burgers, I had the barbecue bacon burger while my wife and son both had the Big Cheeseburger.  They all came out cooked to perfection and I was pleasantly surprised how good they were for a chain burger.  They were overpriced but that's to be expected in the tourist area of town.

I had planned to attend a conference for a week in April. I canceled the reservation and they charged me. I have called the hotel all morning. No one answer's the phone, they have transferred me around to 4 different call center's and I can't seem to talk to a live person. No one call's me back to entertain my question or try and resolve my situation. Tried all morning to contact Mary Roman or Charley Morales. This hotel is chaos, avoid it!!! Will never stay in a Sheraton or Marriott hotels, ever.............

Heard some great music here...I really enjoyed listening to the band I heard.

Plus, whenever I walked by this place, the sounds emanating from the place were great.  The staff here were friendly and fun too, from the bouncers to the bartenders.

However, the crowds made me want to leave this place a little early.  I guess I'm getting old, but I don't understand why some people have to get sooooo drunk to have a good time.  There was this obnoxious blonde girl who was trashed and she was "dancing" in front of the stage.  And by dancing, I mean she was trying to twerk to Alan Jackson songs.  She could barely stand and she was smacking everyone on the butt.  She kept spinning around and shouting "woo" and sloshing her drink all over the place.  I felt embarrassed for her  but I was also pissed that instead of being able to watch/listen to the terrific band, I had to dodge a drunken idiot.   The bar should have cut her off and thrown her out.

In short, I liked the music , but the floor show made me leave.

Saturday night was the most fun I've ever had in this bar!! Love music, all the write songs!! The crowd plays off of each other's energy! We spent hours here drinking and dancing! Most fun bar we hung out in our entire weekend trip!! I love that the bars in Nashville have a jug of water with a stack of cups next to it to help yourself and to cut the bar lines down.

I came here for QDP over the weekend and had SO much fun!! They had free bottles of water, awesome perk. The music was great, the vibe was everything you'd hope a dance party would be, and the people were too much fun. They had a photo booth and a small stage to dance on. I can't wait to come back. East Nashville never disappoints!

The food here was really good but I must say the experience of trying to get a table was beyond ridiculous. There was a hostess named "Tasha" that repeatedly rolled her eyes at our group of 7 and had such an attitude while we were trying to get a table. We walked in and there was no line and after dealing with her crappy attitude she told us that there would be an hour wait. NO ONE ELSE WAS WAITING. So after about 15 min we went back and asked if it would be quicker to split our group up since there were plenty of vacant tables and she said out loud "well it's gonna be an hour wait." Another hostess just so happened to be walking by and heard "Tasha" say this and was shocked and said "Where is there an hour wait?!" So needless to say we got seated within 45 min at a table that was literally clean and available THE ENTIRE TIME WE WAITED. While we were leaving the girl freaking ducked behind the desk.
Great little bar. Love the vibe and the atmosphere. Super nice staff. Great music!!! Will be back!!!

Local bar with artists from the area coming to play their tunes. $10 cover at the door, which seemed fine given the band and crowd.

Was out with a group of friends, and then insulted one of them by a bartender who decided not to serve because she wasn't quick to make the order. He then proceeded to tell the other bartenders not to serve her, and that we would all be kicked out if he found she had a drink. Reaction was extreme, and didn't work to de-escalate anything.  

Needless to say, we didn't stay after that, and didn't get to hear much of the great music this place is known for.

Underwhelmed....
Three levels of live country music. Ample space for groups of people just wanting to dance, sing and drink to some good music.

California Crew here. 

Great music, Staff is great.

I'd like to give a specific shout out to Grace at the topside bar. There's a bunch of us west coasters in Nashville for the first time and she's truly a rockstar amongst a bunch of great folks.

Thank you lass for putting up with us and be better at your job than almost everyone we met on the bar scene in NSH. 

Looking forward to coming back!

Worst ever literally 40 mins and still counting for our damn check and its not that busy.  Completely unacceptable time is money and I don't have time to waste.  Stay far away from this place, its really not even that good "Hard Rock" is just a name!

This place is everything a good honky tonk should be:  good music, fun crowd, lots of energy!  We are locals and neither me or my husband are crazy about country music, so we don't frequent Broadway a ton, but we do get down there every 2 months or so to catch some live music and cut loose a little.  This is one of my favorite spots to do that.  

The bands that play here are always awesome - they play a good mix of country and  80s/90s/00s rock/pop with a real oldie (think "Sweet Caroline","Brown Eyed Girl" or something from the Rolling Stones) thrown in every so often.  The crowd is also usually pretty fun - not overly rowdy, just people who want to come and sing and dance with the band.  Not much seating here so be prepared to stand but the bands usually have you on your feet anyway.  The Stage always delivers a good time!

With all the jam packs places on Broadway, Bootleggers was  a little Slice of Heaven with some Hometown loving!

 This place had such a great vibe that it brought us back twice during our short visit to Nashville. That says a lot with all of the bars on that street. 

Both times the music was fantastic and the second time the band was so gracious to accommodate all my friend's request. That gave me plenty of times to sample all the crazy flavors of moonshine that this bar had. Who knew that you could get a moonshine that came with a bloody mary back!

Both times the servers were beyond friendly and the place just had this cool kick back vibe. Don't miss this place if you were on Broadway. You might be dazzled by all the name brand places but this is true Country Music Row.

Nice and clean. We stopped early but we stayed for a couple because of the singer who was fantastic!! Barmaid was still waking up for the day of something. Not exactly a ball of fire. All in all a pretty decent time.

I really enjoyed the 3 piece band!  They were playing requests and the crowd was very enthusiastic.  The bartender was friendly and prompt and my drink was affordable.
I very much enjoyed my 30 minute stop in.

The security wouldn't let us in on CMA Fest. We had planned to spend the evening there (from 5 til close) drinking and eating with bartender Mallory.

We were denied entrance per the Security Guard. We decided to go down to Tootsies instead and stayed there until 1am.

I WOULD NOT recommend this bar if you are looking to have a good time.

Here for funky music $10 cover 
Bring id
Wow we came for a show on Saturday night and was suppose to start at 9pm but it was 1030 and hasn't started yet! They were still trying to set up and it was for funky music yet since it was Cinco de mayo -- they were just playing the "themed" music. We waited until 1030 and realize that they were stalling this whole time. 

My local friends love this place and took us here because they usually come on Sundays and they were as outraged and thrown off as we were that this was acceptable.

The hotel has a beautiful lobby and that's about all I can say good about this hotel.  There is only one set of elevators that you can use a luggage cart on.  Hallway after hallway of rooms,  be prepared to walk a long time.  It's hotter than can be inside.  Ordered 4 cans of soda,  an ice cream sundae,  and a bowl of banana pudding.  $41!!!  And they weren't that good.  It's Nashville,  find something else.  You'll be a while lot happier.

I was supposed to be walking back to the hotel. I was seduced by a saxophone, as one is. Rarely have I heard saxophone on Broadway, so I took a chance and went in. It has that divey feel but turns out, it seems like Sunday nights are unofficial social swing dancing nights at Whiskey Bent. A phenomenal band playing *real* country music (not the pop stuff), and fun-as-all-get-out swing dancers hanging out. If you're looking for where the locals hang out, this is it. 

I had a fantastic time, the dancers recognized right away that I wanted to dance. Everyone is so friendly, right down to the bouncer. I loved the various whiskey-themed art on the walls. Everyone packed up around 10:30pm to head to Robert's Western World, so I followed suit. I can't wait to come back.
One of the few places in Nashville that feels like a club you'd find in LA or Miami. Can be really crowded and the upper levels are usually pretty dead.
I just wish they would clean their ceilings.   This is actually a collection of dust and mold. Anyways had to leave bc my friend had an asthma attack. Otherwise God Bless

If you're not into dive bars, don't come here. It's super divey, but that's just how they roll!! The lack of ambiance is definitely made up for in the LIVE MUSIC!! My friends and I were road tripping across the country, and Nashville was our first stop. We obviously wanted to check out some live music, and this place was recommended to us by some locals. It's definitely a hole-in-the-wall local spot, but it's great!! The place was crowded but not terribly. The 4 of us were able to find a table to hang out. The drinks are relatively cheap for how big they are. They also have deals on certain days for cheap beers etc. The bands we saw that night were amazing!! They could each be on the radio in my opinion. Even my country hating husband love the music!!! That's a HUGE teller of how good these bands were. Check this place out if you are in the area!!
This was good, not great. The food and service was decent, but really expensive. Steak was prepared as ordered, but was too heavily seasoned.
They have the worst customer service I've ever encountered. Their lack of organizational abilities lost them a lot of business tonight from many different people. Don't stay here!
Awesome service and great music. Highly recommend the moonshine drinks. Get there early as it seemed to get packed around 7pm

My son and his friend are musicians and were so excited to have lunch here today! We have been to at least 10 locations in other cities and had great experiences. This was a bad experience. The food was mediocre, some of the food was served cold and the service was horrible! I asked for a manager who never came. I asked for the check and it took 20 minutes for them to get around to providing it. We live in Franklin and will not be back!

I stayed here Labor day weekend for a seminar and Inwas quite impressed with how nice and accommodating the staff was. Too notch customer service! Some decor was a little outdated, but eh oh well. The room was nice, ironing board a little raggedy, and yall definitely need to change cable carriers. And get some smart tv's. I had to bring my tablet to the fitness center to do workout videos. No complimentary breakfast  And a huge parking lot, but there's a daily fee of $10 for customers staying here. Also not having a microwave in the room was a nuisance. Having to walk to and from the lobby each time I needed to use one. The hotel does offer a shuttle to the airport and anywhere within a 3 mi. radius of the hotel, which was Very helpful. Also there's a shuttle company called Monarch that will take you from the hotel to downtown for $10 round trip  All in all, I had a good experience.

Hotel is fine and close to airport but shuttle front desk communication is bad.  Called from airport, front desk said they would send shuttle.  Waited 20+ minutes until another party needed shuttle.  Shuttle driver had no idea I was waiting.  On leaving front desk told me shuttle driver would announce noticeably when he was leaving.  I waited in lobby shuttle came and went no announcement I could see.  From airport call a second time if you don't see shuttle right away, I guess.  Definitely don't wait in lobby for shuttle, wait outside.

The Sheraton Music City hotel was one of the official hotel partners of Yelp Spring Break Nashville 2014. The official hotel partner rate was $139 per night but I ended up booking with Living Social for only $109 per night which included a $30 dining voucher per night. Because I am a Starwood Preferred guest Gold Member, I was upgraded to a junior suite and even received complimentary cocktails coupons up to $15 each. In total I paid $128.12 per night for the three night stay which included $90 in dining credit and $45 in drink credit. Definitely a great value!

The hotel amenities include a complimentary airport transfer service, outdoor pool, 24 hour gym, jacuzzi, and an indoor heated pool. There's also an on-site restaurant and lounge. Food service stops promptly at 12 midnight even though the bar is open much later.  Not even cold items are available after 12 midnight.

One slight draw back is that the hotel is located about 15 minutes from the downtown area. The hotel has two shuttles which could easily schedule complimentary shuttle service to the downtown areas at certain times of the day. Other than that it's a fantastic hotel and I would definitely stay here again!  

Thanks so very much Janece for LS & Daniel at the Front Desk!

The service was very bad. The restaurant was only 1/4 full, but it took almost an hour to get our food. We were not given utensils and our waitress did not check on us. That said, the worst part was the food. It was disgusting. My chicken was rubbery and pink on the inside. I couldn't finish my meal. Everyone at our table remarked that their food was gross. My husband got sick afterwards and I feel nauseated.

Sorry guys, once again a bar waiter that would much rather puts around the bar dancing with other employees that wait on customers; when did they quit emphasizing customer service; I don't pay for customer avoidance!
This is our first time visiting the hard rock cafe.  It is excellent...the staff is very nice and friendly.  The food was good as well.

My salad was very bland and old also my chicken was very overcooked and dry. I expected more based on other reviews but it was a dissapoinment. Go try the restaurant before you look at reviews it might be good to some and not to others.
Bartender on the top floor on 11/09/18 around 10:15 pm was so nasty. I doubt I am the 1st to tell you that. She needs to go.

After many years as a Sheraton customer I doubt I would ever book again. The hotel itself is in a good location and the room was clean and spacious. In fact everything was fine, until about 9PM when the entire hotel lost power. Guest began to run amok in the courtyard screaming and yelling. Pitch black darkness in the room. A call to the front desk yielded little information. With nothing else to do my wife and I tried to sleep through the night. There was no AC so it was super hot and uncomfortable. 

The power seems to have been restored around 5:30AM. After getting some sleep I went to the front desk to find out if they would be offering any compensation for the loss of service.  I was told there was no discount or vouchers be given because it was a regional blackout. I asked if there was a generator. I was told yet, but it failed to power up and give power to the hotel.

For the price I paid, I expect the hotel to have a generator. And I expect it to work. If not I expect to be compensated. I called Sheraton corporate hoping for a resolution. They took down my complaint and passed it on to the hotel and said they would be getting back to me.

Guess what they never did? Not a call back. Nothing. No apology. No measly discount off a future stay or anything. Poor customer service. Too cheap to give me half off one nights stay during which I lost expected services and now the company will likely miss out on thousands of future revenue from this guest.

I try to visit Hard Rock Cafes in every city I visit. I read the other bad reviews and thought that they could have been having a bad day. But noooo!! 
That was the worst experience ever!!! We were told we could sit upstairs and there was a live band. It was wayyy too loud, we couldn't hear ourselves talk. After 15 minutes, I finally asked if someone was working our table because no one ever stopped to greet or serve us. It was two other tables with people. So they weren't busy. We ordered simple, two burgers and wings. The wings came out burnt, only one burger came out. Still don't know what happened to the other burger. We heard another couple complaining about the service. They gave us the excuse that it was busy. I pointed out each table that was empty when we arrived. We asked for a house salad, that was literally lettuce and two tomatoes only. They didn't get any of the add ons or substitutes correct!!! It was horrible.

I've eaten in and taken out and have loved the food both times. The food is very smoky so if you like that this is your place. My favorite is the smoked mushrooms which I haven't yet seen anywhere else in Nashville. My only concern is that I haven't yet seen the restaurant crowded, I'm not sure what's keeping others away, hopefully they just don't know about it yet.

In Nashville for my 30th Birthday. This was one of several bars we visited during the trip. The bartenders were fast and knowledgeable. Now for the poor experience. We ordered one round and spent around 50$ no sooner than that we were told that we couldn't sit at our table any longer because they wanted to expand the dance floor. So we are standing there holding 7 freshly purchased drinks as the crew is bumping into us telling us to look out as they carried tables and chairs around the bar. Poor timing to say the least.

Our stay here couldn't have been better, perfect everything!  :D



ps- every room has a private balcony!
Prob one of fave bars on broadway! Highest rooftop and awesome view! Best customer service & their menu is amazing! Gotta have the chicken sandwich!!!! Hands down awesome staff & entertainment too!
Typical Nashville bar. There was a great live band playing, an attentive bartender making strong drinks and an overall good time. Loved the "chandeliers."
small but loud! T-shirt's are a bit pricey and beer was 5.50 each...it was like a big party in there

I drank some vodka here.

I drank some vodka here after I drank some vodka elsewhere.

I listened to a really solid country band here. The bass player was pretty sick.

I dig hearing about venue history, acts that played there... stuff like that. Interesting! 

East Nashville is pretty cool, if I lived in Nashville, I'd probably hang there often.

Woot!

This bar has a great location and overall on my trip had the best sound and live bands. I did feel like a sardine in this place though. Super uncomfortable and didn't stay long the Friday night I was here.

This venue is by far the best and most fun on the strip. We stopped in several of the hot spots and they were over crowded and the drinks were $12 for a tiny plastic cup. This place is on spot with an amazing band that plays non stop. The drinks were very affordable and strong pours. I can't wait to return for another fun evening. The staff also looks so happy and it makes the vibe feel alive.
Consistently one of my favorite places on Broadway. Not overly hyped, laid back crowd, reasonably price drinks, and the music's always great. Stop in!

When this venue is elbow to elbow and the staff can still make you feel that it's all about you, is a sign of great leadership. 

The service provided this New Year's Eve was simply amazing for my party of six!  I will always look forward to their ability to exceed expectations. 

Thanks Zeke P. and the WB team for making your guests feel like friends.

I have frequented many a Hard Rock Cafe throughout the world and I can say that this experience was not one of the better ones.  My colleagues and I were in town for a conference and we decided to explore Downtown Nashville for dinner.  We originally wanted to experience Demos or BB Kings, but the line for both were very long and we were hungry.  We ended up at the Hard Rock Cafe and were seated immediately.

I will say that the service was very good and friendly (never really had a problem with service during our stay in Nashville) but the quality of the food left a lot to be desired.  I was in the mood for some nachos and ordered the Nachopalooza.  My colleague ordered the spinach dip and my other colleague the potato skins.  Each of us expressed disappointment when we received our dishes as there was nothing special about any of them.  I asked for a side of salsa for my nachos and was informed that they do not have salsa - very strange.  I ordered a draft beer which was not as chilled as I would have liked, which added to the negative experience.

I suppose there was a reason why the Hard Rock Cafe had immediate seating while other places in town were packed to the max.  I would not recommend this place to anyone visiting Nashville - plenty of other locations to experience the local fare.

Loved that they had wine and the beer was reasonably priced. Classic rock cover band was also awesome! 


But why do they use plastic cups for water? And plastic STRAWS!? It's 2018, ya'll. Most plastic isn't recycled and seeps into groundwater and ends up in your fish! It's not just about the environment, it's about the future of our children.

We were running behind and most restaurants were on a 2 hour wait.  We decided to go to Hard Rock because big name chains typically always give you exactly what you expect food and service wise.  No less and typically no more.  We arrived last Saturday evening and decided to go upstairs for the live band.  Band was awesome and the food was exactly what we wanted.  The service was far from acceptable though.

We thought it was weird that customers did not seem that happy and that during prime dinner time, the crowd was clearing out (though the 1st floor wasn't).  After waiting 15-25 min for our first round of drinks, it became very obvious what the issue was.  Everything took a ton of time.  We actually ended up walking up to the service bar and grabbing our 2nd round of drinks ourselves since our server was constantly walking past it.  We were there for quite a bit of time and not even a manager touched the table to ask us about our experience.

My wife and I both come from the service industry and typically always give people the benefit of the doubt.  This was not acceptable though.  There were not many sat tables and they had plenty of staff capable of helping each other.  The bar was empty and bartender was completely free to run drinks.

This place doesn't offer the kind of live entertainment that you see around town, but It's still a cozy place to eat. TVs at every booth showing great Rock music videos. I had the Atomic Burger, and it wasn't all that "atomic" (fine by me). The fried jalapeño was hot hot! But the burger was delicious! This was my birthday lunch outing and they offered me a free ice cream dessert, which was melty under a pile of whipped cream. It's a good place, but they have these restaurants everywhere, so I wouldn't recommend it while in Nashville.

On our last stop of the night and we decided to give this place a try. From the street level, we could see people looking down on to Broadway. There's actually a few places with rooftop bars, we just happened to choose this one. From standing on street level ,you cannot tell what the music is like until you get to the top! Luckily, it was GOOD! Make sure you are ready to trek up (and later down) 3 flights of stairs! They don't call it rooftop for nothing! I didn't recall seeing where the elevator was, but I'm sure it was there...somewhere!

Too bad we were already exhausted from driving, otherwise we definitely would have stayed and hung out a lot longer. I think we strolled in around 10pm ish and the place seemed like it was already cranked up. Literally, within 15 minutes after grabbing a drink and finding a table to hold up (no chairs) the dance floor was packed, the band was taking requests and it had everyone ready to rumble (no line dancing!) They were playing a great mix!

We had stopped in a few places that evening, but I'd say hands down, this one was our favorite. It had the open air, rooftop bar and view of everything going on below, a nice dance floor and band stage set up, fast and friendly bartenders, no cover, and an awesome band complete with a fiddle player too! I think the band made more money off of playing requests for people who offered the highest dollar than they did asking for tips/donations! The band played a variety of artists and genres, which is a great way to keep the audience on their feet. This would be a great place to come after dinner since they only serve drinks, no food. 

There is no shortage of talent anywhere in Nashville, so enjoy the presenters, have fun and put your dancing shoes ( or cowboy boots) on while in town!

This was a terrible experience.  We made reservations and were taken to the bar to sit. Then as a party of 6 we were taken to a table meant for 4.  Our waitress was not attentive and it took many requests to even fill our water.  We waited over 1.5 hours for our food. I have been to many Hard Rock locations and this one by far is the worst.

First off- this is not a review for the bar because I didn't even manage to make it in. It was a warm rainy night in Nashville with a group of 20 or so. 9 of us decided to head to the valentine to check it out. HUGE MISTAKE. As we are walking in, the first 8 managed to make it in and I was the last one walking in and I was on my phone, telling people where the location was. I held the door propped open for (no exaggeration) 5 seconds. Only to have the door pushed closed on me, forcing me out of the bar. I was confused and walked back in the door to meet up with my group. There I was greeted by one of the coolest bouncers (which is such a great career for this 30 year old) with a choke hold, picking me up off of the ground with his two bouncer butt-buddies walking me out of the bar. As this action was for no apparent reason - I began to go bizzerk, calling these two every name in the book (as they woke-heartedly deserved). The Valentine deserves these three fine gentlemen and they just as much deserve  a rewarding career in the bar bouncing industry. I will follow up this review with a call to the manager. Ruined mine and my groups night, and lost them out of money that I'm sure their owner wouldn't be proud of.

This place is great. Bands are first rate. Sound is same. Have to mention the customer friendly restrooms. No attendant wanting to splash Aqua Velva on you. And my pet peace, the door of the restrooms open out so you don't have to grab the dirty handle on the way out. Kudos

Motown Mondays at The 5 Spot in Nashville was the highlight of my entire Nashville trip! 

I know, I know... when in Nashville I am supposed to listen to the plethora of still undiscovered country singers on Broadway Ave and appreciate the lyrical geniuses strumming their acoustic tunes on songwriters nights.

But I absolutely loved my night dancing away to Motown Mondays at The 5 Spot!

The DJs had the entire club on the dance floor all night! 

What I loved the most was that the crowd was so diverse. Nobody was pretentious (like some of the other bars and clubs I went to in Nashville) and everyone only cared about having a good time.

Highly, highly recommend Motown Monday and live music nights at The Five Spot if you are looking for a good night in Music City USA!

The Hard Rock Cafe was amazing! The burger was SUPERB and the service was also very amazing! Everyone was so kind! The burger was so juicy, and full of flavor, and I love the flag that come in the burgers! 5/5

Definitely a tourist spot. However, when you're showing someone Nashville for the first time it's a must on the Broadway tour.

While we were there we took in a band who performed requests and on the spot could play and sing anything that was thrown at them.

It's a nice venue with friendly servers and decent prices for beers.
Great new bar! The rooftop is AWESOME and the venue is really cool. All of the staff and bartenders are super nice too. Solid music.

I flew in from mass and it was my first time being in Nashville and going out. We decided to start at the Hard Rock Cafe and it was the worst decision we have made so far on this trip. We sat at the bar and the bartender Lindsay was completely unprofessional and had a disgusting attitude. The way she was dress with her breasts hanging out and with an unpleasant attitude towards me and everyone I was with. She was rude to us the second we sat down saying "what do you want" not even a hi how are you or anything. Then started to complain to other customers next to us how she got 3 hours of sleep.... excuse me? How is that any of your customers problems? Completely and utterly the worst and nastiest waitress I have ever came across. We had then told her we did not like our strawberry mojitos because they were literally strawberry liquid with barely any alcohol and she continued to roll her eyes saying "what do you then instead". Not once was she pleasant at all and was a miserable wench who does not deserve to work at a nice restaurant like this. I will not be returning to this Hard Rock Cafe or any other for that matter.

There was a moment, during my meal, that the video for Prince's classic 1980s track Kiss came up on the television screens placed throughout the restaurant & many of the diners, myself included, simply stopped eating & watched, until the final notes played out.  

Music, like good food, is a communal experience & whoever it was that thought it would be a good idea to combine the two was really on to something.  While Nashville is known for country music & few songs in Prince's catalog are in the country genre, no other guitar crackles with the same dry, tart twang like his, so it's understandable that so many eyes shifted to the video when that memorable song came up in their rotation.  It's part of our musical DNA at this point.  It's familiar.

And I happen to appreciate the familiar.  I've been to Hard Rock Cafes from NYC to San Francisco & all points in between.  I've visited locations in Dublin & Paris.  I go because I enjoy the music memorabilia on the walls, sure, but I also appreciate the consistency in quality & service that I've come to expect after so many visits.  

At this location, I thought I'd try their take on a Nashville regional specialty- the "hot chicken sandwich," & I was not disappointed.  I was in a bit of a hurry with the Paul Simon concert looming, so I didn't get to take a survey of what rock & roll items were on the wall, outside of a shovel used to plant a tree in honor of Ringo's 72nd birthday (I later went & found the actual tree in a park across from the Country Music Hall of Fame), I did make a point of visiting the Rock Shop.  They have one inside the restaurant & a separate on in another building just steps away.

If you're like me & a little more rock & roll than you are country, this is a great option for lunch, dinner, drinks, or just a good time in general.  Fun & family friendly, it's always reliable.

Pretty interesting spot. Based on the crowd and decor, you'll most definitely feel like you're in the 60's, which is never a bad thing! The live music is good, and the crowd is very diverse. Drink prices are much better than downtown Nashville.

I've been to several Hard Rock cafés and though they seem the same in many ways they are different. This one has a waterfront view and of course it is in Nashville "The Music Capitol of the World" and it is exciting. They also have valet parking and it's a very reasonable price $7.00 We learned the hard way that it cost more to park in public parking. Our wait or was Nixon and he was very friendly. He not  only took the time to tell us about the Local specials he also let us in on the special taste and the one he liked best. Karla decided to order Nixon's favorite and that's a good thing. I say any Hard Rick Cafe is good but so far Nashville is the best.

Where do I begin. My family and friends decided to visit the "famous" Hard Rock Cafe today in Nashville and from the moment we sat down at the bar I was baffled by the bartender, Lindsay. From the start she was complaining, lethargic, and was dressed completely unprofessionally (her breasts were hanging out and hair was all over the place). Every word that came out of her mouth was negative and her actions were not any better. We ordered 4 strawberry mojitos and she sarcastically replied "great" rolled her eyes and told her co-worker to make them because god-forbid she had to muddle some mint. Following that moment she never came in to check in on us and we were sitting right in front of her struggling to drink this sugar cocktail. I never have sent back a drink and I was honestly afraid to tell her I didn't like the beverage. So of course as predicted she rolled her eyes and gave us a bad attitude about how she should have made the drinks and said "what do you want now." I don't know who hired this woman, but she is absolutely the WORST bartender I have ever met. We came to Nashville to have a nice get away from work and we can understand work can be stressful, but you should never bring your own problems into it. We will never be coming back to this establishment ever again.

I was a little disappointed by this place as I was ready for a delicious cocktail since it's listed as a cocktail bar and it's definitely not. The live music down stairs was a bit too loud so I enjoyed the roof top a bit more. I settled for a corona as the beer selection on the roof top is pretty minimal. You cannot go wrong though with sunshine overlooking broadway and a cold corona. I think I would have liked this place better if I had different expectations going in. Overall, I would recommend the rooftop and a beer.
Cool place, it was nice to experience a different ambiance of live music that wasn't in the downtown area during my visit. The cover charge was only 5$ and the bands that performed were great!

This is our favorite place on Broadway. 2nd time here in 24 hours! This place has a little bit of everything you could want in Nashville within its 4 floors. Great live music (of course) on the first floor-especially enjoyed Ryan Tolson last night- excellent service on all floors and totally different
 fun atmosphere and great view of Broadway with a dj on roof. Came back tonight for dinner because we saw the menu last night. And last of all, love the atmosphere/decor in here. My favorite is the huge chandelier hanging from what looks like reclaimed wood ceiling. Super cool place. Check it out

When I first moved to Nashville my girlfriend turned me on to this bar and it became my favorite place to listen to live music downtown! Shawna Hornbeck instantly became my bartender & love visiting whenever I stroll thru town!

All you need to know about this place is POOR SERVICE. Had a reservation and sat for 20 mins before getting up and asking someone to come greet us at the table and take our drink order. After another 10 mins of no service we got up and went downstairs to hostess stand thinking maybe we could sit in the main dining room instead of upstairs but the 4 employees standing at the hostess stand were so stressed out they didn't even talk to us. We left and went elsewhere. They were not even busy but the staff acted like there were people waiting around the block to get in. I will never visit again! Don't waste your time!

Right on the main strip, and a few doors down from Tootsies. Lots of good country music from talented but struggling musicians. We stopped in for a beer. This was an older crowd on this particular Monday. The strip, itself, is very touristy.

Excellent place to stay! We arrived early and were able to check in by 1230 pm. The front desk was staffed by friendly agents, who took their time with each guest and assisted with everything needed.  

The lobby, elevator, halls and rooms were immaculate and in very good condition.  There was an all-over air freshener in the lobby that smelled faintly like men's cologne - which I absolutely enjoyed!  The beds were super soft and cozy, with deep pillows and down duvets. 

The outdoor area near the pool was very relaxing, well maintained and afforded enough room with several guests while allowing for privacy.  The outdoor pool was well-maintained & clean with plenty of lounge chairs, tables and pool toys for the kids. 

The hotel arranged our ride to downtown Nashville, which was entertaining and convenient.  We ended up checking out a day early and, once again, there weren't any issues or problems. 

This will be my go-to hotel next time I visit Nashville!

Like most locals, I generally can't with Lower Broad honky tonks. They can be too much. They can really play to a tourist element (understandable). They can be unbearably crowded. They can be a lot. So, I, like most locals, avoid them... until I have friends in town. And, then I go... and try and choose the least painful option.

On my last go 'round Downtown, I found myself trying to figure out where to go on a Wednesday evening. The day of the week didn't have much effect on the crowd situation, so I turned to experience and Yelp. I wanted to go somewhere I'd never been. I also wanted to go somewhere well-reviewed. Whiskey Bent, tonight was your night.

At the risk of telling all my secrets, I tend to go straight back and upstairs when entering a Lower Broad honky tonk. Not seeing a staircase and not  recalling reading about one, I stayed put up front so as not to make an ass of myself looking for a second level that wasn't there. Even though it wasn't Sunday, there were plenty of people dancing -- mostly tourists. That said, everyone was good-natured. The bar was split between onlookers, women who knew every country line dance (and song), a group of men from Canada with a penchant for... uncomfortable bending and touching, and me & my friend. A motley crew, to be sure, but one that shows WB is open to all kinds. 

The band was fantastic. It was a four piecer with the female lead vocalist showing a vast range of musical ability and a deft hand at working the crowd. So often I get frustrated at the amount of raw talent one can hear throughout this city and who won't get their fair shot at stardom while the radio is full of no talent hacks. The entertainment business isn't fair. Back to WB: I stood at the edge of the bar, nursing a weak Jack & Coke (point deducted for that) and marveled at the ability for the band to turn on a dime. They were playing requests and went from country to rock to soul to pop. They never missed a beat.

I spend a lot of time grousing about traffic, crowds and woo-hoo girls when I go to Lower Broad. It took me spending some time at Whiskey Bent to remember that Nashville is home to really incredible musicians who ply their trade at the same bars locals (tend to) overlook. We should do better. I should do better. I'll be back to Whiskey Bent... but I'm going to want a better-made drink.

We just left the Sheraton Music city hotel,

What a nice stay even with a mixup the hotel responded beautifully and settled the issue fast. 

Gay in the lunge is the best, Love this lady as we only get through there once a year and she remembered us and what we always order.

Rachel behind the desk is exceptional in her care for the guest at check in and even after the fact, well done Rachel.

Monty McKenna was one person we never thought we would see, the Director of operations spent 20 or 30 minutes talking with us in the club lounge and even brought us bacon when we asked if there was a meat offering. His style and professionalism is amazing and made my wife and I feel like family.

I absolutely recommend staying here is you get the opportunity.

We love the hotel and the staff in Nashville, well done.

Jason Durrett

So on opening night it appears they are not ready to open. Small  things overlooked that I'm sure for the price tag they paid for this place was an oversight.  Stage is awkwardly placed,  second level has poor view of the acts. Handrails falling  apart  tables are simply  poor craftsmanship. Basically some laminate flooring as a table, very underimpressed. Knowing who backed this place I would expect way more,hopefully they put on the finishing touches over the next few weeks. First impression leaves something to be desired. On the bright side the staff they hired is super friendly,  very engaging bar tenders. They will probably do just fine once they work out some kinks
Worst place in Nashville! Go anywhere but here. Rude staff terrible service not a good Nashville experience

Stopped here on Friday night and great band was playing.  Not only did they play country music but they also play Motown classics as well as today's music.  On the rooftop, was a DJ and he played mostly rap, so you get a mix at Valentine's, which I loved. I was drinking Tito's and seltzer.  Seltzer was flat, not only did they ask me if I wanted something else, they had me try the seltzer on the other floors to make sure it wasn't flat anywhere else!!  Really nice old building and view on the rooftop is spectacular.

The most expensive bar I have ever been into.  That includes New York City and any Ritz Carlton.  Just stupidly expensive.  I was an idiot for starting a tab so I did not realize.  The location is nice.  That's about all I have to say.

This place was awesome during the day and on Friday night but was awful on Saturday night
 I was told by the locals that Michael Scott is here every Saturday night and he is the worst live music we have heard since we got here 3 days ago.  Love the bar but leaving because of the band!

Great music by both bands. We were there during happy hour so the prices were great! $3 beers and appetizer specials. Brussels sprouts were amazing! The pretzel sticks were soft and the Gouda dipping cheese was excellent!

Love this place! The bartenders were knowledgable and skilled! We went there every day for a jalapeño moonshine shot and their white lightning margaritas! It is more low-key but provided us with great entertainment and even better drinks! Keep it up Bootleggers!

the bartenders are attentive. however I can't say much else good about the place. the doorman security staff are absolutely ignorant and rude.. for example I was trying to walk upstairs one of them stood there in my way with his leg on the stairs and would not move

the band was unimpressive partly because you couldn't see them with a column standing in the way. we stayed in line about a half an hour to get into the place it really wasn't worth it.

Be careful when you go. I always keep my credit card receipts, and the bartender added an extra dollar to her tip. The copy I kept clearly has an indent from the one I signed showing the tip and final amount matching what I kept for myself. I know a dollar isn't much to fuss about, but if this is a trend that's bad business!

This location is not within walking distance of anything you will need during your stay.  The hotel staff are very friendly and always eager to please.  This location would be perfect for large scale events or venue style gatherings.  For a one night stay in Nashville I would recommend checking what is close by.

I chose this hotel for the 24hr hot tub.  This may sound strange, but given that I was going to be on the 3rd leg of a long road trip, I chose to pay double the price of the newly renovated Four Points Sheraton in order to be able to soak my road-weary joints after an evening out seeing Nashville.  
Imagine my surprise when I discovered a locked pool door since their policy (but not their website) changed 2 weeks ago.  I was back in my room at 2am to practically participate in the activities next door which were as audible as if room divides did not exist. This frisky couple was up and back at it at 8, and then thanks to the obviously lacking walls, conversations were also shared between rooms.  
When I arrived I couldn't park in a close or well-lit spot due to conference guests, but at night there is a driveway guard who checks your name to insure you are allowed to drive up (and considerably more available spots). 
The courtyard is pretty, and our breakfast server was fantastic.  
I really wish they had walls, and that they updated their website when situations like 24hr hot tub access change.

It's a fine place. Good food and good service. The prices are pretty good as well. I just don't like eating in places I can't hear my own voice. I didn't pick but it was convenient. I have been to a couple Hard Rocks, it's a nice place to check out.

We did not pass go, did not collect $200, we just went straight for the rooftop bar.
It was staying stubbornly, unseasonably warm for mid-September, and it was still 80+ degrees at 9pm.
The bourbon was hitting the spot, and the band was on fire - it was a pretty chill evening - I think it was a Wednesday - so not too packed, not too crazy, but just the right amount of fun.
There are probably "cooler" places to go, but I've no complaints about it.

I am not exaggerating when I say this was the worst dining experience I've ever experienced. I must've been there during a perfect storm, because I can't believe anyone could give this place 5 stars. It was completely mismanaged. They were out of so many foods, I thought they were joking. The food I order at every hard rock (so I know what it should look & taste like) was a joke: dried out hard chicken chunks, no sauce on my pasta... I wanted to send it back, but our waiter disappeared for 15 minutes, so it was basically cold before I could even get it fixed and start eating dinner. During those 15 minutes, my friend still hadn't gotten her NACHOS, that she'd ordered initially, and should've been out with my food. The waiter finally showed up with her nachos, but they weren't what she ordered. He said he'd fix it, but disappeared for another 20 minutes. Meanwhile, the rest of the group was done with their dinner. They finally brought out her nachos & my remade pasta, apologizing that it was because they ran out of chips. They couldn't tell her that earlier?? Offered to get her ANY other food as she sat there watching others eat? We talked with the manager afterward & got our dinner covered, but it still wasn't enough to make up for the disaster of the evening. Did I mention it was my friend's first time ever at a Hard Rock? Yeah she'll never go back to one.
Perfect Nashville Bar, good music, cold drinks.
Extremely friendly staff, prompt service, nice change of pace from other venue's in the area.
This is a really fun bar in downtown Nashville. They always have a live band and there is plenty of space to fit a lot of people on multiple levels. They also have a great deck to view the city from.

Came here with my girlfriends hoping for a fun local spot with good music and a laid back atmosphere. One bar tender in particular was unwelcoming and abrasive.  Despite attempts at being friendly each bar encounter was awkward and uncomfortable.  Between bands there was silence. No music. No dancing. No fun. Literally for one hour.  It got to a point we didn't want to give then more money or have our night be ruined. Don't bother going.

Great bar ... Great bartender, Brandon .
Great Moonshine Margaritas... My first moonshine !  The strawberry and blueberry margaritas were 80% and quite good. The white whiskey and lemonade Margarita was even better!  Then we tried the 'Apple Pie' Moon Shine Margarita...it was our favorite!
If you like HOT, the Jalapeño -Bloody Mary Margarita is for you !!
The guitar player, Randy Moore, was excellent.  He played and sang a lot of the '70's songs which we truly enjoyed. The music was very relaxing, not the usual 'too loud' music establishments often offer !

It's in a beautiful and convenient location. Smells great inside. And now the ugly! One thing I can't do and I can do a lot by the way - is bugs! Omg ! Jumping crawling flying! No! No ! No! Ashely the manager was very unprofessional and rude! Hyatt Place is so much more clean the employees are pleasant and believe it or not the food is bomb! Ashely wanted me to leave with only her word that I was being refunded then had a very condescending demeanor. Mocking me and rolling her eyes! On top of that left me waiting for 30mins to "see if she can get" the 25$ at the restaurant compd for the inconvenience. Not about the money - about honesty integrity and principles ! Gross! Scum! Stay somewhere else Kimpton or Cambria if you're on a budget Hyatt place !! By the way Andrew is grotesquely rude! After about 40mins tells me she's in a meeting.. so she decided to have a meeting when an upset dissatisfied customer is waiting for a response?! Wow! I'm really just blown away!

Great place on Broadway for great music and Shine! I love how the band is on a raised stage. Place is small and that's another reason to like it, you really feel connected to the band. Try the flavored Shine! Service is good!

The Stage is definitely one venue I would come back to enjoy good beer and great live music. When you walk in it might seem familiar as it was used as a music venue in the movie Country Strong with Gyneth Paltrow and Tim McGraw. We had a private set up upstairs with Jessica as our bartender. She was cool and even interacted with our party. Beer, well... I went old school and drank PBR all night long. The band, again, can't remember the name but was really talented and had a great female lead singer.  Coincidentally, The Stage actually had a location on 6th Street in Austin a few years back, and I learned this because I had the pleasure of meeting the owners that night. Nice people, down to Earth and totally opposite of what one would think a bar owner would be like. The Stage is definitely a bar on Broadway worth visiting when in Nashville.

I was surprised to see this hotel only has a 3 star rating on yelp.....I definitely think it was above average.  First of all, it's BEAUTIFUL. Decor and woodworking and interior design are on point. It was very clean. 

PROS:
Cleanliness
Decent beds and pillows 
Cheap shuttle to downtown 
Nice pool weather permitting
Good fitness area
Multiple elevators 
Spacious rooms

CONS:
Expensive subpar breakfast
No fan in bathroom 
Found old dog toy under the sofa....have to wonder how well they clean 
A little farther out from the city than you'd think 

I personally think the pros outweighed the cons!

Great place to people watch & rehydrate/refuel.

Service was prompt & efficient. Can't go wrong with fast food! Sit outside on a nice day or inside & watch the footy at the bar.

Went to The Stage this past weekend during a bachelor party, this place is a lot of fun.  Drink prices were actually the cheapest of the 4 or so bars we went to on Broadway.  I think I paid $4 for a bottle of Bud Light.  The live music and atmosphere here is fantastic.  I'm not sure of the band who played on Saturday (06/15), but they were fantastic and very entertaining.

Word to the wise, there was a line to get in which I thought was worth the 5 minute wait, however the inside was PACKED towards the front of the bar where the stage is within The Stage.  You will have trouble moving through the mass of people, but if you like a less crowded area head towards the back.

Great times were had, and memories were made.

After 5 years in Nashville, I finally visited Foobar! Wish I hadn't. Lame lame LAME! Maybe it was just the wrong night to be there. Saturday night in East Nashville, you'd think the place would be packed. There were people there, but not nearly as many as there would have been if it weren't for a DJ playing really loud hip-hop nonstop. It was painfully clear that the only one in the place that was remotely entertained by this mess was the DJ himself. there are places to go to hear loud hip-hop and modern R&B, but totally wrong for Foobar. We only stayed for a round, and got the hell out quickly. 

I'm certainly no hater, I love East Nashville. I love many of the bars there. Go to 3 Crow, Red Door, 5 Spot, Beyond the Edge, Battered and Fried, Family Wash, Village Pub, Rose Pepper, whatever...all of those bars get it, Foobar doesn't. Foobar blows. At least on Saturday nights it does.

My girlfriends and I visited this place on a Saturday night and it was really cool. Just like any bar on broadway on the weekend, the bar was understaffed and slow and we were packed in there like sardines, but this got better as you went up each level. There were 3-4 floors (can't remember exactly) and each one was its own bar with a different talented band. The top floor is where we spent most of our time, posted on the rooftop at a table overlooking broadway. We loved it and I would love to come back.

Make sure that when they ask you where you are from, you don't actually tell them. They are asking what bar you are coming from and if you answer wrong they won't let you in. Stupid considering no
One was in the bar.,

Having a great time, no cover,  and sodas were free for my dad who doesn't drink or they didn't charge.   The alcohol drinks are a little expensive but you have to drink whisky in TN if given the chance. Have a wide variety of liquor/whisky and a few good beers.   Wish they had a couple local drafts.

There's great fun to be had at The Stage. I love country music and don't even mind the new pop-country songs. The cover band that played the night was great--played song after popular song--and kept the energy alive. I went for my sister's bachelorette party so we got pulled on stage to sing Brown-eyed girl and that made my night! Great place to come to with a big group on friends. Not a whole lot of places to sit so wear comfy shoes--or boots to be more appropriate.

Hard Rock is actually what they call me. But that's another story for another day.

Or rather, another night.

I originally gave them a bad review, not for service or product, but for commercializing the area to this degree, in a chain way rather than a local way. However the manager of this location is so friendly and understanding and felt so bad about my review, that she reached out to me and I realized that for customer service skills alone, they deserved a better star rating.

The Hard Rock Cafe is a little bit plastic (and not in a good way) compared to the rest of Nashville, which is much less fake, in a weird way despite its touristiness.

It's a full city block at the end of Lower Broadway basically, but I don't have anything against it.

I'm happy that HRC is on Broadway and I appreciate how friendly the people in charge are. However, I hope that no other massive chains take over and "gentrify" another city block of Lower Broadway, because there's really nowhere like Broadway in the country - and hardly even in the world, and the last thing you want is for casinos and Trump Towers and Hard Rock Cafes and MGM Grands to start buying up the land and taking over it and turning into Disney volume 227. Like they did with Times Square. And so many other places.

But I know that will happen. That's life.

Oh. And some of the waitresses here are so gorgeous, it's almost painful. (Swoon)

This place has a pretty cool vibe. Jenny was super nice. She was attentive, knowledgeable and friendly. 

The space could fill up fast on a busy night. They offer a cool Western decor. Dive bar feel. They have a bar that sits about 10 ppl and a few top tables and each have 4 stools. They have a couple of TVs by the bar and a small stage where they offer live music.

They don't have beer on tab but they do have a variety of bottles to choose from. They have different flavors of moonshine and liquors. 

Definitely come check them out and try some of the moonshine shots. Perfect if you want to feel like a local while you're out of town.

I somehow remember enjoying this place more before I lived here. It's really close to our house so I'm sure we'll be back. It's just really smoky inside and I'm not into dry cleaning my winter coat because "let's just go have A beer" when I can have multiple beers at my smoke-free house with no dry cleaning bill.

When this place advertises to close at 4 am, don't believe it. Walk in the door, "we're kicking everyone out! Y'all need to leave!" While there's 30 ppl standing in the bar. They wouldn't even let us stand inside to call another uber while it was 20 degrees outside.. #notafan

Great live music, bartenders were attentive.  Small venue but awesome. No food which is fine. We went on a Friday night before NYE and the place was busy but not too packed.  Had the apple pie moonshine and loved it.

This place looks pretty average from the outside, but the inside is enormous and beautiful. I ordered the fiesta burger, and it was wonderful. It was cooked exactly how I ordered it. The fries taste good, and even better when you dip them in the cup of sauce that is provided. This place is a little bit pricy, but is worth it.

Perfect for my wife and I. Downstairs was busy so the lady on the door sent us upstairs which was a stroke of luck really. Only a few tables of people upstairs and some live music. Had a great burger with just the right amount of fries. Music was great and the guy singing had a good banter going with the crowd. Really enjoyed the whole experience and that was my first ever visit to a Hard Rock.

Nice presentation of the food but the food it self wasn't that great. I ordered a chicken sandwich and the chicken was hard as a rock. My first thought was "is there something in my food" but no it was the chicken. How am I supposed to enjoy this when I can't even eat it! My waiter was overall nice but the person who seated me wasn't as friendly. 

Glad my fries were okay it's something that always I could eat but I don't think this is a place I'll visit again.

Staff is less than accommodating.  Didn't have our reservation.  Then questioned our reservation before admitting that they made the mistake.  They have no official transportation to downtown.  I would not recommend staying here!
Great selection of beer!  Good choice off liquors.  Great music!  Go and try out Bootleggers!  It is convenient to the riverfront and on Broadway.

I think we came here everyday. Both in the afternoon and at night, and the stage did not fail us. 

If you're hoping to be impressed by some live music, come to the Stage! We even heard an electric violinist and she was truly the cherry on top.  

people in the front are always starting a dance party and on the back you'll have the chance the sit down and relax. Either way, you will love this place!

My partner and I had came here randomly walking around five points and was not disappointed. We had a chance to see local funk group called Funk Good Time which was absolutely amazing. They really know how to pump the crowd up. In addition the crowd was quite diverse with all ages and ethnicities. I had an amazing time there and would definitely go back. At the time when I went I had to pay cover but regardless I would recommend

5 stars for what it is. The drinks were reasonably priced. The local resident bands were not bad. What made this bar was the rooftop patio/bar. It overlooked downtown and was a great spot to relax, drink, listen to local music and have a good time.

This bar is great b/c it isn't one of the main attractions do you aren't packed in like sardines! However because it isn't a main bar, the music may not always be top notch. The last band I saw in there played Pearl Jam so they were a winner in my book!

We discovered this bar several years ago during a girls' trip and have gone back during each subsequent trip. In fact in this last trip, we went back both nights we were in town!

This is where I was introduced to Oatmeal Cookie Moonshine and my life will never be the same! It is delicious over ice and goes down way too easy. My friend loves the Bloody Mary with Jalapeño Moonshine!

Went here for lunch for a low key option (compared to the craziness of some of the other local spots). I ordered the Veggie Panini with Jalapeño honey tator tots and really wish I could eat that meal every day. The atmosphere was nice and laid back. Just as most in the area, they had live music but this was a one man band. He was another great addition to the Nashville vibe!
This place was packed liked it was was New Years Eve when we stopped by. Finally found some room at one of the bars. The music was ok, not great, not bad.

I used to love this place, but the craftsmanship on the outdoor bar is a total disaster...uneven cuts on the lumber?! How can I trust these people to make my drink correctly?!
I doubt I'll ever come here again until my gig next Tuesday

Love this little bar. They had a really good singer to listen to while we were enjoying a bloody Mary. Also have a wide selection of moonshine, loved having oatmeal cookie on the rocks it was great! Friendly staff, just a small hole in the wall but we loved it

Looking for some of that good 'ole Honky Tonk in the heart of Nashville??? Look no further, you've found your place! Always lively, lots of energy, locals and transients alike are here. Bartenders are hot and sexy too. There's security just in case someone consumes too much Fireball and gets out of hand, but everyone here is pretty friendly so it's unlikely that would happen.

The live music is a great, and they play a wide range of old and new. This is a MUST visit, even if you don't drink, that's okay. You have to visit this place when you're in Nashville!!! Seating around the sides and in the back, and an upfront dance floor for the more adventurous.

I went there on Dec27,2019 Friday
I ordered drinks  and they kept my Visa card
When I went home I forgot my Visa card
The next day I check my charges
And I was going to go pick my card up
Someone from The bar charged over $800 at the mall and I had to cancel my visa I see now why they want to keep your visa card
Lesson learned never ever let them keep your visa card pay as you go or pay cash I did call the establishment about it but they never called me back yet about this theft

I was leaving Monday night and stopped at the bathroom as they were closing... apparently the female employee working the door propped it open to announce that I was "throwing up" and males and females alike were going by while I was peeing in the stall right next to them and i was oblivious about everything going on. I have no plans to go back to this an establishment that condones an employee holding the door open while a patron is using the restroom
Worth the burn on your legs from climbing all the stairs to get to the top!  Amazing patio, music & fast service for how crowded it was. Definitely will be back again on our next trip to Nashville!

As previous reviews state, this is a chain restaurant so you will get the chain food with the chain service. Way over priced, lack in flavor, & poor customer service. This location was no different than the other chains. You're left on your own to find parking in the street. Good luck! If you want the chain restaurant experience, that's all it is.

If it were not for the employee's it would be 1 star.. anything and everything LITTLE thing went wrong.. be prepared to walk a good distance to your room, unless you're a special guest to be nearer to elevator.. I had no ideal when I ask not to be near elevator how far it would be.. just a weird stay.. I found dirty ashtray full on patio..digital scale in my coffee maker, yeap.. hot frig.. lack of ac.. moved to different room, .. 4:30 am.. 2nd room .. non working guide on tv remote.. frig too cold froze my fruit.. makeup mirror lite not working.. got locked out keys not working.. SHEETS HORRIBLE..
Restaurant food sucks..  raw hash browns.. greasy omelette.. bread cold not toasted..
AND THEY EXPECT YOU TO  PAY AND BE HAPPY..
I WENT TO NASHVILLE FOR FUN NOT TO COMPLAIN.. 
THESE HOTELS SHOULD HAVE AN UNDERCOVER GUEST TO SEE FOR THEM SELF'S.. 
LOOKS GOOD BUT .. HORRIBLE.. OVERALL..
THIS HOTEL IS GEARED FOR THE CORPORATE TRAVELERS SUCH AS WORKING EMPLOYEES OF AIRLINES..
I WOULD NOT CALL THIS A RESORT!!!!

Terrible Service!
The only reason why we went in there was because I was walking around broadway with kids and none of the places would allow them in, except here. 
The place has 2 floors and we were told they had live music on the top floor so we asked the hostess to give us a table there. She said we had to wait 20 minutes. 
When the 20 minutes passed, We went up and the place was empty! She didn't even walk up with us but rather told us we could go up now, so we didn't get a table assignment. There was a band playing and a couple of tables with customers. The Batman didn't even notice us, and I tried going up to him to ask where we could sit but he didn't even acknowledge I was there. 
We decided to sit outside on the terrace. The waitress came over and took our order. It took her 10 minutes to bring the drinks out which were a lemonade and waters. Another 10 or 15 minutes went by and we asked if the food was going to take much longer because the kids were very hangry by now. She said the kitchen was swamped but was going to check. We had to ask another waiter about our food and our waitress because she never returned. He said he was going to check on the food, but we told him to come back, we didn't want to lose another server. When he returned he said he didn't know how long it was going to take, that he couldn't find out. At this point, we decided to leave the place. We wasted close to an hour just waiting in this place. They need more servers, kitchen staff, I don't know why else but it is not acceptable to wait for food and for a table at an empty restaurant that long!
Only reason I don't give it a 1 star is the location and the fact that they accept kids
Whenever we come into town we eat here! We love the staff, food and environment. Its a great place with good music.
SAD! The failing hard rock cafe took over an hour to bring appetizers. Then the $20 chicken tenders took another 45 minutes. Wouldn't recommend.

Started out with a great band, great music until 10pm then these punk ass kids show up ( a supposed band)  waited for 45 mins while these jackasses set up.  I had a gut feeling it wasn't going to go well.  This is NASHVILLE !!!!   Not senior prom.   Anyway they started singing bouncing around the stage and acting like they were some famous wanna be boy band.   Who the F*+# is Jerry Jacobs?   He isn't country !   Not the country I've heard. My whole like.  Damn I'm getting old .....My kids can sing better than this idiot !!!!   Finished my drink and left.  They ruined my experience tonight !!!   The Stage hired some talentless morons that sang crap!!!!
Like I mentioned the 1st group we could have stayed listening to them all night , but cocky wanna be talentless think their hot shit punks don't belong in this venue.  So many better bands we saw tonight.  Anyway,  they should go to LA and find their fame along Hollywood Blvd where they are better suited.  This was not country !    Oh
Well,   Hopefully they see this post and try singing lessons. If you see skinny jeans and punk hairdos and unwarranted attitude ......walk away.   Lol

This hotel offers airport parking that I've purchased several times. Each time it's complete chaos. They advertise a shuttle to/from your car, however, they sometimes will flat out refuse to take you to your car. The long-term parking lot is about a 1/4mile walk. Being forced to walk a 1/4mile downhill with luggage while wearing heels in 30 degree weather after flying on a redeye all night is absolutely absurd. 
If the hotel doesn't intend to offer a shuttle service to customers vehicles, perhaps they shouldn't ADVERTISE the shuttle! 
Parking here is just chaotic. You have to pull your car up to the valet attendant each time, as opposed to going straight to park like every other parking facility. Then you have to drive down to the long term lot and wait for a shuttle driver to come pick you up in no designated spot. And most of the time the driver never bothers to show up.
